words.zh: a. 易受傷害的, 有弱點的, 易受影響的, 脆弱的, 成局的；[醫] 易損的
words.example: Newborns are especially vulnerable to infection because their immune systems are immature.
words.example_zh: 新生兒因免疫系統尚未成熟，特別容易受到感染。

words.zh: n. 屬下, 附屬物；a. 下級的, 次要的, 附屬的；vt. 使居下位, 使服從
words.example: A good leader treats subordinate staff with the same respect as senior colleagues.
words.example_zh: 好的領導者對下屬與資深同事一視同仁地尊重。

words.zh: a. 有害的, 致命的, 惡劣的, 險惡的；[醫] 惡性的
words.example: Smoking has a pernicious effect on nearly every organ in the body.
words.example_zh: 吸菸對身體幾乎每個器官都有有害的影響。

words.zh: n. 釋放, 發洩, 豁免, 發行, 釋放證書；vt. 釋放, 解除, 放鬆, 豁免, 免除, 釋出, 放棄, 讓與；n. 釋出；[計] 版本, 釋出
words.example: The gland releases hormones directly into the bloodstream.
words.example_zh: 腺體將荷爾蒙直接釋放進血液中。

words.zh: n. 精神, 心靈, 靈魂, 態度, 志氣, 人格, 情緒, 心情, 烈酒；vt. 誘拐, 鼓勵, 鼓舞
words.example: The team showed great fighting spirit despite the setback.
words.example_zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，團隊仍展現了高昂的奮鬥精神。

words.zh: a. 內在的, 國內的；[醫] 內的, 內部的
words.example: The company launched an internal investigation into the leak.
words.example_zh: 公司針對洩密展開了內部調查。

words.zh: n. 外部, 外面；a. 外部的, 客觀的, 表面的
words.example: The wound healed, but an external scar remained.
words.example_zh: 傷口癒合了，但外部留下了疤痕。

words.zh: a. 有資格的；給與名稱的
words.example: Full-time employees are entitled to paid annual leave.
words.example_zh: 全職員工有資格享有帶薪年假。

words.zh: n. 制服；a. 統一的, 一律的, 始終如一的
words.example: The samples were kept at a uniform temperature throughout the test.
words.example_zh: 整個實驗過程中，樣本都維持在一致的溫度。

words.zh: a. 樂觀的, 樂觀主義的, 樂天的
words.example: Doctors are optimistic that she will make a full recovery.
words.example_zh: 醫生樂觀地認為她會完全康復。

words.zh: a. 免疫的, 免除的, 不受影響的；n. 免疫者
words.example: Once you have had the disease, you may be immune to it for life.
words.example_zh: 一旦得過這種病，你可能終生對它免疫。

words.zh: n. 改革論者, 進步論者；a. 前進的, 累進的, 進步的
words.example: The disease causes a progressive loss of memory.
words.example_zh: 這種疾病會造成漸進性的記憶喪失。

words.zh: a. 命令的, 託管的；[經] 受託者, 命令者
words.example: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory for all passengers.
words.example_zh: 所有乘客都必須強制繫安全帶。

words.zh: a. 完全跟據經驗的, 經驗主義的；[醫] 經驗主義的
words.example: Their conclusion is backed by empirical evidence from years of experiments.
words.example_zh: 他們的結論有多年實驗的實證證據支持。

words.zh: n. 原始人, 早期藝術家；a. 原始的, 上古的；[計] 圖元; 原語; 基元
words.example: Primitive tools made of stone have been found at the site.
words.example_zh: 遺址出土了以石頭製成的原始工具。

words.zh: n. 缺乏, 不足；[醫] 缺乏, 不足
words.example: A deficiency of vitamin D can lead to weakened bones.
words.example_zh: 維生素 D 缺乏可能導致骨骼變弱。

words.zh: vt. 使模糊, 弄髒；vi. 弄髒, 模糊
words.example: Tears blurred her vision as she read the letter.
words.example_zh: 讀信時，淚水模糊了她的視線。

words.zh: a. 有利益的, 獲利的, 合算的
words.example: Cosmetic surgery can be a highly lucrative specialty.
words.example_zh: 整形外科可以是利潤很高的專科。

words.zh: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束縛；[法] 抑制, 遏制, 制止
words.example: She could barely restrain her anger during the meeting.
words.example_zh: 會議中她幾乎無法抑制自己的怒氣。

words.zh: a. 豐富的, 富裕的；n. 支流, 富人
words.example: She grew up in an affluent neighborhood where every house had a pool.
words.example_zh: 她在一個富裕的社區長大，家家戶戶都有泳池。

words.zh: n. 試驗；a. 試驗性的, 暫時的
words.example: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.example_zh: 我們暫定下週見面。

words.zh: vt. 危害, 使受危困, 使陷危地
words.example: One careless mistake could jeopardize the entire mission.
words.example_zh: 一個粗心的錯誤可能危及整個任務。

words.zh: a. 無所不在的, 到處存在的, 普遍存在的
words.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
words.example_zh: 智慧型手機在現代生活中已無所不在。

words.zh: a. 漠不關心的, 無重要性的, 中立的；[醫] 中性的, 無作用的, 無親和力的, 淡漠的
words.example: She remained indifferent to the criticism and continued her work.
words.example_zh: 她對批評漠不關心，繼續做她的工作。

words.zh: a. 好爭吵的, 愛爭論的, 有異議的；[法] 訴訟的, 爭執的, 引起爭論的
words.example: Funding for the project remains a contentious issue in the committee.
words.example_zh: 該計畫的經費在委員會中仍是個有爭議的議題。

words.zh: n. 不可缺少之物；a. 不可缺少的, 責無旁貸的, 絕對必要的
words.example: Clean water is indispensable to public health.
words.example_zh: 乾淨的水對公共衛生不可或缺。

words.zh: a. 一絲不苟的, 精確的, 過細的
words.example: The surgeon is meticulous about sterilizing every instrument.
words.example_zh: 這位外科醫師對每件器械的消毒都一絲不苟。

words.zh: a. 觸染性的, 會蔓延的；[醫] (接)觸(傳)染的
words.example: Measles is highly contagious and spreads through the air.
words.example_zh: 麻疹傳染性極強，會透過空氣傳播。

words.zh: a. 有責任心的, 負責的, 本著良心的；[法] 憑良心做的, 有道德感的
words.example: A conscientious student reviews her notes the same day she takes them.
words.example_zh: 盡責的學生當天就會複習當天的筆記。

words.zh: vt. 做(惡), 犯(罪), 胡說, 惡劣地做；[法] 犯, 作, 行
words.example: The hackers perpetrated the fraud from another country.
words.example_zh: 駭客從另一個國家犯下這起詐騙。

words.zh: a. 膨脹的, 充了氣的, 誇張的, 通貨膨脹的
words.example: The report gave an inflated estimate of the project's benefits.
words.example_zh: 該報告對計畫效益給出了誇大的估計。

words.zh: n. 無感情, 無興趣, 冷漠；[醫] 無情[感], 淡漠
words.example: Voter apathy led to the lowest turnout in the country's history.
words.example_zh: 選民的冷漠造成該國史上最低的投票率。

words.zh: a. 劇毒的, 致命的, 刻毒的, 惡毒的, 惡性的, 有病毒的, 過強的；[醫] 有毒力的, 毒性的
words.example: A virulent strain of the virus spread rapidly through the ward.
words.example_zh: 一種劇毒的病毒株在病房中迅速傳播。

words.zh: a. 頭腦精明的, 賢明的, 判斷正確的
words.example: A judicious use of resources kept the clinic running through the crisis.
words.example_zh: 明智地運用資源，讓診所撐過了危機。

words.zh: a. 體貼的, 體諒的, 考慮周到的
words.example: It was considerate of you to call before visiting.
words.example_zh: 你來訪前先打電話，真是體貼。

words.zh: a. 第三的, 第三位的, 第三產業的；n. 第三修道會會員, 第三紀；第三的; 三代的(指無機鹽)
words.example: Tertiary education includes universities and colleges.
words.example_zh: 高等教育包含大學與學院。

words.zh: a. 易受騙的；[法] 易受騙的, 輕信的
words.example: He was gullible enough to believe the email promising him a fortune.
words.example_zh: 他輕信到相信那封承諾給他財富的電子郵件。

words.zh: a. 吉兆的, 幸運的
words.example: The clear sky was an auspicious start to their wedding day.
words.example_zh: 晴朗的天空為他們的婚禮揭開了吉祥的序幕。

words.zh: a. 裝飾表面的, 鋪張的, 誇示的, 華美的, 顯眼的
words.example: He drove an ostentatious sports car to impress his clients.
words.example_zh: 他開著一輛炫耀的跑車來打動客戶。

words.zh: 喝醉的,極其興奮的
words.example: He was intoxicated and could not drive home safely.
words.example_zh: 他喝醉了，無法安全開車回家。

words.zh: a. 寬敞的, 方便的
words.example: The hotel suite was commodious enough for the whole family.
words.example_zh: 這間飯店套房寬敞到足以容納全家人。

words.zh: a. 沒有錢的, 身無分文的, 貧窮的
words.example: As an impecunious student, he survived on instant noodles.
words.example_zh: 身為一個身無分文的學生，他靠泡麵度日。

words.zh: a. [法]取消的；v. 撤銷, 取消, 廢除( revoke的過去式和過去分詞 )
words.example: His medical license was revoked after the scandal.
words.example_zh: 醜聞之後，他的醫師執照被撤銷。

words.zh: v. 減輕（alleviate的過去分詞）；使…緩和
words.example: The new medication alleviated her chronic back pain within days.
words.example_zh: 新藥在幾天內就減輕了她的慢性背痛。

words.zh: vt. 積聚, 積累
words.example: Over decades he amassed a vast collection of rare medical texts.
words.example_zh: 數十年間他累積了大量珍稀的醫學典籍。

words.zh: n. 高度, 高處；a. 高的, 高階的, 主要的, 高尚的, 高原的, 高音的, 昂貴的, 傲慢的；adv. 高度地, 奢侈地
words.example: The patient's fever stayed dangerously high all night.
words.example_zh: 病人的高燒整晚都居高不下，相當危險。

words.zh: n. 數, 數字, 數目, 號碼；vt. 數, 計算, 共計；vi. 計算, 報數；[計] 數字
words.example: A large number of patients reported the same side effect.
words.example_zh: 大量病患回報了同樣的副作用。

words.zh: vt. 帶來, 產生, 促使, 提出；vi. 生產
words.example: Please bring your medical records to the appointment.
words.example_zh: 請把你的病歷帶到看診時。

words.zh: prep. 直到, 在...以前；conj. 直到...時, 在...以前
words.example: The pharmacy stays open until midnight on weekdays.
words.example_zh: 這家藥局平日營業到午夜。

words.zh: prep. 包含, 包括；[經] 包括, 算入
words.example: The course covers several systems, including the heart and lungs.
words.example_zh: 這門課涵蓋多個系統，包括心臟與肺臟。

words.zh: n. 上升, 高地, 增高；vt. 升起, 舉起, 喚起, 提高, 使出現, 使復活, 提出, 籌集, 飼養
words.example: Regular exercise can raise your level of good cholesterol.
words.example_zh: 規律運動能提高你體內好膽固醇的含量。

words.zh: adv. 平行地, 向前；prep. 沿著
words.example: We walked along the river until we reached the clinic.
words.example_zh: 我們沿著河走，直到抵達診所。

words.zh: n. 光, 光亮, 燈, 日光, 發光體, 光源, 傑出人物, 火花, 眼光；a. 輕的, 少量的, 輕微的, 輕快的, 輕浮的, 明亮的, 淡色的, 容易的；vt. 點燃, 照亮
words.example: The nurse dimmed the light so the patient could rest.
words.example_zh: 護理師把燈光調暗，好讓病人休息。

words.zh: n. 位置, 空間, 距離, 太空, 空白, 間隔, (期刊等的)篇幅；vt. 隔開, 分隔；vi. 留間隔；[計] 空白, 空格校驗
words.example: There was barely enough space in the ward for another bed.
words.example_zh: 病房裡幾乎沒有空間再擺一張床。

words.zh: n. 精力, 精神, 活力, 能量；[化] 能; 能量
words.example: After the illness, she slowly regained her energy.
words.example_zh: 病後，她慢慢恢復了體力。

words.zh: vt. 包括, 使陷於, 潛心於, 包圍；[醫] 累及, 牽涉, 包含
words.example: The surgery will involve a long recovery period.
words.example_zh: 這項手術會牽涉到一段漫長的恢復期。

words.zh: a. 重要的, 有效的, 有含義的, 暗示的, 值得注意的
words.example: The trial showed a significant improvement in survival rates.
words.example_zh: 該試驗顯示存活率有顯著的改善。

words.zh: n. 能力, 才幹；[經] 能力, 才能
words.example: Years of training gave her the ability to diagnose rare diseases.
words.example_zh: 多年的訓練讓她具備診斷罕見疾病的能力。

words.zh: adv. 寧可, 稍微, 相當
words.example: I would rather take the stairs than wait for the elevator.
words.example_zh: 我寧可走樓梯，也不要等電梯。

words.zh: vt. 包含, 容納, 控制；vi. 自制
words.example: This supplement is said to contain several essential vitamins.
words.example_zh: 據說這款保健品含有多種必需維生素。

words.zh: n. 尺寸, 量度器, 量度標準, 測量, 量具, 程度, 範圍, 限度, 分寸, 措施, 方法；vt. 測量, 測度, 估量, 權衡, 調節, 拿(自己或自己的力量等)作較量；v
words.example: The government introduced a new measure to control the outbreak.
words.example_zh: 政府推出了一項新措施來控制疫情。

words.zh: vt. 影響, 感動, 假裝, 模仿, 愛好, 傾向於；n. 自覺感情
words.example: Lack of sleep can seriously affect your concentration.
words.example_zh: 睡眠不足會嚴重影響你的專注力。

words.zh: n. 方法, 手段, 工具, 財產, 收入；[經] 方法, 手段, 工具; 意謂
words.example: Vaccination is an effective means of preventing the disease.
words.example_zh: 接種疫苗是預防這種疾病的有效方法。

words.zh: n. 投資；[醫] 包埋料, 圍模料, 包埋法, 圍模法
words.example: Good health is the best investment you can make.
words.example_zh: 健康是你能做的最好投資。

words.zh: n. 身份, 相同, 一致, 特性, 恆等式；[計] (打)標記, 標識
words.example: The hospital protects the identity of every donor.
words.example_zh: 醫院保護每一位捐贈者的身分。

words.zh: adv. 逐漸地, 漸增地
words.example: Doctors are increasingly worried about antibiotic resistance.
words.example_zh: 醫生對抗生素抗藥性越來越擔憂。

words.zh: n. 內容, 滿足, 意義, 要旨；a. 滿足的, 滿意的；vt. 使...滿足, 使...安心；[計] 內容
words.example: He was perfectly content to recover quietly at home.
words.example_zh: 他很滿足於在家靜靜養病。

words.zh: n. 懇求, 訴請, 上訴, 吸引力；vi. 呼籲, 訴請, 要求, 上訴, 有吸引力；vt. 將...上訴
words.example: The charity made an urgent appeal for blood donors.
words.example_zh: 該慈善機構緊急呼籲民眾捐血。

words.zh: adv. 特定地, 明確地, 按特性
words.example: This drug was designed specifically to target cancer cells.
words.example_zh: 這種藥物是專門設計來鎖定癌細胞的。

words.zh: n. 兩者擇一, 供替代的選擇；a. 兩者擇一的, 供選擇的；[計] 選擇物件
words.example: When surgery failed, they looked for an alternative treatment.
words.example_zh: 手術失敗後，他們尋求替代療法。

words.zh: vt. 保護, 保持, 儲存, 維持, 醃, 禁獵；vi. 加工食品, 禁獵；n. 加工成的食品, 禁獵地, 保護區, 防護物
words.example: Salt has long been used to preserve food.
words.example_zh: 鹽長久以來被用來保存食物。

words.zh: n. 姿勢, 姿態, 裝模作樣, 偽裝；vi. 擺姿勢, 裝模作樣, 假裝；vt. 使擺好姿勢, 提出, 造成
words.example: Untreated high blood pressure can pose a serious risk.
words.example_zh: 未經治療的高血壓可能構成嚴重風險。

words.zh: adv. 很少地, 罕有地
words.example: This complication rarely occurs in healthy adults.
words.example_zh: 這種併發症在健康成人身上很少發生。

words.zh: n. 工具, 器具, 手段；vt. 實現, 使生效, 執行
words.example: The hospital will implement the new safety rules next month.
words.example_zh: 醫院下個月將實施新的安全規定。

words.zh: n. 解釋, 演出, 翻譯；[計] 插值; 插值法; 解釋
words.example: Two doctors gave different interpretations of the X-ray.
words.example_zh: 兩位醫師對這張 X 光片有不同的解讀。

words.zh: a. 不像的, 不同的；prep. 不像, 和...不同
words.example: Unlike his brother, he has never been allergic to pollen.
words.example_zh: 不像他哥哥，他從未對花粉過敏。

words.zh: vt. 回覆, 恢復, 歸還, 修補, 修復；vt. 還原；vi. 還原；[計] 還原; DOS外部命令:從備份盤中取回檔案
words.example: Physical therapy helped restore movement to her injured arm.
words.example_zh: 物理治療幫助她受傷的手臂恢復了活動能力。

words.zh: n. 提倡者, 擁護者；vt. 主張, 提倡
words.example: She is a tireless advocate for patients' rights.
words.example_zh: 她是病人權益不知疲倦的倡導者。

words.zh: n. 傳染, 影響, 傳染病；[醫] 傳染, 感染
words.example: The wound became red and swollen from an infection.
words.example_zh: 傷口因感染而紅腫。

words.zh: vi. 繼續進行, 進行, 開始, 發出, 起訴；[法] 所得, 收入, 收益
words.example: Once the test results are normal, we can proceed with surgery.
words.example_zh: 一旦檢查結果正常，我們就能進行手術。

words.zh: vt. 保持, 保有, 留住, 記得, 付定金聘請；[經] 保留, 留存
words.example: The body struggles to retain water in hot weather.
words.example_zh: 天氣炎熱時，身體難以保住水分。

words.zh: n. 擴充, 開展, 膨脹；[計] 擴充套件
words.example: The clinic announced a major expansion of its services.
words.example_zh: 診所宣布大幅擴充服務項目。

words.zh: vt. 解散, 開除, 解職；vi. 解散；[計] 解散
words.example: Don't dismiss the symptom as simple tiredness.
words.example_zh: 別把這個症狀當成單純的疲倦而不予理會。

words.zh: a. 廣的, 廣泛的, 多方面的；[經] 廣大的, 擴大的
words.example: The patient required extensive treatment after the accident.
words.example_zh: 那名病人在意外後需要大量的治療。

words.zh: n. 發射, 放任, 放縱；a. 寬鬆的, 松的, 寬的, 不牢固的, 散漫的, 自由的, 不精確的；vt. 釋放, 放槍, 開船；vi. 變鬆, 開火；adv. 鬆散地
words.example: One of the screws in the device had come loose.
words.example_zh: 裝置裡有一顆螺絲鬆掉了。

words.zh: n. 維護, 保持, 維修, 生活費用, 堅持, 扶養；[計] 維護; 維修
words.example: Regular maintenance keeps the equipment working safely.
words.example_zh: 定期保養能讓設備安全運作。

words.zh: a. 謙遜的, 羞怯的, 端莊的, 適度的；[經] 適當的
words.example: The new drug brought only a modest improvement.
words.example_zh: 這款新藥只帶來了適度的改善。

words.zh: n. 依賴他人者；a. 依賴的, 從屬的
words.example: After the stroke he became dependent on his family.
words.example_zh: 中風後，他變得依賴家人。

words.zh: vt. 管理, 控制, 調節, 調整, 校準；[經] 控制, 管理
words.example: The kidneys help regulate the level of salt in the blood.
words.example_zh: 腎臟有助於調節血液中的鹽分濃度。

words.zh: n. 診斷；[計] 診斷
words.example: An early diagnosis greatly improves the chance of recovery.
words.example_zh: 早期診斷能大幅提高康復的機會。

words.zh: n. 基礎結構, 基礎設施；[經] 基礎設施
words.example: Rural areas often lack basic medical infrastructure.
words.example_zh: 偏鄉地區往往缺乏基本的醫療基礎設施。

words.zh: n. 觸發器, 扳機；vt. 觸發, 發射, 引起；vi. 鬆開扳柄；[計] 切換開關
words.example: Certain foods can trigger a severe allergic reaction.
words.example_zh: 某些食物會引發嚴重的過敏反應。

words.zh: a. 實際上起作用的, 虛的, 實質的, 有效的, 事實上生效的；[計] 虛擬
words.example: The two drugs are virtual equals in effectiveness.
words.example_zh: 這兩種藥在療效上幾乎相當。

words.zh: n. 大混亂, 混沌；[化] 混沌; 渾沌
words.example: The emergency room descended into chaos after the crash.
words.example_zh: 車禍後，急診室陷入一片混亂。

words.zh: n. 補償, 賠償金, 工資；[醫] 代償(機能), 補償
words.example: The heart enlarges as a compensation for the damaged valve.
words.example_zh: 心臟擴大，作為對受損瓣膜的代償。

words.zh: n. 諾言, 約會, 婚約, 交戰；[醫] 銜接
words.example: Their engagement was announced at the family dinner.
words.example_zh: 他們的婚約在家庭聚餐上宣布。

words.zh: n. 光譜, 範圍, 系列；[化] 光譜
words.example: Autism covers a wide spectrum of symptoms.
words.example_zh: 自閉症涵蓋了範圍很廣的症狀。

words.zh: a. 偶然的, 不經意的, 便裝的；n. 臨時工, 待命士兵
words.example: He gave only a casual glance at the report.
words.example_zh: 他只是隨意地瞄了一眼報告。

words.zh: n. 責任, 債務, 傾向；[經] 責任, 義務, 負債
words.example: Failing to warn patients can be a legal liability.
words.example_zh: 未能警告病人可能構成法律責任。

words.zh: a. 敵人的, 懷敵意的, 敵對的；n. 敵對分子
words.example: The new employee faced a hostile reception from the team.
words.example_zh: 新員工受到團隊充滿敵意的對待。

words.zh: a. 反對的, 敵對的, 對抗的, 相對的；[機] 反對的, 相反的, 對立的
words.example: Many residents are strongly opposed to closing the clinic.
words.example_zh: 許多居民強烈反對關閉這間診所。

words.zh: n. 中立者, 中立國, 非彩色, 空檔；a. 中立的, 中性的, 無色的
words.example: Keep the solution at a neutral pH before the test.
words.example_zh: 實驗前讓溶液維持在中性的酸鹼值。

words.zh: n. 感激, 賞識, 鑑別；[經] 漲價, 增值
words.example: She wrote a card to show her appreciation to the nurses.
words.example_zh: 她寫了張卡片，向護理師們表達感激。

words.zh: a. 收養的, 養育的；vt. 養育, 撫育, 培養, 鼓勵, 抱(希望)
words.example: Good teachers foster a love of learning in their students.
words.example_zh: 好老師會在學生心中培養對學習的熱愛。

words.zh: adv. 故意地
words.example: He deliberately skipped his medication to see what would happen.
words.example_zh: 他故意漏服藥物，想看看會發生什麼事。

words.zh: a. 可疑的, 多疑的, 懷疑的；[法] 懷疑的, 令人懷疑的, 可疑的
words.example: The doctor was suspicious of the lump and ordered a scan.
words.example_zh: 醫生對那個腫塊起了疑心，安排了掃描。

words.zh: vi. 粘緊, 附著, 緊貼, 堅持
words.example: A frightened child will often cling to a parent.
words.example_zh: 受驚的孩子常會緊緊抓住父母。

words.zh: a. 有資格當選的, 合格的；n. 有資格者, 合格者, 適任者
words.example: Only patients over sixty-five are eligible for the free vaccine.
words.example_zh: 只有六十五歲以上的病人才有資格接種免費疫苗。

words.zh: a. 精細的, 詳盡的, 精心計劃(或製作)的；vt. 詳細地說明, 用心地製作, 發揮；vi. 變複雜, 作詳細說明
words.example: The surgeon explained the procedure in elaborate detail.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生鉅細靡遺地說明了手術過程。

words.zh: n. 必死的命運, 死亡數目, 死亡率；[醫] 必死性, 死亡率
words.example: The new treatment cut the mortality rate in half.
words.example_zh: 新療法將死亡率降低了一半。

words.zh: a. 毀滅性的, (非正式)很好的, 引人注目的
words.example: The diagnosis was devastating news for the whole family.
words.example_zh: 這個診斷對全家來說是毀滅性的消息。

words.zh: n. 冒險, 危險, 機會；vt. 冒...的危險, 賭運氣, 使冒危險；[計] 相關危險; 冒險
words.example: Loose wires on the floor are a serious safety hazard.
words.example_zh: 地上鬆脫的電線是嚴重的安全危害。

words.zh: vt. 娛樂, 招待, 懷抱；vi. 款待
words.example: Clowns visit the ward to entertain the sick children.
words.example_zh: 小丑會到病房逗生病的孩子們開心。

words.zh: a. 加強的, 內涵的, 集中的；n. 加強器
words.example: After the surgery she spent a week in intensive care.
words.example_zh: 手術後她在加護病房待了一週。

words.zh: n. 同情, 憐憫
words.example: She treated every patient with warmth and compassion.
words.example_zh: 她以溫暖與同情心對待每一位病人。

words.zh: vi. 努力, 奮鬥, 鬥爭
words.example: We must strive to make healthcare available to everyone.
words.example_zh: 我們必須努力讓人人都能獲得醫療。

words.zh: n. 抗生素；a. 抗生的
words.example: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic to clear the infection.
words.example_zh: 醫生開了抗生素來清除感染。

words.zh: vt. 傳染, 感染；[醫] 傳染, 感染
words.example: A single careless touch can infect an open wound.
words.example_zh: 一次不小心的碰觸就可能讓開放性傷口受到感染。

words.zh: a. 謹慎的, 小心的
words.example: Be cautious about mixing different medicines.
words.example_zh: 對於混用不同藥物要謹慎。

words.zh: a. 幸運的, 幸福的
words.example: He was fortunate that the tumor was caught early.
words.example_zh: 他很幸運，腫瘤被早期發現。

words.zh: a. (被)建立的, 固定的, 既定的, 確定的, 確認的, 確立的, (被)制定的；[計] 確定的, 既定的
words.example: It is now an established fact that smoking causes cancer.
words.example_zh: 吸菸致癌如今已是確立的事實。

words.zh: a. 奇特的, 罕見的, 特殊的, 特別的；n. 特有財產, 特權
words.example: She noticed a peculiar smell coming from the wound.
words.example_zh: 她注意到傷口傳出一股奇怪的氣味。

words.zh: a. 卓著的, 著名的
words.example: A distinguished surgeon was invited to lead the operation.
words.example_zh: 一位傑出的外科醫生獲邀主刀。

words.zh: n. 盾, 防衛物, 保護者, 遮蔽；vt. 保護, 遮蔽, 遮蔽, 庇護, 擋開, 避開；vi. 起保護作用
words.example: Sunscreen helps shield your skin from harmful rays.
words.example_zh: 防曬乳能幫助保護你的皮膚免受有害射線傷害。

words.zh: a. 可預言的
words.example: The side effects of the drug are mild and predictable.
words.example_zh: 這種藥的副作用輕微且可預測。

words.zh: n. 過度, 剩於, 超過, 超額；a. 過量的, 額外的
words.example: An excess of salt in the diet raises blood pressure.
words.example_zh: 飲食中過量的鹽會使血壓升高。

words.zh: a. 模糊的, 昏暗的, 難解的, 晦澀的, 偏僻的, 微賤的, 無名的；vt. 使變暗, 隱藏, 使變模糊, 使難解
words.example: The cause of her illness remained obscure for months.
words.example_zh: 她生病的原因好幾個月來始終不明。

words.zh: vt. 發揮, 運用, 施以影響；[法] 施加, 產生, 行使
words.example: The tumor began to exert pressure on the nerve.
words.example_zh: 腫瘤開始對神經施加壓力。

words.zh: a. 俯伏的, 面向下的, 有...傾向的；[醫] 旋前的, 伏的, 俯的
words.example: People with diabetes are more prone to infections.
words.example_zh: 糖尿病患者較容易發生感染。

words.zh: n. 認識, 相識者
words.example: He is not a close friend, just a casual acquaintance.
words.example_zh: 他不是好友，只是個普通的點頭之交。

words.zh: n. 衝突, 干涉；[計] 干擾
words.example: Static interference made the recording hard to hear.
words.example_zh: 雜訊干擾使得這段錄音很難聽清楚。

words.zh: vt. 引出, 推匯出, 引起
words.example: The doctor's questions were meant to elicit the patient's history.
words.example_zh: 醫生的問題是為了引出病人的病史。

words.zh: n. 支援, 長枕；vt. 支援, 支撐
words.example: The good test results helped bolster her confidence.
words.example_zh: 良好的檢查結果有助於增強她的信心。

words.zh: n. 命令者, 獨裁者
words.example: The country suffered for decades under a ruthless dictator.
words.example_zh: 這個國家在殘酷的獨裁者統治下苦了數十年。

words.zh: n. 合成物質；a. 綜合(性)的, 人造的, 合成的
words.example: The jacket is made of a synthetic material, not wool.
words.example_zh: 這件外套是合成材質製成的，不是羊毛。

words.zh: a. 有嫌疑的
words.example: She was admitted with a suspected heart attack.
words.example_zh: 她因疑似心臟病發作而住院。

words.zh: a. 普遍的, 流行的
words.example: Obesity is increasingly prevalent among young people.
words.example_zh: 肥胖在年輕人之間越來越普遍。

words.zh: a. 善良的, 良性的；[醫] 良性的
words.example: The biopsy showed that the lump was benign.
words.example_zh: 切片顯示那個腫塊是良性的。

words.zh: a. 易受影響的, 易感動的, 容許...的；[法] 易感的, 易受影響的, 容許
words.example: Newborns are highly susceptible to cold temperatures.
words.example_zh: 新生兒對低溫非常敏感。

words.zh: a. 憤世嫉俗的, 諷刺的, 冷嘲的
words.example: Years of broken promises had made him cynical.
words.example_zh: 多年來不斷被毀棄的承諾使他變得憤世嫉俗。

words.zh: adv. 偶然地, 意外地
words.example: She accidentally took a double dose of the pill.
words.example_zh: 她不小心服用了雙倍劑量的藥丸。

words.zh: adv. 不情願地, 勉強地
words.example: He reluctantly agreed to stay in hospital overnight.
words.example_zh: 他勉強同意留院過夜。

words.zh: a. 貌似真實的, 貌似合理的, 說得煞有其事的；[法] 花言巧語的, 似乎有理的
words.example: His explanation for the symptoms sounded plausible.
words.example_zh: 他對這些症狀的解釋聽起來似乎合理。

words.zh: n. 敵手, 對手；a. 敵手的, 敵對的
words.example: In the debate, she treated her adversary with respect.
words.example_zh: 在辯論中，她對對手以禮相待。

words.zh: a. 成功的, 繁盛的, 幸運的；[經] 繁榮的, 昌盛的
words.example: The clinic grew into a prosperous private hospital.
words.example_zh: 這間診所發展成一家興盛的私人醫院。

words.zh: vt. 損害, 減少, 削弱；[法] 損害, 傷害, 減少
words.example: Even one drink can impair your ability to drive.
words.example_zh: 即使一杯酒也可能損害你的開車能力。

words.zh: a. 可繁殖的, 肥沃的, 生產多的；[醫] 能生育的
words.example: The valley's fertile soil produces three harvests a year.
words.example_zh: 山谷肥沃的土壤一年能有三次收成。

words.zh: n. 洞, 空穴, 腔；[化] 空穴
words.example: The dentist found a small cavity in her back tooth.
words.example_zh: 牙醫在她的後牙發現一個小蛀洞。

words.zh: n. 稱讚, 恭維, 敬意；vt. 稱讚, 褒揚, 恭維
words.example: He paid her a sincere compliment on her recovery.
words.example_zh: 他真誠地稱讚她康復得很好。

words.zh: n. 移情作用, 共鳴；[醫] 移情, 神入
words.example: A good nurse listens with genuine empathy.
words.example_zh: 好的護理師會以真誠的同理心傾聽。

words.zh: a. 能實行的, 可行的, 適宜的；[法] 可行的, 可執行的, 可完成的
words.example: Surgery was no longer a feasible option for the elderly patient.
words.example_zh: 對這位年長病人來說，手術已不再是可行的選擇。

words.zh: vt. 使永存, 使不朽, 保持
words.example: Such myths only perpetuate the fear of vaccines.
words.example_zh: 這類迷思只會延續人們對疫苗的恐懼。

words.zh: vi. 渴望, 立志於
words.example: Many students aspire to become doctors one day.
words.example_zh: 許多學生立志有朝一日成為醫生。

words.zh: n. 提高, 美化, 增進, 增強, 增加；[計] 增強, 加強, 提高, 充實
words.example: The new lens offers a real enhancement in image quality.
words.example_zh: 新鏡頭在影像品質上有實質的提升。

words.zh: n. 剖析, 解剖學, 骨骼, 結構；[醫] 解剖學, 解剖
words.example: First-year students spend hours studying human anatomy.
words.example_zh: 一年級學生花大量時間研讀人體解剖學。

words.zh: a. 遺忘的, 健忘的, 不知不覺的；[法] 忘卻的, 健忘的, 不在意的
words.example: He kept working, oblivious to the chaos around him.
words.example_zh: 他繼續工作，渾然不覺周遭的混亂。

words.zh: n. 多數, 群眾
words.example: A multitude of factors can affect blood pressure.
words.example_zh: 眾多因素都可能影響血壓。

words.zh: vt. 圍繞, 圈起, 放入封套, 附上
words.example: Please enclose a copy of your test results with the form.
words.example_zh: 請隨表格附上一份你的檢查結果。

words.zh: a. 補充的, 補足的；[經] 補足的, 補充的
words.example: The two therapies have a complementary effect.
words.example_zh: 這兩種療法有互補的效果。

words.zh: a. 審慎的, 三思而後行的, 精明的, 節儉的
words.example: It is prudent to get a second opinion before surgery.
words.example_zh: 手術前徵詢第二意見是明智的。

words.zh: vt. 溫和, 緩和, 減輕；[醫] 緩和, 減輕
words.example: Painkillers can mitigate the worst of the symptoms.
words.example_zh: 止痛藥能減輕最嚴重的症狀。

words.zh: a. 假裝的, 做作的, 受影響的
words.example: The affected limb was swollen and painful to the touch.
words.example_zh: 受影響的肢體又腫又痛，一碰就疼。

words.zh: a. 回顧的, 懷舊的, 在後面的；n. 回顧展
words.example: A retrospective study reviewed records from the past decade.
words.example_zh: 一項回顧性研究檢視了過去十年的病歷。

words.zh: vt. 縮減, 剝奪, 簡略；[法] 剝奪特權
words.example: The hospital had to curtail visiting hours during the outbreak.
words.example_zh: 疫情期間，醫院不得不縮減探病時間。

words.zh: a. 豪華的, 奢侈的, 放縱的
words.example: The recovery suite was as luxurious as a hotel room.
words.example_zh: 那間恢復室豪華得像飯店房間。

words.zh: a. 要求高的, 費力的
words.example: Nursing is a physically demanding job.
words.example_zh: 護理是一份體力負荷很重的工作。

words.zh: vt. 根除, 撲滅, 根絕, 消滅
words.example: Vaccines have helped eradicate smallpox worldwide.
words.example_zh: 疫苗幫助全球根除了天花。

words.zh: adv. 可公開, 顯然, 表面, 外表, 詭稱, 假裝
words.example: He stayed late, ostensibly to study, but really to rest.
words.example_zh: 他留到很晚，表面上是為了讀書，其實是想休息。

words.zh: n. 剝奪, 剝奪官職, 免職；[醫] 喪失, 剝奪, 缺乏
words.example: Long-term sleep deprivation harms the immune system.
words.example_zh: 長期的睡眠剝奪會損害免疫系統。

words.zh: n. 半徑, 範圍, 輻射光線；[電] 半徑
words.example: The ambulance covers every village within a ten-mile radius.
words.example_zh: 救護車服務範圍涵蓋十英里半徑內的每個村莊。

words.zh: vt. 沖淡, 稀釋；a. 淡的, 稀釋的
words.example: Dilute the medicine with water before giving it to a child.
words.example_zh: 給孩子服用前，先用水稀釋藥物。

words.zh: a. 發光的, 明亮的；[醫] 發光的
words.example: The dial of the monitor glowed with a luminous green.
words.example_zh: 監測儀的刻度盤發出明亮的綠光。

words.zh: n. (美)總統就職, 開幕儀式, 就職典禮, 開始, 開闢, 開創, 為...舉行開幕式；[法] 就職, 就職典禮, 創造
words.example: The new wing opened with a formal inauguration ceremony.
words.example_zh: 新側翼以正式的啟用典禮揭幕。

words.zh: n. 地球上的人；a. 地球的, 陸生的, 陸地的, 人間的
words.example: Unlike whales, these animals are entirely terrestrial.
words.example_zh: 不像鯨魚，這些動物完全是陸生的。

words.zh: vt. 瀰漫, 滲透, 充滿, 影響, 感染；vi. 透入, 散佈
words.example: A faint smell of antiseptic permeated the whole ward.
words.example_zh: 一股淡淡的消毒水味瀰漫了整間病房。

words.zh: n. 降落傘；vi. 跳傘
words.example: The skydiver's parachute opened just in time.
words.example_zh: 跳傘者的降落傘及時張開。

words.zh: vt. 指示, 表示
words.example: On the chart, a red dot denotes an abnormal result.
words.example_zh: 在圖表上，紅點表示異常的結果。

words.zh: n. 嚴格, 嚴厲, 苛刻, 嚴酷, 嚴密, 精確；[醫] 寒戰, 強直, 僵硬
words.example: The study was carried out with great scientific rigor.
words.example_zh: 這項研究以極高的科學嚴謹度進行。

words.zh: a. 受損的
words.example: After the stroke, his speech was severely impaired.
words.example_zh: 中風後，他的語言能力嚴重受損。

words.zh: n. 再起, 復活, 再現
words.example: Doctors warn of a resurgence of measles in unvaccinated areas.
words.example_zh: 醫生警告未接種地區麻疹可能捲土重來。

words.zh: n. 腹瀉；[醫] 腹瀉
words.example: The infection left him with fever and diarrhea.
words.example_zh: 這次感染讓他發燒並腹瀉。

words.zh: vt. 描繪...的輪廓, 描繪, 描寫
words.example: The report clearly delineates each step of the procedure.
words.example_zh: 這份報告清楚地勾勒出手術的每個步驟。

words.zh: a. 彈回的, 有彈力的；[醫] 回彈的, 回能的
words.example: Children are often remarkably resilient after surgery.
words.example_zh: 孩子在手術後往往恢復力驚人。

words.zh: a. 可歸於...的
words.example: Many deaths are directly attributable to smoking.
words.example_zh: 許多死亡可直接歸因於吸菸。

words.zh: a. 引出的, 派生的；n. 引出之物, 派生物, 衍生字
words.example: Aspirin is a derivative of a substance found in willow bark.
words.example_zh: 阿斯匹靈是柳樹皮中一種物質的衍生物。

words.zh: n. 分離, 分遣, 分遣隊；[醫] 脫離, 分離, 支隊
words.example: The patient was diagnosed with retinal detachment.
words.example_zh: 病人被診斷出視網膜剝離。

words.zh: a. 輕佻的, 妄動的, 瑣碎的；[法] 輕薄的, 輕浮的, 無意義的
words.example: The court dismissed the frivolous lawsuit at once.
words.example_zh: 法院當即駁回了這宗無理取鬧的訴訟。

words.zh: a. 有分歧的；[醫] 散開的, 偏斜的
words.example: The two doctors held sharply divergent views.
words.example_zh: 兩位醫生持有極為分歧的看法。

words.zh: a. 善意的, 慈善的
words.example: A benevolent donor paid for the new equipment.
words.example_zh: 一位仁慈的捐贈者支付了新設備的費用。

words.zh: a. 迷惑的, 虛偽的, 欺詐的
words.example: The calm before a seizure can be deceptive.
words.example_zh: 癲癇發作前的平靜可能具有欺騙性。

words.zh: [計] 平衡, 均衡, 結算；[經] 平衡, 結出餘額
words.example: Treating the disease is a balancing act between risk and benefit.
words.example_zh: 治療這種疾病是在風險與效益之間求取平衡。

words.zh: n. 仲裁者, 調解者, 媒介物, 中間人；a. 中間的, 媒介的
words.example: The pharmacist acts as an intermediary between doctor and patient.
words.example_zh: 藥師扮演醫生與病人之間的中介者。

words.zh: vt. 繁殖, 傳播, 傳送；vi. 繁殖, 蔓延
words.example: Bacteria propagate rapidly in warm, moist conditions.
words.example_zh: 細菌在溫暖潮濕的環境中迅速繁殖。

words.zh: vt. 熄滅, 使消亡, 壓制, 使減色；[醫] 消滅
words.example: Firefighters worked through the night to extinguish the blaze.
words.example_zh: 消防員徹夜奮戰撲滅大火。

words.zh: a. 不可否認的
words.example: The link between diet and health is undeniable.
words.example_zh: 飲食與健康之間的關聯不可否認。

words.zh: a. 瞬間的, 剎那間的
words.example: She felt a momentary dizziness when she stood up.
words.example_zh: 她站起來時感到一陣短暫的暈眩。

words.zh: n. 行為不良, 失職；[經] 毀約, 怠工, 曠職
words.example: The clinic struggles with the delinquency of unpaid bills.
words.example_zh: 這間診所為帳單拖欠的問題而苦惱。

words.zh: vi. 增殖, 激增, 擴散；vt. 使激增
words.example: Cancer cells can proliferate at an alarming rate.
words.example_zh: 癌細胞能以驚人的速度增生。

words.zh: a. 有惡意的, 惡性的, 有害的；[化] 惡性的
words.example: The tests confirmed that the tumor was malignant.
words.example_zh: 檢查證實腫瘤為惡性。

words.zh: n. 遺忘, (頭腦的)一片空白狀, 湮沒, 大赦, 赦免；[法] 忘卻, 被忘卻的事, 大赦
words.example: After the anesthetic, he sank into a peaceful oblivion.
words.example_zh: 麻醉之後，他陷入了平靜的無意識狀態。

words.zh: a. 累計的；累積的；達到
words.example: Over the years, fatty deposits had accumulated in his arteries.
words.example_zh: 多年來，脂肪沉積物在他的動脈中累積。

words.zh: a. 似非而是的, 矛盾的, 詭論的；[醫] 奇異的, 矛盾的, 逆理的, 反常的
words.example: It is paradoxical that the cure caused new symptoms.
words.example_zh: 矛盾的是，療法竟引發了新的症狀。

words.zh: n. 失眠症；[醫] 失眠[症]
words.example: Stress at work led to weeks of insomnia.
words.example_zh: 工作壓力導致他連續數週失眠。

words.zh: a. 可信任的, 可靠的, 可信賴的
words.example: She is the most dependable nurse on the night shift.
words.example_zh: 她是夜班裡最可靠的護理師。

words.zh: a. 刺激性的, 尖刻的, 苦痛的；[醫] 衝味的, 刺激味的
words.example: The ointment had a pungent, medicinal smell.
words.example_zh: 這款藥膏有股刺鼻的藥味。

words.zh: a. 諷刺的, 譏諷的
words.example: His sarcastic remark hurt the new intern.
words.example_zh: 他諷刺的話傷了那位新來的實習生。

words.zh: a. 問候的, 稱讚的, 誇獎的；免費贈送的
words.example: The hotel offered a complimentary health check to guests.
words.example_zh: 飯店為房客提供免費的健康檢查。

words.zh: a. 懷惡意的, 惡毒的
words.example: The hospital's network was hit by a malicious attack.
words.example_zh: 醫院的網路遭到惡意攻擊。

words.zh: a. 異種的, 異質的, 由不同成分形成的；[醫] 不均勻的, 多相的, 異質的
words.example: The sample was a heterogeneous mix of different cells.
words.example_zh: 這個樣本是由不同細胞混雜而成的不均勻混合物。

words.zh: n. 力量, 權力, 效力；[化] 能力
words.example: Stored too long, the drug loses much of its potency.
words.example_zh: 存放太久，藥物會喪失大部分的效力。

words.zh: n. 行為不良的人, 違法者；a. 怠忽的, 有過失的
words.example: The hospital sent reminders to patients with delinquent accounts.
words.example_zh: 醫院向帳款逾期的病人寄出催繳通知。

words.zh: vt. 宣告離婚, 拒絕, 拒付, 拒絕履行；[經] 拒付(公債,國債等)
words.example: The scientist was forced to repudiate his earlier claims.
words.example_zh: 這名科學家被迫否認他先前的主張。

words.zh: a. 難以明瞭的, 無形的；[經] 無形的
words.example: Trust is an intangible but vital part of medical care.
words.example_zh: 信任是醫療照護中無形卻至關重要的一環。

words.zh: a. 疏忽的, 粗心的, 不在意的
words.example: The clinic was found negligent in handling the records.
words.example_zh: 該診所被認定在處理病歷上有疏失。

words.zh: a. 朝生暮死的, 短命的, 短暫的；[醫] 暫時的
words.example: The drug's effect is ephemeral and wears off in an hour.
words.example_zh: 這種藥的效果短暫，一小時內就消退。

words.zh: a. 修改的；改變信仰的
words.example: The old library was converted into a research lab.
words.example_zh: 那座舊圖書館被改建成研究實驗室。

words.zh: vt. 訂正, 矯正, 改正, 調正, 校正, 精餾, 整流；[化] 精餾
words.example: The pharmacist quickly rectified the dosing error.
words.example_zh: 藥師迅速糾正了劑量錯誤。

words.zh: adv. 不具名地；化名地
words.example: The donor wished to give the money anonymously.
words.example_zh: 這位捐贈者希望匿名捐出這筆錢。

words.zh: vt. 放棄, 斷念, 拋棄；[法] 遺棄, 拋棄, 摒絕
words.example: A good doctor will never forsake a patient in need.
words.example_zh: 好醫生絕不會棄有需要的病人於不顧。

words.zh: a. 緊握的, 固執的, 不屈不撓的, 黏著力強的；[醫] 堅韌的
words.example: Her tenacious fight against the illness inspired everyone.
words.example_zh: 她與病魔頑強的搏鬥鼓舞了每個人。

words.zh: a. 限制的, 拘謹的, 剋制的
words.example: The agitated patient had to be gently restrained.
words.example_zh: 躁動的病人不得不被溫和地約束。

words.zh: a. 相伴的, 伴隨的, 共存的；n. 伴隨物
words.example: Weight loss was a concomitant symptom of the disease.
words.example_zh: 體重減輕是這種疾病的伴隨症狀。

words.zh: a. 彬彬有禮, 謙恭的
words.example: The staff were courteous even under great pressure.
words.example_zh: 即使在巨大壓力下，員工仍彬彬有禮。

words.zh: a. 風味極佳的, 可口的, 味香的；n. 開胃菜
words.example: After the bland hospital food, the soup tasted wonderfully savory.
words.example_zh: 在清淡的醫院餐後，這碗湯嚐起來特別鮮美。

words.zh: n. 有插畫的報章雜誌
words.example: The textbook is richly illustrated with anatomical diagrams.
words.example_zh: 這本教科書配有大量解剖圖解。

words.zh: vt. 回報, 互換, 交換, 報答, 使往復運動；vi. 往復運動, 回報, 互換, 酬答
words.example: She was kind to me, and I tried to reciprocate.
words.example_zh: 她對我很好，我也試著回報她。

words.zh: n. 婦科醫生；[醫] 婦科學家
words.example: She made an appointment with her gynecologist for a checkup.
words.example_zh: 她和婦科醫生預約了一次檢查。

words.zh: a. 假裝的, 裝的, 假定的；[法] 設想的, 假定的, 被承擔的；（assume 過去式/分詞）承擔、就任、假定
words.example: The intern assumed full responsibility for the ward overnight.
words.example_zh: 實習醫生夜間承擔了病房的全部責任。

words.zh: n. 偶然性, 偶然事件；a. 無計劃的, 偶然的, 隨便的；adv. 偶然地
words.example: The files were stored in a haphazard, careless way.
words.example_zh: 這些檔案以雜亂無章、隨便的方式存放。

words.zh: a. 協調的, 一致的, 適意的, 趣味相同的
words.example: They worked together in a warm, congenial atmosphere.
words.example_zh: 他們在溫馨融洽的氣氛中共事。

words.zh: n. 退化, 惡化, 墮落；[化] 簡併性
words.example: The disease causes a slow degeneration of the nerves.
words.example_zh: 這種疾病會造成神經的緩慢退化。

words.zh: a. 輕蔑的, 鄙視的, 瞧不起人的
words.example: He gave a contemptuous laugh at the suggestion.
words.example_zh: 他對這個建議發出一聲輕蔑的笑。

words.zh: a. 多汁的, 多水分的；[醫] 多汁的(植物)
words.example: The garden was full of succulent plants that store water.
words.example_zh: 花園裡長滿了能儲水的多肉植物。

words.zh: a. 分散式的；[計] 分散對齊, 分散式處理
words.example: The medicine was distributed evenly among the clinics.
words.example_zh: 藥品被平均分配到各個診所。

words.zh: vt. (使)脫水；[醫] 脫水, 去水
words.example: A high fever can quickly dehydrate a small child.
words.example_zh: 高燒可能很快讓幼童脫水。

words.zh: vt. 獨佔, 壟斷；[經] 壟斷, 專營, 專利
words.example: One company has come to monopolize the drug's supply.
words.example_zh: 一家公司已壟斷了這種藥的供應。

words.zh: vt. 使滿足
words.example: It gratified her to see her patient walk again.
words.example_zh: 看到病人能再次走路，令她感到滿足。

words.zh: a. 受委屈的, 權利受到不法侵害的
words.example: The aggrieved family demanded a full investigation.
words.example_zh: 受委屈的家屬要求徹底調查。

words.zh: 老著臉皮
words.example: He unabashedly admitted that he had never read the report.
words.example_zh: 他毫不害臊地承認自己從沒讀過那份報告。

words.zh: a. 專橫的, 傲慢的, 迫切的；[醫] 強制的, 不隨意的
words.example: The senior doctor had an imperious, commanding manner.
words.example_zh: 那位資深醫生有著專橫、發號施令的作風。

words.zh: a. 纖細的, 稀薄的, 稀釋的；vt. 使減弱, 使纖細；vi. 變稀薄, 變纖細, 減少；[計] 衰減
words.example: The vaccine uses an attenuated form of the virus.
words.example_zh: 這款疫苗使用了減毒型的病毒。

words.zh: n. 便秘, 秘結；[醫] 便秘
words.example: A diet low in fiber often leads to constipation.
words.example_zh: 低纖維的飲食常會導致便秘。

words.zh: a. 溶解的；溶化的
words.example: The tablet dissolved completely in a glass of water.
words.example_zh: 藥片在一杯水中完全溶解。

words.zh: vt. 證明可信, 證實為真, 使具法律效力；[法] 認證, 鑑定, 證明
words.example: A signature is required to authenticate the prescription.
words.example_zh: 處方需要簽名來證明其真實性。

words.zh: adv. 強迫地, 強制地
words.example: All staff were compulsorily tested before returning to work.
words.example_zh: 所有員工在復工前都被強制接受檢測。

words.zh: n. 單調, 平凡, 陳腐, 陳詞濫調
words.example: His speech was full of empty platitudes about caring.
words.example_zh: 他的演說滿是關於關懷的空洞陳腔濫調。

words.zh: vt. 僱傭（employ的過去分詞）
words.example: The hospital employed two hundred nurses last year.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院去年僱用了兩百名護理師。

words.zh: a. 能實現個人抱負的；令人高興的；令人滿意的
words.example: She finds nursing a deeply fulfilling career.
words.example_zh: 她覺得護理是一份極有成就感的職業。

words.zh: adv. 父死後出生, 遺腹, 著作者死後出版, 身後, 死後
words.example: He was posthumously honored for his research.
words.example_zh: 他因其研究在過世後獲得表彰。

words.zh: a. 沒法辯解的, 不可寬赦的
words.example: Such a careless mistake in surgery is inexcusable.
words.example_zh: 手術中如此粗心的錯誤是不可原諒的。

words.zh: a. 有幫助的, 有用的, 奉承的
words.example: She refused to be subservient to the demands of the board.
words.example_zh: 她拒絕對董事會的要求唯命是從。

words.zh: a. 水星的, 敏捷的, 活潑的, 水銀的；n. 汞劑
words.example: His mercurial moods made him hard to work with.
words.example_zh: 他善變的情緒讓人很難與他共事。

words.zh: v. 出汗, 流汗, 分泌, 滲出
words.example: Patients with a high fever often perspire heavily.
words.example_zh: 高燒的病人常會大量出汗。

words.zh: v. 沒收, 充公( confiscate的過去式和過去分詞 )
words.example: Security confiscated the sharp objects at the door.
words.example_zh: 保全在門口沒收了尖銳物品。

words.zh: [機] 通氣
words.example: The lab has a special hood for venting toxic fumes.
words.example_zh: 實驗室有專用排氣罩來排出有毒煙霧。

words.zh: n. 魯莽, 蠻勇
words.example: He had the temerity to question the chief surgeon.
words.example_zh: 他竟有膽量質疑主刀醫生。

words.zh: a. 不能滲透的, 不能通過的；[醫] 不[滲]透性
words.example: The gloves are impermeable to most chemicals.
words.example_zh: 這種手套對大多數化學物質都無法滲透。

words.zh: a. 使人誤解的, 謬誤的, 不合理的, 騙人的
words.example: The claim that the herb cures cancer is fallacious.
words.example_zh: 宣稱這種草藥能治癒癌症是謬誤的。

words.zh: a. 輕信的, 易受騙的
words.example: Credulous patients are easily fooled by false cures.
words.example_zh: 輕信的病人容易被假療法所騙。

words.zh: a. 可稱譽的, 聲譽好的, 可信的
words.example: The young doctor gave a creditable performance under pressure.
words.example_zh: 這位年輕醫生在壓力下表現可圈可點。

words.zh: v. 將…驅逐出境( deport的過去式和過去分詞 ); 舉止
words.example: The man was deported after his visa expired.
words.example_zh: 那名男子在簽證到期後被驅逐出境。

words.zh: adv. 可觸知地
words.example: The new policy tangibly improved patient care.
words.example_zh: 新政策切實地改善了病人的照護。

words.zh: v. 憎惡, 嫌惡, 痛恨( detest的過去式和過去分詞 )
words.example: As a child she detested the taste of cough syrup.
words.example_zh: 小時候她極討厭咳嗽糖漿的味道。

words.zh: v. 美化( embellish的過去式和過去分詞 ); 裝飾; 修飾; 潤色
words.example: He embellished the story with details that never happened.
words.example_zh: 他用從未發生的細節來潤飾這個故事。

words.zh: a. 疏散；排空的, 撤退者的
words.example: The ward was evacuated as soon as the alarm sounded.
words.example_zh: 警報一響，病房立刻被疏散。

words.zh: v. 促進( facilitate的過去式和過去分詞 ); 使便利; 推進; 幫助（某人）進步
words.example: The new software facilitated faster sharing of records.
words.example_zh: 新軟體促成了病歷更快速的分享。

words.zh: v. 保證, 許諾, 發誓( pledge的過去式和過去分詞 ); 典當; 保證給予（或做）; 以誓言約束
words.example: The foundation pledged a million dollars to the hospital.
words.example_zh: 該基金會承諾捐給醫院一百萬美元。

words.zh: v. 使免罪, 免除( exonerate的過去式和過去分詞 )
words.example: The investigation exonerated the nurse of any blame.
words.example_zh: 調查還了那名護理師清白，免除了一切責任。

words.zh: a. 對齊的；均衡的
words.example: The surgeon made sure the broken bones were properly aligned.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生確保斷骨正確接合對位。

words.zh: v. 淹沒( inundate的過去式和過去分詞 ); （洪水般地）湧來; 充滿; 給予或交予（太多事物）使難以應付
words.example: After the report, the clinic was inundated with calls.
words.example_zh: 報導之後，診所被電話淹沒。

words.zh: a. 觸發的；起動的；有扳機的
words.example: The bright lights triggered a sudden migraine.
words.example_zh: 強光引發了突如其來的偏頭痛。

words.zh: v. 通知, 告知, 報告( notify的過去式和過去分詞 )
words.example: The lab notified the doctor of the abnormal result at once.
words.example_zh: 實驗室立刻通知醫生這項異常結果。

words.zh: a. 不及物的；n. 不及物動詞
words.example: In grammar, 'sleep' is an intransitive verb that takes no object.
words.example_zh: 在文法上，sleep 是不及物動詞，不接受詞。

words.zh: n. （辯護）律師( advocate的名詞複數 ); 提倡者; 辯護律師; [A-]基督；v. 提倡( advocate的第三人稱單數 ); 擁護; 鼓吹; 為…辯護
words.example: She advocates a low-salt diet for all her heart patients.
words.example_zh: 她為所有心臟病患者提倡低鹽飲食。

words.zh: v. 設法克服或避免（某事物）, 迴避( circumvent的過去式和過去分詞 ); 繞過, 繞行, 繞道旅行
words.example: They circumvented the rule by using a clever loophole.
words.example_zh: 他們利用一個巧妙的漏洞規避了這項規定。

words.zh: v. 勾畫, 描述( delineate的第三人稱單數 )
words.example: The manual clearly delineates each safety step.
words.example_zh: 這本手冊清楚地界定了每個安全步驟。

words.zh: v. 悲嘆, 痛惜, 強烈反對( deplore的過去式和過去分詞 )
words.example: Critics deplored the cuts to the health budget.
words.example_zh: 批評者強烈譴責削減醫療預算的做法。

words.zh: a. 被稱為的；譯製的
words.example: The drug was dubbed a miracle cure by the press.
words.example_zh: 這種藥被媒體稱為神奇療法。

words.zh: v. 點燃, 引發( ignite的第三人稱單數 )
words.example: A single spark ignites the gas instantly.
words.example_zh: 一個火花就能瞬間點燃瓦斯。

words.zh: v. 發射( launch的過去式和過去分詞 ); [計算機]開始（應用程式）; 發動; 開展（活動、計劃等）
words.example: The hospital launched a campaign to encourage blood donation.
words.example_zh: 醫院發起了一項鼓勵捐血的活動。

words.zh: v. 減輕, 緩和( mitigate的過去式和過去分詞 )
words.example: Prompt treatment mitigated the worst of the damage.
words.example_zh: 及時治療減輕了最嚴重的傷害。

words.zh: n. 夢神, 睡神, 睡眠
words.example: In Greek mythology, Morpheus is the god of dreams.
words.example_zh: 在希臘神話中，摩耳甫斯是夢之神。

words.zh: n. （食品或化學品）營養物, 營養品( nutrient的複數形式 )
words.example: Fresh vegetables are packed with essential nutrients.
words.example_zh: 新鮮蔬菜富含必需的營養素。

words.zh: n. 義務；債務；承付款項（obligation的複數）
words.example: Doctors have legal and ethical obligations to their patients.
words.example_zh: 醫生對病人負有法律與道德上的義務。

words.zh: v. 獲得（obtain的過去分詞）
words.example: Consent was obtained before the operation began.
words.example_zh: 手術開始前已取得同意。

words.zh: n. 機會( occasion的名詞複數 ); 時刻; 原因; 需要
words.example: On several occasions, the patient refused treatment.
words.example_zh: 病人曾數度拒絕治療。

words.zh: v. 起源於, 來自, 產生( originate的過去式和過去分詞 ); 創造; 創始; 開創
words.example: The outbreak originated in a crowded market.
words.example_zh: 這次疫情起源於一個擁擠的市場。

words.zh: n. 步行者( pedestrian的複數形式 )
words.example: The new crossing makes the road safer for pedestrians.
words.example_zh: 新的行人穿越道讓這條路對行人更安全。

words.zh: n. 許可( permit的名詞複數 ); 許可證; 執照；v. 允許( permit的第三人稱單數 ); 許可
words.example: The license permits the clinic to perform minor surgery.
words.example_zh: 這張執照允許診所進行小手術。

words.zh: n. （某事業、理論等的）支持者, 擁護者( proponent的複數形式 )
words.example: Proponents of the diet claim it lowers cholesterol.
words.example_zh: 這種飲食法的支持者宣稱它能降低膽固醇。

words.zh: n. 預期；前景；潛在顧客；遠景展望
words.example: Early treatment greatly improves a patient's prospects.
words.example_zh: 早期治療能大幅改善病人的康復前景。

words.zh: v. 申斥, 懲戒, 譴責( reprimand的過去式和過去分詞 )
words.example: The intern was reprimanded for ignoring the protocol.
words.example_zh: 實習醫生因無視規範而受到申斥。

words.zh: v. 責備( reproach的過去式和過去分詞 ); 內疚
words.example: She gently reproached him for skipping his medication.
words.example_zh: 她溫和地責備他漏服藥物。

words.zh: n. 不足( shortage的複數形式 ); 缺少; 缺少量; 不足額
words.example: Staff shortages forced the ward to close two beds.
words.example_zh: 人力短缺迫使病房關閉了兩張床。

words.zh: v. 高飛( soar的過去式和過去分詞 ); 猛增; （音樂）升高; 高聳
words.example: After the recall, demand for the vaccine soared.
words.example_zh: 回收事件後，這款疫苗的需求量暴增。

words.zh: n. 系統, 體系, 制度, 方式, 秩序, 分類原則；[計] 系統; 體制; 體系
words.example: The immune system defends the body against invading germs.
words.example_zh: 免疫系統保護身體抵禦入侵的病菌。

words.zh: n. 社群, 公眾, 共有, 共同體；[經] 公眾, 共有, 社會
words.example: The clinic serves a large rural community.
words.example_zh: 這間診所服務著廣大的鄉村社區。

words.zh: n. 理由, 原因, 理智, 道理, 前提, 理性；vt. 說服, 推論, 辯論；vi. 推論, 勸說, 思考
words.example: There is no obvious reason for her sudden fever.
words.example_zh: 她突然發燒沒有明顯的原因。

words.zh: vi. 出現, 顯得, 來到；[法] 出庭, 到案, 出現
words.example: Symptoms may not appear until weeks after infection.
words.example_zh: 症狀可能在感染數週後才出現。

words.zh: n. 結果, 影響, 效果, 印象；vt. 實行, 引起, 完成；[計] 效果
words.example: The drug had an immediate calming effect.
words.example_zh: 這種藥立刻產生了鎮靜的效果。

words.zh: n. 底部, 壘, 基礎, 基地；vt. 以...作基礎；a. 卑鄙的, 低劣的；[計] 基準
words.example: The hospital is the base for the region's air ambulance.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院是該地區空中救護的基地。

words.zh: adv. 幾乎, 密切地
words.example: She has worked here for nearly thirty years.
words.example_zh: 她在這裡工作了將近三十年。

words.zh: n. 根據, 證據, 跡象；[經] 證據, 憑證
words.example: There is strong evidence that exercise reduces stress.
words.example_zh: 有充分的證據顯示運動能減輕壓力。

words.zh: n. 規則, 統治, 控制, 支配, 規律, 標準, 章程, 破折號, 鉛線；vt. 規定, 統治, 管理, 控制, 支配, 裁決；vi. 統治, 管轄, 裁定；[計] 規則, 水
words.example: It is a strict rule that visitors wash their hands.
words.example_zh: 訪客洗手是一條嚴格的規定。

words.zh: n. 運動, 遊戲, 娛樂, 消遣, 玩笑；a. 運動的, 戶外穿戴的；vi. 遊戲, 參加體育運動, 戲弄, 產生變種；vt. 炫耀, 使產生變種
words.example: Swimming is a sport that is gentle on the joints.
words.example_zh: 游泳是一種對關節溫和的運動。

words.zh: n. 施行, 工作情況, 成績, 行為, 表現, 演出；[電] 績效, 效能
words.example: The new drug's performance in trials was impressive.
words.example_zh: 這款新藥在試驗中的表現令人印象深刻。

words.zh: n. 目標, 終點, 得分, 球門, 守門員；vi. 攻門, 射門得分
words.example: Her goal is to walk unassisted within a month.
words.example_zh: 她的目標是在一個月內能不靠協助行走。

words.zh: adv. 最近
words.example: He was recently discharged from the hospital.
words.example_zh: 他最近剛出院。

words.zh: n. 白痴；a. 自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物質的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然數的
words.example: The body has a natural ability to heal small wounds.
words.example_zh: 身體有自然癒合小傷口的能力。

words.zh: n. 因素, 因數, 係數, 基因, 代理人；[計] 因式
words.example: Age is a major risk factor for heart disease.
words.example_zh: 年齡是心臟病的主要風險因素。

words.zh: n. 治療, 待遇, 處理；[醫] 療法, 治療; 處理
words.example: Early treatment can stop the disease from spreading.
words.example_zh: 早期治療能阻止疾病擴散。

words.zh: a. 嚴肅的, 認真的, 重要的, 嚴重的；[電] 嚴重的
words.example: The patient is in a serious but stable condition.
words.example_zh: 病人情況嚴重但穩定。

words.zh: vi. 發生, 被想到, 存在
words.example: Side effects rarely occur with this medication.
words.example_zh: 這種藥很少出現副作用。

words.zh: n. 標準, 規格, 旗, 軍旗, 本位；a. 標準的, 合規格的；[計] 標準
words.example: The clinic follows the highest standard of hygiene.
words.example_zh: 這間診所遵循最高的衛生標準。

words.zh: n. 分析；[計] 分析機; 分析員; 分析; 分析程式
words.example: A blood analysis revealed a vitamin deficiency.
words.example_zh: 血液分析顯示出維生素缺乏。

words.zh: vt. 比較, 比喻, 對照；vi. 相比；n. 比較；[計] 比較
words.example: It helps to compare the scan with last year's image.
words.example_zh: 把這次掃描和去年的影像比較會有幫助。

words.zh: vt. 移動, 調動, 除去, 遷移, 開除, 移交；vi. 遷移, 移動, 搬家；n. 班級, 升級, 移動, 搬家, 間距；[計] 刪除
words.example: The surgeon will remove the inflamed appendix.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生將切除發炎的闌尾。

words.zh: n. 完成, 結束, 末道漆, 磨光, 完美；vt. 完成, 結束, 用完, 毀掉；vi. 結束；[計] 完成
words.example: Always finish the full course of antibiotics.
words.example_zh: 抗生素一定要服完整個療程。

words.zh: vt. 維持, 維修, 保持, 堅持, 供養, 主張；[化] 維修
words.example: Drink plenty of water to maintain healthy kidneys.
words.example_zh: 多喝水以維持腎臟健康。

words.zh: n. 一項(或條、點), 個別專案, 詳細說明；a. 特別的, 獨有的, 挑剔的, 詳盡的
words.example: She is very particular about keeping the wound clean.
words.example_zh: 她對保持傷口清潔非常講究。

words.zh: v. 預防, 防止, 阻止, 妨礙
words.example: Washing your hands helps prevent the spread of germs.
words.example_zh: 洗手有助於防止病菌傳播。

words.zh: n. 專業人才；a. 專業的, 職業的
words.example: Always seek professional advice before stopping a drug.
words.example_zh: 停藥前務必尋求專業建議。

words.zh: a. 孤獨的, 單獨的, 獨自的；adv. 獨自地
words.example: The elderly man lives alone and rarely sees a doctor.
words.example_zh: 這位老先生獨居，很少看醫生。

words.zh: a. 批評的, 決定性的, 危險的, 臨界的；[醫] 危象的; 臨界的, 極期的
words.example: The next twenty-four hours are critical for the patient.
words.example_zh: 接下來的二十四小時對病人至關緊要。

words.zh: a. 關心的, 有關的, 參與的, 擔心的
words.example: The doctor was concerned about her rapid weight loss.
words.example_zh: 醫生對她快速的體重下降感到擔憂。

words.zh: a. 有效的, 有力的, 實際的；n. 有生力量
words.example: Rest is the most effective remedy for a common cold.
words.example_zh: 休息是治療普通感冒最有效的方法。

words.zh: a. 最初的, 原始的, 有創意的；n. 原物, 原作
words.example: We compared the copy with the original prescription.
words.example_zh: 我們把副本和原始處方做了比對。

words.zh: a. 難懂的, 複雜的, 不易懂的, 捲入...之中的, 累及..., 與...有關, 被糾纏的；[計] 包含, 涉及
words.example: The operation was more involved than they expected.
words.example_zh: 這場手術比他們預期的還要複雜。

words.zh: n. 腦；vt. 打碎腦部
words.example: A stroke cuts off the blood supply to part of the brain.
words.example_zh: 中風會切斷腦部某個區域的血液供應。

words.zh: a. 完全的, 十足的, 完成的；vt. 完成, 完工, 使圓滿
words.example: The patient made a complete recovery within a month.
words.example_zh: 病人在一個月內完全康復。

words.zh: n. 狀態, 情形, 地位, 要人身份；[計] 狀態
words.example: The nurse checked the patient's status every hour.
words.example_zh: 護理師每小時檢查一次病人的狀況。

words.zh: n. 視覺, 眼光, 視力, 幻想；vt. 夢見, 想象, 顯示
words.example: The infection left him with blurred vision.
words.example_zh: 這次感染讓他視力模糊。

words.zh: n. 常態, 標準, 正常, 普通；a. 正常的, 正規的, 標準的, 師範的, 正態的；[計] 標準, 普通
words.example: Her blood pressure returned to normal after treatment.
words.example_zh: 治療後她的血壓恢復正常。

words.zh: n. 解決, 解答, 溶液；[化] 溶液
words.example: The wound was cleaned with a sterile saline solution.
words.example_zh: 傷口以無菌生理食鹽水溶液清潔。

words.zh: n. 嘗試, 企圖；vt. 嘗試, 企圖
words.example: Doctors made one last attempt to save the patient.
words.example_zh: 醫生做了最後一次嘗試來搶救病人。

words.zh: n. 潛在性, 可能性, 潛力, 潛能, 勢, 位；a. 有潛力的, 可能的, 潛在的
words.example: The new drug has the potential to save many lives.
words.example_zh: 這款新藥有拯救許多生命的潛力。

words.zh: n. 獨立自主者, 無黨派者；a. 獨立的, 有主見的, 不須依賴的, 不受約束的
words.example: After rehab, she is finally independent again.
words.example_zh: 復健後，她終於又能自理。

words.zh: vt. 促進, 晉升, 創辦, 推銷；[經] 促進, 推廣, 推銷
words.example: A balanced diet helps promote good health.
words.example_zh: 均衡的飲食有助於促進健康。

words.zh: vt. 比...活得長, 生存, 生還, 倖免於；vi. 活下來, 倖存
words.example: Most patients survive the surgery without complications.
words.example_zh: 大多數病人能平安度過手術，沒有併發症。

words.zh: a. 有責任的, 負責的, 責任重大的；[法] 應負責任的, 有責任的, 能履行責任的
words.example: The doctor on call is responsible for the whole ward.
words.example_zh: 值班醫生負責整個病房。

words.zh: n. 程式, 過程, 手續；[計] 規程; 過程
words.example: The procedure takes about an hour under local anesthetic.
words.example_zh: 這項手術在局部麻醉下約需一小時。

words.zh: vt. 不理睬, 忽視, 駁回, 忽略；[計] 忽略
words.example: Never ignore a sudden, severe headache.
words.example_zh: 千萬別忽視突然的劇烈頭痛。

words.zh: n. 宗教, 信仰；[法] 宗教, 宗教信仰, 信仰
words.example: The hospital respects every patient's religion.
words.example_zh: 醫院尊重每位病人的宗教信仰。

words.zh: n. 領袖, 酋長, 長官, 主要部分；a. 主要的, 首位的
words.example: She was promoted to chief of the surgical team.
words.example_zh: 她升任外科團隊的主任。

words.zh: n. 交換, (電話)交換局, 交換機, 匯兌, 交易所；v. 交換, 交易, 兌換；[計] 交換; 電話局
words.example: There was a brief exchange of notes between the doctors.
words.example_zh: 醫生之間簡短地交換了筆記。

words.zh: n. 應用, 申請, 志願書, 應用程式；[計] 應用, 應用程式
words.example: He filled in an application for the clinical trial.
words.example_zh: 他填了一份參加臨床試驗的申請書。

words.zh: n. 濫用, 虐待, 惡習, 辱罵；vt. 濫用, 辱罵, 虐待
words.example: Long-term abuse of painkillers can damage the liver.
words.example_zh: 長期濫用止痛藥會損害肝臟。

words.zh: n. 期間, 開庭期, 會議, 學期；[計] 會話, 對話, 會晤, 通用任務程式
words.example: Each therapy session lasts about fifty minutes.
words.example_zh: 每次治療療程約持續五十分鐘。

words.zh: n. 票, 券, 車票, 標籤, 入場券, 證明書；vt. 加標籤於, 為...購票
words.example: She bought a ticket for the night train home.
words.example_zh: 她買了一張回家的夜車車票。

words.zh: v. 探險, 探測, 探究
words.example: Doctors will explore other options if the drug fails.
words.example_zh: 若藥物無效，醫生會探究其他選項。

words.zh: n. 綜合體, 情結, 絡合物；a. 複雜的, 組合的
words.example: The brain is the most complex organ in the body.
words.example_zh: 大腦是人體中最複雜的器官。

words.zh: n. 靈魂, 心靈, 精神, 精髓, 人, 化身, 典型, 鬼魂；a. 黑人的
words.example: Music seemed to lift the patient's weary soul.
words.example_zh: 音樂似乎振奮了病人疲憊的心靈。

words.zh: n. 熊；vt. 忍受, 支承, 產生, 懷有, 通過賣空使跌價；vi. 忍受, 結果實, 壓擠, 行進, 轉向
words.example: She could no longer bear the pain in her knee.
words.example_zh: 她再也無法忍受膝蓋的疼痛。

words.zh: n. 結果, 重要性；[法] 結果, 後果, 推斷
words.example: Ignoring the symptoms had a serious consequence.
words.example_zh: 忽視這些症狀造成了嚴重的後果。

words.zh: n. 平衡, 差額；vi. 平衡, 相等；vt. 稱, 權衡, 比較, 使平衡, 結算, 抵消
words.example: Good health depends on a balance of diet and exercise.
words.example_zh: 健康有賴於飲食與運動的平衡。

words.zh: vt. 採用, 正式通過, 收養, 接受；[醫] 採取
words.example: The hospital decided to adopt the new safety system.
words.example_zh: 醫院決定採用新的安全系統。

words.zh: n. 直線, 直；a. 直的, 筆直的, 正直的, 直接的, 連續的, 整齊的；adv. 直接地, 立即, 不斷地
words.example: Keep your back straight to avoid injury.
words.example_zh: 保持背部挺直以避免受傷。

words.zh: a. 空的, 空虛的, 空腹的, 空洞的；n. 空的東西, 空車；vt. 倒空, 使變空, 使排出；vi. 流空；[計] 空
words.example: Take this medicine on an empty stomach.
words.example_zh: 這種藥要空腹服用。

words.zh: vt. 承認, 告知收悉, 答謝, 報償；[經] 承認, 答謝, 收到的通知
words.example: The doctor acknowledged that the diagnosis was wrong.
words.example_zh: 醫生承認診斷有誤。

words.zh: n. 暴風雨, 騷動, 風波, 風暴, 猛攻；vi. 起風, 猛衝, 怒吼；vt. 猛攻
words.example: The storm knocked out power to the entire hospital.
words.example_zh: 暴風雨使整間醫院停電。

words.zh: n. 收入, 歲入, 稅收, 稅務局；[經] 歲入, 稅收, 稅務局
words.example: The clinic's revenue grew after it expanded.
words.example_zh: 診所擴張後，收入有所成長。

words.zh: n. 包裹, 套裝軟體, 包, 包裝用物, 程式包；vt. 包裝, 打包；a. 一攬子的；[計] 包, 軟體包, 包裝
words.example: The benefits package includes free health checks.
words.example_zh: 這份福利方案包含免費健康檢查。

words.zh: n. 趨勢, 傾向, 走向；vi. 傾向, 轉向；[計] 趨勢
words.example: There is a worrying trend of obesity among children.
words.example_zh: 兒童肥胖出現了令人擔憂的趨勢。

words.zh: n. 利潤, 贏利, 利益；vi. 有益, 獲利, 賺錢；vt. 有益於
words.example: The hospital is run for care, not for profit.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院以照護為宗旨，不以營利為目的。

words.zh: a. 獨一無二的, 獨特的, 稀罕的
words.example: Every patient's case is unique in some way.
words.example_zh: 每位病人的病例在某方面都是獨一無二的。

words.zh: vt. 賞識, 鑑別, 為...而感激, 領會, 欣賞；vi. 增值, 漲價
words.example: Patients appreciate a doctor who listens carefully.
words.example_zh: 病人欣賞會仔細傾聽的醫生。

words.zh: adv. 剛剛, 幾乎不, 勉強是
words.example: She had hardly slept for three nights.
words.example_zh: 她已經三個晚上幾乎沒睡。

words.zh: vt. 追趕, 追蹤, 追隨, 追求, 實行, 繼續, 從事；vi. 追趕, 繼續
words.example: He decided to pursue a career in medicine.
words.example_zh: 他決定追求醫學方面的事業。

words.zh: n. 外科, 手術, 手術室, 換球術
words.example: She is recovering well after major heart surgery.
words.example_zh: 她在重大心臟手術後恢復良好。

words.zh: a. 保守的, 守舊的, 有儲存力的；[化] 防腐劑; 儲存劑
words.example: The doctor took a conservative approach and avoided surgery.
words.example_zh: 醫生採取保守的做法，避免動手術。

words.zh: n. 分, 分開, 除法, 部門(如部、處、系等), 師；[計] 部分
words.example: He works in the cardiology division of the hospital.
words.example_zh: 他在醫院的心臟科部門工作。

words.zh: vt. 證實, 確定, 批准, 使鞏固；[計] 確認
words.example: A second test was needed to confirm the diagnosis.
words.example_zh: 需要第二次檢查來確認診斷。

words.zh: n. 秘密, 機密, 秘訣, 秘方；a. 秘密的, 極機密的, 隱蔽的, 暗中的, 神秘的, 偏僻的
words.example: Keeping a patient's records secret is a legal duty.
words.example_zh: 為病人保密病歷是一項法律義務。

words.zh: n. 捆綁物, 結合, 債券, 契約, 粘合劑, 保證人, 鍵, 關棧保留；vt. 存入關棧, 使黏合；vi. 結合
words.example: A strong bond formed between the nurse and the child.
words.example_zh: 護理師與孩子之間建立了深厚的情誼。

words.zh: n. 冊, 卷, 體積, 容量, 大量, 許多, 份量, 音量；vi. 成團捲起；vt. 把...收整合卷；a. 大量的；[計] 卷
words.example: The patient lost a large volume of blood.
words.example_zh: 病人失去了大量的血。

words.zh: n. 插入, 介入, 調停；[經] 干預
words.example: Early intervention can prevent the disease from worsening.
words.example_zh: 早期介入能防止病情惡化。

words.zh: n. 字首, 首字母；a. 開始的, 最初的, 字首的；vt. 用姓名的首字母簽名
words.example: The initial symptoms were mild and easy to miss.
words.example_zh: 最初的症狀輕微，容易被忽略。

words.zh: a. 有限制的, 有限的, 有限責任的；n. 特別快車
words.example: There is only limited evidence that the herb works.
words.example_zh: 這種草藥有效的證據相當有限。

words.zh: n. 浪費, 廢物, 損耗, 消耗, 荒地, 垃圾, 地面風化物；a. 廢棄的, 荒蕪的, 多餘的；vt. 浪費, 消耗, 使荒蕪；vi. 浪費, 消耗, 變消瘦
words.example: The clinic disposes of medical waste with great care.
words.example_zh: 診所非常謹慎地處理醫療廢棄物。

words.zh: adv. 明確無疑地, 清楚地
words.example: The scan definitely shows a fracture.
words.example_zh: 這張掃描明確顯示有骨折。

words.zh: n. 立法, 法律；[醫] 立法, 法規
words.example: New legislation requires clearer drug labels.
words.example_zh: 新法規要求藥品標示更清楚。

words.zh: n. 演員陣容, 投擲, 鑄件, 預測, 特性；vt. 投, 擲, 拋, 脫落, 鑄, 使彎曲, 計算；vi. 投, 計算, 澆鑄成型
words.example: His broken arm was set in a plaster cast.
words.example_zh: 他斷掉的手臂打上了石膏。

words.zh: n. 高度, 海拔, 高地, 頂點；[化] 高度
words.example: Her height and weight were recorded at the checkup.
words.example_zh: 健檢時記錄了她的身高與體重。

words.zh: n. 加法, 增加的人(或物)；[計] 加法
words.example: The new wing was a welcome addition to the hospital.
words.example_zh: 新側翼是醫院樂見的增建。

words.zh: n. 半升音調, 利刃, 騙子；a. 鋒利的, 明顯的, 敏銳的, 急劇的, 尖刻的, 嚴厲的, 刺耳的, 精明的；adv. 銳利地, 急速地
words.example: She felt a sharp pain in her lower abdomen.
words.example_zh: 她下腹部感到一陣劇痛。

words.zh: vt. 贊同, 核准, 為...提供證據；vi. 讚許
words.example: The agency was slow to approve the new vaccine.
words.example_zh: 該機構遲遲未核准這款新疫苗。

words.zh: vt. 獲得, 學到；[電] 目標鎖定
words.example: Patients can acquire infections during a long hospital stay.
words.example_zh: 病人在長期住院期間可能感染疾病。

words.zh: n. 顯示, 陳列, 炫耀, 顯示器；vt. 陳列, 顯示, 表現, 誇示；[計] 顯示器; 顯示
words.example: The monitor displays the patient's heart rate.
words.example_zh: 螢幕顯示病人的心跳速率。

words.zh: n. 不景氣, 消沉, 沮喪, 窪地；[醫] 抑鬱[症], 阻抑, 壓低, 凹, 窩, 衰退, 俯角
words.example: After the loss, she sank into a deep depression.
words.example_zh: 失去親人後，她陷入深深的憂鬱。

words.zh: n. 被懷疑者, 嫌疑犯；a. 令人懷疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的；v. 懷疑, 猜想
words.example: Doctors suspect the rash is caused by an allergy.
words.example_zh: 醫生懷疑這疹子是過敏引起的。

words.zh: n. 請求, 需要, 申請書；vt. 請求, 要求, 邀請；[計] 請求
words.example: The patient made a request to see her own records.
words.example_zh: 病人提出要求，想查看自己的病歷。

words.zh: vt. 重新獲得, 恢復, 復原, 拯救；vi. 痊癒, 復原, 勝訴；[計] 恢復
words.example: It took months for him to recover from the surgery.
words.example_zh: 他花了好幾個月才從手術中康復。

words.zh: [電] 剩餘的
words.example: The remaining tablets should be returned to the pharmacy.
words.example_zh: 剩下的藥片應退還給藥局。

words.zh: n. 比較, 對照, 比喻；[經] 比較, 對比
words.example: In comparison with last year, infections have dropped.
words.example_zh: 與去年相比，感染人數下降了。

words.zh: a. 立即的, 直接的, 接近的；[醫] 直接的, 立即的
words.example: The drug gave immediate relief from the pain.
words.example_zh: 這種藥立刻緩解了疼痛。

words.zh: vt. 使轉換, 改變, 改造, 使...變形；vi. 改變, 轉化, 變換；[計] 變換
words.example: New drugs have transformed the treatment of the disease.
words.example_zh: 新藥徹底改變了這種疾病的治療方式。

words.zh: n. 大氣, 空氣, 氣氛；[醫] 大氣; 大氣壓
words.example: The ward had a calm and reassuring atmosphere.
words.example_zh: 病房裡有種平靜而令人安心的氣氛。

words.zh: n. 哲學, 人生觀, 哲學思想, 哲理, 基本原理, 見解, 達觀, 沉著
words.example: Her philosophy is that prevention beats cure.
words.example_zh: 她的理念是預防勝於治療。

words.zh: n. 減少, 縮影, 變化；[化] 還原
words.example: The new program led to a sharp reduction in errors.
words.example_zh: 新計畫使錯誤大幅減少。

words.zh: n. 物質, 實質, 主旨, 資產, 本質, 牢固；[化] 物質
words.example: The bottle was labeled as a hazardous substance.
words.example_zh: 瓶子上標示為危險物質。

words.zh: a. 實際的, 現實的, 實用性的；[法] 事實上的, 實際上的, 接近...的
words.example: The course offers practical training in the ward.
words.example_zh: 這門課提供病房中的實務訓練。

words.zh: a. 非常的, 強烈的, 緊張的, 熱情的；[醫] 強的
words.example: She felt intense pain just before the operation.
words.example_zh: 手術前她感到劇烈的疼痛。

words.zh: n. 前進, 進展, 行過的路程；vi. 前進, 進展, 提高, 上漲；vt. 使前進, 促進, 提出, 提高, 使提前, 預付；a. 前面的, 預先的
words.example: Recent advances in medicine have saved countless lives.
words.example_zh: 醫學近年的進展拯救了無數生命。

words.zh: v. 支配, 佔優勢
words.example: One symptom came to dominate all the others.
words.example_zh: 有一個症狀變得比其他所有症狀都明顯。

words.zh: vt. 分析, 細察, 分解；[機] 分析
words.example: The lab will analyze the sample for bacteria.
words.example_zh: 實驗室會分析這個樣本是否含有細菌。

words.zh: n. 災禍, 不幸, 徹底失敗
words.example: The outbreak turned into a public health disaster.
words.example_zh: 這場疫情演變成公共衛生的災難。

words.zh: n. 景色, 展望；vt. 勘探, 勘察；vi. 勘探, 有前途
words.example: The prospect of surgery frightened the young patient.
words.example_zh: 手術的前景嚇壞了這名年輕病人。

words.zh: n. 基本原理, 原則, 基波；a. 基本的, 重要的, 原音的
words.example: Hand washing is a fundamental rule of hygiene.
words.example_zh: 洗手是衛生的基本準則。

words.zh: a. 嚴格的, 尖銳的, 嚴肅的, 嚴重的, 嚴厲的, 樸素的；[法] 嚴厲的, 苛刻的, 嚴重的
words.example: He was admitted with severe chest pain.
words.example_zh: 他因劇烈胸痛而入院。

words.zh: vt. 提高, 加強, 增加
words.example: The new lens enhances the clarity of the scan.
words.example_zh: 新鏡頭提升了掃描的清晰度。

words.zh: vt. 徵(稅), 把...強加於, 以...欺騙；vi. 利用, 欺騙, 施加影響
words.example: The hospital had to impose strict visiting limits.
words.example_zh: 醫院不得不實施嚴格的探病限制。

words.zh: n. 強調, 加強, 重點, 強語氣
words.example: The training places great emphasis on patient safety.
words.example_zh: 這項訓練非常強調病人安全。

words.zh: vt. 舉例說明, 作圖解, 闡明；vi. 舉例說明
words.example: The diagram illustrates how blood flows through the heart.
words.example_zh: 這張圖說明血液如何流經心臟。

words.zh: n. 委任狀, 任官令, 所委職責, 佣金, 犯, 委託, 所託之事；vt. 委任, 委託製作, 使服役
words.example: An independent commission reviewed the clinic's records.
words.example_zh: 一個獨立委員會審查了診所的紀錄。

words.zh: n. 赤字, 不足額；[醫] 短缺
words.example: The tests revealed a deficit in his short-term memory.
words.example_zh: 檢查顯示他的短期記憶有缺損。

words.zh: n. 牽連, 含義, 暗示；[法] 推斷, 含蓄之意, 暗示
words.example: The result has serious implications for her treatment.
words.example_zh: 這個結果對她的治療有重大的影響。

words.zh: a. 永久的, 不變的, 固定的, 持久的；n. 燙髮；[計] 永久的
words.example: The injury left him with permanent nerve damage.
words.example_zh: 這次受傷讓他留下永久的神經損傷。

words.zh: adv. 逐字地, 按照字面上地, 不誇張地
words.example: He was literally too weak to lift a spoon.
words.example_zh: 他真的虛弱到連湯匙都舉不起來。

words.zh: vt. 構造, 建造, 對...進行構思, 作圖；n. 構成物
words.example: Workers will construct a new wing for the clinic.
words.example_zh: 工人將為診所興建一座新側翼。

words.zh: a. 無慮的, 安心的, 安全的, 可靠的, 保險的；vt. 固定, 獲得, 保證, 使安全, 掩護, 招致；vi. 停止操作, 船拋錨
words.example: Make sure the bandage is secure before moving.
words.example_zh: 移動前確保繃帶固定牢靠。

words.zh: vt. 安裝, 安置, 使就職；[計] 安裝, 安裝程式; DOS內部命令:安裝常駐程式
words.example: Engineers came to install the new scanner.
words.example_zh: 工程師前來安裝新的掃描儀。

words.zh: a. 侵略的, 挑畔的, 進取的；[法] 侵略的, 愛挑釁的, 行為過火的
words.example: The cancer was aggressive and spread quickly.
words.example_zh: 這種癌症具侵略性，擴散得很快。

words.zh: n. 贊成, 批准；[化] 核准
words.example: The drug is still waiting for government approval.
words.example_zh: 這種藥仍在等待政府核准。

words.zh: a. 傳統的, 習慣的, 約定的；[經] 慣例的, 常規的, 傳統的
words.example: They tried conventional medicine before herbal remedies.
words.example_zh: 他們先嘗試了傳統醫學，才用草藥療法。

words.zh: n. 常規, 日常工作, 慣例, 例行公事；a. 日常的, 常規的；[計] 例程
words.example: A blood test is part of the routine checkup.
words.example_zh: 抽血是例行健檢的一部分。

words.zh: n. 成分, 因素；[化] 配合劑; 拼料; 成分; 組分
words.example: Sugar is the main ingredient in the cough syrup.
words.example_zh: 糖是這款咳嗽糖漿的主要成分。

words.zh: n. 假定, 自負, 擔任, 假裝；[經] 假定, 承擔
words.example: The treatment was based on a false assumption.
words.example_zh: 這項治療建立在一個錯誤的假設上。

words.zh: a. 遠的, 疏遠的；[經] 遠期的
words.example: The pain spread to a distant part of the body.
words.example_zh: 疼痛蔓延到身體較遠的部位。

words.zh: n. 戲劇, 戲劇藝術；戲劇性事件、波折
words.example: The recovery was full of unexpected drama.
words.example_zh: 這段康復過程充滿了意想不到的波折。

words.zh: n. 掃除, 打掃, 肅清, 視野, 範圍, 全勝；vt. 掃除, 撣去, 猛拉, 掃蕩, 肅清, 沖走, 颳起, 環視, 掠過, 掃射；vi. 掃, 打掃, 襲擊, 席捲, 掃視
words.example: Nurses sweep the ward for hazards every morning.
words.example_zh: 護理師每天早上巡查病房，排除危險。

words.zh: n. 天花板；[經] 頂點, 頂線, 上限
words.example: The patient stared blankly at the ceiling.
words.example_zh: 病人茫然地盯著天花板。

words.zh: n. 肖像, 人像, 半身像, 描寫, 豎排格式；[計] 縱向
words.example: A portrait of the founder hung in the lobby.
words.example_zh: 創辦人的肖像掛在大廳裡。

words.zh: n. 負擔, 過載, 擔子, 責任；vt. 裝貨於, 煩擾, 使負擔
words.example: Chronic illness places a heavy burden on families.
words.example_zh: 慢性病為家庭帶來沉重的負擔。

words.zh: n. 合作, 協力, 配合；[化] 合作
words.example: Recovery requires close cooperation with the doctor.
words.example_zh: 康復需要與醫生密切配合。

words.zh: n. 側面, 輪廓, 傳略；vt. 描繪...輪廓, 寫...的傳略；[計] 提問檔; 剖面圖法; 剖面法
words.example: Her risk profile suggested a higher chance of stroke.
words.example_zh: 她的風險概況顯示中風的機率較高。

words.zh: n. 機械, 機構, 結構, 機理, 技巧；[化] 機理; 歷程; 機構
words.example: Scientists studied the mechanism behind the disease.
words.example_zh: 科學家研究這種疾病背後的機制。

words.zh: n. 破壞, 毀滅；[醫] 破壞
words.example: The disease causes the destruction of healthy tissue.
words.example_zh: 這種疾病會造成健康組織的破壞。

words.zh: adv. 最初, 開頭
words.example: Initially the symptoms seemed harmless.
words.example_zh: 起初這些症狀似乎無害。

words.zh: a. 太陽的, 日光的, 源自太陽的；[醫] 太陽的; 腹腔叢的
words.example: Solar panels now power the rural clinic.
words.example_zh: 太陽能板現在為這間鄉村診所供電。

words.zh: n. 望遠鏡；vi. 疊縮, 嵌進, 縮短；vt. 使疊縮, 使縮短
words.example: Astronomers used a telescope to study the comet.
words.example_zh: 天文學家用望遠鏡研究這顆彗星。

words.zh: n. 比賽, 競賽, 錦標賽, 聯賽
words.example: He injured his knee during a tennis tournament.
words.example_zh: 他在一場網球錦標賽中傷了膝蓋。

words.zh: vt. 發現, 察覺, 探測；[法] 發現, 查明, 探測
words.example: The scan can detect tumors at an early stage.
words.example_zh: 這項掃描能在早期偵測出腫瘤。

words.zh: a. 遙遠的, 偏僻的, 疏遠的, 微少的；[計] 遠端, 遠端訪問實用程式
words.example: The doctor advises patients in remote villages by phone.
words.example_zh: 醫生透過電話為偏遠村莊的病人看診。

words.zh: n. 保護, 儲存；[醫] 儲存
words.example: Energy conservation is vital for a weakened patient.
words.example_zh: 對虛弱的病人來說，保存體力至關重要。

words.zh: vt. 替...辯護, 證明；vi. 證明合法；[計] 段落重排, 兩端對齊
words.example: The small benefit did not justify the risks of surgery.
words.example_zh: 那一點點效益不足以證明手術的風險是值得的。

words.zh: adv. 本來, 原來, 最初, 就起源而論, 獨創地
words.example: The drug was originally developed to treat malaria.
words.example_zh: 這種藥原本是為治療瘧疾而開發的。

words.zh: a. 更重要的, 較早的, 在先的；n. 小隱修院院長, 大隱修院副院長
words.example: Tell the doctor about any prior allergic reactions.
words.example_zh: 告訴醫生你先前是否有過敏反應。

words.zh: n. 有知識者, 知識分子, 憑理智做事者；a. 智力的, 用腦力的, 聰明的
words.example: The illness slowly affected his intellectual abilities.
words.example_zh: 這種疾病慢慢影響了他的智力。

words.zh: n. 攻擊, 襲擊；vt. 襲擊, 攻擊；vi. 發動攻擊
words.example: The patient survived a brutal assault.
words.example_zh: 病人在一場殘暴的攻擊中倖存下來。

words.zh: n. 論爭, 辯論, 論戰, 爭論；[法] 論戰, 爭論, 爭吵
words.example: The new treatment sparked a heated controversy.
words.example_zh: 這項新療法引發了激烈的爭議。

words.zh: vi. 褪色, 消失, 凋謝；vt. 使褪色；n. 淡入, 淡出；a. 平淡的
words.example: The bruise will slowly fade over two weeks.
words.example_zh: 瘀青會在兩週內慢慢褪去。

words.zh: n. 面具, 假面具, 掩飾, 石膏面模；vt. 戴面具, 掩飾, 使模糊；vi. 化裝, 戴面具, 掩飾, 參加化裝舞會；[計] 遮蔽; 掩碼
words.example: Wearing a mask reduces the spread of the virus.
words.example_zh: 戴口罩能減少病毒的傳播。

words.zh: v. 假裝, 偽稱, 自命, 自稱
words.example: The child pretended that the medicine tasted fine.
words.example_zh: 孩子假裝藥很好喝。

words.zh: n. 表示法, 表現, 陳述, 代表；[計] 表示法指定
words.example: The chart gives a clear representation of the data.
words.example_zh: 這張圖清楚地呈現了數據。

words.zh: n. 發射, 射出, 發行；[醫] 發射, 遺精
words.example: The factory's emission of fumes harmed local health.
words.example_zh: 工廠排放的煙霧危害了當地居民的健康。

words.zh: n. 區別
words.example: There is an important distinction between the two diseases.
words.example_zh: 這兩種疾病之間有重要的區別。

words.zh: n. 片段, 部分, 分節, 段；v. 分割, 分裂；[計] 段
words.example: Only a small segment of patients had side effects.
words.example_zh: 只有一小部分病人出現副作用。

words.zh: n. 變更, 變化, 變種, 變奏；[醫] 變異, 變易; 變度
words.example: There is wide variation in how patients respond.
words.example_zh: 病人的反應差異很大。

words.zh: n. 激進分子, 詞根, 基礎, 根式, 根；a. 激進的, 根本的, 基本的, 根的
words.example: The doctor suggested a radical change in his diet.
words.example_zh: 醫生建議他的飲食做出徹底的改變。

words.zh: vt. 使適應, 改編；vi. 適應
words.example: The body slowly adapts to the high altitude.
words.example_zh: 身體會慢慢適應高海拔。

words.zh: n. 安定, 穩定性, 堅實, 鞏固；[化] 穩定性
words.example: The patient's stability allowed the team to operate.
words.example_zh: 病人狀況穩定，讓團隊得以動手術。

words.zh: a. 前進的, 進行的, 不間斷的；n. 前進, 發展
words.example: She is receiving ongoing care for her condition.
words.example_zh: 她的病況正接受持續的照護。

words.zh: n. 蔭, 陰暗, 遮光物, 燈罩, 簾, 濃淡, 微量, 底紋；vi. 漸變；vt. 使陰暗, 使漸變, 遮蔽, 微減；[計] 底紋
words.example: He rested in the shade after feeling faint.
words.example_zh: 他感到頭暈後在陰涼處休息。

words.zh: n. 義務, 責任, 約束, 契約, 恩惠, 債務；[經] 待付款, 債務, 義務
words.example: A doctor has an obligation to keep patients informed.
words.example_zh: 醫生有義務讓病人知情。

words.zh: n. 作文, 創作, 組成；[化] 成分; 組成
words.example: The lab studied the chemical composition of the stone.
words.example_zh: 實驗室研究了這顆結石的化學組成。

words.zh: vt. 使滿意, 滿足, 符合, 使確信, 賠償；vi. 令人滿意, 替人贖罪
words.example: The results were enough to satisfy the cautious doctor.
words.example_zh: 這些結果足以讓謹慎的醫生放心。

words.zh: vt. 消耗, 消費, 消滅；vi. 耗盡, 毀滅
words.example: Patients should not consume alcohol with this drug.
words.example_zh: 服用這種藥時病人不應飲酒。

words.zh: n. 頻率, 頻數；[計] 頻率
words.example: The frequency of his seizures slowly decreased.
words.example_zh: 他癲癇發作的頻率慢慢降低。

words.zh: vt. 相似, 類似
words.example: The rash can resemble an ordinary insect bite.
words.example_zh: 這種疹子可能看起來像普通的蟲咬。

words.zh: a. 爭論的, 論爭的, 被議論的
words.example: The controversial drug was pulled from the market.
words.example_zh: 這款引發爭議的藥被撤出市場。

words.zh: a. 不顧一切的, 危急的, 令人絕望的, 極渴望的
words.example: The family was desperate for any kind of cure.
words.example_zh: 這家人迫切渴望任何能治癒的方法。

words.zh: n. 筆劃, 打, 中風, 撫, 摩, 衝程；vt. 劃尾槳, 撫, 摩, 劃去；[計] 筆劃
words.example: He lost the use of his left arm after a stroke.
words.example_zh: 中風後他的左臂失去了功能。

words.zh: n. 少數, 一把, 棘手事
words.example: Only a handful of patients reported the side effect.
words.example_zh: 只有少數幾名病人回報了這項副作用。

words.zh: a. 好奇的, 求知的, 古怪的
words.example: The student was curious about how the drug worked.
words.example_zh: 這名學生對這種藥的作用機制感到好奇。

words.zh: n. 激勵, 提示, 提醒物, 提詞, 付款期限；a. 迅速的, 敏捷的, 立刻的, 提詞員的；vt. 激勵, 鼓動, 提示；adv. 準時地；[計] 提示符; DOS內部命令:設
words.example: Prompt treatment saved the patient's leg.
words.example_zh: 及時的治療保住了病人的腿。

words.zh: n. 滋味, 調味品；vt. 加味於
words.example: The syrup has an artificial cherry flavor.
words.example_zh: 這款糖漿有人工櫻桃口味。

words.zh: vt. 俯瞰, 遠眺, 沒注意到；n. 眺望, 俯瞰到的景色
words.example: It is easy to overlook the early warning signs.
words.example_zh: 早期的警訊很容易被忽略。

words.zh: n. 示範, 實證；[醫] 示教, 實物教授
words.example: The nurse gave a demonstration of how to inject insulin.
words.example_zh: 護理師示範了如何注射胰島素。

words.zh: n. 消費, 消費量, 癆病；[化] 消耗量; 耗量
words.example: Excessive salt consumption raises blood pressure.
words.example_zh: 過量攝取鹽分會使血壓升高。

words.zh: a. 絕對的, 專制的, 完全的, 獨立的；n. 絕對事物
words.example: There is no absolute guarantee that the drug will work.
words.example_zh: 沒有絕對的保證說這種藥一定有效。

words.zh: a. 令人不快的, 侮辱的, 攻擊性的；[法] 攻擊的, 進攻的, 冒犯的
words.example: The wound gave off an offensive smell.
words.example_zh: 傷口散發出令人作嘔的氣味。

words.zh: vt. 任命, 指定, 下令；[法] 派, 派任, 任命
words.example: The board will appoint a new head of surgery.
words.example_zh: 董事會將任命新的外科主任。

words.zh: a. 佔優勢的, 支配的；[醫] 優性的, 顯性的
words.example: Brown eyes are caused by a dominant gene.
words.example_zh: 棕色眼睛是由顯性基因決定的。

words.zh: n. 延長, 擴充, 範圍, 副檔名；a. 伸縮的；[計] 副檔名, 擴充名
words.example: She was given an extension to finish her training.
words.example_zh: 她獲准延長時間以完成訓練。

words.zh: n. 聳肩；v. 聳肩
words.example: The doctor gave a helpless shrug at the question.
words.example_zh: 面對這個問題，醫生無奈地聳了聳肩。

words.zh: a. 合法的, 正當的, 婚生的；vt. 認為正當, 立為嫡嗣, 使合法
words.example: Pain relief is a legitimate reason to see a doctor.
words.example_zh: 緩解疼痛是看醫生的正當理由。

words.zh: n. 崩潰, 倒塌, 虛脫；vi. 倒塌, 崩潰, 瓦解；vt. 使倒塌, 摺疊；[計] 摺疊
words.example: He suffered a sudden collapse at work.
words.example_zh: 他在工作時突然昏倒。

words.zh: n. 抵押, 約束性義務, 抵押借款；vt. 抵押, 以...作擔保, 把...許給
words.example: The young couple took out a mortgage on their first home.
words.example_zh: 這對年輕夫妻為他們的第一間房子辦了房貸。

words.zh: vt. 抓住, 逮捕, 俘獲, 沒收, 扣押, 掌握；vi. 突然抓住, 利用
words.example: Paramedics had to seize the moment to restart his heart.
words.example_zh: 醫護人員必須把握時機讓他的心臟恢復跳動。

words.zh: n. 道德規範；[醫] 倫理學
words.example: Medical ethics require honesty with every patient.
words.example_zh: 醫學倫理要求對每位病人誠實。

words.zh: n. 酸, 酸類物質, 尖刻, 迷幻藥；a. 酸的, 酸性的, 尖刻的, 敏銳的；[計] 自動文件互參與索引生成程式
words.example: Too much stomach acid can cause a painful ulcer.
words.example_zh: 胃酸過多可能導致疼痛的潰瘍。

words.zh: vt. 勸, 使相信, 懇求, 敦促, 說服；vi. 勸服, 被說服
words.example: It took hours to persuade him to take the medicine.
words.example_zh: 花了好幾個小時才說服他服藥。

words.zh: a. 後來的, 接下去的；[經] 後來的
words.example: The first dose was fine, but a subsequent one caused a rash.
words.example_zh: 第一劑沒問題，但後續一劑引起了疹子。

words.zh: n. 合意, 一致, 同感；[計] 合意
words.example: The doctors reached a consensus on the treatment plan.
words.example_zh: 醫生們對治療方案達成了共識。

words.zh: a. 記錄的, 記錄用的；n. 錄音
words.example: A recording of the heartbeat was saved for review.
words.example_zh: 心跳的錄音被保存下來以供檢視。

words.zh: n. 敗北, 失敗；vt. 擊敗, 使落空
words.example: Early detection can mean defeat for the disease.
words.example_zh: 早期發現可能意味著戰勝這種疾病。

words.zh: vt. 加強, 增援, 補充；vi. 求援, 得到增援；n. 加固材料
words.example: The good results reinforce the case for the new drug.
words.example_zh: 這些良好的結果強化了採用新藥的理由。

words.zh: a. 認知的, 認識的
words.example: The illness caused a slow cognitive decline.
words.example_zh: 這種疾病造成緩慢的認知衰退。

words.zh: n. 屬性, 標誌, 定語；vt. 把...歸於, 認為...屬於；[計] 屬性
words.example: She attributes her recovery to a positive attitude.
words.example_zh: 她把康復歸功於正向的心態。

words.zh: n. 容器, 集裝箱；[化] 集裝箱; 貯存箱; 容器(任何一種)
words.example: Store the tablets in their original container.
words.example_zh: 藥片請存放在原本的容器裡。

words.zh: n. 儀式, 典禮, 宗教儀式；a. 儀式的, 依儀式進行的
words.example: Hand washing became a daily ritual on the ward.
words.example_zh: 洗手成了病房裡每天的例行儀式。

words.zh: n. 爭鬥, 戰鬥；vi. 戰鬥, 爭鬥；vt. 與...戰鬥, 與...鬥爭
words.example: New antibiotics are needed to combat resistant bacteria.
words.example_zh: 需要新的抗生素來對抗抗藥性細菌。

words.zh: n. 莖, 幹, 柄, 船首, 血統, 堵塞物；vt. 摘掉莖, 裝柄於, 阻止, 堵住, 逆行；vi. 堵住, 逆行
words.example: Doctors worked quickly to stem the bleeding.
words.example_zh: 醫生迅速行動以止血。

words.zh: n. 正直, 廉正, 完整；[計] 完整性
words.example: The integrity of the bone was checked with an X-ray.
words.example_zh: 以 X 光檢查骨骼的完整性。

words.zh: n. 相反, 背面, 倒退, 挫折, 失敗；a. 反面的, 相反的, 反向的, 顛倒的；vt. 使顛倒, 使逆轉, 使倒退, 使反向；vi. 倒退, 反向, 倒轉, 反轉；[計]
words.example: Quitting smoking can reverse some of the damage.
words.example_zh: 戒菸能逆轉部分的傷害。

words.zh: n. 人性, 人類, 博愛
words.example: She treated every patient with warmth and humanity.
words.example_zh: 她以溫暖與人性對待每一位病人。

words.zh: a. 管理的, 行政的；[法] 行政的, 管理的, 遺產管理的
words.example: Doctors spend too many hours on administrative tasks.
words.example_zh: 醫生花太多時間在行政事務上。

words.zh: n. 市郊住宅區, 郊區, 邊緣
words.example: The new hospital was built in a quiet suburb.
words.example_zh: 新醫院蓋在一個寧靜的市郊。

words.zh: vt. 限制, 限定, 約束；[醫] 限制
words.example: The diet restricts the amount of salt you may eat.
words.example_zh: 這種飲食法限制你能攝取的鹽量。

words.zh: n. 欺騙, 欺詐, 詭計, 騙子；[經] 欺詐, 舞弊, 騙子
words.example: He was charged with insurance fraud.
words.example_zh: 他被控保險詐欺。

words.zh: vi. 奮鬥, 鬥爭, 競爭；vt. 為...鬥爭
words.example: Many patients have to contend with chronic pain.
words.example_zh: 許多病人必須與慢性疼痛搏鬥。

words.zh: vt. 集合, 收集, 裝配；vi. 集合；[計] 彙編
words.example: The team assembled quickly for the emergency surgery.
words.example_zh: 團隊迅速集結，準備進行緊急手術。

words.zh: n. 破裂, 突發, 爆發；v. 爆裂, 突發, 充滿；[計] 二進位制位組; 字元組; 脈衝串
words.example: The appendix can burst if surgery is delayed.
words.example_zh: 若延誤手術，闌尾可能會破裂。

words.zh: a. 不可避免的, 必然的；[法] 不可避免的, 無法規避的, 必然的
words.example: With such an injury, some scarring is inevitable.
words.example_zh: 這樣的傷勢，留下一些疤痕是無法避免的。

words.zh: vt. 使容易, 促進, 幫助；[法] 使容易, 使便利, 推進
words.example: A clear chart can facilitate a faster diagnosis.
words.example_zh: 清楚的圖表能促成更快的診斷。

words.zh: n. 障礙, 妨害物, 阻礙
words.example: Fear of needles is a common obstacle to treatment.
words.example_zh: 怕打針是治療上常見的障礙。

words.zh: n. 執行, 經營, 起訴
words.example: The clinic faced prosecution for the safety breach.
words.example_zh: 這間診所因違反安全規定而面臨起訴。

words.zh: n. 改革, 創新；[法] 創新, 改革, 重新整理
words.example: The device was a major innovation in heart surgery.
words.example_zh: 這項裝置是心臟手術上的一大創新。

words.zh: n. 緊張, 拉緊, 張力, 過勞, 扭傷, 血緣, 種, 族, 氣質, 曲調, 旋律, 口吻；vt. 使勞累, 拉緊, 過分使用, 扭傷, 濫用, 曲解, 濾；vi. 盡力, 努
words.example: He lifted the box badly and felt a sharp strain in his back.
words.example_zh: 他抬箱子的姿勢不對，背部感到一陣劇烈的拉傷。

words.zh: vt. 修正, 變更, 修飾, 緩和, 減輕；vi. 被修改；[計] 修改
words.example: The doctor modified the dose to reduce side effects.
words.example_zh: 醫生調整了劑量以減少副作用。

words.zh: n. 緊握, 柄, 握力, 握手方式, 手提包, 掌握, 支配, 控制；vt. 抓緊, 抱住, 吸住, 掌握；vi. 握牢, 有吸引力
words.example: She kept a firm grip on the handrail while walking.
words.example_zh: 她走路時緊緊抓著扶手。

words.zh: n. 修辭, 修辭學, 雄辯(術)
words.example: His speech was full of fine rhetoric but few facts.
words.example_zh: 他的演說滿是華麗的辭藻，卻少有事實。

words.zh: n. 命令, 指令, 要求；vt. 委任統治
words.example: The new law gives the agency a mandate to inspect clinics.
words.example_zh: 新法賦予該機構檢查診所的職權。

words.zh: n. 帆布, 畫布, 油畫；[化] 帆布
words.example: The artist stretched a fresh canvas before painting.
words.example_zh: 畫家在作畫前繃好一塊新的畫布。

words.zh: a. 極深的, 深厚的, 深刻的, 淵博的
words.example: The diagnosis had a profound effect on her outlook.
words.example_zh: 這個診斷對她的人生觀產生了深遠的影響。

words.zh: n. 妥協, 折中, 折中方案, 和解；vi. 妥協處理；vt. 危害
words.example: The two doctors reached a compromise on the dose.
words.example_zh: 兩位醫生在劑量上達成了折衷。

words.zh: vt. 重新開始, 取回, 恢復；vi. 再開始；n. 摘要, 個人簡歷；[計] 繼續執行
words.example: She was eager to resume work after her recovery.
words.example_zh: 康復後她迫不及待想恢復工作。

words.zh: n. 皮包, 公文包, 部長職務, 有價證券財產目錄, 藝術代表作選輯；[法] 公文包, 資料夾, 閣員職務
words.example: The investor spread risk across a wide portfolio.
words.example_zh: 這名投資人將風險分散在多元的投資組合中。

words.zh: n. 副本, 複本, 配對物, 相應物；[經] 副本, 正副二份中之一
words.example: The generic drug is cheaper than its branded counterpart.
words.example_zh: 這種學名藥比它的品牌對應產品便宜。

words.zh: v. 診斷
words.example: It can be hard to diagnose the illness early on.
words.example_zh: 這種病在早期可能很難診斷。

words.zh: n. 公平, 公正；[經] 權益, 產權
words.example: The reform aims to bring equity to rural healthcare.
words.example_zh: 這項改革旨在為鄉村醫療帶來公平。

words.zh: n. 修理, 補救, 修復；vt. 修理, 修補, 補救, 恢復, 補償；vi. 修理, 修補, 補救, 恢復, 去, 常去, 集合
words.example: The surgery will repair the damaged heart valve.
words.example_zh: 這項手術將修補受損的心臟瓣膜。

words.zh: a. 慷慨的, 有雅量的, 大量的, 豐富的
words.example: A generous donor funded the children's ward.
words.example_zh: 一位慷慨的捐贈者資助了兒童病房。

words.zh: adv. 幾乎, 差不多, 事實上
words.example: The waiting room was practically empty by evening.
words.example_zh: 到了傍晚，候診室幾乎空無一人。

words.zh: n. 遊行, 炫耀, 閱兵；v. 遊行, 炫耀, (使)列隊行進
words.example: A charity parade raised money for the hospital.
words.example_zh: 一場慈善遊行為醫院募款。

words.zh: n. 隱喻
words.example: The doctor used a simple metaphor to explain the illness.
words.example_zh: 醫生用一個簡單的比喻來解釋這種病。

words.zh: n. 實體, 實存物, 存在；[計] 實體
words.example: The clinic is now a separate legal entity.
words.example_zh: 這間診所現在是獨立的法律實體。

words.zh: a. 優雅的, 端莊的, 高雅的
words.example: The solution to the problem was surprisingly elegant.
words.example_zh: 這個問題的解法出奇地簡潔優雅。

words.zh: n. 需要, 必需品, 必然；[法] 必要性, 必然性, 必要
words.example: Clean water is a basic necessity in any clinic.
words.example_zh: 乾淨的水是任何診所的基本必需品。

words.zh: vt. 使隔離, 使孤立, 使絕緣；n. 隔離種群
words.example: Patients with the virus were isolated from others.
words.example_zh: 染病的病人被隔離開來。

words.zh: n. 巨大, 重大, 重要, 大小, 數量, 星等(指星的亮度)；[計] 大小; 值
words.example: No one grasped the magnitude of the outbreak at first.
words.example_zh: 起初沒人意識到這場疫情的嚴重程度。

words.zh: n. 憤怒, 情緒激動, 狂暴；vi. 大怒, 狂吹, 流行
words.example: He could barely contain his rage at the bad news.
words.example_zh: 聽到壞消息，他幾乎無法抑制怒火。

words.zh: a. 人造的, 假的, 非原地產的；[醫] 人工的, 人造的, 偉牟
words.example: The patient was kept alive on an artificial heart for weeks.
words.example_zh: 病人靠人工心臟維持生命達數週。

words.zh: a. 抽象的, 深奧的；n. 摘要, 抽象概念；vt. 摘要, 提煉, 使抽象化；[計] 摘錄; 摘要; 抽象
words.example: The lecture was too abstract for the new students to follow.
words.example_zh: 這場講課太抽象，新生跟不上。

words.zh: n. 革命者, 革命黨人；a. 革命的, 革命性的
words.example: The new scanner was a revolutionary step in diagnosis.
words.example_zh: 這台新掃描儀是診斷上革命性的一步。

words.zh: n. 不足, 缺乏；[化] 缺額
words.example: A shortage of nurses forced the ward to close beds.
words.example_zh: 護理人力短缺迫使病房關閉床位。

words.zh: a. 神的, 神聖的, 非凡的；n. 神學家
words.example: In ancient times, illness was seen as divine punishment.
words.example_zh: 在古代，疾病被視為神的懲罰。

words.zh: n. 紀念碑, 紀念物, 石碑
words.example: A stone monument honors the doctors who died in the epidemic.
words.example_zh: 一座石碑紀念在疫情中殉職的醫生。

words.zh: a. 延續的, 伸出的, 竭盡全力的, 廣大的, 擴大範圍的；[法] 展期的, 延期的, 延長的
words.example: She needed an extended stay in hospital to recover fully.
words.example_zh: 她需要延長住院時間才能完全康復。

words.zh: n. 工具, 復滑車, 滑車, 裝備, 扭倒；vt. 固定, 處理, 抓住；vi. 扭倒
words.example: The new policy aims to tackle the shortage of doctors.
words.example_zh: 新政策旨在解決醫生短缺的問題。

words.zh: n. 昏厥, 昏倒；a. 模糊的, 微弱的, 無力的；vi. 昏倒, 變得微弱
words.example: She felt faint and had to sit down quickly.
words.example_zh: 她感到頭暈，不得不趕緊坐下。

words.zh: n. 破產者；[經] 破產, 倒閉
words.example: Huge medical bills drove the family into bankruptcy.
words.example_zh: 龐大的醫療費用使這家人破產。

words.zh: n. 牛痘苗, 疫苗；a. 疫苗的, 牛痘的
words.example: A new vaccine could protect millions from the flu.
words.example_zh: 一款新疫苗能保護數百萬人免於流感。

words.zh: vt. 承認, 退讓；vi. 讓步
words.example: The doctor conceded that the treatment had failed.
words.example_zh: 醫生承認這項治療失敗了。

words.zh: n. 記錄片；a. 檔案的
words.example: A documentary followed the lives of three nurses.
