words.zh: n. 離婚；vt. 與...離婚
words.example: The stress of his illness nearly ended in divorce.
words.example_zh: 他生病的壓力差點以離婚收場。

words.zh: n. 輕蔑, 怠慢；a. 輕微的, 纖細的, 脆弱的, 苗條的；vt. 輕視, 忽略, 怠慢
words.example: She felt only a slight ache after the injection.
words.example_zh: 注射後她只感到輕微的痠痛。

words.zh: n. 尾部, 後部, 辮子, 隨員, 特務, 燕尾服, 蹤跡, 限定繼承(權)；a. 在後面的, 從後面而來的, 限定繼承的, 尾部的, 後部的；vt. 為...裝尾, 附於其後,
words.example: A long tail of side effects worried the patient.
words.example_zh: 一長串的副作用讓病人擔憂。

words.zh: vt. 承受, 支援, 供養, 繼續, 忍受, 蒙受, 證實, 准許；[電] 持續
words.example: He could not sustain the effort for long.
words.example_zh: 他無法長時間維持這樣的努力。

words.zh: n. 角, 角度, 角落；vi. 釣魚, 謀取, 博取, 斜向移動, 轉變角度；vt. 使轉動角度, 在...釣魚, 獲取
words.example: The X-ray was taken from a different angle.
words.example_zh: X 光從另一個角度拍攝。

words.zh: n. 習慣, 風俗, 海關, 自定義；a. 定製的；[計] 定製; 自定義
words.example: It is the ward's custom to greet each new patient.
words.example_zh: 問候每位新病人是這個病房的習慣。

words.zh: n. 湯, 馬力；vt. 加速, 增加馬力
words.example: A bowl of warm soup was all she wanted.
words.example_zh: 一碗溫熱的湯是她唯一想要的。

words.zh: a. 有效率的, 能幹的
words.example: The new system is far more efficient.
words.example_zh: 這套新系統的效率高出許多。

words.zh: n. 堆, 大堆, 大廈, 建築群, 電池, 大量, 橋樁, 軟毛, 痔瘡；vi. 堆起, 堆積, 積累, 擠, 猛烈攻擊；vt. 堆於, 累積, 堆疊, 打樁於, 用樁支撐
words.example: A pile of charts waited on the nurse's desk.
words.example_zh: 護理師桌上堆著一疊病歷。

words.zh: n. 碳, 副本, 複寫紙；[化] 碳
words.example: Too much carbon dioxide builds up in the blood.
words.example_zh: 過多的二氧化碳在血液中累積。

words.zh: n. 方案, 計劃, 組合, 系統, 圖解, 詭計, 陰謀；v. 計劃, 設計, 圖謀, 策劃
words.example: The clinic joined a free vaccination scheme.
words.example_zh: 這間診所加入了一項免費接種計畫。

words.zh: n. 裂縫, 爆裂聲；v. (使)爆裂, (使)裂開, (使)發出爆裂聲；a. 第一流的；adv. 啪地一聲
words.example: A small crack appeared in the bone.
words.example_zh: 骨頭上出現了一道小裂縫。

words.zh: n. 菸草, 香菸；[醫] 菸草
words.example: Years of tobacco use scarred his lungs.
words.example_zh: 多年使用菸草在他的肺上留下了傷痕。

words.zh: n. 生還者, 倖存者；[法] 生還者, 生存者, 辛存者
words.example: She is a survivor of a rare childhood cancer.
words.example_zh: 她是一種罕見兒童癌症的倖存者。

words.zh: prep. 除...之外；adv. 而且, 此外
words.example: Besides rest, she needs plenty of fluids.
words.example_zh: 除了休息，她還需要大量補充水分。

words.zh: n. 心理學家；[醫] 心理學家
words.example: A psychologist helped him manage his anxiety.
words.example_zh: 一位心理師幫助他控制焦慮。

words.zh: n. 銀河, 星系, 一群(顯赫的人物)；[電] 銀河系
words.example: The night sky was full of distant galaxies.
words.example_zh: 夜空中布滿了遙遠的星系。

words.zh: n. 限制, 缺陷, 限額；[醫] 限界, 限制, 限度
words.example: Old age brings some limitation in movement.
words.example_zh: 年老會帶來行動上的一些限制。

words.zh: n. 痕跡, 蹤跡, 微量, 跡線, 韁繩；vt. 追蹤, 回溯, 描繪；vi. 追溯, 沿路走
words.example: There was a trace of blood in the sample.
words.example_zh: 樣本中有微量的血液。

words.zh: n. 約會, 委任的職位, 委派；[經] 任命, 派, 指定
words.example: She missed her appointment because of the storm.
words.example_zh: 因為暴風雨，她錯過了預約。

words.zh: n. 偏愛, 優先, 喜愛物；[計] 首選項
words.example: The patient stated a preference for tablets over injections.
words.example_zh: 病人表示比起打針，他更傾向吃藥片。

words.zh: a. 難以置信的
words.example: Her recovery was truly incredible.
words.example_zh: 她的康復實在令人難以置信。

words.zh: n. 准許進入, 入場費, 錄用, 承認；[經] 加入, 入股
words.example: His admission to hospital was delayed by hours.
words.example_zh: 他的住院被延誤了好幾個小時。

words.zh: n. 嬰兒, 兒童, 初學者；a. 嬰兒的, 幼稚的
words.example: The infant was too small to feed on her own.
words.example_zh: 這名嬰兒太小，無法自己進食。

words.zh: v. 計算, 預測, 計劃, 打算
words.example: The pharmacist calculated the dose by weight.
words.example_zh: 藥師按體重計算了劑量。

words.zh: n. 趨向, 傾向；[醫] 趨向, 趨勢
words.example: He has a tendency to ignore mild symptoms.
words.example_zh: 他有忽視輕微症狀的傾向。

words.zh: vt. 免除, 以...清除, 使獲自由, 使擺脫；[法] 免除, 清除, 擺脫
words.example: Antibiotics helped rid her body of the infection.
words.example_zh: 抗生素幫她的身體擺脫了感染。

words.zh: n. 學問, 學術成就, 獎學金
words.example: She won a scholarship to study nursing.
words.example_zh: 她贏得了攻讀護理的獎學金。

words.zh: n. 形成, 構造, 編隊；[醫] 形成, 結構
words.example: The drug slows the formation of clots.
words.example_zh: 這種藥能減緩血栓的形成。

words.zh: n. 效率, 效能, 功效；[醫] 效率, 效力
words.example: The new layout improved the ward's efficiency.
words.example_zh: 新的格局提升了病房的效率。

words.zh: vi. 取得資格, 有資格；vt. 使有資格, 使合格, 限定, 限制, 准予
words.example: She studied hard to qualify as a nurse.
words.example_zh: 她苦讀以取得護理師的資格。

words.zh: n. 林蔭路；購物中心
words.example: She felt faint while shopping at the mall.
words.example_zh: 她在購物中心逛街時感到頭暈。

words.zh: vt. 得自；vi. 起源
words.example: The medicine is derived from a tropical plant.
words.example_zh: 這種藥提取自一種熱帶植物。

words.zh: n. 醜聞, 中傷, 恥辱, 反感, 流言蜚語；[法] 醜事, 醜聞, 幹醜事的人
words.example: A safety scandal hit the hospital last year.
words.example_zh: 去年一樁安全醜聞重創了這家醫院。

words.zh: a. 有幫助的, 有益的, 有用的
words.example: The nurse gave some very helpful advice.
words.example_zh: 護理師給了一些很有幫助的建議。

words.zh: n. 腳後跟, 踵, 後部, 傾側；vt. 尾隨, 裝以鞋跟, 傾側, 追趕；vi. 緊隨, 用腳後跟傳球
words.example: A blister formed on the heel of her foot.
words.example_zh: 她的腳後跟長了一個水泡。

words.zh: n. 幽默, 詼諧, 心情；vt. 迎合, 牽就, 順應
words.example: His good humor lifted everyone on the ward.
words.example_zh: 他的幽默感讓整個病房的人都開朗起來。

words.zh: n. 織物, 布, 結構, 構造, 建築物；[經] 組織, 建築物, 工廠
words.example: The bandage is made of a soft, breathable fabric.
words.example_zh: 這款繃帶以柔軟透氣的織物製成。

words.zh: n. 競賽, 爭論；vt. 競爭, 爭取, 爭辯；vi. 競爭
words.example: Quitting smoking felt like a daily contest.
words.example_zh: 戒菸感覺像是每天的一場較量。

words.zh: n. 比例, 比率, 均衡, 部分, 面積；vt. 使成比例, 使均衡
words.example: A large proportion of patients made a full recovery.
words.example_zh: 大部分的病人完全康復了。

words.zh: n. 來復槍, 步槍；vt. 用步槍射擊, 搶奪；vi. (抱有不良意圖)迅速翻查
words.example: The hunter cleaned his rifle by the fire.
words.example_zh: 獵人在火堆旁擦拭他的步槍。

words.zh: n. 定罪, 信服, 堅信；[法] 定罪, 證明有罪, 判罪
words.example: She spoke with quiet conviction about her care.
words.example_zh: 她以平靜的堅定談論她的照護方式。

words.zh: n. 詭計, 欺詐, 謀略, 惡作劇, 習慣, 決竅；vt. 愚弄, 欺騙, 裝飾；vi. 哄騙, 戲弄；a. 有決竅的, 特技的, 欺詐的, 漂亮的, 靠不住的
words.example: The nurse had a clever trick for giving pills to children.
words.example_zh: 護理師有個讓孩子吃藥的聰明妙招。

words.zh: a. 器官的, 有機的, 組織的, 根本的；[醫] 器官的, 有生命的, 有機的, 器質的
words.example: The damage was organic, not just in his mind.
words.example_zh: 這種損傷是器質性的，並非只是心理作用。

words.zh: vt. 加強, 變堅固；vi. 變強, 股票上漲
words.example: The exercises will strengthen her weak leg.
words.example_zh: 這些運動會強化她虛弱的腿。

words.zh: n. 神話, 虛構的事, 虛構的人
words.example: It is a myth that you must starve a fever.
words.example_zh: 「發燒要餓著」是個迷思。

words.zh: a. 複雜的, 久經世故的；[法] 尖端的, 高階的, 非常有經驗的
words.example: The scanner is a sophisticated piece of equipment.
words.example_zh: 這台掃描儀是一件精密的設備。

words.zh: n. 母牛, 母獸；vt. 威脅
words.example: Fresh milk came from the farm's own cows.
words.example_zh: 新鮮的牛奶來自農場自己養的乳牛。

words.zh: n. 起立, 持續, 身分；a. 立著的, 不動的, 經常的, 持續的
words.example: He has long-standing pain in his lower back.
words.example_zh: 他的下背部有長期的疼痛。

words.zh: n. 精神, 勇氣, 葉脈, 神經；vt. 鼓起勇氣
words.example: The injury had damaged a nerve in his hand.
words.example_zh: 這次受傷傷到了他手上的一條神經。

words.zh: n. 桶；vt. 裝入桶內
words.example: The chemicals were stored in a sealed barrel.
words.example_zh: 這些化學品存放在一個密封的桶子裡。

words.zh: n. 選單, (功能)選擇單；[計] 選單
words.example: The hospital menu offers low-salt meals.
words.example_zh: 醫院的菜單提供低鹽餐點。

words.zh: n. 比, 比率；[醫] 比, 比率, 比例
words.example: Nurses worry about the high patient-to-staff ratio.
words.example_zh: 護理師擔心病人與人力的比例過高。

words.zh: n. 敘述, 故事；a. 敘述的, 敘事的, 故事體的
words.example: She gave a clear narrative of her symptoms.
words.example_zh: 她清楚地描述了她的症狀經過。

words.zh: a. 充分的, 足夠的；[法] 充分的, 足夠的
words.example: Rest and water are often sufficient for a cold.
words.example_zh: 對感冒而言，休息和喝水往往就足夠了。

words.zh: n. 耽擱, 遲滯；v. 耽擱, 延遲；[計] 延遲, 延時
words.example: Any delay in treatment can be dangerous.
words.example_zh: 治療上的任何延誤都可能很危險。

words.zh: vi. 爆炸, 爆發, 激增；vt. 使爆炸
words.example: Anger seemed to explode out of the frightened man.
words.example_zh: 怒氣彷彿從這名受驚的男子身上爆發出來。

words.zh: n. 範圍, 機會, 廣度, 眼界, 觀察儀器, 導彈射程；[計] 作用域
words.example: The illness was beyond the scope of the small clinic.
words.example_zh: 這種病超出了這間小診所的能力範圍。

words.zh: n. 地平線, 眼界, (天)視地平
words.example: New treatments are appearing on the horizon.
words.example_zh: 新的療法正在逐漸浮現。

words.zh: n. 市中心區；a. 市中心的；adv. 往鬧市區
words.example: The clinic moved to a downtown office.
words.example_zh: 診所搬到了市中心的一間辦公室。

words.zh: vt. 吸收, 使全神貫注, 同化, 買進, 理解, 承受, 忍受, 承擔；[醫] 吸收
words.example: The body cannot absorb the vitamin without fat.
words.example_zh: 沒有脂肪，身體就無法吸收這種維生素。

words.zh: n. 調整, 調節, 校正；[化] 調節
words.example: A small adjustment to the dose eased the side effects.
words.example_zh: 劑量的小幅調整減輕了副作用。

words.zh: a. 熱心的, 渴望的, 熱望的
words.example: She was eager to get back on her feet.
words.example_zh: 她迫不及待想重新站起來。

words.zh: n. 校長, 首長, 本金, 主犯, 資本, 委託人；a. 主要的, 最重要的, 首要的
words.example: The principal cause of his illness was poor diet.
words.example_zh: 他生病的主要原因是不良的飲食。

words.zh: n. 動機, 刺激, 推動；[醫] 促動, 推動, 誘導
words.example: Seeing his grandchild gave him motivation to recover.
words.example_zh: 看到孫子給了他康復的動力。

words.zh: n. 限制, 限定, 約束；[計] 限定
words.example: The diet places a strict restriction on salt.
words.example_zh: 這種飲食法對鹽分有嚴格的限制。

words.zh: n. 分配, 功課, 任務, 轉讓, 歸因, 陳述；[計] 賦值
words.example: Her first assignment was on the night ward.
words.example_zh: 她的第一份工作是在夜間病房。

words.zh: n. 實驗室, 研究室, 化工廠；[醫] 實驗室, 檢驗室, 化驗室
words.example: The samples were sent to the laboratory at once.
words.example_zh: 樣本立刻被送往實驗室。

words.zh: n. 棉花；vi. 和諧, 有好感, 理解
words.example: The nurse pressed a ball of cotton on the cut.
words.example_zh: 護理師用一團棉花按住傷口。

words.zh: vt. 控告, 起訴, 請求；vi. 提出訴訟, 提出請求
words.example: The family threatened to sue the hospital.
words.example_zh: 家屬揚言要控告醫院。

words.zh: n. 漂流物, 浮舟, 漂浮, 浮萍, 彩車；vi. 浮動, 飄動, 散播, 搖擺, 動搖, 浮動；vt. 使漂浮, 容納, 淹沒, 發行, 實行；[計] 浮動
words.example: A relaxed body seems to float in warm water.
words.example_zh: 放鬆的身體彷彿漂浮在溫水中。

words.zh: vt. 遭受, 經歷, 忍受；[法] 經受, 經歷, 忍受
words.example: She will undergo surgery next week.
words.example_zh: 她下週將接受手術。

words.zh: n. 序列, 續發事件, 順序, 連續；vt. 按順序排好；[計] 順序
words.example: The nurse followed each step in the right sequence.
words.example_zh: 護理師依正確的順序完成每個步驟。

words.zh: vt. 主張, 堅稱, 斷言；[法] 宣稱, 斷言, 維護
words.example: He asserted that he felt no pain at all.
words.example_zh: 他堅稱自己完全不痛。

words.zh: n. 葉片, 刀鋒, 刀口, 劍；[醫] 頁[片], 葉片, 刀片, 刀刃, 刀口
words.example: The surgeon's blade made a clean, shallow cut.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生的刀刃劃出一道乾淨的淺切口。

words.zh: a. 暫時的, 臨時的；n. 臨時工, 臨時僱員；[計] 臨時
words.example: The pain relief was only temporary.
words.example_zh: 這種止痛只是暫時的。

words.zh: n. 小屋, 客艙；vt. 關在小屋
words.example: He recovered in a quiet cabin by the lake.
words.example_zh: 他在湖邊一間寧靜的小屋裡休養。

words.zh: n. 咬, 一口；v. 咬, 刺痛, 穿透
words.example: The insect bite swelled into a red lump.
words.example_zh: 蟲咬處腫成一個紅色的硬塊。

words.zh: n. 程度, 坡度, 頂點, 前傾, 傾斜, 投擲, 音高, 螺距, 節距, 攤位, 樹脂, 瀝青；vt. 投, 擲, 向前傾跌, 紮營, 竭力推銷, 為...定調, 定位於, 用
words.example: Her voice rose in pitch as the pain grew.
words.example_zh: 隨著疼痛加劇，她的聲音越來越高。

words.zh: n. 松樹, 松木；vi. 消瘦, 憔悴, 痛苦, 懷念, 渴望；[計] 郵件程式
words.example: She began to pine for home after weeks in hospital.
words.example_zh: 住院數週後，她開始想家。

words.zh: n. 廚師
words.example: The hospital chef cooked a soft, gentle meal.
words.example_zh: 醫院的廚師煮了一頓軟嫩好入口的餐。

words.zh: n. 差別, 岐視, 辨別力；[化] 鑑別
words.example: Patients should never face discrimination over their illness.
words.example_zh: 病人絕不該因疾病而受到歧視。

words.zh: n. 繁榮, 隆隆聲；vi. 急速發展, 發隆隆聲；vt. 使興旺, 發隆隆聲
words.example: There was a boom in demand for the new vaccine.
words.example_zh: 這款新疫苗的需求激增。

words.zh: n. 暫存器, 記錄, 登記簿, 註冊；vt. 記錄, 註冊, 提示, 表達, 把...掛號；vi. 登記, 註冊, 掛號；[計] 暫存器
words.example: Please register at the front desk before seeing the doctor.
words.example_zh: 看醫生前請先在櫃檯掛號。

words.zh: n. 遺產, 祖先遺留物, 繼承物；[醫] 遺傳性
words.example: Caring for the sick is part of the family's heritage.
words.example_zh: 照顧病人是這個家族傳承的一部分。

words.zh: vi. 遊蕩, 漫步, 徘徊, 迷路, 離題, 蜿蜒；vt. 在...漫遊
words.example: The confused patient began to wander the halls at night.
words.example_zh: 神智不清的病人開始在夜裡於走廊間遊蕩。

words.zh: vt. 使服從, 使受到, 委託, 提交, 認為；vi. 屈服, 服從
words.example: Please submit the form before the operation.
words.example_zh: 請在手術前繳交表格。

words.zh: a. 裸體的, 無裝飾的, 無保護的, 赤貧的；[醫] 裸露的
words.example: The rash was barely visible to the naked eye.
words.example_zh: 這疹子幾乎是肉眼看不見的。

words.zh: n. 經濟學；[經] 經濟學
words.example: She studied the economics of public health.
words.example_zh: 她研究公共衛生的經濟學。

words.zh: vt. 預期, 佔先, 加速, 提前使用；[醫] 提前出現, 先期發生
words.example: Doctors anticipate a full recovery within weeks.
words.example_zh: 醫生預期幾週內就能完全康復。

words.zh: n. 祖先傳下來之物, 遺贈物；[經] 遺產, 遺贈物
words.example: The old doctor left a legacy of kindness.
words.example_zh: 這位老醫生留下了仁慈的典範。

words.zh: n. 電池, 毆打；[化] 蓄電池
words.example: The pacemaker's battery lasts about ten years.
words.example_zh: 心律調節器的電池約可用十年。

words.zh: n. 定方位, 適應, 向東方；n. 方向；[計] 方向
words.example: New nurses go through a week of orientation.
words.example_zh: 新進護理師會經歷一週的職前訓練。

words.zh: n. 脹大, 誇張, 通貨膨脹；[化] 充氣吹脹; 膨脹
words.example: Rising inflation pushed up the cost of drugs.
words.example_zh: 不斷上升的通貨膨脹推高了藥品的價格。

words.zh: vi. 競爭, 應付；n. 長袍
words.example: She learned to cope with the daily pain.
words.example_zh: 她學會了應付每天的疼痛。

words.zh: n. 火焰, 火舌, 熱情, 光輝；vt. 焚燒, 用火焰給...滅菌, 用火焰傳送(訊號), 點燃, 激動；vi. 燃燒, 爆發, 閃耀；[計] 無聊郵件, 無益郵件
words.example: The nurse passed the needle through a flame.
words.example_zh: 護理師把針穿過火焰消毒。

words.zh: n. 串, 叢, 群, 簇；vi. 成串, 叢生；vt. 使聚集；[計] 簇
words.example: A cluster of cases appeared in one village.
words.example_zh: 一個村莊出現了一群聚集的病例。

words.zh: n. 陣雨, 淋浴, 一陣, 展出者, 顯示者；vi. 淋浴, 下陣雨；vt. 淋溼, 傾注
words.example: He felt strong enough to take a shower at last.
words.example_zh: 他終於覺得有力氣能洗個澡了。

words.zh: vt. 描述, 描寫
words.example: The chart depicts how the disease spreads.
words.example_zh: 這張圖描繪了疾病如何傳播。

words.zh: n. 操作員, 行家, 經紀人, 運算元, 運算子；[計] 運算子
words.example: A trained operator runs the scanning machine.
words.example_zh: 受過訓練的操作員操控掃描儀。

words.zh: n. 喜劇, 有趣的事情
words.example: A light comedy helped the patients pass the time.
words.example_zh: 一部輕鬆的喜劇幫病人打發了時間。

words.zh: n. 核准, 制裁, 處罰, 約束力；vt. 制定制裁規則, 認可, 核准, 同意
words.example: Strong sanctions were placed on the unsafe clinic.
words.example_zh: 這間不安全的診所受到嚴厲的處分。

words.zh: n. 平民, 民法專家；a. 平民的, 百姓的, 民用的
words.example: The army doctors also treated civilian patients.
words.example_zh: 軍醫也為平民病人看診。

words.zh: n. 棲息地, 居留地, 自生地, 聚集處；[醫] 習生地, 產地, 生境, 棲所
words.example: The mosquito's habitat is warm, still water.
words.example_zh: 蚊子的棲息地是溫暖、靜止的水域。

words.zh: n. 穀粒, 顆粒, 穀類, 紋理, 本質；v. (使)成穀粒
words.example: Whole grain bread is gentler on blood sugar.
words.example_zh: 全穀麵包對血糖較溫和。

words.zh: n. 意識, 知覺, 自覺；[醫] (有)意識, 清醒
words.example: He slowly drifted back to consciousness.
words.example_zh: 他慢慢恢復了意識。

words.zh: vt. 投入於, 獻身
words.example: She devoted her life to rural medicine.
words.example_zh: 她把一生奉獻給了鄉村醫療。

words.zh: n. 省, 地方, 職權, 領域；[法] 省, 地方, 領域
words.example: The disease spread across the whole province.
words.example_zh: 這種病蔓延了整個省份。

words.zh: n. 許可, 允許；[計] 許可, 認可
words.example: You need the doctor's permission to leave early.
words.example_zh: 你需要醫生的許可才能提早離開。

words.zh: n. 頂點, 最高階層, 最高階會議；a. 政府首腦的, 最高階的
words.example: Reaching the mountain summit left him breathless.
words.example_zh: 登上山頂讓他喘不過氣。

words.zh: a. 有天才的
words.example: She was a gifted surgeon, calm under pressure.
words.example_zh: 她是位天賦異稟的外科醫生，臨危不亂。

words.zh: n. 可能性, 機率, 機會, 勝算, 不平等
words.example: Against all odds, the patient pulled through.
words.example_zh: 在不被看好的情況下，病人挺了過來。

words.zh: n. 挫折, 頓挫；[醫] 挫折
words.example: He felt frustration at his slow recovery.
words.example_zh: 他對自己緩慢的康復感到挫折。

words.zh: n. 媒體, 方法, 媒介；a. 半生熟的, 中間的；[計] 媒體, 中
words.example: Blood is the medium that carries oxygen.
words.example_zh: 血液是運送氧氣的媒介。

words.zh: n. 海岸, 海濱, 斜撐柱；vt. 把...送上岸, 支撐, 支援
words.example: She walked along the shore to clear her mind.
words.example_zh: 她沿著海岸散步，讓思緒沉澱。

words.zh: v. 區別, 辨別
words.example: It is hard to distinguish the two diseases early on.
words.example_zh: 在早期很難分辨這兩種疾病。

words.zh: n. 肺, 肺臟, 空地；[醫] 肺
words.example: Years of smoking damaged his left lung.
words.example_zh: 多年吸菸損害了他的左肺。

words.zh: n. 談話, 演講；vi. 談話, 講述
words.example: The lecture was a clear discourse on heart disease.
words.example_zh: 這場演講是對心臟病的清楚論述。

words.zh: a. 清楚的, 顯著的, 不同的
words.example: The rash has a distinct ring-like shape.
words.example_zh: 這種疹子有明顯的環狀外形。

words.zh: a. 給人深刻印象的, 威嚴的
words.example: Her progress in just a week was impressive.
words.example_zh: 她短短一週的進步令人印象深刻。

words.zh: n. 粉, 粉末, 火藥；vt. 搽粉於, 搽粉, 撒粉, 使成粉末；vi. 搽粉, 變成粉末
words.example: The medicine comes as a powder you mix with water.
words.example_zh: 這種藥是粉末狀，要加水沖泡。

words.zh: a. 醜陋的, 邪惡的, 險惡的, 不祥的；n. 醜陋的人(或物)
words.example: The wound looked ugly but healed cleanly.
words.example_zh: 傷口看起來嚇人，卻乾淨地癒合了。

words.zh: vt. 描繪, 描寫, 描繪...的肖像
words.example: The film portrays the daily life of a country nurse.
words.example_zh: 這部電影描繪了一位鄉村護理師的日常生活。

words.zh: a. 適度的, 穩健的, 中等的, 節制的；vt. 節制, 減輕, 使緩和；vi. 變緩和, 主持會議
words.example: Doctors advise moderate exercise during recovery.
words.example_zh: 醫生建議康復期間進行適度的運動。

words.zh: a. 時常發生的, 頻繁的, 快速的；vt. 時常來訪, 常常聚集, 常與...交往
words.example: She made frequent trips to the clinic that winter.
words.example_zh: 那年冬天她頻繁地往返診所。

words.zh: n. 禁令；vt. 禁止, 取締
words.example: The hospital placed a ban on smoking in its grounds.
words.example_zh: 醫院在院區內全面禁菸。

words.zh: vt. 讚美, 欽佩, 愛慕；vi. 稱讚, 驚奇
words.example: The students admire her steady hands in surgery.
words.example_zh: 學生們欽佩她手術時穩定的雙手。

words.zh: n. 寵物, 受寵愛的人, 寵壞的孩子, 不悅, 生氣；a. 寵愛的, 表示親暱的, 養著觀賞的, 特別珍愛的, 格外的；vt. 寵愛, 溺愛, 撫摸；vi. 擁抱, 愛撫, 生氣
words.example: Stroking a pet can lower a patient's blood pressure.
words.example_zh: 撫摸寵物能降低病人的血壓。

words.zh: n. 奇蹟, 奇事
words.example: His recovery felt like a small miracle.
words.example_zh: 他的康復感覺像個小小的奇蹟。

words.zh: n. 旋律, 節奏, 韻律, 勻稱, 張弛節律；[醫] 節律
words.example: The drug helped steady the heart's rhythm.
words.example_zh: 這種藥幫助穩定了心臟的節律。

words.zh: vt. 超過, 超越, 勝過；vi. 超過其他
words.example: The dose must not exceed two pills a day.
words.example_zh: 劑量一天不可超過兩顆。

words.zh: a. 充分伸展的, 廣佈的, 普及的, 流傳廣的
words.example: There is widespread fear of the new virus.
words.example_zh: 對這種新病毒有著普遍的恐懼。

words.zh: n. 罪, 犯罪, 過失, 失禮；v. 犯
words.example: In her eyes, wasting medicine was almost a sin.
words.example_zh: 在她眼中，浪費藥幾乎是一種罪過。

words.zh: n. 英畝
words.example: The hospital sits on a ten-acre plot of land.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院坐落在十英畝的土地上。

words.zh: n. 手跡, 手稿, 正本, 手寫體；vt. 改編為演出本；[計] 手寫體, 小型程式
words.example: The pharmacist could not read the doctor's script.
words.example_zh: 藥師看不懂醫生的手寫字跡。

words.zh: n. 慈悲, 博愛, 慈善團體, 施捨；[法] 寬大, 寬恕, 慈善機關
words.example: A local charity paid for her surgery.
words.example_zh: 一個當地的慈善團體支付了她的手術費。

words.zh: n. 一項戰術, 一條策略；a. 戰術的, 順序的, 排列的
words.example: Distraction is a useful tactic when giving a child an injection.
words.example_zh: 分散注意力是幫孩子打針時的實用招數。

words.zh: n. 識別, 身份證明, 認同；[化] 鑑定; 鑑別; 鑑別法; 認證
words.example: Early identification of the disease saves lives.
words.example_zh: 早期辨識出這種病能挽救生命。

words.zh: n. 變形, 變質, 變化, 改革, 變換；[化] 轉化; 變換
words.example: The new drug brought a transformation in her health.
words.example_zh: 新藥為她的健康帶來了徹底的改變。

words.zh: n. 冒險, 風險；vt. 敢於, 冒...的危險；vi. 冒險
words.example: Opening the rural clinic was a bold venture.
words.example_zh: 開設這間鄉村診所是個大膽的冒險。

words.zh: n. 侵犯, 侵入, 侵害；[醫] 侵襲, 侵入, 發病
words.example: The body fights off the invasion of bacteria.
words.example_zh: 身體會抵禦細菌的入侵。

words.zh: a. 適當的, 足夠的；[法] 勝任的, 適當的, 充分的
words.example: The clinic had adequate supplies for the winter.
words.example_zh: 這間診所有足夠的物資撐過冬天。

words.zh: conj. 然而, 儘管, 不過；adv. 不過, 仍然, 儘管如此, 然而
words.example: The drug is old; nonetheless, it still works well.
words.example_zh: 這種藥很舊，儘管如此，它依然很有效。

words.zh: n. 鋼琴
words.example: She played the piano softly for the patients.
words.example_zh: 她為病人輕柔地彈著鋼琴。

words.zh: n. 顯示, 顯現, 展覽品, 陳列品, 展覽；vt. 展現, 陳列, 展覽；vi. 開展覽會
words.example: The patient began to exhibit signs of recovery.
words.example_zh: 病人開始顯現出康復的跡象。

words.zh: n. 毛毯, 毯子；vt. 掩蓋, 覆蓋；a. 總共的
words.example: The nurse tucked a warm blanket around him.
words.example_zh: 護理師把一條溫暖的毯子掖在他身邊。

words.zh: n. 頁邊的空白, 邊緣, 界限, 餘裕, 差數, 差額, 保證金；vt. 加邊於, 加旁註於；[計] 頁邊距
words.example: There is little margin for error in surgery.
words.example_zh: 手術中容錯的餘地很小。

words.zh: n. 繩, 索, 粗繩, 絞索, 決竅；vt. 捆, 縛, 綁, 圈起, 以繩將...繫住；vi. 擰成繩狀
words.example: Rescuers lowered a rope to the trapped hiker.
words.example_zh: 救難人員把繩子垂放給受困的登山者。

words.zh: n. 凝結物, 混凝土；a. 具體的, 實在的, 混凝土的；v. (使)凝結, 用混凝土澆築
words.example: The doctor gave no concrete answer about the cause.
words.example_zh: 醫生對病因沒有給出具體的答案。

words.zh: n. 處方, 命令, 指定；[醫] 處方, 藥方
words.example: She picked up her prescription at the pharmacy.
words.example_zh: 她在藥局領了她的處方藥。

words.zh: n. 追求, 狩獵, 追逐；vt. 追捕, 追逐, 雕刻, 在...上鑲嵌寶石；vi. 追趕, 奔跑
words.example: The toddler led the nurse on a merry chase.
words.example_zh: 這名幼兒讓護理師追得團團轉。

words.zh: n. 新兵, 新手, 新會員, 補給品；vt. 恢復, 補充, 充實, 徵募；vi. 徵募新兵, 復原, 得到補充
words.example: The hospital is trying to recruit more nurses.
words.example_zh: 醫院正設法招募更多護理師。

words.zh: n. 磚塊, 積木；a. 用磚做的；vt. 用磚造, 用磚砌
words.example: The old clinic was a small brick building.
words.example_zh: 那間舊診所是一棟小磚房。

words.zh: n. 片, 補綴, 碎片, 斑, 傻瓜；vt. 補綴, 掩飾, 拼湊, 平息；[計] 修補; 拼湊
words.example: A nicotine patch helped him quit smoking.
words.example_zh: 一片尼古丁貼片幫他戒了菸。

words.zh: n. 驚駭, 恐怖, 慘狀；[醫] 恐怖, 恐懼
words.example: She watched in horror as he collapsed.
words.example_zh: 她驚恐地看著他倒下。

words.zh: a. 殖民的, 殖民地的；[法] 殖民地居民
words.example: The hospital dates back to the colonial era.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院可追溯到殖民時代。

words.zh: n. 目的, 緣故, 理由
words.example: For the sake of your health, please stop smoking.
words.example_zh: 為了你的健康，請戒菸。

words.zh: n. 注視, 凝視；vi. 注視, 凝視
words.example: Her gaze drifted to the window as she rested.
words.example_zh: 她休息時，目光飄向了窗外。

words.zh: vt. 發誓, 咒罵, 使宣誓；vi. 發誓, 詛咒；n. 詛咒, 誓言
words.example: He swore he had taken every dose.
words.example_zh: 他發誓自己每一劑都服用了。

words.zh: n. 線索, 暗示；vt. 暗示, 提供線索
words.example: The rash was the first clue to her illness.
words.example_zh: 那疹子是她生病的第一條線索。

words.zh: n. 薄的切片, 一部分, 菜刀；vt. 切成薄片, 切下；vi. 切；[計] 片
words.example: She managed to eat a slice of toast.
words.example_zh: 她勉強吃下一片吐司。

words.zh: n. 職業, 佔有, 佔有期, 佔領, 佔領軍；[經] 佔有, 佔用, 職業
words.example: His occupation as a miner harmed his lungs.
words.example_zh: 他礦工的職業損害了他的肺。

words.zh: n. 混亂, 混淆, 無秩序；[計] 含混
words.example: Sudden confusion can be a sign of a stroke.
words.example_zh: 突然的意識混亂可能是中風的徵兆。

words.zh: a. 神聖的, 獻給上帝的, 莊嚴的, 祭祀的；[法] 神聖的, 不可侵犯的
words.example: To her, the duty of care was almost sacred.
words.example_zh: 對她而言，照護的責任近乎神聖。

words.zh: n. 客套語, 公式, 準則；[計] 公式；嬰兒配方奶
words.example: The nurse mixed the baby's formula carefully.
words.example_zh: 護理師仔細地調配嬰兒的配方奶。

words.zh: a. 精確的, 準確的, 精密的；vt. 強求, 急需
words.example: Tell the doctor the exact time the pain began.
words.example_zh: 告訴醫生疼痛開始的確切時間。

words.zh: a. 集體的, 聚集的, 共同的；[醫] 集體的, 集合的
words.example: Patient safety is a collective responsibility.
words.example_zh: 病人安全是大家共同的責任。

words.zh: n. 嘆息；vi. 嘆息, 渴望；vt. 嘆息著說
words.example: She let out a sigh of relief at the good news.
words.example_zh: 聽到好消息，她鬆了一口氣。

words.zh: n. 走廊, 最高樓座, 畫廊, 收集, 相簿；[計] 相簿
words.example: A glass gallery linked the two hospital wings.
words.example_zh: 一條玻璃長廊連接醫院的兩翼。

words.zh: n. 隧道, 地下道；vi. 挖隧道；vt. 掘隧道於
words.example: The scanner felt like a narrow tunnel around her.
words.example_zh: 掃描儀在她四周像一條狹窄的隧道。

words.zh: n. 被告；[經] 被告方
words.example: The clinic was the defendant in the lawsuit.
words.example_zh: 這間診所是這宗訴訟的被告。

words.zh: n. 適合, 合宜, 合理, 恰當, 健康；[醫] 適合性, 適應性
words.example: Months of training restored his fitness.
words.example_zh: 數月的訓練恢復了他的體能。

words.zh: n. 墓穴, 墳墓, 終結, 死亡；a. 莊重的, 嚴肅的, 重大的, 低沉的；vt. 雕刻
words.example: The doctor wore a grave expression as she spoke.
words.example_zh: 醫生說話時神情凝重。

words.zh: n. 膝蓋, 舔, 一圈, 下襬, 衣兜, 山坳；vi. 重疊, 圍住, 輕拍, 舔；vt. 包圍, 抱...在膝上, 使重疊, 舔, 拍打, 潑濺；[計] 連結訪問程式
words.example: The child sat on her mother's lap during the exam.
words.example_zh: 檢查時孩子坐在母親的腿上。

words.zh: n. 足趾, 趾部, 腳趾；vt. 以趾踏觸, 用腳尖走；vi. 動腳尖
words.example: He stubbed his toe and broke a small bone.
words.example_zh: 他踢到腳趾，斷了一根小骨頭。

words.zh: n. 德行, 美德, 優點, 功效, 效力；[法] 美德, 貞操, 優點
words.example: Patience is a vital virtue in a nurse.
words.example_zh: 耐心是護理師至關重要的美德。

words.zh: adv. 往國外, 到室外, 到處；a. 往國外的, 在室外的, 廣泛四散的
words.example: She trained abroad before returning home to practice.
words.example_zh: 她在國外受訓後才回國行醫。

words.zh: adv. 戲劇地, 引人注目地, 突然地
words.example: His health improved dramatically after the surgery.
words.example_zh: 手術後他的健康狀況戲劇性地好轉。

words.zh: n. 建築師, 設計者, 締造者
words.example: An architect designed the airy new clinic.
words.example_zh: 一位建築師設計了這間通風明亮的新診所。

words.zh: n. 組成, 性格, 化妝品, 化裝(術), 虛構, 補考
words.example: The drug's chemical makeup is complex.
words.example_zh: 這種藥的化學組成很複雜。

words.zh: n. 質詢, 探索, 調查, 詢盤；[計] 詢問; 查詢
words.example: The family launched an inquiry into the error.
words.example_zh: 家屬針對這項疏失展開了調查。

words.zh: n. 加亮區, 精彩場面；vt. 加亮, 使顯著, 以強光照射, 突出；[計] 突出
words.example: The nurse highlighted the key dose on the chart.
words.example_zh: 護理師在病歷上把關鍵的劑量標了出來。

words.zh: n. 減少, 減少量；v. 減少
words.example: There was a steady decrease in his fever.
words.example_zh: 他的高燒穩定地下降。

words.zh: n. 橫杆, 圍欄, 欄杆, 鐵軌, 扶手, 秧雞；vt. 以橫木圍欄, 給...鋪鐵軌；vi. 責罵, 抱怨
words.example: He held the rail tightly as he climbed the stairs.
words.example_zh: 他爬樓梯時緊握著扶手。

words.zh: n. 聯盟, 聯合；[法] 同盟, 聯盟, 聯姻
words.example: An alliance of clinics shared the new equipment.
words.example_zh: 一個診所聯盟共用了這套新設備。

words.zh: n. 假設；[化] 假設
words.example: The doctor tested her hypothesis with a blood test.
words.example_zh: 醫生用一項血液檢查來驗證她的假設。

words.zh: vt. 組成, 寫作, 作曲, 使平靜；vi. 創作, 排字；[計] 編寫
words.example: She tried to compose herself before the surgery.
words.example_zh: 手術前她試著讓自己鎮定下來。

words.zh: n. 傳說, 傳奇文學, 圖例；[計] 圖例
words.example: The old surgeon was a legend in the hospital.
words.example_zh: 這位老外科醫生是醫院裡的傳奇人物。

words.zh: n. 光澤, 陽光；vt. 使發光；vi. 照耀, 發光, 發亮
words.example: A bright light was made to shine into her eye.
words.example_zh: 一道強光被照進她的眼睛。

words.zh: a. 青春期的, 青少年的；n. 青少年
words.example: The disease is most common in adolescent boys.
words.example_zh: 這種病在青春期男孩身上最常見。

words.zh: n. 基準, 模範, 標準, 準則, 平均數；[化] 定額
words.example: It is the norm to fast before this blood test.
words.example_zh: 在做這項血液檢查前禁食是常規。

words.zh: a. 弄翻的, 混亂的, 心煩的；vt. 弄翻, 顛覆, 推翻, 打亂, 使不適, 使心煩；vi. 翻倒
words.example: Spicy food can upset a sensitive stomach.
words.example_zh: 辛辣的食物會讓敏感的胃不舒服。

words.zh: n. 評論, 注意；vt. 評論, 注意；vi. 評論, 談論；[計] 註釋
words.example: The doctor made a kind remark to ease her fear.
words.example_zh: 醫生說了句體貼的話來緩解她的恐懼。

words.zh: n. 報酬, 酬謝, 賞金；vt. 獎賞, 酬謝, 給...應有報應
words.example: Good health is the reward for years of care.
words.example_zh: 健康是多年保養的回報。

words.zh: a. 溫和的, 文雅的
words.example: The nurse had a gentle touch with the newborn.
words.example_zh: 護理師對新生兒的動作很輕柔。

words.zh: prep. 關於；[法] 關於
words.example: She had a question concerning her medication.
words.example_zh: 她有個關於用藥的問題。

words.zh: n. 諮詢服務
words.example: The hospital offers free counseling to families.
words.example_zh: 醫院為家屬提供免費的諮商。

words.zh: n. 接收器；接受者；收信機；收款員, 接待者
words.example: He picked up the telephone receiver to call the nurse.
words.example_zh: 他拿起電話聽筒打給護理師。

words.zh: n. 鮭魚, 大麻哈魚；[醫] 鮭
words.example: Salmon is rich in oils that are good for the heart.
words.example_zh: 鮭魚富含對心臟有益的油脂。

words.zh: vt. 中斷, 妨礙, 插嘴；vi. 打斷；n. 中斷；[計] 中斷
words.example: Please do not interrupt the surgeon during the operation.
words.example_zh: 手術過程中請勿打斷外科醫生。

words.zh: n. 長者, 佔優勢的人, 上級；a. 上級的, 出眾的, 高傲的
words.example: The new drug proved superior to the old one.
words.example_zh: 新藥被證實優於舊藥。

words.zh: n. 魔術, 魔法；a. 魔術的, 有魔力的, 不可思議的
words.example: There is no magic cure for the common cold.
words.example_zh: 治療普通感冒沒有神奇的解藥。

words.zh: n. 外科醫生, 軍醫, 船醫；[醫] 外科醫師
words.example: The surgeon scrubbed her hands before the operation.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生在手術前刷洗雙手。

words.zh: n. 商議, 忠告, 法律顧問；v. 商議, 勸告
words.example: The doctor's counsel was to wait and watch.
words.example_zh: 醫生的建議是觀察等待。

words.zh: a. 連續的, 繼續的, 連續不斷的；[計] 連續的
words.example: The patient needs continuous monitoring overnight.
words.example_zh: 病人需要整夜持續的監測。

words.zh: n. 記錄, 圓木, 日誌, 計程儀；vt. 伐木, 切, 航行；vi. 伐木；[計] 日誌
words.example: The nurse kept a careful log of his fluids.
words.example_zh: 護理師仔細記錄了他的進出水量。

words.zh: n. 回聲, 迴音, 回波；vi. 發回聲, 隨聲附和；vt. 摹仿, 重複, 反射；[計] 回顯; DOS批處理命令:控制MS-DOS命令是否在螢幕上顯示
words.example: The scan uses sound echoes to picture the heart.
words.example_zh: 這項掃描利用聲波的回聲來呈現心臟。

words.zh: n. 藥丸, 彈丸, 屈辱, 胡說；v. 做成藥丸, 形成丸狀, 服藥丸, 挫敗, 搶劫
words.example: She swallowed the pill with a sip of water.
words.example_zh: 她就著一口水把藥丸吞下。

words.zh: n. 雕刻, 雕塑；vt. 雕刻, 雕塑；vi. 當雕刻師
words.example: A small sculpture stood in the hospital garden.
words.example_zh: 醫院花園裡立著一座小雕塑。

words.zh: n. 混合物, 複合詞, 化合物, 院子；a. 複合的, 混合的, 化合的；vi. 化合, 和解, 妥協；vt. 使複合, 使化合
words.example: The drug is a compound of two simple chemicals.
words.example_zh: 這種藥是兩種簡單化學物質的化合物。

words.zh: n. 麵粉, 粉沫, 碎粉；[醫] 麵粉, 麥粉
words.example: She is allergic to anything made with wheat flour.
words.example_zh: 她對任何用小麥麵粉做的東西都過敏。

words.zh: a. 赤裸的, 缺少的, 無遮蔽的, 坦率的；vt. 使赤裸, 露出
words.example: The doctor pressed gently on his bare stomach.
words.example_zh: 醫生輕輕按壓他裸露的腹部。

words.zh: vt. 綜合, 使完整, 使成整體；vi. 成一體；a. 完整的, 完全的
words.example: The clinic works hard to integrate body and mind care.
words.example_zh: 這間診所努力整合身與心的照護。

words.zh: n. 總統職權, 總裁職位
words.example: He fell ill during his second year of the presidency.
words.example_zh: 他在總統任期的第二年病倒了。

words.zh: n. 租金, 房租, 出租物, 裂縫, 破裂處, 分裂；vt. 租用, 租出；vi. 出租；a. 分裂的, 破裂的；rend的過去式和過去分詞
words.example: Rising rent forced the clinic to move.
words.example_zh: 上漲的租金迫使診所搬遷。

words.zh: n. 傾斜, 斜坡, 斜率, 扛槍姿勢；vt. 使傾斜, 弄斜, 扛；vi. 傾斜, 走, 逃走
words.example: The wheelchair ramp had a gentle slope.
words.example_zh: 輪椅坡道的斜度很平緩。

words.zh: a. 敏銳的, 精細的, 狡猾的, 稀薄的, 靈巧的, 微妙的；[醫] 銳敏的; 精細的
words.example: The change in her breathing was very subtle.
words.example_zh: 她呼吸的變化非常細微。

words.zh: n. 抽水機, 打氣筒, 泵, 抽吸；vt. 用唧筒抽水, 打氣, 盤問, 傾注, 使疲憊；vi. 抽水, 上下(或往復)運動
words.example: The heart is a powerful pump for the blood.
words.example_zh: 心臟是輸送血液的強力幫浦。

words.zh: n. 獎牌, 勳章；vt. 授勳予
words.example: He received a medal for donating blood a hundred times.
words.example_zh: 他因捐血一百次而獲頒一面獎章。

words.zh: v. 乞求, 乞討, 請求
words.example: She had to beg him to see a doctor.
words.example_zh: 她不得不央求他去看醫生。

words.zh: n. 保證人, 贊助者, 發起者, 倡議者, 教父；vt. 發起, 贊助, 倡議
words.example: A local firm agreed to sponsor the children's ward.
words.example_zh: 一家當地公司同意贊助兒童病房。

words.zh: a. 中級的, 中等的, 次要的, 第二的, 從屬的, 輔助的；[化] 仲(指CH-3...CH(CH-3)-型支鏈烴基或指二元胺及R-2CHOH型的醇); 第二
words.example: The headache was secondary to the high blood pressure.
words.example_zh: 這頭痛是高血壓引起的次發症狀。

words.zh: n. 文明, 教化；[法] 文明, 文化, 文明國家的總稱
words.example: Clean water transformed public health across the civilization.
words.example_zh: 乾淨的水改變了整個文明的公共衛生。

words.zh: n. 曲線, 彎曲, 曲線球；vt. 彎, 使彎曲；vi. 成曲形
words.example: The chart showed a steady curve of recovery.
words.example_zh: 圖表顯示出一條穩定的康復曲線。

words.zh: vt. 給...權利, 取名為, 給予名稱, 叫做；[法] 給...權利, 使有資格, 稱呼
words.example: Full-time staff are entitled to sick leave.
words.example_zh: 全職員工有資格享有病假。

words.zh: a. 顯然的, 明顯的
words.example: It was evident that the medicine was working.
words.example_zh: 顯然這種藥正在發揮作用。

words.zh: n. 實質, 本質, 香精；[化] 香精
words.example: Rest is the essence of a good recovery.
words.example_zh: 休息是良好康復的關鍵所在。

words.zh: n. 邏輯, 邏輯學, 推理的方法, 推理, 邏輯性；[計] 邏輯
words.example: There was a clear logic behind the treatment plan.
words.example_zh: 這套治療計畫背後有清楚的邏輯。

words.zh: vt. 除外, 排除, 排斥；[醫] 除外(診斷)
words.example: The test helped exclude a more serious illness.
words.example_zh: 這項檢查幫助排除了更嚴重的疾病。

words.zh: a. 粗糙的, 刺耳的, 嚴厲的；[法] 粗糙的, 嚴厲的, 苛刻的
words.example: Harsh soap can dry out sensitive skin.
words.example_zh: 刺激性的肥皂會讓敏感肌膚變得乾燥。

words.zh: n. 壁櫥, 小室；a. 秘密的, 空談的；vt. 把...關入小室
words.example: Spare blankets are kept in the hall closet.
words.example_zh: 備用毯子放在走廊的壁櫥裡。

words.zh: n. 走廊, 迴廊, 人口密集地帶
words.example: She walked slowly down the long corridor.
words.example_zh: 她沿著長長的走廊慢慢走著。

words.zh: n. 內部, 內政；a. 內部的, 心靈的, 內地的, 內政的
words.example: The interior of the clinic was calm and bright.
words.example_zh: 診所的內部平靜而明亮。

words.zh: n. 有把的大罐, 瓶狀體, 投手, 攤販
words.example: A pitcher of water sat on the bedside table.
words.example_zh: 床邊桌上放著一壺水。

words.zh: n. 零售；a. 零售的；vt. 零售, 詳述, 傳播；vi. 零售
words.example: The drug costs less than its retail price here.
words.example_zh: 這種藥在這裡比零售價便宜。

words.zh: n. 蛇, 陰險的人；vi. 曲折行進；vt. 迂迴, 拉, 急抽
words.example: He was rushed to hospital after a snake bite.
words.example_zh: 被蛇咬後他被緊急送醫。

words.zh: n. 三月, 進行, 行軍, 步伐, 長途跋涉, 進行曲, 邊界；vi. 進軍, 前進, 交界；vt. 使行軍, 使行進
words.example: The patients took a slow march around the ward.
words.example_zh: 病人們在病房裡慢慢地走動。

words.zh: vt. 原諒, 申辯, 做為...的託辭；n. 致歉, 理由, 饒恕, 藉口
words.example: Tiredness is no excuse to skip your medicine.
words.example_zh: 疲倦不是漏服藥物的藉口。

words.zh: n. 折層, 折, 羊欄, 摺痕, 信徒；vt. 摺疊, 包, 合攏, 交迭；vi. 摺疊起來, 徹底失敗；[計] 摺疊; 合併
words.example: The nurse helped fold the clean sheets.
words.example_zh: 護理師幫忙摺好乾淨的床單。

words.zh: n. 謠言, 傳聞；vt. 謠傳
words.example: A rumor spread that the clinic would close.
words.example_zh: 診所要關閉的謠言傳了開來。

words.zh: n. 閃光, 閃現, 一瞬間；vi. 閃光, 閃現, 反射；vt. 使閃光, 反射
words.example: A flash of pain shot down his arm.
words.example_zh: 一陣劇痛竄下他的手臂。

words.zh: a. 可靠的, 可信賴的；[法] 可靠的, 可信賴的, 確實的
words.example: She is a reliable nurse you can always count on.
words.example_zh: 她是個你隨時可以信賴的可靠護理師。

words.zh: n. 刺激, 興奮；[醫] 興奮, 激動
words.example: The excitement of going home tired her out.
words.example_zh: 要回家的興奮讓她累壞了。

words.zh: n. 建築學, 建築式樣；[計] 體系結構
words.example: The hospital's open architecture lets in plenty of light.
words.example_zh: 醫院開闊的建築設計引入了充足的光線。

words.zh: a. 偶然的, 臨時的；[法] 偶然的, 特殊場合的
words.example: She still has the occasional dizzy spell.
words.example_zh: 她仍偶爾會頭暈。

words.zh: n. 手肘, 彎頭, 扶手；v. 用手肘推開, 推擠
words.example: He bruised his elbow when he fell.
words.example_zh: 他跌倒時撞傷了手肘。

words.zh: a. 致命的, 致死的；adv. 非常, 如死一般地
words.example: The bite of this snake is deadly without treatment.
words.example_zh: 這種蛇若不治療，咬傷足以致命。

words.zh: a. 西班牙的
words.example: The clinic serves a large Hispanic community.
words.example_zh: 這間診所服務著一個龐大的西語裔社區。

words.zh: n. 斷言, 主張, 申辯；[法] 宣告, 事實陳述, 斷言
words.example: The hospital denied the allegation of neglect.
words.example_zh: 醫院否認了疏於照顧的指控。

words.zh: vt. 使混亂, 使狼狽, 使困惑；[法] 混淆
words.example: It is easy to confuse the two diseases.
words.example_zh: 這兩種疾病很容易被混淆。

words.zh: n. 劑量, 服用量；vt. 給藥, (用藥)醫治；vi. 服藥
words.example: Take one dose of the syrup before bed.
words.example_zh: 睡前服用一劑糖漿。

words.zh: n. 入會, 開始；a. 新加入的；vt. 開始, 傳授基本知識給
words.example: The doctor decided to initiate treatment at once.
words.example_zh: 醫生決定立刻展開治療。

words.zh: vi. 辯護, 懇求；vt. 為...辯護, 提出...藉口, 託稱, 懇求
words.example: The family pleaded with him to eat something.
words.example_zh: 家人懇求他吃點東西。

words.zh: n. 樹幹, 幹線, 軀幹, 主幹, 象鼻, 箱子；vt. 把...放入旅行箱內；a. 樹幹的, 軀幹的, 幹線的, 箱形的；[計] 中繼線; 母線
words.example: The accident left his trunk badly bruised.
words.example_zh: 這場意外讓他的軀幹嚴重瘀傷。

words.zh: vt. 給與動機, 刺激, 提高...的學習慾望, 促動；[經] 促動, 激發, 激勵
words.example: A clear goal can motivate a patient to recover.
words.example_zh: 明確的目標能激勵病人康復。

words.zh: n. 燕子, 吞嚥, 喉；vt. 咽, 淹沒, 吞沒, 耗盡, 輕信, 忍受, 抑制；vi. 吞下, 嚥下
words.example: It hurt to swallow because of her sore throat.
words.example_zh: 因為喉嚨痛，她吞嚥時會痛。

words.zh: vt. 回報, 給於, 付給, 彙報, 提出, 捨棄, 反映, 表示, 表演, 致使, 執行, 實施；vi. 給予補償；n. 交納, 打底
words.example: The shock rendered him unable to speak.
words.example_zh: 這個打擊讓他說不出話來。

words.zh: n. 圈套, 陷阱, 詭計, 存水彎；vi. 設圈套, 設陷阱；vt. 誘捕, 誘騙, 抓住, 使受限制；[計] 俘獲; 陷井
words.example: Dirt can get trapped under the bandage.
words.example_zh: 髒汙可能卡在繃帶下面。

words.zh: adv. 看來似乎, 表面上看來
words.example: A seemingly minor cut became badly infected.
words.example_zh: 一道看似輕微的傷口竟嚴重感染。

words.zh: n. 效力；[經] 有效性, 能行性
words.example: Trials proved the effectiveness of the new drug.
words.example_zh: 試驗證明了這款新藥的有效性。

words.zh: n. 透鏡, 鏡頭, 鏡片, 晶狀體；vt. 給...攝影
words.example: The eye's lens grows cloudy with a cataract.
words.example_zh: 罹患白內障時，眼睛的水晶體會變得混濁。

words.zh: n. 朋友, 陪伴, 指南, 升降口圍罩；vt. 陪伴
words.example: A faithful companion sat with her every day.
words.example_zh: 一位忠實的同伴每天陪著她。

words.zh: n. 平原, 草原, 樸實無華的東西, 無格式；a. 簡單的, 明白的, 平常的, 不好看的, 樸素的, 清晰的, 普通的, 平坦的, 十足的；adv. 清楚地, 顯然地；[計]
words.example: The doctor explained it in plain language.
words.example_zh: 醫生用淺白的語言解釋了它。

words.zh: n. 檢查員, 巡視員；[化] 檢查員
words.example: A health inspector visited the clinic kitchen.
words.example_zh: 一位衛生稽查員視察了診所的廚房。

words.zh: a. 嚴厲的, 絕對的, 詳盡的, 嚴格的, 精確的；[法] 嚴格的, 精確的, 絕對的
words.example: The patient was put on a strict low-salt diet.
words.example_zh: 病人被要求採行嚴格的低鹽飲食。

words.zh: n. 排列, 衣服, 大批, 軍隊；vt. 佈署, 打扮, 排列；[計] 陣列; 陣列
words.example: The lab held an array of testing machines.
words.example_zh: 實驗室裡擺著一整排的檢驗儀器。

words.zh: n. 釘子, 指甲；vt. 用釘釘牢, 使固定, 截住, 揭露
words.example: An infection had spread under the toe nail.
words.example_zh: 感染已蔓延到腳趾甲下方。

words.zh: n. 鼠, 卑鄙的人, 破壞者, 變節者；vi. 捕鼠, 變節；vt. 弄蓬鬆
words.example: Lab rats are used to test the new drug.
words.example_zh: 實驗室的老鼠被用來測試新藥。

words.zh: n. 門廳；玄關；走廊
words.example: She paced the hallway while she waited for news.
words.example_zh: 等候消息時她在走廊裡來回踱步。

words.zh: n. 怪物, 惡人, 巨物；[醫] 畸胎
words.example: To the child, the scanner looked like a monster.
words.example_zh: 對孩子來說，掃描儀看起來像個怪物。

words.zh: n. 裂痕, 破綻, 拉裂, 浪子, 巨浪；vi. 被拉開, 裂開, 猛衝；vt. 撕, 扯, 劈
words.example: Be careful not to rip the stitches open.
words.example_zh: 小心別把縫線扯開。

words.zh: n. 藥草, 香草；[醫] 草, 草本, 草藥
words.example: The old woman brewed a bitter herb for her cough.
words.example_zh: 老婦人為她的咳嗽熬了一帖苦草藥。

words.zh: n. 水晶, 水晶裝飾品, 結晶；a. 水晶的, 水晶一樣的, 透明的
words.example: The kidney stone was made of tiny crystals.
words.example_zh: 這顆腎結石是由微小的結晶組成的。

words.zh: n. 後退, 凹處, 衰退, 歸還；[醫] 退縮
words.example: During the recession, fewer people sought care.
words.example_zh: 經濟衰退期間，求醫的人變少了。

words.zh: n. 動機, 目的, 主題, 基調；a. 運動的, 成為動機的
words.example: Her only motive was to help the sick.
words.example_zh: 她唯一的動機就是幫助病人。

words.zh: a. 苦的, 痛苦的, 懷恨的；adv. 刺骨；v. (使)變苦
words.example: The medicine had a bitter, unpleasant taste.
words.example_zh: 這種藥有股苦澀難喝的味道。

words.zh: n. 洪水, 大量之水, 漲潮；vt. 淹沒, 使氾濫, 注滿；vi. 被淹, 溢位, 湧進
words.example: The clinic was flooded after the heavy rain.
words.example_zh: 大雨過後診所淹了水。

words.zh: n. 鋼筆, 筆, 筆調, 筆桿子, 作家, 圍欄, 柵欄, 禽畜；vt. 寫, 關入欄中, 囚禁；vi. 動筆, 寫作
words.example: The doctor signed the form with a borrowed pen.
words.example_zh: 醫生用借來的筆簽了表格。

words.zh: n. 夢魘, 惡夢, 可怕的事物(或情景、人物)；[醫] 夢魘, 惡夢
words.example: The long wait for results was a nightmare.
words.example_zh: 漫長地等待結果簡直是場惡夢。

words.zh: n. 檢驗, 檢查, 視察；[醫] 檢查, 視察, 監督, 望診
words.example: A close inspection of the wound showed no infection.
words.example_zh: 仔細檢查傷口後沒發現感染。

words.zh: n. 管理者, 監督者, 指導者, 視導員；[計] 管理程式
words.example: Her supervisor checked the dose before it was given.
words.example_zh: 她的督導在給藥前核對了劑量。

words.zh: n. 角鬥場, 舞臺, 場地；[醫] 尿沉渣, 尿沙; 腦沙
words.example: The hospital became an arena in the fight against the virus.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院成了對抗病毒的戰場。

words.zh: vi. 商討, 商量, 協商, 會診；vt. 向...請教, 查閱, 考慮
words.example: Always consult a doctor before stopping a drug.
words.example_zh: 停藥前務必諮詢醫生。

words.zh: n. 擁有, 佔有, 所有, 財產, 領土, 領地, 自制, 著迷；[經] 佔有, 持有
words.example: The police found stolen drugs in his possession.
words.example_zh: 警方發現他持有贓物。

words.zh: adv. 堅固, 堅實, 一致, 始終如一, 連貫；[計] 相容地
words.example: She consistently took her pills on time.
words.example_zh: 她始終如一地準時服藥。

words.zh: n. 地下室, 牆腳；[化] 地下室
words.example: The records were stored in the hospital basement.
words.example_zh: 病歷存放在醫院的地下室。

words.zh: n. 漂流物, 漂流, 動向；v. (使)漂流
words.example: His attention began to drift as the fever rose.
words.example_zh: 隨著高燒上升，他的注意力開始渙散。

words.zh: n. 排水溝, 消耗, 排水；vt. 排出, 喝光, 耗盡；vi. 排水, 流乾
words.example: A small tube was placed to drain the wound.
words.example_zh: 放入一根小管子來引流傷口。

words.zh: n. 製作者, 工人
words.example: The old wright built the wooden ward by hand.
words.example_zh: 那位老工匠親手蓋了這間木造病房。

words.zh: n. 極點, 最大量, 極大；a. 最高的, 最大的, 最大極限的；[計] 最大值
words.example: Do not take more than the maximum daily dose.
words.example_zh: 不要超過每日的最大劑量。

words.zh: n. 公告, 發表, 告知；[經] 通告, 佈告, 公告
words.example: The hospital made an announcement about new rules.
words.example_zh: 醫院發布了關於新規定的公告。

words.zh: n. 調查表, 問卷；[經] 調查表
words.example: Each patient filled in a short health questionnaire.
words.example_zh: 每位病人都填了一份簡短的健康問卷。

words.zh: n. 戰士, 勇士, 武士, 鼓吹戰爭的人, 戰鬥, 尚武
words.example: She was a warrior in her long fight with cancer.
words.example_zh: 在與癌症的長期抗戰中，她是個鬥士。

words.zh: n. 預言, 預報；[化] 預測
words.example: The doctor's prediction of a full recovery came true.
words.example_zh: 醫生對完全康復的預測成真了。

words.zh: n. 製圖法, 製圖學, 圖解演算法, 圖形顯示；[計] 圖形; DOS外部命令:列印圖形方式下的螢幕內容
words.example: The report used clear graphics to show the data.
words.example_zh: 這份報告用清楚的圖表來呈現數據。

words.zh: n. 泥, 誹謗；vt. 弄髒
words.example: The wound was washed clean of mud and grit.
words.example_zh: 傷口被清洗乾淨，去除了泥土和砂礫。

words.zh: pl. 細菌；[醫] 細菌, [無芽胞]桿菌
words.example: Harmful bacteria can live on unwashed hands.
words.example_zh: 有害的細菌能在未洗的手上存活。

words.zh: n. 特權, 特別恩典, 基本權利, 特免；vt. 給與...特權, 特免
words.example: It was a privilege to care for her in her last days.
words.example_zh: 能在她生命最後的日子裡照顧她是種榮幸。

words.zh: n. 聖堂, 廟宇, 教堂, 禮拜堂, 太陽穴, 鬢角；[醫] 顳顬, 顳部
words.example: He felt a throbbing pain at his temple.
words.example_zh: 他感到太陽穴一陣抽痛。

words.zh: n. 廣播, 傳播；a. 廣播的；v. 廣播；adv. 經廣播, 四散地；[計] 廣播命令, 廣播
words.example: A health warning was broadcast on the radio.
words.example_zh: 一則健康警示透過收音機播送。

words.zh: n. 隨意, 隨機；a. 任意的, 隨便的, 胡亂的, 隨機的；adv. 胡亂地
words.example: Patients were placed in random groups for the trial.
words.example_zh: 病人被隨機分組進行試驗。

words.zh: n. 跳躍, 劇增, 急變, 被越過之物；vi. 跳躍, 突然經過；vt. 躍過, 使躍過
words.example: The new drug was a great leap forward in treatment.
words.example_zh: 這款新藥是治療上的一大躍進。

words.zh: n. 帳, 幕, 窗簾；vt. 裝簾子於, 遮蔽
words.example: The nurse drew the curtain for some privacy.
words.example_zh: 護理師拉上簾子以保有隱私。

words.zh: n. 手腕, 腕關節；[醫] 腕
words.example: She wore a band on her wrist with her patient number.
words.example_zh: 她手腕上戴著一條印有病人編號的手環。

words.zh: n. 領域, 領土, 產業, 範圍；[計] 域, 區域, 支配命令
words.example: Rare diseases are the domain of specialist doctors.
words.example_zh: 罕見疾病是專科醫生的領域。

words.zh: n. 罪行, 內疚；[法] 罪, 犯罪, 罪行
words.example: He felt a heavy guilt for ignoring the warning signs.
words.example_zh: 他為忽視了警訊而深感內疚。

words.zh: a. 怪異的, 超自然的, 不可思議的；n. 命運, 預言, 符咒
words.example: She had a weird taste in her mouth after the drug.
words.example_zh: 服藥後她嘴裡有股奇怪的味道。

words.zh: a. 最小的, 最低的；n. 最小值；[計] 最小值
words.example: Keep the dose to the safe minimum.
words.example_zh: 把劑量保持在安全的最低限度。

words.zh: a. 財政的, 國庫的；[經] 財政上的, 會計的, 國庫的
words.example: The hospital faced a tough fiscal year.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院面臨一個艱困的會計年度。

words.zh: n. 垃圾場；vt. 傾倒, 傾銷；vi. 倒垃圾, 傾銷商品；[計] 轉出; 轉儲; 傾卸; 切斷電源
words.example: Old medicines should never be dumped in the river.
words.example_zh: 過期藥絕不該倒入河中。

words.zh: n. 裙子, 下襬, 邊緣, 郊區；vt. 位於...邊緣, 繞過, 迴避；vi. 位於邊緣
words.example: The new road skirts the old town.
words.example_zh: 這條新路繞過舊城區。

words.zh: adv. 因此, 從此
words.example: He skipped his pills, hence the relapse.
words.example_zh: 他漏服了藥，因此病情復發。

words.zh: vt. 執行, 實行, 完成, 處死, 製成；[計] 執行
words.example: The team executed the surgery without a hitch.
words.example_zh: 團隊毫無差錯地完成了手術。

words.zh: n. 四肢, 枝幹, 翼, 邊緣；vt. 切斷...之手足
words.example: The injured limb was kept raised to reduce swelling.
words.example_zh: 受傷的肢體被墊高以減輕腫脹。

words.zh: n. 思想體系, 意識形態, 觀念學, 空論；[醫] 觀念學, 觀念形態
words.example: Her care was guided by an ideology of kindness.
words.example_zh: 她的照護以仁慈的理念為依歸。

words.zh: n. 歌曲, 主旋律, 心情, 聲調, 和諧, 一致, 語調, 程度；vt. 為...調音, 調整, 調諧, 使一致；vi. 協調, 調諧
words.example: She hummed a familiar tune to soothe the child.
words.example_zh: 她哼著一首熟悉的曲子安撫孩子。

words.zh: vt. 忍受, 忍耐, 容忍, 耐；vi. (正式)持久, 持續；[計] 仍能工作, 繼續工作
words.example: He had to endure weeks of painful therapy.
words.example_zh: 他必須忍受數週痛苦的治療。

words.zh: n. 傷害, 害處；vt. 傷害, 損害
words.example: Smoking does great harm to the lungs.
words.example_zh: 吸菸對肺造成極大的傷害。

words.zh: n. 輻射；[化] 放射
words.example: She received radiation to shrink the tumor.
words.example_zh: 她接受放射治療來縮小腫瘤。

words.zh: n. 角, 角質, 喇叭, 號角；a. 角制的；vt. 用角觸, 長角於
words.example: The ambulance sounded its horn through the traffic.
words.example_zh: 救護車在車陣中鳴笛。

words.zh: a. 慢性的, 習慣性的；n. 慢性病患者
words.example: He suffers from chronic pain in his knees.
words.example_zh: 他的膝蓋有慢性的疼痛。

words.zh: vi. 舉止端正, 行為規矩；vt. 檢點(自己的)行為, 使表現好
words.example: The children behaved well while waiting at the clinic.
words.example_zh: 孩子們在診所候診時很守規矩。

words.zh: vt. 管理, 料理, 執行；vi. 執行遺產管理人的職責, 給予幫助
words.example: A nurse will administer the injection.
words.example_zh: 一名護理師將施打這針。

words.zh: adv. 同時發生, 一齊, 同時, 同時存在
words.example: Both drugs were given simultaneously.
words.example_zh: 兩種藥同時給予。

words.zh: n. 傳輸, 傳送, 變速器；[計] 傳輸
words.example: Hand washing breaks the transmission of germs.
words.example_zh: 洗手能阻斷病菌的傳播。

words.zh: n. 修訂, 改善, 改良, 改正；[化] 調理劑; 修正
words.example: An amendment to the law improved patient rights.
words.example_zh: 這項法律修正案改善了病人的權益。

words.zh: n. 溢位, 濺出, 摔下, 溢位量, 木片, 小塞子；vt. 使溢位, 使散落, 灑, 使流出, 倒出, 使摔下；vi. 溢位, 湧流, 摔下
words.example: She cleaned up the spill of medicine at once.
words.example_zh: 她立刻清理了灑出來的藥水。

words.zh: a. 感謝的, 感激的, 令人快意的, 受歡迎的
words.example: She was deeply grateful for the nurses' care.
words.example_zh: 她對護理師的照顧深懷感激。

words.zh: n. 殖民地, 移民隊；[醫] 菌(集)落, 菌叢; 移民區
words.example: A colony of bacteria grew in the dish.
words.example_zh: 培養皿中長出了一群細菌。

words.zh: n. 採用, 採納, 收養；[法] 收養, 採納, 採用
words.example: The adoption of the new rule cut infections.
words.example_zh: 採用這項新規定後感染減少了。

words.zh: n. 囚犯, 罪犯；vt. 宣告有罪, 使知罪
words.example: The convict was treated in the prison clinic.
words.example_zh: 這名囚犯在監獄診所接受治療。

words.zh: a. 本土的, 國產的, 固有的；[醫] 原產的, 本土的
words.example: The remedy uses an indigenous mountain herb.
words.example_zh: 這帖藥使用了一種本土的山區草藥。

words.zh: n. 手巾, 毛巾；v. 擦乾身子
words.example: The nurse dried his hands with a clean towel.
words.example_zh: 護理師用一條乾淨的毛巾擦乾他的手。

words.zh: n. 顆粒, 粒子, 質點, 極小量；[化] 粒子; 質點
words.example: Tiny particles of dust can harm weak lungs.
words.example_zh: 微小的灰塵顆粒會傷害虛弱的肺。

words.zh: n. 登陸, 碼頭, 降落；[經] 上岸, 登陸, 降落；樓梯平台
words.example: She paused on the landing to catch her breath.
words.example_zh: 她在樓梯轉角平臺停下來喘口氣。

words.zh: n. 推進, 吹捧；vt. 推進, 提高, 宣揚, 促進
words.example: A good meal gave him a much-needed boost.
words.example_zh: 一頓好飯給了他急需的能量。

words.zh: n. 驚恐, 警報, 警鐘；vt. 使驚恐, 警告；[計] 報警訊號
words.example: The monitor's alarm woke the whole ward.
words.example_zh: 監測儀的警報吵醒了整個病房。

words.zh: a. 節日的, 喜慶的, 快樂的；n. 節日, 慶祝, 歡宴
words.example: She was home in time for the autumn festival.
words.example_zh: 她及時回家過秋天的節慶。

words.zh: n. 汗, 汗水, 水珠, 焦急；vi. 出汗, 滲出, 冒出水氣, 結水珠, 煩惱, 懊惱；vt. 使出汗, 流出, 榨出, 使汗流浹背
words.example: Cold sweat covered his brow during the attack.
words.example_zh: 發作時他的額頭冒著冷汗。

words.zh: vt. 在...下面挖, 漸漸破壞, 暗地裡破壞；[法] 暗中破壞, 以陰謀中傷傷害
words.example: Skipping meals can undermine your recovery.
words.example_zh: 不吃飯會破壞你的康復。

words.zh: adv. 傳統上；傳說上；習慣上
words.example: Such illnesses were traditionally treated with herbs.
words.example_zh: 這類疾病傳統上以草藥治療。

words.zh: n. 投票, 投票用紙, 抽籤；vi. 投票, 抽籤；vt. 投票選出, 拉選票
words.example: The staff voted by secret ballot on the new shifts.
words.example_zh: 員工以不記名投票表決新的班表。

words.zh: a. 聰明的, 智慧的, 瞭解的
words.example: An intelligent guess saved valuable time.
words.example_zh: 一個聰明的判斷省下了寶貴的時間。

words.zh: n. 共和國, 共和政體, 團體, 界
words.example: The disease spread across the small republic.
words.example_zh: 這種病蔓延了整個小共和國。

words.zh: v. 統治, 支配, 管理
words.example: Strict rules govern how the drug is stored.
words.example_zh: 嚴格的規定規範這種藥的存放方式。

words.zh: a. 確信的, 深信的
words.example: She was convinced the treatment would work.
words.example_zh: 她確信這項治療會有效。

words.zh: n. 巨大的熱情, 熱心
words.example: He tackled his recovery with real enthusiasm.
words.example_zh: 他以真正的熱忱投入康復。

words.zh: vt. 使適應, 調和, 通融, 容納, 向...提供；vi. 適應
words.example: The new ward can accommodate twenty more beds.
words.example_zh: 新病房可再容納二十張床。

words.zh: n. 讚美, 稱讚, 崇拜；vt. 稱讚, 讚美；vi. 讚揚, 表揚
words.example: The doctor praised her for taking her pills on time.
words.example_zh: 醫生稱讚她準時服藥。

words.zh: vt. 傷害, 損害, 使受冤屈；[醫] 損傷
words.example: He injured his back lifting a heavy box.
words.example_zh: 他搬重箱子時傷了背。

words.zh: a. 不停的, 無窮盡的, 無盡的；[機] 無端的, 環狀的
words.example: The night before surgery felt endless.
words.example_zh: 手術前一晚感覺漫長無盡。

words.zh: adv. 各自地, 獨自地, 個別地, 分別地
words.example: The two drugs ease pain and fever respectively.
words.example_zh: 這兩種藥分別緩解疼痛與發燒。

words.zh: a. 機械的, 機械性的, 力學的；[醫] 機械的, 力學的
words.example: A mechanical pump kept his heart going.
words.example_zh: 一台機械幫浦維持著他的心跳。

words.zh: n. 開本, 版式, 形式, 格式；vt. 格式化；[計] 格式; DOS外部命令:對磁碟進行格式化
words.example: The chart follows a simple, clear format.
words.example_zh: 這份病歷採用簡單清楚的格式。

words.zh: n. 大廳, 休息室, 遊說議員者；vi. 遊說議員, 遊說；vt. 遊說
words.example: Patients waited in the bright hospital lobby.
words.example_zh: 病人在明亮的醫院大廳等候。

words.zh: n. 特徵, 特性, 一筆, 少許
words.example: Patience is a key trait in a good nurse.
words.example_zh: 耐心是好護理師的關鍵特質。

words.zh: n. 貨幣, 通貨, 流通, 通用；[計] 貨幣, 貨幣型
words.example: Trust is the real currency between doctor and patient.
words.example_zh: 信任是醫病之間真正的通貨。

words.zh: vi. 道歉, 辯解
words.example: The clinic was quick to apologize for the delay.
words.example_zh: 診所很快為延誤致歉。

words.zh: n. 儲備品, 貯量, 後備軍, 自然保護區, 保留, 拘謹, 節制, 儲備金；vt. 保留, 儲存, 預訂, 延期, 推遲
words.example: The hospital keeps a reserve of blood for emergencies.
words.example_zh: 醫院為緊急狀況保留了一批血液。

words.zh: n. 橫樑, 杆, 光線, 容光煥發；vi. 用梁支承, 微笑, 射出光線；vt. 照耀, 感到欣喜；[計] 束
words.example: A warm beam of sunlight fell across the bed.
words.example_zh: 一道溫暖的陽光灑落在床上。

words.zh: n. 腐敗, 墮落, 貪汙；[計] 論誤
words.example: Corruption left the public hospitals starved of funds.
words.example_zh: 貪腐使公立醫院經費拮据。

words.zh: n. 天文學家
words.example: The astronomer spent cold nights at the telescope.
words.example_zh: 這位天文學家在寒夜裡守著望遠鏡。

words.zh: n. 立契約的人, 承包商；[化] 承包者; 承包工廠
words.example: A contractor built the new wing in record time.
words.example_zh: 一位承包商以破紀錄的速度蓋好了新側翼。

words.zh: n. 教條, 學說；[醫] 學說
words.example: Do no harm is a central doctrine of medicine.
words.example_zh: 「不造成傷害」是醫學的核心原則。

words.zh: a. 真正的, 真實的, 誠懇的；[醫] 真性的
words.example: She showed genuine concern for every patient.
words.example_zh: 她對每位病人都流露出真誠的關切。

words.zh: n. 拇指；vt. 以拇指撥弄, 笨拙地擺弄, 用拇指翻舊, 迅速翻閱, 作搭車手勢
words.example: He cut his thumb while slicing vegetables.
words.example_zh: 他切菜時割傷了拇指。

words.zh: n. 一致, 聯合, 單一(性), 個體；[經] 統一
words.example: There was a sense of unity among the ward staff.
words.example_zh: 病房的工作人員之間有股團結的氛圍。

words.zh: a. 排外的, 獨佔的, 唯一的；[計] 獨佔的
words.example: The clinic offers exclusive care to its members.
words.example_zh: 這間診所為會員提供專屬的照護。

words.zh: n. 消散, 分散, 散播, 散射, 散佈, 酒館；vi. 散佈, 散播, 消散；vt. 使消散, 使分散, 撒, 散佈, 散播, 散射；[計] 散點圖
words.example: The pills scattered across the floor when she dropped them.
words.example_zh: 她把藥丸掉在地上，散落一地。

words.zh: vt. 傳達, 運輸, 轉讓；[經] 轉讓(財產等), 搬運
words.example: The nurse tried to convey hope to the family.
words.example_zh: 護理師試著把希望傳達給家屬。

words.zh: n. 複雜, 複雜性, 複雜的事物
words.example: The complexity of the case puzzled the doctors.
words.example_zh: 這個病例的複雜讓醫生們困惑。

words.zh: n. 一扭, 扭曲, 曲折, 歪曲, 螺旋狀, 新手法；vt. 擰, 扭, 捻, 編織, 使扭轉, 纏繞, 盤繞, 歪曲, 使轉動, 使苦惱, 使混亂, 使旋轉；vi. 轉向, 彎
words.example: She felt a sharp twist of pain in her ankle.
words.example_zh: 她感到腳踝一陣劇烈的扭痛。

words.zh: n. 懷疑, 覺察, 嫌疑；[法] 懷疑, 疑心, 嫌疑
words.example: A lump in the breast aroused the doctor's suspicion.
words.example_zh: 乳房裡的腫塊引起了醫生的懷疑。

words.zh: vt. 減輕, 救濟, 解除, 使免除, 換...的班, 使得到調劑, 使不單調, 襯托, 使顯著；vi. 救濟, 當替補投手, 呈鮮明突出
words.example: A cold compress can relieve the swelling.
words.example_zh: 冷敷能減輕腫脹。

words.zh: n. 住宅, 居留, 駐紮, 居住期間；[醫] 住房
words.example: The doctor's residence was just behind the clinic.
words.example_zh: 醫生的住所就在診所後面。

words.zh: a. 意味深長的
words.example: A meaningful talk with the nurse eased her fears.
words.example_zh: 與護理師一席有意義的談話緩解了她的恐懼。

words.zh: n. 簽字, 識別標誌, 調號；[計] 簽名附件
words.example: The form is not valid without the doctor's signature.
words.example_zh: 沒有醫生的簽名，這份表格便無效。

words.zh: vt. 懸, 吊, 使懸浮, 暫停, 中止, 推遲；vi. 暫停, 中止, 懸浮, 停止償付債務；[計] 暫停
words.example: The drug was suspended after the safety scare.
words.example_zh: 安全疑慮發生後，這種藥被暫停使用。

words.zh: n. 叛徒, 反叛者；vi. 造反, 反抗, 抵抗, 反感；a. 造反的, 反抗的
words.example: His immune system began to rebel against his own body.
words.example_zh: 他的免疫系統開始反過來攻擊自己的身體。

words.zh: n. 配偶
words.example: Her spouse stayed with her throughout the treatment.
words.example_zh: 她的配偶在整個療程中都陪著她。

words.zh: n. 液體, 分泌液, 流體；a. 流動的, 可改變的
words.example: The patient was given fluid through a drip.
words.example_zh: 病人經由點滴補充體液。

words.zh: a. 理論的, 理論上的, 假設的, 推理的；[計] 理論的
words.example: The risk is largely theoretical, not practical.
words.example_zh: 這種風險大多是理論上的，並非實際的。

words.zh: n. 鈉；[化] 鈉Na
words.example: Too much sodium in the diet raises blood pressure.
words.example_zh: 飲食中鈉含量過高會使血壓升高。

words.zh: n. 養老金, 退休金, 津貼, 年金, 撫卹金, 膳宿學校, 膳宿費；vt. 發給退休金, 用津貼拉攏
words.example: He lived on a small pension after retiring.
words.example_zh: 退休後他靠著微薄的退休金生活。

words.zh: a. 細緻優雅的, 微妙的, 美味的；[醫] 柔弱的
words.example: The surgeon's work on the eye was extremely delicate.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生在眼睛上的手術極為精細。

words.zh: vt. 改建, 重建, 改造；vi. 重建
words.example: Therapy helped him rebuild the strength in his arm.
words.example_zh: 治療幫助他重建了手臂的力量。

words.zh: n. 鉤, 鉤狀, 鐮刀, 陷阱；vt. 掛...於鉤上, 鉤住, 引上鉤, 偷竊；vi. 彎成鉤狀, 鉤緊；[計] 鉤
words.example: The drip bag hung from a metal hook.
words.example_zh: 點滴袋掛在一個金屬鉤上。

words.zh: n. 跳, 跳躍, 彈力, 撞擊；vi. 反跳, 彈跳；vt. 使跳回, 撞擊；[計] 打回
words.example: Children seem to bounce back from illness quickly.
words.example_zh: 孩子似乎能很快從疾病中復原。

words.zh: n. 偵探；a. 偵探的
words.example: Diagnosing the rare illness was like detective work.
words.example_zh: 診斷這種罕見疾病就像偵探辦案。

words.zh: n. 出口, 退場, 離去, 去世；vi. 退出, 脫離, 去世；[計] 退出; DOS內部命令:本命令用於退出當前的命令處理器(COMMAND.COM)；恢復前一個命令處理器
words.example: The nurse showed the family to the exit.
words.example_zh: 護理師領著家屬走向出口。

words.zh: vt. 獻出, 貢獻
words.example: She chose to dedicate her life to caring for others.
words.example_zh: 她選擇把一生奉獻給照顧他人。

words.zh: n. 吸引, 吸引人的事物, 吸引力；[醫] 吸引
words.example: The hospital's garden was a quiet attraction for patients.
words.example_zh: 醫院的花園是病人一處寧靜的去處。

words.zh: v. 雕刻, 切開
words.example: The surgeon carved away the dead tissue with care.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生小心地切除了壞死的組織。

words.zh: n. 針, 尖；vt. 用針縫；vi. 縫紉；[計] 探針
words.example: She barely felt the needle go in.
words.example_zh: 她幾乎沒感覺到針扎進去。

words.zh: n. 驚嚇, 恐慌；vt. 驚嚇, 使恐慌；vi. 受驚
words.example: The strange reading gave the doctor a scare.
words.example_zh: 這個異常的數值嚇了醫生一跳。

words.zh: n. 穿梭, 梭子, 往返移動之物；v. (使)穿梭移動, 往返運送
words.example: A free shuttle takes patients to the clinic.
words.example_zh: 一輛免費接駁車載送病人去診所。

words.zh: n. 交易, 辦理, 學報, 和解協議；[計] 事務處理
words.example: The pharmacy logs every transaction carefully.
words.example_zh: 藥局仔細記錄每一筆交易。

words.zh: n. 援救, 解救, 營救；vt. 援救, 救出, 營救
words.example: A quick rescue saved the drowning boy.
words.example_zh: 一次迅速的搶救救了這名溺水的男孩。

words.zh: a. 溫和的, 溫柔的, 淡味的, 適度的, 輕微的, (肥皂等)軟性的；[醫] 輕的, 緩和的
words.example: She had only a mild fever overnight.
words.example_zh: 她整晚只有輕微的發燒。

words.zh: a. 同一的, 恆等的, 完全相同的；[醫] 同一的, 同等的
words.example: The twins had identical symptoms.
words.example_zh: 這對雙胞胎有著一模一樣的症狀。

words.zh: n. 洋娃娃, 無頭腦的美麗女人
words.example: The sick child clutched her favorite doll.
words.example_zh: 生病的孩子緊抱著她最愛的娃娃。

words.zh: n. 騎手, (檔案後的)附件, 扶手；[化] 遊碼
words.example: The injured rider was thrown from his horse.
words.example_zh: 那名受傷的騎手從馬背上摔了下來。

words.zh: prep. 在其間, 在其中；[經] 在...中
words.example: The nurse stayed calm amid the chaos.
words.example_zh: 在一片混亂中，護理師保持鎮定。

words.zh: a. 精確的, 嚴謹的, 明確的；[機] 精密的, 正確的
words.example: The dose must be precise for such a small child.
words.example_zh: 對這麼小的孩子，劑量必須精確。

words.zh: a. 憂慮的, 發愁的, 渴望的
words.example: She felt anxious as she waited for the results.
words.example_zh: 等待結果時她感到焦慮。

words.zh: a. 住宅的, 與居住有關的；[法] 有關居住的, 房產的:居所的, 適於居住的
words.example: The clinic sits in a quiet residential area.
words.example_zh: 這間診所位於一個寧靜的住宅區。

words.zh: a. 結構的, 建築的；[醫] 結構的
words.example: The X-ray showed structural damage to the bone.
words.example_zh: X 光顯示骨頭有結構性的損傷。

words.zh: n. 碳水化合物, 糖類；[化] 糖類; 碳水化合物
words.example: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.example_zh: 麵包和米飯富含碳水化合物。

words.zh: n. 海報, 招貼, 驛馬
words.example: A poster on the wall explained how to wash hands.
words.example_zh: 牆上一張海報說明如何洗手。

words.zh: n. 自由, 特權, 許可, 冒失；[法] 自由, 自由權, 自由區域
words.example: Recovering her health gave her a sense of liberty.
words.example_zh: 恢復健康給了她一種自由的感覺。

words.zh: n. 爬行, 匍匐而行, 養魚池；v. 爬行
words.example: The baby could barely crawl across the floor.
words.example_zh: 寶寶才剛能勉強在地上爬。

words.zh: n. 氧；[化] 氧O-2
words.example: The patient was given extra oxygen to help her breathe.
words.example_zh: 病人被給予額外的氧氣以助呼吸。

words.zh: n. 總數, 總和, 金額, 概要, 頂點；vt. 總計, 概括；vi. 合計；[計] 系統實用程式和維護
words.example: The treatment cost a large sum of money.
words.example_zh: 這項治療花了一大筆錢。

words.zh: a. 有希望的, 前途有望的；[經] 有希望的
words.example: Early results of the drug are very promising.
words.example_zh: 這種藥的早期結果非常有希望。

words.zh: a. 有意識的, 知覺的, 覺察的；[醫] 有意識的, 清醒的
words.example: The patient was awake and fully conscious.
words.example_zh: 病人清醒，意識完全清楚。

words.zh: n. 決心, 果斷；[化] 判定; 測定
words.example: Her determination to walk again amazed everyone.
words.example_zh: 她重新走路的決心讓所有人驚嘆。

words.zh: n. 捐贈人；[化] 給體; 供體
words.example: The blood donor saved three lives that day.
words.example_zh: 那位捐血者那天救了三條人命。

words.zh: n. 爵士樂, 喧鬧；a. 爵士樂的, 喧吵的；vi. 演奏爵士樂, 跳爵士舞, 遊蕩；vt. 奏爵士樂, 使活潑
words.example: Soft jazz played quietly in the waiting room.
words.example_zh: 候診室裡輕柔地播著爵士樂。

words.zh: n. 牧師
words.example: The pastor visited the dying man to comfort him.
words.example_zh: 牧師探望這位垂死的男子來安慰他。

words.zh: n. 歌劇
words.example: She had been a famous opera singer in her youth.
words.example_zh: 她年輕時曾是位著名的歌劇女伶。

words.zh: n. 獲得, 獲得物；[經] 收購, 招攬, 取得
words.example: The hospital's acquisition of new scanners helped patients.
words.example_zh: 醫院購置新掃描儀嘉惠了病人。

words.zh: n. 深坑, 礦井, 果核, 地窖, 深淵, 絕境, 陷阱；vt. 窖藏, 使凹下, 使有麻點, 去...之核, 使留疤痕, 使相鬥, 使競爭；vi. 起凹點, 凹陷
words.example: An old mine pit lay abandoned outside the town.
words.example_zh: 鎮外有一座廢棄的舊礦坑。

words.zh: n. 野生動植物
words.example: The park protects rare wildlife.
words.example_zh: 這座公園保護珍稀的野生動物。

words.zh: n. 離開, 出發, 違背, 偏離；[經] 啟運
words.example: Her departure from hospital was a happy day.
words.example_zh: 她出院的那天是個快樂的日子。

words.zh: n. 電梯, 升降機；[化] 提升機
words.example: The elevator took the stretcher up to the ward.
words.example_zh: 電梯把擔架送上了病房。

words.zh: vt. 以雕像裝飾；n. 雕像
words.example: A statue of the founder stood in the courtyard.
words.example_zh: 庭院裡立著一座創辦人的雕像。

words.zh: n. 口試；a. 口頭的, 口述的, 口部的
words.example: The doctor switched her to an oral medicine.
words.example_zh: 醫生把她換成口服藥。

words.zh: n. 辦事員, 職員, 文書；vi. 當店員
words.example: The clerk at the desk checked her appointment.
words.example_zh: 櫃檯的職員核對了她的預約。

words.zh: a. 有分寸的, 得體的, 大方的；尚可的、相當好的
words.example: After surgery he finally got a decent night's sleep.
words.example_zh: 手術後他終於睡了個像樣的好覺。

words.zh: n. 拳頭, 手；vt. 拳打, 握成拳, 緊握
words.example: He clenched his fist as the needle went in.
words.example_zh: 針扎進去時他握緊了拳頭。

words.zh: n. 目的地, 目標, 目的；[計] 目的檔案, 目的單元
words.example: The ambulance reached its destination in minutes.
words.example_zh: 救護車在幾分鐘內抵達了目的地。

words.zh: vt. 支援, 贊同, 背書於, 簽署；[經] 贊成, 背書
words.example: Doctors widely endorse the new vaccine.
words.example_zh: 醫生普遍支持這款新疫苗。

words.zh: n. 探險, 踏勘, 探測；[醫] 探察
words.example: Careful exploration of the wound found the splinter.
words.example_zh: 仔細探查傷口後找到了那根刺。

words.zh: n. 反饋, 反應；[計] 反饋
words.example: The doctor welcomed feedback from her patients.
words.example_zh: 這位醫生樂於聽取病人的回饋。

words.zh: adv. 因此
words.example: He quit smoking, thereby easing his cough.
words.example_zh: 他戒了菸，因而減輕了咳嗽。

words.zh: n. 紫色, 帝位；a. 紫色的, 帝王的, 華而不實的；v. (使)成紫色
words.example: The bruise slowly turned a deep purple.
words.example_zh: 瘀青慢慢變成了深紫色。

words.zh: n. 日光；[醫] 日光, 太陽光
words.example: A little sunlight helps the body make vitamin D.
words.example_zh: 適度的日照有助於身體合成維生素 D。

words.zh: n. 雷射；[計] 雷射器
words.example: The surgeon used a laser to remove the growth.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生用雷射切除了那塊增生物。

words.zh: a. 大膽的；n. 粗體；[計] 粗體
words.example: It was a bold decision to operate so soon.
words.example_zh: 這麼快就動手術是個大膽的決定。

words.zh: n. 專家意見, 專門技術；[法] 專門知識, 專家意見
words.example: Her expertise in heart surgery is widely known.
words.example_zh: 她在心臟手術上的專業廣為人知。

words.zh: a. 不情願的, 勉強的；[法] 不願的, 勉強的, 難以處理的
words.example: He was reluctant to take such strong medicine.
words.example_zh: 他不太情願服用這麼強的藥。

words.zh: adv. 銳利地, 嚴厲地, 厲害地；[經] 劇烈地
words.example: His blood pressure dropped sharply.
words.example_zh: 他的血壓急遽下降。

words.zh: n. 暗示, 提示；v. 暗示, 示意
words.example: A faint smell of smoke was the first hint of fire.
words.example_zh: 一絲煙味是失火的第一個跡象。

words.zh: n. 王國, 領土, 領域；[計] 領域
words.example: Such cures lie in the realm of folk medicine.
words.example_zh: 這類療法屬於民俗醫療的範疇。

words.zh: vt. 混合；n. 混合
words.example: The drug is a careful blend of two compounds.
words.example_zh: 這種藥是兩種化合物的精心調配。

words.zh: n. 取消, 撤消, 蓋銷(郵票)；vt. 取消, 刪去, 抵銷, 蓋銷；vi. 相互抵銷；[計] 作廢
words.example: She had to cancel her appointment due to the storm.
words.example_zh: 因為暴風雨，她不得不取消預約。

words.zh: n. 構成, 憲法, 體格；[醫] 體質; 結構, 組織
words.example: He has a strong constitution and rarely falls ill.
words.example_zh: 他體質強健，很少生病。

words.zh: a. 領受的, 容易接受的, 感受性強的；n. 領受者, 容納者, 容器
words.example: The recipient of the kidney is doing well.
words.example_zh: 接受腎臟的病人狀況良好。

words.zh: n. 皮, 外殼；vt. 削...皮, 剝去...的殼；vi. 蛻皮, 剝落, 脫皮, 脫去衣服
words.example: The sunburned skin began to peel after a few days.
words.example_zh: 曬傷的皮膚過幾天後開始脫皮。

words.zh: n. 會計學, 帳單, 清帳；[計] 帳戶處理, 記帳
words.example: The clinic keeps careful accounting of its costs.
words.example_zh: 這間診所仔細記帳，控管費用。

words.zh: vt. 擲, 彈, 輕擊, 空翻；vi. 用指輕彈, 抽打, 蹦跳；n. 拋, 彈, 筋斗；a. 無禮的；[計] 翻轉
words.example: The doctor flipped through the thick file.
words.example_zh: 醫生翻閱著那本厚厚的病歷。

words.zh: vi. 猶豫, 遲疑, 躊躇, 支吾, 停頓
words.example: Do not hesitate to call if the pain returns.
words.example_zh: 若疼痛復發，請別猶豫，立刻來電。

words.zh: n. 偏見, 斜紋；a. 偏斜的；adv. 偏斜；vt. 使有偏見；[計] 偏流; 偏壓; 偏磁; 偏離
words.example: The study was designed to avoid any bias.
words.example_zh: 這項研究的設計是為了避免任何偏差。

words.zh: a. 法庭的, 公正的, 審判上的, 司法的；[法] 司法的, 審判上的, 法官的
words.example: The case went through a long judicial process.
words.example_zh: 這個案件經歷了漫長的司法程序。

words.zh: n. 垃圾, 廢物；[計] 無用資訊
words.example: Medical garbage must be disposed of with care.
words.example_zh: 醫療垃圾必須謹慎處理。

words.zh: n. 燈；vt. 照亮；[計] 邏輯模擬分析系統
words.example: A small lamp lit the corner of the ward.
words.example_zh: 一盞小燈照亮了病房的角落。

words.zh: a. 受控制的, 統制的, 調整的；[經] 規則的
words.example: The drug passed every regulatory check.
words.example_zh: 這種藥通過了每一項法規審查。

words.zh: a. 外交的, 老練的；[法] 外交的, 外交上的, 文獻上的
words.example: The doctor was diplomatic in breaking the bad news.
words.example_zh: 醫生在告知壞消息時很有分寸。

words.zh: vt. 將...減到最少；vt. 最小化；vi. 最小化；[計] 最小化
words.example: Wash your hands to minimize the risk of infection.
words.example_zh: 勤洗手以將感染的風險降到最低。

words.zh: n. 接待, 接受, 招待會；[醫] 接受, 感受
words.example: The drug got a warm reception from doctors.
words.example_zh: 這種藥受到醫生們的熱烈歡迎。

words.zh: vi. 消失, 不見, 成為零
words.example: The pain seemed to vanish after the injection.
words.example_zh: 注射後疼痛彷彿消失了。

words.zh: v. 承認, 坦白, 懺悔, 供認
words.example: He confessed that he had not taken his pills.
words.example_zh: 他坦承自己沒有吃藥。

words.zh: n. 地心引力, 重力；[化] 重力；嚴重性、嚴肅
words.example: She did not grasp the gravity of her condition.
words.example_zh: 她沒有意識到自己病情的嚴重性。

words.zh: v. (使)減少, (使)變小
words.example: The swelling will diminish over the next week.
words.example_zh: 腫脹會在接下來一週內消退。

words.zh: n. 意圖, 含義, 故意；a. 專心的, 決心的, 熱心的
words.example: She read his chart with intent focus.
words.example_zh: 她全神貫注地讀他的病歷。

words.zh: n. 表演者, 執行者, 完成者；[法] 執行者, 履行者, 實行者
words.example: As a stage performer, she feared losing her voice.
words.example_zh: 身為舞臺表演者，她害怕失去嗓音。

words.zh: n. 肋條肉, 排骨, 砍, 戳記, 商標；vt. 剁碎, 砍, 切擊, 割斷；vi. 砍, 突然轉向
words.example: She chopped the vegetables for a healthy soup.
words.example_zh: 她切好蔬菜煮一鍋健康湯。

words.zh: n. 與會者, 集會, 裝配, 元件；[化] 裝配
words.example: The whole assembly fell silent as the doctor spoke.
words.example_zh: 醫生開口時，全場一片寂靜。

words.zh: n. 味, 調味香料, 滋味, 香味, 氣味, 風味, 情味, 情趣, 風韻；vt. 給...調味, 給...增添風趣, 加香料, 加味於
words.example: The medicine had a faint mint flavour.
words.example_zh: 這種藥有股淡淡的薄荷味。

words.zh: a. 能生產的, 有生產價值的, 多產的；[醫] 產出性的, 產生性的
words.example: A good night's sleep made her more productive.
words.example_zh: 一夜好眠讓她更有效率。

words.zh: n. 詳細目錄, 存貨清單；vt. 列入詳細目錄, 清點存貨；[計] 存貨清單
words.example: The pharmacy took an inventory of its drugs.
words.example_zh: 藥局清點了藥品的庫存。

words.zh: a. 市的, 市民的, 公民的；[法] 公民的, 市民的, 公民資格的
words.example: The new hospital was a source of civic pride.
words.example_zh: 這座新醫院是市民的驕傲。

words.zh: n. 浸漬, 懸崖；a. 險峻的, 陡峭的, 急劇升降的, 誇大的；v. 浸, 泡
words.example: The path to the clinic was short but steep.
words.example_zh: 通往診所的路雖短卻陡。

words.zh: n. 名聲, 受大眾歡迎, 流行
words.example: The clinic's popularity meant long waiting times.
words.example_zh: 這間診所太受歡迎，候診時間因而很長。

words.zh: n. 外國人, 外僑；a. 外國的, 相異的
words.example: The hospital felt cold and alien at first.
words.example_zh: 醫院起初讓人覺得冰冷又陌生。

words.zh: a. 動態的, 有活力的, 有力的, 動力的, 不斷變化的；n. 動力, 動態；[計] 動態的
words.example: Recovery is a dynamic process, not a single step.
words.example_zh: 康復是個動態的過程，而非單一的步驟。

words.zh: n. 相等, 等式, 平衡；[化] 方程式; 等式; 反應式; 公式
words.example: Cost is only one part of the equation in care.
words.example_zh: 費用只是照護這道難題的一部分。

words.zh: a. 寶貴的, 珍貴的, 過於精緻的, 珍愛的
words.example: Every minute is precious after a heart attack.
words.example_zh: 心臟病發作後，每一分鐘都很寶貴。

words.zh: vt. 禁止, 阻止；[經] 禁止
words.example: The rules prohibit eating in the operating room.
words.example_zh: 規定禁止在手術室內進食。

words.zh: vt. 登記, 使加入；vi. 參軍, 註冊
words.example: She decided to enroll in a first-aid course.
words.example_zh: 她決定報名一門急救課程。

words.zh: a. 傑出的, 突出的, 未償付的, 未決定的；[經] 未解決的, 未償付
words.example: The young nurse showed outstanding care.
words.example_zh: 這位年輕護理師展現了出色的照護。

words.zh: n. 絆倒, 蹣跚而行, 失足；vt. 使絆倒, 使困惑；vi. 絆倒, 失足, 失策, 犯錯, 蹣跚, 躊躇
words.example: The weak patient began to stumble as he walked.
words.example_zh: 虛弱的病人走著走著開始踉蹌。

words.zh: n. 破曉, 黎明；vi. 破曉
words.example: She finally fell asleep just before dawn.
words.example_zh: 她終於在天亮前睡著了。

words.zh: vi. 下降, 世代相傳, 屈尊, 襲擊；vt. 下降
words.example: A calm seemed to descend over the ward at night.
words.example_zh: 夜裡一股平靜彷彿籠罩了整個病房。

words.zh: a. 愚蠢的, 糊塗的
words.example: It was silly of him to ignore the warning.
words.example_zh: 他忽視這個警訊真是太傻了。

words.zh: n. 潮, 潮汐, 趨勢, 潮流, 漲潮, 高潮；vt. 使隨潮漂流；vi. 順潮行駛
words.example: The tide of the epidemic finally began to turn.
words.example_zh: 疫情的局勢終於開始扭轉。

words.zh: adv. 迅速地, 輕易地, 樂意地
words.example: The new nurse readily admitted her mistake.
words.example_zh: 這位新護理師爽快地承認了自己的錯誤。

words.zh: vi. 合作, 協力, 配合；[化] 合作
words.example: The patient agreed to cooperate with the tests.
words.example_zh: 病人同意配合接受檢查。

words.zh: n. 冒險故事, 浪漫史, 傳奇文學；vi. 寫傳奇, 作空想, 虛構
words.example: Their romance began in the hospital ward.
words.example_zh: 他們的戀情始於醫院病房。

words.zh: n. 枕頭, 靠墊, 枕狀巖；vt. 作...的枕頭, 墊, 枕於；vi. 靠在枕上
words.example: The nurse fluffed his pillow before he slept.
words.example_zh: 護理師在他睡前把枕頭拍鬆。

words.zh: n. 硬體, 五金器具, 零件；[計] 硬體
words.example: The scanner is the most costly piece of hardware.
words.example_zh: 掃描儀是最昂貴的一件硬體設備。

words.zh: n. 印章, 封條, 海豹, 海豹皮, 火漆, 封蠟, 璽, 保證, 批准, 象徵, 標誌；vt. 封閉, 蓋印, 蓋章；vi. 獵海豹
words.example: A tight seal keeps the wound dressing clean.
words.example_zh: 緊密的封口能讓傷口敷料保持乾淨。

words.zh: n. 大陸, 洲；a. 自制的
words.example: The disease spread across the whole continent.
words.example_zh: 這種病蔓延了整個大陸。

words.zh: n. 電路, 環(行)道, 巡迴；[計] 線路; 電路
words.example: The doctor made her morning circuit of the ward.
words.example_zh: 醫生進行了她早上的病房巡視。

words.zh: adv. 一年一次, 每年；[經] 年度的, 每年的
words.example: Staff are screened for the disease annually.
words.example_zh: 員工每年都會接受這種病的篩檢。

words.zh: adv. 近來, 最近
words.example: She has been feeling tired lately.
words.example_zh: 她最近一直覺得疲倦。

words.zh: n. 審視, 瀏覽, 掃描, 細查；vt. 細看, 瀏覽, 掃描, 詳細調查, 標出格律；vi. 押韻, 掃描；[計] 網路軟體目錄, 編碼與分析系統
words.example: The scan showed no sign of a tumor.
words.example_zh: 掃描沒有顯示出腫瘤的跡象。

words.zh: n. 後面, 背後, 後方；a. 後面的, 背面的, 後方的；vt. 養育, 培養, 飼養, 舉起, 樹立, 栽種；vi. 高聳, 暴跳
words.example: A scar ran across the rear of his head.
words.example_zh: 一道疤橫過他的後腦。

words.zh: vt. 試圖, 從事, 保證, 承擔, 同意, 接受；[化] 承包; 承擔
words.example: The hospital agreed to undertake the risky surgery.
words.example_zh: 醫院同意進行這場高風險的手術。

words.zh: n. 大牧場；v. 經營牧場
words.example: He grew up working on a cattle ranch.
words.example_zh: 他在一個養牛的牧場長大工作。

words.zh: a. 用言辭的, 言語的, 口頭的, 逐字的, 動詞的；[醫] 言語的, 口述的
words.example: The doctor gave only verbal instructions.
words.example_zh: 醫生只給了口頭的指示。

words.zh: a. 燃燒的, 象燃燒一樣的；n. 燒, 燃燒
words.example: She had a burning pain in her chest.
words.example_zh: 她胸口有種灼熱的疼痛。

words.zh: a. 部落的, 宗族的
words.example: The clinic respects the village's tribal customs.
words.example_zh: 這間診所尊重村莊的部落習俗。

words.zh: a. 荒謬的, 可笑的
words.example: It seemed ridiculous to wait so long for a simple test.
words.example_zh: 為一項簡單的檢查等這麼久似乎很荒謬。

words.zh: n. 自動手槍, 自動機械；a. 自動的, 機械的, 必然的, 無意識的
words.example: The pump gives an automatic dose every hour.
words.example_zh: 這台幫浦每小時自動給予一次劑量。

words.zh: n. 進口貨, 進口, 輸入, 含義, 重要性；vt. 輸入, 引入, 進口, 含...的意思, 重要；vi. 有關係；[計] 引入
words.example: The clinic relies on the import of cheap drugs.
words.example_zh: 這間診所仰賴廉價藥品的進口。

words.zh: n. 感情, 感傷, 情操, 情緒, 感想, 意見；[醫] 情感, 情操
words.example: There was a strong sentiment of hope in the ward.
words.example_zh: 病房裡瀰漫著一股強烈的希望之情。

words.zh: n. 二輪運貨馬車；vi. 駕運貨馬車；vt. 用車裝載
words.example: The nurse wheeled the medicine cart down the hall.
words.example_zh: 護理師推著藥車走過走廊。

words.zh: vt. 向下看, 瞭望, 監督, 偷看到；[法] 監察, 監督, 俯瞰
words.example: A senior doctor will oversee the operation.
words.example_zh: 一位資深醫生將監督這場手術。

words.zh: n. 量, 數量, 總量；[計] 數量; 量
words.example: Only a small quantity of the drug is needed.
words.example_zh: 只需少量的這種藥。

words.zh: n. 靈感, 鼓舞人心的人或物, 妙計, 吸氣；[醫] 吸[氣]
words.example: Her brave patient was a real inspiration.
words.example_zh: 她那勇敢的病人真是個鼓舞人心的榜樣。

words.zh: n. 配偶, 對手, 助手, (象棋)將死；vt. 使配對, 使一致, 結伴, (象棋)將死；vi. 成配偶, 緊密配合
words.example: His wife was his closest mate through the illness.
words.example_zh: 在病中，妻子是他最親密的伴侶。

words.zh: n. 天才, 天賦, 精神, 神魔；[醫] 特徵
words.example: It took no genius to see he needed rest.
words.example_zh: 不用天才也看得出他需要休息。

words.zh: n. 探索, 尋求, 調查；v. 尋找, 找, 追尋獵物
words.example: Her quest for a cure took her around the world.
words.example_zh: 她尋找解藥的旅程帶她走遍世界。

words.zh: n. 犧牲, 供奉, 祭品；vt. 犧牲, 祭祀, 賤賣；vi. 獻祭
words.example: She made many sacrifices to care for her sick father.
words.example_zh: 為了照顧生病的父親，她做了許多犧牲。

words.zh: n. 出價；v. 命令, 吩咐, 請求, 表示, 宣佈, 投標
words.example: The hospital made a bid for new funding.
words.example_zh: 醫院爭取新的經費。

words.zh: n. 動力學；[化] 動力學
words.example: The dynamics of the family changed after his illness.
words.example_zh: 他生病後，家庭的互動關係改變了。

words.zh: n. 掮客, 經紀人；[經] 經紀人, 掮客
words.example: An insurance broker helped explain her coverage.
words.example_zh: 一位保險經紀人幫她解釋了保險給付。

words.zh: n. 寶物, 財富；vt. 珍愛, 重視, 秘藏
words.example: She treasured the time she had left with him.
words.example_zh: 她珍惜與他剩下的相處時光。

words.zh: n. 精確, 正確；[計] 準確度
words.example: The accuracy of the diagnosis was vital.
words.example_zh: 診斷的準確性至關重要。

words.zh: a. 天資高的, 有才能的
words.example: He was a talented young surgeon.
words.example_zh: 他是位才華洋溢的年輕外科醫生。

words.zh: n. 被提名者, 被任命者；[經] 被指定人
words.example: She was the clear nominee for the nursing award.
words.example_zh: 她是護理獎當之無愧的被提名人。

words.zh: n. 汽油；[化] 汽油
words.example: The smell of gasoline made her feel sick.
words.example_zh: 汽油的味道讓她感到噁心。

words.zh: a. 堅硬的, 嚴厲的, 呆板的, 生硬的, 剛強的, 強烈的, 粘的, 稠的, 艱難的；n. 死屍, 醉鬼, 鈔票；vt. 不肯付...小費
words.example: His joints felt stiff after the long flight.
words.example_zh: 長途飛行後他的關節感到僵硬。

words.zh: n. 輸出, 產品, 產量；[計] 輸出
words.example: The heart's output of blood dropped sharply.
words.example_zh: 心臟的血液輸出量急遽下降。

words.zh: n. 摑, 掌擊, 侮辱, 拍擊聲；v. 拍擊, 懲罰；adv. 正面地, 直接地, 突然地
words.example: She gave the newborn a gentle slap to start it breathing.
words.example_zh: 她輕拍新生兒讓他開始呼吸。

words.zh: n. 顎, 頜；v. 閒談, 教訓, 嘮叨
words.example: He broke his jaw in the fall.
words.example_zh: 他跌倒時摔斷了下巴。

words.zh: n. 糖尿病, 多尿症；[醫] 糖尿病; 多尿症
words.example: Her diabetes is controlled with daily insulin.
words.example_zh: 她的糖尿病靠每天施打胰島素來控制。

words.zh: a. 有毒的, 中毒的；[醫] 中毒的, 毒物的
words.example: The fumes from the cleaner are highly toxic.
words.example_zh: 這種清潔劑的氣味毒性很強。

words.zh: n. 傷心, 憂愁, 悲痛, 不幸, 災難
words.example: She was overcome with grief at the loss.
words.example_zh: 失去親人讓她悲痛不已。

words.zh: a. 神秘的, 難解的, 不可思議的
words.example: His sudden fever had a mysterious cause.
words.example_zh: 他突如其來的發燒原因不明。

words.zh: v. 捐贈
words.example: He chose to donate a kidney to his brother.
words.example_zh: 他選擇捐一顆腎給弟弟。

words.zh: n. 弓, 眼睛框；v. 用弓拉琴, 彎成弓形；n. 鞠躬, 屈服
words.example: The old doctor gave a slight bow to his patient.
words.example_zh: 老醫生向他的病人微微鞠了個躬。

words.zh: n. 尊嚴, 高貴；[法] 尊嚴, 高位, 高貴
words.example: The hospice let her die with dignity.
words.example_zh: 安寧病房讓她有尊嚴地離世。

words.zh: n. 泡沫；vi. 冒泡, 沸騰；vt. 使冒泡, 滔滔不絕地說
words.example: An air bubble in the drip line worried the nurse.
words.example_zh: 點滴管裡的一個氣泡讓護理師擔憂。

words.zh: n. 穀倉；[化] 靶(恩)(核反應截面單位)
words.example: The injured man was carried into a nearby barn.
words.example_zh: 受傷的男子被抬進附近的一間穀倉。

words.zh: n. 好朋友, 夥伴
words.example: His old army buddy visited him in hospital.
words.example_zh: 他的老戰友到醫院探望他。

words.zh: vt. 使特殊化, 列舉, 特別指明, 限定...的範圍；vi. 成為專家, 專攻
words.example: She chose to specialize in children's medicine.
words.example_zh: 她選擇專攻兒科醫學。

words.zh: n. 困境, (進退兩難的)窘境
words.example: The doctor faced a hard ethical dilemma.
words.example_zh: 醫生面臨一個棘手的道德兩難。

words.zh: n. 水淺的地方, 淺灘；a. 淺的, 膚淺的；v. (使)變淺
words.example: His breathing grew shallow and quick.
words.example_zh: 他的呼吸變得又淺又快。

words.zh: n. 帆, 篷, 帆船, 航程, 帆狀物；vi. 航行, 啟航, 張帆而行；vt. 航行於, 駕船
words.example: After recovering, he was eager to sail again.
words.example_zh: 康復後，他迫不及待想再次出海。

words.zh: n. 商人, 店主；a. 商業的, 商人的
words.example: A kind merchant donated food to the clinic.
words.example_zh: 一位善心的商人捐了食物給診所。

words.zh: n. 提款, 撤退, 退回, 撤消, 退隱, 戒毒過程；[醫] 戒除, 脫癮
words.example: He suffered painful withdrawal when he quit the drug.
words.example_zh: 戒掉這種藥時，他經歷了痛苦的戒斷症狀。

words.zh: n. 電冰箱, 冷藏庫；[計] 冷凍機; 致冷器
words.example: The vaccine must be kept in a refrigerator.
words.example_zh: 這款疫苗必須冷藏在冰箱裡。

words.zh: adv. 徹底地, 絕對地, 透徹地, 詳盡地, 周到地, 完全地, 完善地, 全面地
words.example: Wash the wound thoroughly with clean water.
words.example_zh: 用乾淨的水徹底清洗傷口。

words.zh: n. 祖先, 祖宗
words.example: The disease ran in the family from a distant ancestor.
words.example_zh: 這種病從遠祖開始就在家族中遺傳。

words.zh: vt. 判刑, 責備, 譴責；[法] 定罪, 判刑, 宣告有罪
words.example: The report condemned the clinic's poor hygiene.
words.example_zh: 報告譴責了這間診所惡劣的衛生。

words.zh: n. 蒸汽, 精力；a. 蒸汽的；vi. 蒸發, 行駛, 發怒；vt. 蒸, 煮, 散發
words.example: She breathed in warm steam to ease her cough.
words.example_zh: 她吸入溫暖的蒸氣來緩解咳嗽。

words.zh: n. 蝦, 小蝦, 矮子；vi. 捕小蝦
words.example: He came out in a rash after eating shrimp.
words.example_zh: 他吃了蝦之後起了疹子。

words.zh: vt. 裝備, 配備；[機] 裝置, 裝置
words.example: The clinic is well equipped for emergencies.
words.example_zh: 這間診所配備齊全，足以應付緊急狀況。

words.zh: n. 架, 行李架, 飼草架, 擱物架, 痛苦, 折磨, 齒條, 行雲團；vt. 把...放在架上, 在架上製作, 折磨, 使痛苦, 壓榨, 榨取, 猛烈撕拉, 拷問；vi. 變形
words.example: The test tubes stood in a wooden rack.
words.example_zh: 試管立在一個木架上。

words.zh: n. 裝束, 服裝
words.example: The volunteer wore a clown costume for the children.
words.example_zh: 志工為孩子們穿上小丑裝。

words.zh: n. 法令, 成文法律, 法規, 章程, 條例；[法] 法令, 法規, 成文法
words.example: A new statute tightened the rules on drug safety.
words.example_zh: 一項新法規收緊了藥品安全的規定。

words.zh: n. 露齒笑；v. 露齒而笑
words.example: A wide grin spread across the boy's face.
words.example_zh: 男孩臉上露出了大大的笑容。

words.zh: n. 卡通畫, 漫畫；v. 畫漫畫
words.example: A cartoon on the wall made the children laugh.
words.example_zh: 牆上的一幅卡通逗笑了孩子們。

words.zh: n. 生產力；[經] 生產率, 生產能力
words.example: Poor health lowered his productivity at work.
words.example_zh: 不佳的健康降低了他工作的生產力。

words.zh: n. 農業；[機] 農業, 農學
words.example: Many of his patients work in agriculture.
words.example_zh: 他的許多病人從事農業。

words.zh: vt. 構思, 認為；vi. 懷孕
words.example: It is hard to conceive how much she suffered.
words.example_zh: 很難想像她受了多少苦。

words.zh: n. 獎金, 紅利；[經] 獎金, 紅利, 額外補貼
words.example: Recovering early was an unexpected bonus.
words.example_zh: 提早康復是個意外的收穫。

words.zh: n. 合作, 勾結；[法] 通敵賣國者, 奸細
words.example: The cure came from close collaboration between labs.
words.example_zh: 這帖解藥來自各實驗室之間的密切合作。

words.zh: n. 耐性, 忍耐
words.example: Healing slowly tested her patience.
words.example_zh: 緩慢的癒合考驗著她的耐性。

words.zh: n. 軌道, 常軌, 眼眶；vt. 繞...軌道而行；vi. 進入軌道, 盤旋
words.example: The satellite circles the earth in a low orbit.
words.example_zh: 這顆衛星在低軌道上繞行地球。

words.zh: n. 惡意, 怨恨, 使人煩惱的事物；vt. 故意刁難, 欺侮
words.example: In spite of the pain, she kept smiling.
words.example_zh: 儘管疼痛，她仍保持微笑。

words.zh: n. 把握, 抓緊, 理解, 抓, 柄, 控制；vt. 抓住, 緊握, 領會；vi. 抓
words.example: He was too weak to grasp the spoon.
words.example_zh: 他虛弱到握不住湯匙。

words.zh: a. 熱帶的, 熱情的；[醫] 熱帶的
words.example: The disease is common in tropical climates.
words.example_zh: 這種病在熱帶氣候中很常見。

words.zh: n. 巡邏, 巡邏員, 偵察隊；v. 巡邏, 巡視
words.example: A night nurse made a quiet patrol of the ward.
words.example_zh: 一名夜班護理師靜靜地巡視病房。

words.zh: n. 揭露, 洩露, 發覺, 默示, 啟示
words.example: The test result was a shocking revelation.
words.example_zh: 這項檢查結果是個令人震驚的揭露。

words.zh: n. 珠寶, 珠寶類
words.example: Patients are asked to remove jewelry before surgery.
words.example_zh: 病人在手術前被要求取下首飾。

words.zh: n. 平穩, 風平浪靜；a. 平靜的, 冷靜的；vi. 平靜下來, 鎮靜；vt. 使平靜
words.example: The nurse's calm voice settled the frightened child.
words.example_zh: 護理師平靜的聲音安撫了受驚的孩子。

words.zh: a. 古巴的, 古巴人的；n. 古巴人
words.example: The Cuban doctor had trained in three countries.
words.example_zh: 這位古巴醫生曾在三個國家受訓。

words.zh: n. 用力拖拉, 拖運, 強拉, 捕獲量, 拖運距離；vi. 拖, 拉, 改變方向, 改變主意；vt. 拖拉, 拖運
words.example: Rescuers had to haul him up the cliff.
words.example_zh: 救難人員不得不把他從懸崖拉上來。

words.zh: n. 四輪馬車, 貨車；[法] 囚車, 馬車, 運貨車
words.example: The supplies arrived by horse and wagon.
words.example_zh: 物資是用馬車運來的。

words.zh: a. 公開展示的, 驚人的, 壯觀的；n. 奇觀, 驚人之舉, 展覽物
words.example: Her recovery was nothing short of spectacular.
words.example_zh: 她的康復簡直令人嘆為觀止。

words.zh: n. 毀滅, 推翻, 廢墟；vi. 毀滅, 衰敗, 破壞, 破產, 墮落；vt. 使毀滅, 毀壞, 使破產
words.example: Heavy drinking can ruin the liver.
words.example_zh: 酗酒會毀掉肝臟。

words.zh: a. 絕對的, 全然的, 純粹的, 透明的, 峻峭的；vi. 偏轉, 偏航；vt. 使急轉向, 使偏航；adv. 完全, 全然, 峻峭；n. 偏航
words.example: It was sheer luck that the tumor was found.
words.example_zh: 腫瘤能被發現純粹是運氣。

words.zh: n. 信度, 可靠性；[計] 可靠性
words.example: Doctors trust the reliability of the new test.
words.example_zh: 醫生信賴這項新檢查的可靠性。

words.zh: a. 迷人的, 吸引人的, 使人神魂顛倒的
words.example: She found the workings of the heart fascinating.
words.example_zh: 她覺得心臟的運作十分迷人。

words.zh: a. 異國的, 外來的；n. 外來人, 外來物, 舶來品
words.example: He fell ill after eating an exotic fruit.
words.example_zh: 他吃了一種奇特的水果後病倒了。

words.zh: n. 修剪, 夾子, 回形針, 剪下來的東西；vt. 修剪, 痛打, 夾牢, 剪報；vi. 剪報
words.example: The nurse used a clip to close the small wound.
words.example_zh: 護理師用一個夾子來閉合這道小傷口。

words.zh: n. 大腿, 股；[醫] 股, 大腿
words.example: The injection goes into the muscle of the thigh.
words.example_zh: 這針打進大腿的肌肉裡。

words.zh: vt. 使氣餒, 阻礙
words.example: A slow start should not discourage you.
words.example_zh: 起步緩慢不該讓你氣餒。

words.zh: n. 抽屜, 開票人；[計] 抽屜
words.example: The bandages are in the top drawer.
words.example_zh: 繃帶在最上層的抽屜裡。

words.zh: a. 意識形態的, 空想的；[法] 思想的, 思想上的, 意識形態的
words.example: The debate over the drug became ideological.
words.example_zh: 關於這種藥的爭論演變成意識形態之爭。

words.zh: a. 親密的, 私人的, 秘密的；vt. 暗示, 通知, 告訴；n. 至交
words.example: She shared her fears in an intimate talk with the nurse.
