words.example_zh: 她在與護理師的私密談話中道出了恐懼。

words.zh: n. 修道院外的教士；a. 世俗的, 現世的, 長期的
words.example: The hospital offered both secular and religious comfort.
words.example_zh: 醫院同時提供世俗與宗教的慰藉。

words.zh: n. 計程車, 出租汽車, 出租馬車；vi. 乘出租馬車(或汽車)
words.example: She took a cab straight to the hospital.
words.example_zh: 她搭計程車直奔醫院。

words.zh: a. 嫩的, 柔軟的, 脆弱的, 溫柔的, 親切的, 未成熟的, 微妙的, 棘手的, 審慎的；vt. 使變嫩, 提供, 償還；vi. 變柔軟, 投標；n. 照料, 看管人, 供應船
words.example: The skin around the wound was red and tender.
words.example_zh: 傷口周圍的皮膚又紅又疼。

words.zh: n. 同謀, 陰謀, 陰謀集團；[法] 陰謀, 通謀, 共謀
words.example: He spread a wild conspiracy about the vaccine.
words.example_zh: 他散布了一則關於疫苗的離譜陰謀論。

words.zh: n. 鯨；vi. 捕鯨；vt. 使慘敗, 猛揍
words.example: The huge whale surfaced beside the boat.
words.example_zh: 巨大的鯨魚在船邊浮出水面。

words.zh: a. 功能的；[醫] 機能的, 功能的, 官能的
words.example: After therapy, her hand was fully functional again.
words.example_zh: 治療後，她的手又恢復了完全的功能。

words.zh: n. 實行, 完成, 執行, 死刑；[計] 執行
words.example: The plan was good, but its execution was poor.
words.example_zh: 計畫很好，但執行得很糟。

words.zh: a. 非常好的, 極端的, 可怕的
words.example: She made a terrific recovery in just two weeks.
words.example_zh: 她在短短兩週內驚人地康復了。

words.zh: n. 本能, 直覺；a. 充滿著的
words.example: The nurse's instinct told her something was wrong.
words.example_zh: 護理師的直覺告訴她有什麼不對勁。

words.zh: n. 鋁；[化] 鋁Al
words.example: The pills come in a sealed aluminum strip.
words.example_zh: 這些藥丸裝在密封的鋁製泡殼裡。

words.zh: n. 部, 內閣, 服務；[經] 部
words.example: The health ministry issued new guidelines.
words.example_zh: 衛生部發布了新的指引。

words.zh: vt. 教, 教育, 命令, 通知；[法] 託辦, 指導, 指示
words.example: The doctor instructed her to rest for a week.
words.example_zh: 醫生囑咐她休息一週。

words.zh: n. 頭蓋骨, 頭腦, 好學生；[醫] 頭顱
words.example: The fall left a small crack in his skull.
words.example_zh: 這次跌倒讓他的頭骨出現一道小裂縫。

words.zh: n. 裁決, 判決, 判斷性意見, 定論, 結論；[法] 定論, 判斷, 意見
words.example: The biopsy gave the final verdict: benign.
words.example_zh: 切片給出了最終的結論：良性。

words.zh: n. 環, 圈, 彎曲部分, 迴圈；vt. 使成環, 以圈結, 以環連結；vi. 打環, 翻筋斗；[計] 迴圈
words.example: The tube was bent into a small loop.
words.example_zh: 這根管子被彎成一個小環。

words.zh: n. 從業者, 開業者；[醫] 行醫者, 醫師
words.example: A general practitioner treats everyday illnesses.
words.example_zh: 一般科醫師治療日常的病症。

words.zh: n. 補助金, 津貼；[經] 補助金, 津貼, 補貼
words.example: A government subsidy lowered the cost of the drug.
words.example_zh: 政府的補助降低了這種藥的費用。

words.zh: n. 難題, 迷惑；vt. 使困惑, 使為難；vi. 迷惑, 苦思
words.example: Her odd symptoms puzzled even the experts.
words.example_zh: 她古怪的症狀連專家都困惑。

words.zh: n. 蘑菇形物, 蘑菇, 暴發戶；vi. 迅速生長, 迅速增加, 採蘑菇；a. 蘑菇形的, 迅速生長的
words.example: He fell ill after eating a wild mushroom.
words.example_zh: 他吃了一朵野菇後病倒了。

words.zh: n. 數學；[機] 數學
words.example: Calculating the dose takes simple mathematics.
words.example_zh: 計算劑量只需簡單的數學。

words.zh: n. 煮沸, 沸騰, 癤；v. 煮沸, 激動
words.example: Boil the water before mixing the medicine.
words.example_zh: 調藥前先把水煮沸。

words.zh: n. 地震
words.example: The earthquake left the hospital without power.
words.example_zh: 地震讓醫院停了電。

words.zh: n. 廣口瓶, 震動, 刺耳聲；vi. 震驚, 衝突, 發刺耳聲, 不一致；vt. 震動, 刺激
words.example: She kept the herbs in a sealed glass jar.
words.example_zh: 她把草藥存在一個密封的玻璃罐裡。

words.zh: vt. 利用
words.example: The clinic learned to utilize every spare room.
words.example_zh: 這間診所學會了善用每一間空房。

words.zh: a. 在下面的；[經] 優先的, 基礎的, 放在下面的
words.example: The cough had an underlying cause: a weak heart.
words.example_zh: 這咳嗽有個潛在的病因：心臟衰弱。

words.zh: n. 餐後甜點
words.example: She skipped dessert to control her blood sugar.
words.example_zh: 她不吃甜點以控制血糖。

words.zh: n. 同情, 贊同, 憐憫, 慰問, 弔唁；[醫] 交感[作用], 同感[作用], 感應, 同情
words.example: The nurse listened with warmth and sympathy.
words.example_zh: 護理師以溫暖與同情傾聽。

words.zh: n. 隔絕, 孤立, 隔離；[化] 分離; 生物分離
words.example: He spent two weeks in isolation after the surgery.
words.example_zh: 手術後他在隔離病房待了兩週。

words.zh: n. 短襪, 鞋墊, 一擊；vt. 重擊, 猛投, 給...穿襪；vi. 打擊；adv. 正著地, 不偏不倚地；a. 非常成功的
words.example: A clean sock covered the bandaged foot.
words.example_zh: 一隻乾淨的襪子套住了包紮好的腳。

words.zh: n. 企業家, 主辦人；[經] 承包商, 企業家
words.example: The entrepreneur funded a free clinic for the poor.
words.example_zh: 這位企業家資助了一間給窮人的免費診所。

words.zh: n. 併發症狀, 綜合徵, 同時存在的事物；[計] 校驗子; 併發位
words.example: The baby was born with a rare syndrome.
words.example_zh: 這名嬰兒生來患有一種罕見的綜合症。

words.zh: n. 野心, 志向
words.example: Her ambition was to open a rural hospital.
words.example_zh: 她的志向是開一家鄉村醫院。

words.zh: n. 微風, 煤屑, 輕而易舉的事；vi. 吹微風, 逃走
words.example: A cool breeze drifted through the open window.
words.example_zh: 一陣涼風從敞開的窗戶飄了進來。

words.zh: n. 觸地, 觸地得分, 著地
words.example: The plane made a smooth touchdown.
words.example_zh: 飛機平穩地著陸。

words.zh: a. 有野心的, 抱負不凡的, 雄心勃勃的
words.example: The hospital had an ambitious plan to expand.
words.example_zh: 醫院有一項雄心勃勃的擴建計畫。

words.zh: adv. 推測上, 大概
words.example: He is late, presumably stuck in traffic.
words.example_zh: 他遲到了，大概是塞在路上。

words.zh: n. 翻譯, 譯文, 轉化, 調任, 平移, 轉譯；[計] 轉換
words.example: The leaflet came with a Chinese translation.
words.example_zh: 這份說明書附有中文翻譯。

words.zh: n. 大都市居民, 都主教, 宗主國的公民；a. 大都市的, 都主教區的, 宗主國的
words.example: The metropolitan hospital sees thousands of patients a day.
words.example_zh: 這家大都會醫院每天看診數千名病人。

words.zh: v. 溶解, 解散
words.example: The tablet will dissolve quickly in warm water.
words.example_zh: 這顆藥片在溫水中會很快溶解。

words.zh: a. 美學的, 審美的, 有美感的
words.example: The clinic was redesigned with aesthetic appeal in mind.
words.example_zh: 這間診所重新設計時考量了美感。

words.zh: n. 符咒, 魅力, 輪值, 輪班, 工作時間, 一次發作；vt. 拼寫, 拼成, 琢磨, 理解, 招致, 輪換, 迷住；vi. 輪換, 拼字
words.example: She had a dizzy spell and sat down quickly.
words.example_zh: 她一陣暈眩，趕緊坐了下來。

words.zh: n. 插入物；vt. 插入, 把(人造衛星)射入(軌道), 添寫；vi. 附著；[計] 插入
words.example: The nurse inserted a thin tube into the vein.
words.example_zh: 護理師把一根細管插入靜脈。

words.zh: n. 鋼盔, 盔, 防護帽；vt. 給...戴頭盔
words.example: Always wear a helmet to protect your head when cycling.
words.example_zh: 騎單車時一定要戴安全帽保護頭部。

words.zh: n. 腰部, 腰；[醫] 腰
words.example: He has lost weight around his waist this year.
words.example_zh: 他今年腰圍瘦了一圈。

words.zh: adv. 活躍地, 積極地
words.example: She actively took part in her own recovery.
words.example_zh: 她積極參與自己的康復。

words.zh: n. 成就, 完成
words.example: Walking the corridor was a real accomplishment for him.
words.example_zh: 走完這條走廊對他來說是項真正的成就。

words.zh: n. 恐慌, 驚慌；a. 驚慌的, 沒有理由的, 恐慌的；vt. 使驚慌, 使狂熱；vi. 驚慌
words.example: Don't panic if the wound bleeds a little.
words.example_zh: 傷口流一點血時別驚慌。

words.zh: n. 壓碎, 粉碎, 群眾, 迷戀；vt. 壓破, 征服, 塞, 弄皺, 榨出；vi. 被壓碎, 起皺, 擠
words.example: He crushed the pill and mixed it into her food.
words.example_zh: 他把藥丸壓碎，混進她的食物裡。

words.zh: n. 懸崖, 絕壁
words.example: The hikers were stranded on a steep cliff.
words.example_zh: 登山客被困在一處陡峭的懸崖上。

words.zh: a. 最小的, 極微的, 最小限度的；[醫] 最小的, 最低的
words.example: The surgery left only a minimal scar.
words.example_zh: 這場手術只留下極小的疤痕。

words.zh: n. 繩索, 束縛；[醫] 索, 帶
words.example: The doctor cut and tied the baby's cord.
words.example_zh: 醫生剪斷並結紮了嬰兒的臍帶。

words.zh: n. 幻影, 錯覺, 幻想；[醫] 錯覺
words.example: A high fever can cause vivid illusions.
words.example_zh: 高燒可能引起生動的錯覺。

words.zh: vt. 寬容, 容許, 有耐力
words.example: Her stomach could not tolerate solid food yet.
words.example_zh: 她的胃還無法承受固體食物。

words.zh: n. 委員, 理事, 行政長官；[法] 委員, 政府的特派員, 地方地官
words.example: The health commissioner ordered an urgent review.
words.example_zh: 衛生首長下令進行緊急檢討。

words.zh: n. 彈性, 適應性；[計] 靈活性; 適應性
words.example: Stretching restores flexibility to stiff joints.
words.example_zh: 伸展能讓僵硬的關節恢復柔軟度。

words.zh: n. 攀緣, 爬行, 搶奪, 混亂, 緊急起飛；vi. 攀緣, 雜亂蔓延, 爭奪, 拼湊, 匆忙；vt. 攀登, 擾亂, 使混雜
words.example: Nurses scrambled to find a bed for the patient.
words.example_zh: 護理師們手忙腳亂地為病人找床位。

words.zh: v. 裝飾
words.example: The children helped decorate the ward for the festival.
words.example_zh: 孩子們幫忙布置病房過節。

words.zh: a. 固定的, 不變的；[法] 固定的, 確定的, 不變的
words.example: The broken arm was held in a fixed position.
words.example_zh: 斷掉的手臂被固定在一個位置。

words.zh: a. 富有經驗的, 老練的, 熟練的
words.example: An experienced nurse spotted the problem at once.
words.example_zh: 一位經驗豐富的護理師立刻發現了問題。

words.zh: n. 動力, 動量；[化] 動量
words.example: Her recovery slowly gained momentum.
words.example_zh: 她的康復慢慢有了起色。

words.zh: n. 捐贈物, 捐款, 捐贈；[經] 贈品, 捐款, 捐贈
words.example: A generous donation funded the new scanner.
words.example_zh: 一筆慷慨的捐款資助了新的掃描儀。

words.zh: n. 兄弟, 同胞；[醫] 同胞(兄弟姐妹)
words.example: The disease can pass between siblings.
words.example_zh: 這種病可能在手足之間傳染。

words.zh: n. 反語, 諷刺, 具有諷刺意味的事
words.example: The irony was that the cure caused new symptoms.
words.example_zh: 諷刺的是，療法竟引發了新的症狀。

words.zh: n. 匙, 調羹, 匙形工具；vt. 以匙舀起, 調情, 使成匙狀
words.example: She fed him soup with a small spoon.
words.example_zh: 她用一支小湯匙餵他喝湯。

words.zh: vi. 互相影響, 互動作用；n. 幕間劇, 幕間休息
words.example: The two drugs interact in a dangerous way.
words.example_zh: 這兩種藥會以危險的方式互相作用。

words.zh: n. 肥皂, 阿諛；vt. 以肥皂洗, 阿諛；[計] 評語
words.example: Wash your hands well with soap and water.
words.example_zh: 用肥皂和水把手洗乾淨。

words.zh: n. 對手, 競爭者；a. 競爭的
words.example: The two clinics were longtime rivals.
words.example_zh: 這兩間診所是多年的對手。

words.zh: n. 打洞器, 鑽孔機, 沖壓機, 沖床, 潘趣酒；vt. 以拳重擊, 開洞, 沖壓；vi. 用拳猛擊
words.example: The machine punches a code into each label.
words.example_zh: 這台機器在每張標籤上打上編碼。

words.zh: vi. 堅持, 固執, 持續, 堅稱；[經] 持續
words.example: If the pain persists, see a doctor.
words.example_zh: 若疼痛持續，請就醫。

words.zh: n. 畫像, 肖像, 偶像, 圖示, 像標；[計] 像標, 圖示
words.example: She tapped the red icon to call the nurse.
words.example_zh: 她按下紅色的圖示來呼叫護理師。

words.zh: n. 車棚, 小屋, 脫落之物, 分水嶺；vt. 使流出, 放射, 脫落, 散發, 擺脫；vi. 流出, 散佈, 脫落
words.example: A snake will shed its skin as it grows.
words.example_zh: 蛇會隨著成長而蛻皮。

words.zh: n. 錢包, 小錢袋, 金錢, 募捐款, 囊狀物；v. 縮攏, 皺起
words.example: She kept her pills in a small zipped purse.
words.example_zh: 她把藥放在一個拉鍊小錢包裡。

words.zh: n. 液體, 流體, 流音；a. 液體的, 透明的, 明亮的, 流動的, 易變的
words.example: He could only swallow liquid food after surgery.
words.example_zh: 手術後他只能吞嚥流質食物。

words.zh: n. 立法機關, 議會, 立法院；[法] 立法機構, 立法機關
words.example: The legislature passed a new health law.
words.example_zh: 立法機關通過了一項新的衛生法案。

words.zh: adv. 所以
words.example: He skipped the dose and consequently fell ill again.
words.example_zh: 他漏服了一劑，因此再度病倒。

words.zh: n. 濾波器, 過濾器, 濾光器, 過濾嘴, 去塵器；vt. 過濾, 滲透, 走漏；vi. 濾過, 滲入；[計] 過濾器, 篩選
words.example: The kidneys filter waste from the blood.
words.example_zh: 腎臟過濾血液中的廢物。

words.zh: vi. 痊癒；vt. 使復原, 使和解, 治癒
words.example: Most cuts heal on their own within a week.
words.example_zh: 大多數的割傷一週內會自行癒合。

words.zh: n. 功績, 勳績；vt. 開發, 利用, 開拓, 剝削
words.example: Drug makers should not exploit sick people.
words.example_zh: 藥廠不該剝削病人。

words.zh: n. 生物, 有機體, 社會組織；[醫] 生物[體],[有]機體
words.example: A single tiny organism can cause the disease.
words.example_zh: 單一個微小的生物就能引發這種病。

words.zh: n. 硬幣, 金錢, 貨幣；vt. 鑄幣, 創造, 杜撰
words.example: She flipped a coin to decide who would go first.
words.example_zh: 她擲硬幣決定誰先去。

words.zh: a. 易接近的, 可進入的, 可使用的, 易受影響的, 可理解的
words.example: The new ramp made the clinic accessible to all.
words.example_zh: 新的坡道讓所有人都能進入診所。

words.zh: n. 感覺, 轟動；[醫] 感覺
words.example: She felt a tingling sensation in her fingers.
words.example_zh: 她的手指有一種刺麻的感覺。

words.zh: adv. 部分地, 一部分地, 不公平地
words.example: The wound had only partially healed.
words.example_zh: 傷口只癒合了一部分。

words.zh: n. 推, 擠；vt. 推擠, 猛推, 強使；vi. 推
words.example: Please don't shove; everyone will be seen.
words.example_zh: 請別推擠，每個人都會輪到看診。

words.zh: n. 特許狀, 執照, 憲章；vt. 特許, 發給特許執照
words.example: A charter sets out the patients' basic rights.
words.example_zh: 一份憲章列出了病人的基本權利。

words.zh: n. 火爐, 窯；vt. 用火爐烤；stave的過去式和過去分詞
words.example: She kept the soup warm on the stove.
words.example_zh: 她在爐子上把湯保溫。

words.zh: a. 相似的, 同樣的；adv. 一樣, 以同樣的方式
words.example: The two patients looked very much alike.
words.example_zh: 這兩名病人長得非常相像。

words.zh: n. 提醒的人, 暗示；[經] 催單
words.example: The app sends a daily reminder to take your pills.
words.example_zh: 這款應用程式每天提醒你吃藥。

words.zh: n. 同意, 許可；vi. 同意, 贊同
words.example: The patient gave written consent for the surgery.
words.example_zh: 病人為手術簽署了書面同意。

words.zh: vt. 包含, 構成
words.example: The team comprises doctors, nurses, and therapists.
words.example_zh: 這個團隊由醫生、護理師和治療師組成。

words.zh: a. 生態學的, 主張生態保護的；[法] 生態的, 生態學的
words.example: Pollution upset the river's ecological balance.
words.example_zh: 汙染破壞了這條河的生態平衡。

words.zh: n. 水壩, 障礙；v. 控制, 築壩；[計] 直接存取法
words.example: The new dam changed the flow of the river.
words.example_zh: 新水壩改變了這條河的水流。

words.zh: n. 用具, 配備, 機構；vt. 配備, 供應；vi. 得到裝備；全套服裝、裝束
words.example: The surgical outfit must be fully sterile.
words.example_zh: 手術裝束必須完全無菌。

words.zh: n. 專利權, 許可證, 執照, 專利品, 素質；a. 專利的, 特許的, 顯著的, 新奇的；vt. 取得...的專利權, 請準專利
words.example: The company holds the patent on the new drug.
words.example_zh: 這家公司持有這款新藥的專利。

words.zh: n. 驚跳, 驚避；a. 膽怯的, 畏縮的, 遲疑的, 羞怯的；vi. 驚退, 亂投, 亂擲, 厭惡, 避開；vt. 亂投, 亂擲
words.example: The shy boy hid behind his mother at the clinic.
words.example_zh: 害羞的男孩在診所躲在母親身後。

words.zh: n. 垃圾, 廢物；vt. 丟棄
words.example: Used needles must never go in the regular trash.
words.example_zh: 用過的針頭絕不可丟進一般垃圾。

words.zh: n. 總數, 總量；a. 總共的, 未打折扣的, 惡劣的, 粗野的；vt. 總共收入
words.example: The clinic's gross income rose this year.
words.example_zh: 這間診所今年的總收入增加了。

words.zh: n. (織物的)密度, (材料等的)結構, 紋理；[化] 紋理
words.example: The rash gave her skin a rough texture.
words.example_zh: 疹子讓她的皮膚摸起來變得粗糙。

words.zh: n. 一點, 詛咒, 絲毫；interj. 該死, 該死的；vt. 詛咒, 罰...下地獄；vi. 指責, 譴責, 罵...該死, 證明...有罪
words.example: He didn't give a damn about his own health.
words.example_zh: 他對自己的健康毫不在乎。

words.zh: n. 邊界, 邊境；[法] 國境, 邊境, 邊界
words.example: Gene therapy is a new frontier in medicine.
words.example_zh: 基因療法是醫學的一個新領域。

words.zh: n. 水沫, 浪花, 水花, 噴霧, 噴霧器, 小樹枝；vt. 噴霧, 掃射, 噴射；vi. 噴, 濺開
words.example: A salt spray helps clear a blocked nose.
words.example_zh: 鹽水噴霧有助於暢通鼻塞。

words.zh: vt. 揭露, 透露；[法] 揭發, 揭露, 公開
words.example: Doctors must disclose the risks of the drug.
words.example_zh: 醫生必須揭露這種藥的風險。

words.zh: n. 銀行家, 莊家；[經] 銀行業者, 銀行家
words.example: The banker collapsed from stress at work.
words.example_zh: 這名銀行家因工作壓力而昏倒。

words.zh: n. 監護, 拘留, 監禁；[經] 保管, 照顧, 保護
words.example: The drugs are kept in the pharmacist's custody.
words.example_zh: 這些藥由藥師保管。

words.zh: n. 橡樹, 橡木；a. 橡木製的
words.example: An old oak shaded the hospital courtyard.
words.example_zh: 一棵老橡樹為醫院庭院遮蔭。

words.zh: n. 畜生, 動物, 野獸, 獸性
words.example: The fever raged in him like a wild beast.
words.example_zh: 高燒在他體內肆虐，宛如一頭野獸。

words.zh: n. 大綱, 輪廓, 概要；vt. 描畫輪廓, 描述要點；n. 大綱, 分級, 輪廓；[計] 大綱, 分級, 輪廓
words.example: The doctor gave an outline of the treatment plan.
words.example_zh: 醫生概述了治療計畫。

words.zh: n. 沉思, 推測, 投機；[經] 投機交易, 買空賣空
words.example: There was much speculation about the cause.
words.example_zh: 對於病因有許多揣測。

words.zh: n. 光線, 射線, 閃爍, 光輝；vi. 射出光線, 浮現, 放射光線；vt. 放射, 顯出
words.example: An X-ray uses a special kind of ray.
words.example_zh: X 光使用一種特殊的射線。

words.zh: vt. 揭露, 揭開, 暴露, 脫帽致敬；vi. 脫帽致敬, 揭去蓋子
words.example: The tests uncovered a hidden infection.
words.example_zh: 檢查揭露了一個隱藏的感染。

words.zh: n. 出席, 出席的人數, 照料；[法] 管理, 照料, 資助
words.example: Attendance at the clinic doubled this winter.
words.example_zh: 這個冬天診所的就診人數倍增。

words.zh: n. 利益, 方面
words.example: She spoke on behalf of all the patients.
words.example_zh: 她代表所有病人發言。

words.zh: a. 革新的, 創新的, 富有革新精神的
words.example: The clinic uses an innovative way to track doses.
words.example_zh: 這間診所用一種創新的方式追蹤用藥。

words.zh: n. 壓榨機, 磨坊, 製造廠；vt. 碾磨, 磨細, 攪拌, 使亂轉；vi. 亂轉, 被碾磨
words.example: He worked at the flour mill for thirty years.
words.example_zh: 他在麵粉廠工作了三十年。

words.zh: vt. 刺激, 激勵, 鼓舞；vi. 起刺激作用
words.example: Gentle massage can stimulate blood flow.
words.example_zh: 輕柔的按摩能促進血液循環。

words.zh: n. 標籤, 附屬物, 碎片, 結束語, 口頭禪, 附加語, 渾名, 標記, 標記符；vt. 附以籤條, 尾隨, 添飾, 起渾名, 連線；vi. 緊緊跟隨；[計] 標記
words.example: Each newborn wears a small name tag.
words.example_zh: 每名新生兒都戴著一個小名牌。

words.zh: n. 目錄, 大學概況手冊；vt. 編目錄；[計] 目錄; 編目
words.example: The pharmacy keeps a catalog of every drug.
words.example_zh: 藥局保有一份每種藥的目錄。

words.zh: n. 艦隊, 港灣, 小河；a. 快速的, 敏捷的, 淺的, 短暫的；adv. 淺；vi. 疾馳, 飛逝, 掠過；vt. 消磨, 變換船(或船員)的位置
words.example: A fleet of ambulances stood ready outside.
words.example_zh: 一隊救護車在外頭待命。

words.zh: n. 準備擊球姿勢, 站立的姿勢, 位置, 姿態；[經] 地位, 形勢
words.example: The doctor took a firm stance on smoking.
words.example_zh: 這位醫生對吸菸採取堅定的立場。

words.zh: a. 垂直的, 直立的；[醫] 垂直的, 頂的, 頭頂的
words.example: The patient must keep the leg vertical to reduce swelling.
words.example_zh: 病人必須讓腿保持垂直以減輕腫脹。

words.zh: adv. 拼命地；絕望地；極度地
words.example: She fought desperately to stay awake.
words.example_zh: 她拚命掙扎著想保持清醒。

words.zh: n. 敏感, 靈敏度；[計] 靈敏度
words.example: The test has a high sensitivity for the disease.
words.example_zh: 這項檢查對這種病有很高的靈敏度。

words.zh: n. 立即, 瞬間；a. 緊急的, 立即的, 即時的
words.example: The pain stopped the instant the drug took effect.
words.example_zh: 藥一生效，疼痛立刻就停了。

words.zh: n. 徒步旅行, 遠足, 漲價, 提高；vi. 步行, 徒步旅行, 上升；vt. 使高漲, 拉起
words.example: A long hike left blisters on his feet.
words.example_zh: 一趟長途健行讓他的腳起了水泡。

words.zh: a. 全世界的
words.example: The vaccine is now used worldwide.
words.example_zh: 這款疫苗如今在全球各地使用。

words.zh: n. 氣味, 香味, 香水, 蹤跡, 痕跡, 線索, 嗅覺；vt. 聞出, 嗅, 發覺, 使充滿氣味；vi. 嗅獵, 發出氣味
words.example: The faint scent of herbs filled the room.
words.example_zh: 淡淡的草藥香瀰漫了整個房間。

words.zh: n. 堆疊, 堆, 大量, 書庫, 槍架, 煙囪, 堆積, 存貯棧；vt. 堆積, 堆滿, 暗中對...做手腳；vi. 堆起；[計] 堆積, 堆疊
words.example: A stack of files sat on the doctor's desk.
words.example_zh: 醫生的桌上堆著一疊檔案。

words.zh: n. 麻布袋, 洗劫；vt. 把...裝入袋, 洗劫
words.example: He carried a sack of rice to the clinic kitchen.
words.example_zh: 他扛了一袋米到診所廚房。

words.zh: n. 托盤, 公文盤, 滿盤, 發射箱；[化] 淋盤
words.example: The nurse brought a tray of clean instruments.
words.example_zh: 護理師端來一盤乾淨的器械。

words.zh: n. 停止；v. 停止, 終了
words.example: The bleeding finally ceased after an hour.
words.example_zh: 出血在一小時後終於停止。

words.zh: vt. 繼承, 遺傳；vi. 接受遺產
words.example: She inherited a weak heart from her father.
words.example_zh: 她從父親那裡遺傳了一顆虛弱的心臟。

words.zh: n. 例證, 插圖；[化] 插圖
words.example: The book had a clear illustration of the lungs.
words.example_zh: 這本書有一張清楚的肺部插圖。

words.zh: [法] 出現的, 發生的, 形成的
words.example: Doctors watched the emerging signs of recovery.
words.example_zh: 醫生留意著逐漸顯現的康復跡象。

words.zh: n. 小麥
words.example: She cannot eat wheat because of an allergy.
words.example_zh: 她因為過敏不能吃小麥。

words.zh: n. 點, 圓點, 小數點, 小東西, 嫁妝；vt. 作小點記號, 加小點於；vi. 打上點；[計] 點
words.example: A red dot on the chart marked the worst day.
words.example_zh: 圖表上一個紅點標出了最糟的那天。

words.zh: a. 理性的, 合理的；n. 有理數
words.example: She made a calm, rational choice about surgery.
words.example_zh: 她對手術做出了冷靜而理性的選擇。

words.zh: a. 兇猛的, 猛烈的, 熱烈的, 暴躁的
words.example: He put up a fierce fight against the disease.
words.example_zh: 他與病魔展開了激烈的搏鬥。

words.zh: vt. 想象, 預想
words.example: It is hard to envision life without the medicine.
words.example_zh: 很難想像沒有這種藥的生活。

words.zh: n. 草案, 禮儀, 協議；v. 擬定；[計] 協議, 協議列表實用程式
words.example: The nurse followed the safety protocol exactly.
words.example_zh: 護理師嚴格遵循安全規範。

words.zh: n. 王國, 領域；[醫] 界(動物,植物,礦物)
words.example: Bacteria belong to a kingdom of tiny living things.
words.example_zh: 細菌屬於微小生物的一個界。

words.zh: a. 嗓音的, 聲音的, 有聲的, 歌唱的；n. 母音, 聲樂作品
words.example: She lost her vocal power after the throat surgery.
words.example_zh: 喉部手術後她失去了發聲的力量。

words.zh: adv. 排他地, 僅僅, 專門, 只, 僅, 唯一地, 專有地
words.example: This ward cares exclusively for children.
words.example_zh: 這個病房只照顧兒童。

words.zh: n. 地帶, 地區, 地形, 領域, 範圍
words.example: The rough terrain slowed the rescue team.
words.example_zh: 崎嶇的地形拖慢了救援隊。

words.zh: a. 不公平的, 不正直的, 不正當的；[法] 不正直的, 不公平的, 偏頗的
words.example: It felt unfair that she fell ill so young.
words.example_zh: 她這麼年輕就病倒，讓人覺得不公平。

words.zh: a. 危險的
words.example: It was too risky to operate so late at night.
words.example_zh: 在這麼晚的夜裡動手術風險太大。

words.zh: n. 型別, 流派
words.example: Calm music of any genre helped her sleep.
words.example_zh: 任何類型的輕柔音樂都能幫她入睡。

words.zh: vt. 轉移, 分心, 使發狂
words.example: A toy helped distract the child during the shot.
words.example_zh: 一個玩具幫助分散孩子打針時的注意力。

words.zh: a. 沮喪的, 降低的；[醫] 抑鬱的, 阻抑的, 壓低的, 凹[陷]的, 扁平的
words.example: He felt depressed during the long recovery.
words.example_zh: 漫長的康復期讓他感到憂鬱。

words.zh: n. 大塊, 矮胖的人(或物)；[經] 定樣
words.example: She could only eat a small chunk of bread.
words.example_zh: 她只吃得下一小塊麵包。

words.zh: n. 折扣, 貼現率；vt. 打折扣；vi. 貼現
words.example: The pharmacy gave her a discount on the drug.
words.example_zh: 藥局給了她這種藥的折扣。

words.zh: n. 叢林, 雜亂的一堆, 弱肉強食的地方
words.example: The disease is common deep in the jungle.
words.example_zh: 這種病在叢林深處很常見。

words.zh: n. 呼吸, 瞬間, 微風；a. 呼吸的, 逼真的
words.example: Her breathing slowed as she fell asleep.
words.example_zh: 她入睡時呼吸漸漸放慢。

words.zh: n. 移民, 移往, 移動；[計] 遷移
words.example: The migration of cells helps the wound close.
words.example_zh: 細胞的遷移幫助傷口閉合。

words.zh: vt. 侵入, 擁入, 侵略, 侵襲；[法] 強入, 侵犯, 侵略
words.example: Bacteria can invade the body through a cut.
words.example_zh: 細菌能透過傷口入侵身體。

words.zh: n. 颶風, 暴風, 暴風雨
words.example: The hurricane cut off power to the hospital.
words.example_zh: 颶風切斷了醫院的電力。

words.zh: n. 砰然的一擊, 妙計, 出乎意料的行動, 政變；[醫] 發作, 中, 擊
words.example: Saving the patient was a real medical coup.
words.example_zh: 救活這名病人是醫療上的一大成就。

words.zh: n. 好奇心, 新奇的事物, 珍品
words.example: Her curiosity about the body led her to medicine.
words.example_zh: 她對人體的好奇引領她走向醫學。

words.zh: n. 跳躍, 跳讀；vi. 跳越, 跳讀, 跳繩, 遺漏, 跳級；vt. 跳過, 遺漏；[計] 跳過
words.example: Never skip a dose of your antibiotics.
words.example_zh: 千萬別漏服一劑抗生素。

words.zh: n. 侵犯, 侵略；[醫] 攻擊
words.example: The illness sometimes caused sudden aggression.
words.example_zh: 這種病有時會引發突然的攻擊性。

words.zh: n. 新聞業, 報章雜誌；[法] 報刊, 新聞業, 新聞出版
words.example: Health journalism can save lives by informing people.
words.example_zh: 健康新聞報導能藉由提供資訊來拯救生命。

words.zh: n. 刺激, 激勵, 刺激品；[醫] 刺激特, 刺激
words.example: Light is a stimulus that the eye responds to.
words.example_zh: 光是眼睛會反應的一種刺激。

words.zh: n. 生態系統；[醫] 生態系
words.example: The gut is home to a whole ecosystem of bacteria.
words.example_zh: 腸道是一整個細菌生態系的家。

words.zh: a. 非正式的, 不拘禮的, 通俗的；[經] 非正式的, 日常使用的
words.example: The doctor had an informal chat with the family.
words.example_zh: 醫生和家屬非正式地聊了聊。

words.zh: n. 球, 球面, 球體, 天體, 地球儀, 範圍；vt. 包圍, 使成球體, 放入球內
words.example: Prevention is a key sphere of public health.
words.example_zh: 預防是公共衛生的一個關鍵領域。

words.zh: n. 吹牛；vi. 吹牛, 自誇；vt. 誇口說, 自恃有
words.example: The clinic can boast a perfect safety record.
words.example_zh: 這間診所擁有完美的安全紀錄，足以自豪。

words.zh: n. 腳掌, 鞋底, 底部；a. 唯一的, 僅有的, 單獨的, 獨身的；vt. 上鞋底, 觸底
words.example: Rest was the sole treatment she needed.
words.example_zh: 休息是她唯一需要的治療。

words.zh: n. 名聲, 宣傳, 公開場合；[經] 宣傳, 廣告
words.example: The new vaccine got a lot of publicity.
words.example_zh: 這款新疫苗受到大量的宣傳。

words.zh: vt. 展開, 開啟, 披露, 開展, 挑明；vi. 伸展, 開花, 呈現
words.example: The crisis unfolded over a single night.
words.example_zh: 這場危機在一夜之間爆發。

words.zh: n. 有效性, 正確性；[計] 有效性
words.example: Doctors questioned the validity of the test.
words.example_zh: 醫生質疑這項檢查的有效性。

words.zh: n. 雜草, 野草；vi. 除草；vt. 除...的草, 剔除
words.example: She pulled weeds in the hospital garden to relax.
words.example_zh: 她在醫院花園裡拔草來放鬆。

words.zh: n. 遵從, 順從, 屈從；[化] 柔順; 順應
words.example: Good recovery depends on compliance with the plan.
words.example_zh: 良好的康復有賴於遵從計畫。

words.zh: n. 衣領, 頸圈；vt. 控制, 扭住衣領, 給...裝上領子
words.example: A soft collar supported his injured neck.
words.example_zh: 一個軟頸圈支撐著他受傷的脖子。

words.zh: adv. 想象上, 看上去像, 被認為是, 恐怕, 按照推測
words.example: The herb is supposedly good for the heart.
words.example_zh: 這種草藥據說對心臟有益。

words.zh: n. 條理, 斑紋, 傾向；vt. 加條紋；vi. 變成條紋, 飛跑
words.example: A streak of blood showed on the bandage.
words.example_zh: 繃帶上出現了一道血痕。

words.zh: n. 專業, 專長, 特產, 特製品, 特性, 特點；a. 專門的, 獨立的
words.example: Heart surgery is her specialty.
words.example_zh: 心臟手術是她的專長。

words.zh: v. 認為, 相信
words.example: The doctor deemed him fit to go home.
words.example_zh: 醫生認為他適合出院。

words.zh: n. 一瞥, 一閃；vi. 投以一瞥, 閃爍不定；vt. 瞥見
words.example: She caught a glimpse of hope in his eyes.
words.example_zh: 她瞥見了他眼中的一絲希望。

words.zh: vi. 鬼鬼祟祟做事；vt. 偷偷地做；n. 鬼鬼祟祟的人, 偷偷摸摸的行為, 帆布膠底運動鞋；a. 暗中進行的
words.example: He tried to sneak chocolate past the nurse.
words.example_zh: 他試圖瞞著護理師偷吃巧克力。

words.zh: n. 人工製品；[醫] 人為現象, 人工產物
words.example: The shadow on the scan was just an artifact.
words.example_zh: 掃描上的陰影只是個假影。

words.zh: n. 指導者, 良師益友
words.example: Her mentor taught her never to rush a diagnosis.
words.example_zh: 她的導師教她診斷絕不可操之過急。

words.zh: a. 過度的, 過多的, 極端的；[法] 過度的, 過分的, 額外的
words.example: Excessive drinking damaged his liver.
words.example_zh: 過量飲酒損害了他的肝臟。

words.zh: n. 紀念物, 請願書；a. 記念的, 記憶的
words.example: A memorial service was held for the late doctor.
words.example_zh: 為已故的醫生舉行了追悼會。

words.zh: vt. 擾亂, 妨礙, 使不安；[法] 滋擾, 擾亂
words.example: Please do not disturb the resting patient.
words.example_zh: 請勿打擾正在休息的病人。

words.zh: n. 失望
words.example: The failed treatment was a deep disappointment.
words.example_zh: 治療失敗是個深深的失望。

words.zh: n. 肋骨, 肋狀物, 笑話；vt. 裝肋狀物於, 戲弄
words.example: He cracked a rib when he fell.
words.example_zh: 他跌倒時裂了一根肋骨。

words.zh: a. 合乎邏輯的, 合理的；[法] 邏輯的, 符合邏輯的
words.example: It was the logical next step in her care.
words.example_zh: 這是她照護中合乎邏輯的下一步。

words.zh: n. 竿, 笞鞭, 小枝；[化] 棒
words.example: A metal rod was placed to support the broken leg.
words.example_zh: 醫生植入一根金屬棒來支撐斷腿。

words.zh: n. 治療, 治癒, 治療法；vt. 治療, 治癒, 改正, 醃製, 加工處理, 使硫化；vi. 受治療, 被加工處理, 被硫化
words.example: There is still no cure for the common cold.
words.example_zh: 普通感冒至今仍無法根治。

words.zh: n. 農產品, 商品, 有用的物品；[經] 商品, 貨物, 日用品
words.example: Clean water is a precious commodity in the camp.
words.example_zh: 在這個營地裡，乾淨的水是寶貴的物資。

words.zh: n. 礦物, 無機物, 蘇打水；a. 礦物的, 似礦物的
words.example: The water is rich in healthy minerals.
words.example_zh: 這種水富含有益健康的礦物質。

words.zh: n. 飢餓, 渴望, 饑荒；vt. 使捱餓；vi. 捱餓, 渴望
words.example: Constant hunger can be an early sign of diabetes.
words.example_zh: 持續的飢餓感可能是糖尿病的早期徵兆。

words.zh: n. 剩餘, 備用品, 備件, 備用零件, 備用輪胎；a. 多餘的, 備用的, 空閒的, 節約的, 瘦的；vi. 節約, 省掉, 寬恕；vt. 節約, 省用, 剩下, 饒恕, 赦免
words.example: The nurse kept a spare dressing in her pocket.
words.example_zh: 護理師口袋裡備了一份多餘的敷料。

words.zh: n. 平等, 均勻, 相等；[法] 同等, 平等, 相等
words.example: She fought for equality in access to healthcare.
words.example_zh: 她為醫療資源的平等取得而奮鬥。

words.zh: a. 醒目的, 驚人的, 打擊的, 罷工的；[法] 罷工的, 罷市的, 罷課的
words.example: There was a striking change in his color.
words.example_zh: 他的氣色有了顯著的改變。

words.zh: n. 通行費, 代價, 鐘聲；vt. 徵收, 敲鐘, 鳴鐘, 勾引, 引誘；vi. 徵稅, 鳴鐘
words.example: The long illness took a heavy toll on her.
words.example_zh: 這場久病讓她付出了沉重的代價。

words.zh: n. 邊, 輪緣, 框；vt. 鑲邊, 為...裝邊；vi. 形成邊緣
words.example: A red rim formed around the infected cut.
words.example_zh: 受感染的傷口周圍形成了一圈紅暈。

words.zh: a. 孤立的, 孤零零的；[計] 隔離的, 絕緣的
words.example: The patient was kept in an isolated room.
words.example_zh: 病人被安置在一間隔離的房間裡。

words.zh: n. 班, 小隊, 小集團；vt. 編成班
words.example: A rescue squad reached the crash within minutes.
words.example_zh: 一支救援小隊在幾分鐘內趕到車禍現場。

words.zh: vi. 眨眼, 閃亮；vt. 眨眼, 使閃亮；n. 眨眼, 瞬間, 閃光, 閃爍；[計] 閃爍
words.example: He could only blink to answer the questions.
words.example_zh: 他只能用眨眼來回答問題。

words.zh: n. 鑽進, 跳進, 跳水, 跳水池, 猛跌, 落下, 投入, 開始從事, 盲目投資；vi. 投入, 投身於, 跳進, 陷入, 下降；vt. 使投入, 使插入, 使陷入, 使遭受
words.example: Her temperature took a sudden plunge.
words.example_zh: 她的體溫突然驟降。

words.zh: n. 避難所, 安全地帶, 避難, 庇護；vi. 躲避；vt. 給予...庇護
words.example: The clinic was a refuge for the sick and poor.
words.example_zh: 這間診所是病人與窮人的庇護所。

words.zh: n. 重振旗鼓, 集合, 群眾集會, 跌停回升；v. 重整旗鼓, 集合, 恢復精神, 團結, 挖苦, 嘲笑
words.example: His strength began to rally after the meal.
words.example_zh: 用餐後他的力氣開始恢復。

words.zh: vt. 引導, 駕駛, 航行, 控制；vi. 駕駛, 掌舵, 行駛；n. 駕駛指示, 勸告
words.example: The nurse gently steered him back to bed.
words.example_zh: 護理師輕輕地引導他回到床上。

words.zh: n. 出口, 發洩方法, 市場；[醫] 出口
words.example: Painting gave her an outlet during the long recovery.
words.example_zh: 在漫長的康復期，畫畫成了她的抒發出口。

words.zh: a. 尚未被人碰過的, 原封不動的, 完整的；[醫] 完整的, 無傷的
words.example: After the surgery, her memory was still intact.
words.example_zh: 手術後她的記憶仍然完好。

words.zh: vi. 繁榮, 興旺, 茁壯成長；[經] 興旺, 繁榮, 旺盛
words.example: Bacteria thrive in warm, damp places.
words.example_zh: 細菌在溫暖潮濕的地方繁衍興盛。

words.zh: n. 拍賣；vt. 拍賣
words.example: A charity auction raised money for the ward.
words.example_zh: 一場慈善拍賣為病房募了款。

words.zh: n. 牛排, 魚排, 肉排
words.example: He was finally well enough to enjoy a steak.
words.example_zh: 他終於康復到能享用一塊牛排。

words.zh: n. 觀念, 概念；[醫] 妊娠, 受孕; 概念
words.example: The drug must be avoided around the time of conception.
words.example_zh: 受孕前後應避免使用這種藥。

words.zh: vi. 順從, 依從；[法] 遵守, 承諾, 照做
words.example: The clinic must comply with strict safety rules.
words.example_zh: 這間診所必須遵守嚴格的安全規定。

words.zh: n. 凱旋, 勝利, 歡欣；vi. 得勝, 成功
words.example: Her recovery was a triumph of will.
words.example_zh: 她的康復是意志的勝利。

words.zh: a. 可比較的, 比得上的
words.example: The two drugs have comparable side effects.
words.example_zh: 這兩種藥的副作用相當。

words.zh: n. 運輸, 運輸工具, 激動, 狂喜, 流放犯；vt. 傳送, 運輸, 流放；[計] 傳送
words.example: An ambulance will transport her to the hospital.
words.example_zh: 一輛救護車將載送她去醫院。

words.zh: n. 良心；[法] 良心, 道德感, 正義感
words.example: His conscience would not let him ignore the sick man.
words.example_zh: 他的良心不容許他對這名病人視而不見。

words.zh: n. 計算, 考慮, 計算的結果；[經] 計算
words.example: A small error in calculation changed the dose.
words.example_zh: 計算上的一個小錯誤改變了劑量。

words.zh: n. 強制, 約束；[計] 約束
words.example: Time was the biggest constraint in the surgery.
words.example_zh: 時間是這場手術最大的限制。

words.zh: n. 抓痕, 搔, 抓, 擦傷, 刮擦聲, 亂寫, 零分, 起跑線；vt. 搔, 抓, 挖出, 擦, 刮, 亂塗, 勾抹掉；vi. 搔, 抓, 發刮擦聲, 勉強餬口；a. 碰巧的,
words.example: Even a small scratch should be kept clean.
words.example_zh: 即使是小小的擦傷也要保持乾淨。

words.zh: adv. 非常地, 很, 頗
words.example: Her health improved considerably this month.
words.example_zh: 這個月她的健康狀況大有起色。

words.zh: n. 間隔, 距離, 間歇, 間隙；[計] 時間間隔
words.example: Take the pills at regular intervals.
words.example_zh: 按固定的間隔服藥。

words.zh: n. 商業, 商務, 貿易；[經] 商業, 貿易, 商務
words.example: The drug trade is a huge part of global commerce.
words.example_zh: 藥品貿易是全球商業的一大部分。

words.zh: n. 男女平等主義者
words.example: She was a feminist who fought for women's health.
words.example_zh: 她是位為女性健康奮鬥的女權主義者。

words.zh: adv. 不可避免地
words.example: Old age inevitably brings some aches.
words.example_zh: 年老不可避免地會帶來一些痠痛。

words.zh: n. 細菌；[醫] [無芽胞]桿菌屬
words.example: A single bacterium can multiply into millions.
words.example_zh: 一個細菌能繁殖成數百萬個。

words.zh: n. 司法權, 審判權, 管轄權；[經] 法律管轄權, 審判權
words.example: The case fell outside the clinic's jurisdiction.
words.example_zh: 這個案件超出了診所的權責範圍。

words.zh: n. 遠征, 探險隊, 迅速
words.example: A medical expedition brought care to the mountains.
words.example_zh: 一支醫療隊把照護帶進了山區。

words.zh: n. 粗大的一頭, 菸頭, 靶, 笑柄；[醫] 對核
words.example: He stubbed out the cigarette butt and quit for good.
words.example_zh: 他熄掉菸頭，從此戒了菸。

words.zh: a. 啞的, 不說話的, 無聲音的；[醫] 啞的
words.example: The shock left him momentarily dumb.
words.example_zh: 這個打擊讓他一時說不出話。

words.zh: n. 大小, 體積, 大塊, 大多數；vt. 顯得大, 顯得重要
words.example: The bulk of the patients recovered fully.
words.example_zh: 大部分的病人都完全康復了。

words.zh: n. 轉變, 轉換, 改變宗教信仰, 換位法；[計] 轉換
words.example: The conversion of the old ward took six months.
words.example_zh: 舊病房的改建花了六個月。

words.zh: n. 贊助人, 顧客, 保護人；[法] 保護人, 庇護人, 贊助人
words.example: A wealthy patron funded the children's ward.
words.example_zh: 一位富有的贊助人資助了兒童病房。

words.zh: a. 市政的, 自治區的, 內政的；[經] 市政的, 市的
words.example: The municipal hospital treats anyone in need.
words.example_zh: 這家市立醫院為任何有需要的人看診。

words.zh: adv. 僅僅, 單獨地
words.example: Her illness was not caused solely by stress.
words.example_zh: 她的病不僅僅是壓力造成的。

words.zh: n. 祝福
words.example: A safe delivery was a great blessing.
words.example_zh: 平安生產是一大福氣。

words.zh: adv. 從前, 以前
words.example: The building was formerly a small clinic.
words.example_zh: 這棟建築從前是一間小診所。

words.zh: a. 移動的, 易變的, 機動的；n. 活動物體
words.example: A mobile clinic visits the village each week.
words.example_zh: 一輛行動診所每週造訪這個村莊。

words.zh: n. 日曆, 日程表；vt. 列入表中；[計] 日曆
words.example: She marked her checkups on the calendar.
words.example_zh: 她把回診的日子標在日曆上。

words.zh: n. 鬍鬚；vt. 抓住鬍鬚, 公開反對
words.example: He grew a beard during his long stay in hospital.
words.example_zh: 長期住院期間他留起了鬍子。

words.zh: n. 寡婦, 孀婦；vt. 使成寡婦
words.example: The kind widow volunteered at the clinic.
words.example_zh: 這位善良的寡婦在診所當志工。

words.zh: n. 存款, 定金, 堆積物；vt. 存放, 堆積；vi. 沉澱
words.example: A fatty deposit had narrowed the artery.
words.example_zh: 一處脂肪沉積使動脈變窄了。

words.zh: n. 剎車, 阻礙, 叢林；v. 剎車
words.example: The driver hit the brake but it was too late.
words.example_zh: 駕駛踩了剎車，但為時已晚。

words.zh: n. 衝動, 驅使, 刺激, 推動, 衝力, 建議, 脈衝；vt. 推動
words.example: She fought the impulse to scratch the rash.
words.example_zh: 她忍住了想抓疹子的衝動。

words.zh: a. 殘忍的, 野蠻的, 不講理的
words.example: Recovery from the burn was slow and brutal.
words.example_zh: 從燒傷中康復既緩慢又煎熬。

words.zh: vt. 禁止, 不準, 妨礙；[法] 不許, 禁止, 阻止
words.example: Doctors forbid him to lift anything heavy.
words.example_zh: 醫生禁止他提任何重物。

words.zh: n. 食肉動物, 掠奪者；[醫] 捕食者
words.example: In the wild, a sick animal is easy prey for a predator.
words.example_zh: 在野外，生病的動物容易成為掠食者的獵物。

words.zh: n. 毛皮；vt. 以毛皮製作, 使生苔, 使生水垢；vi. 生苔, 積水垢
words.example: Pet fur can trigger her asthma.
words.example_zh: 寵物的毛會引發她的氣喘。

words.zh: a. 自動的, 自願的, 故意的, 志願的, 自發的；n. 自願行動, 志願者, 自由調
words.example: Joining the trial was completely voluntary.
words.example_zh: 參加這項試驗完全是自願的。

words.zh: n. 刺, 戳, 袋子；vt. 戳, 捅, 撥弄, 刺；vi. 戳, 刺, 捅, 搜尋, 伸出, 行動散慢；[計] 存數
words.example: The doctor gave the swelling a gentle poke.
words.example_zh: 醫生輕輕戳了戳那處腫脹。

words.zh: a. 有確實根據的, 有法律效力的, 正當的, 正確的；[經] 有效的
words.example: Her insurance card is still valid.
words.example_zh: 她的保險卡仍然有效。

words.zh: n. 論壇, 公開討論的廣場, 法庭, 討論會；[法] 討論會, 專題討論, 公共論壇
words.example: An online forum lets patients share advice.
words.example_zh: 一個線上論壇讓病人交流建議。

words.zh: n. 高揚, 翱翔；vi. 往上飛舞, 高聳, 翱翔
words.example: Demand for the vaccine continued to soar.
words.example_zh: 這款疫苗的需求持續飆升。

words.zh: vt. 制定法律, 扮演, 頒佈；[法] 法令, 法規, 條例
words.example: The government enacted a law on drug safety.
words.example_zh: 政府制定了一項藥品安全的法律。

words.zh: n. 自治, 自治權；[醫] 自主性
words.example: Patients have the autonomy to refuse treatment.
words.example_zh: 病人有拒絕治療的自主權。

words.zh: n. 線, 絲, 纖維, 線索；vt. 穿線於, 穿過, 通過, 用線穿成；vi. 穿過；[計] 線索, 執行緒
words.example: The surgeon used a fine thread to close the wound.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生用一條細線縫合傷口。

words.zh: n. 陸標, 劃時代的事, 地界標；[醫] 界標
words.example: The discovery was a landmark in cancer research.
words.example_zh: 這項發現是癌症研究的一個里程碑。

words.zh: n. 小部分, 破片, 分數；[醫] 部分, 成分, 分散
words.example: Only a fraction of patients had side effects.
words.example_zh: 只有一小部分病人出現副作用。

words.zh: a. 有特色的, 出眾的
words.example: The disease has a distinctive purple rash.
words.example_zh: 這種病有一種獨特的紫色疹子。

words.zh: n. 門檻, 入口, 開端, 閾；[計] 閾; 閾值
words.example: His pain finally crossed the threshold of what he could bear.
words.example_zh: 他的疼痛終於超過了他能忍受的臨界點。

words.zh: n. 隨員, 套房, (一)組, (一)套, 組曲, 繼之而來的事；[電] 程式組
words.example: She recovered in a private suite at the hospital.
words.example_zh: 她在醫院的一間單人套房裡休養。

words.zh: adv. 日常, 乏味, 常規, 例行
words.example: Blood pressure is checked routinely at each visit.
words.example_zh: 每次就診都會例行測量血壓。

words.zh: a. 易碎的, 脆的；[醫] 脆弱的, 脆的
words.example: The elderly patient was frail and fragile.
words.example_zh: 這位年長的病人虛弱而脆弱。

words.zh: n. 排氣, 排氣裝置, 廢氣；vt. 抽完, 用盡, 耗盡, 使精疲力盡；vi. 排氣
words.example: The long illness began to exhaust her.
words.example_zh: 久病開始讓她精疲力竭。

words.zh: n. 異議, 反對, 不喜歡, 缺點, 缺陷, 妨礙, 拒絕之理由；[法] 異議, 反對, 抗議
words.example: The patient raised an objection to the surgery.
words.example_zh: 病人對這場手術提出了異議。

words.zh: n. 一陣風, 爆炸, 枯萎病；vt. 炸, 使枯萎；vi. 炸, 猛攻, 猛烈抨擊, 枯萎
words.example: A blast of cold air rushed in when the door opened.
words.example_zh: 門一開，一陣冷空氣灌了進來。

words.zh: n. 碎片, 破片, 片段；[計] 段落; 片段; 分段
words.example: A fragment of bone had to be removed.
words.example_zh: 一塊骨頭碎片必須取出。

words.zh: n. 租費, 租金收入；a. 租賃的, 收取租金的
words.example: A wheelchair rental helped her get around.
words.example_zh: 租來的輪椅幫助她四處走動。

words.zh: a. 奇妙的, 稀奇的, 空想的
words.example: She made a fantastic recovery against the odds.
words.example_zh: 她在不被看好的情況下驚人地康復了。

words.zh: n. 螺旋, 螺桿, 螺釘, 螺旋槳, 吝嗇鬼；vt. 調節, 扭緊, 旋, 擰, 加強, 壓榨, 勒索；vi. 轉動, 旋, 擰
words.example: A small screw holds the broken bone together.
words.example_zh: 一根小螺絲把斷骨固定在一起。

words.zh: n. 大學本科生, 大學肄業生；a. 大學生的
words.example: She studied biology as an undergraduate.
words.example_zh: 她大學時主修生物學。

words.zh: n. 發射, 計劃, 突出部分, 設計, 推測；[計] 投影
words.example: The scan gives a clear projection of the bone.
words.example_zh: 這項掃描給出骨頭清晰的投影。

words.zh: n. 鑽孔機, 鑽子, 播種機, 粗斜紋布；v. 訓練, 鑽孔
words.example: The dentist's drill whirred softly.
words.example_zh: 牙醫的鑽頭輕輕地嗡嗡作響。

words.zh: n. 大廈, 宅邸
words.example: The old mansion was turned into a care home.
words.example_zh: 這座古老的宅邸被改成了安養院。

words.zh: a. 殘酷的, 令人極痛苦的；[法] 殘忍的, 殘酷的
words.example: It seemed cruel that she fell ill on her birthday.
words.example_zh: 她偏偏在生日當天病倒，似乎很殘忍。

words.zh: vt. 授權, 批准, 委託；[經] 授權, 委任, 認可
words.example: Only a doctor can authorize this strong drug.
words.example_zh: 只有醫生能授權使用這種強效藥。

words.zh: n. 峽谷, 海底懸崖
words.example: An echo carried across the deep canyon.
words.example_zh: 回聲在深谷中迴盪。

words.zh: n. 吸引力, 魔力, 符咒；vt. 迷住, 使陶醉, 行魔法；vi. 用符咒, 有魅力
words.example: The old nurse had a calming charm.
words.example_zh: 這位老護理師有種令人安心的魅力。

words.zh: a. 忠誠的, 忠實的, 忠貞的
words.example: She was a loyal nurse who never left a patient's side.
words.example_zh: 她是個忠誠的護理師，從不離開病人身邊。

words.zh: n. 泥土, 肉體, 黏土；[化] 粘土
words.example: Children shaped little animals out of clay.
words.example_zh: 孩子們用黏土捏出小動物。

words.zh: n. 氣球；vt. 使成氣球狀；vi. 膨脹如氣球, 激增
words.example: A red balloon cheered up the sick child.
words.example_zh: 一顆紅氣球讓生病的孩子開心起來。

words.zh: n. 雷達, 無線電探測器；[計] 雷達圖
words.example: The disease slipped under the doctor's radar at first.
words.example_zh: 這種病起初沒被醫生察覺。

words.zh: n. 皺眉；vi. 皺眉頭；vt. 皺眉表示
words.example: A worried frown crossed the doctor's face.
words.example_zh: 醫生臉上掠過一抹擔憂的皺眉。

words.zh: n. 分子, 些微；[化] 分子
words.example: A drug molecule is far too small to see.
words.example_zh: 一個藥物分子小到根本看不見。

words.zh: n. 休息寓所, 撤退, 隱居, 退避；vi. 撤退, 隱退, 向後傾；vt. 退(棋)
words.example: She went to a quiet retreat to recover her strength.
words.example_zh: 她去了一處寧靜的休養所恢復元氣。

words.zh: n. 復原；[醫] 復原, 恢復, 康復
words.example: He spent months in rehabilitation after the stroke.
words.example_zh: 中風後他花了好幾個月做復健。

words.zh: n. 小孩, 年輕人, 少年；[法] 兒童, 少年, 青年
words.example: The youngster healed faster than the older patients.
words.example_zh: 這名年輕人比年長的病人癒合得快。

words.zh: n. 負有責任, 可說明性；[化] 衡算計量
words.example: Clear records ensure accountability in care.
words.example_zh: 清楚的紀錄確保了照護上的問責。

words.zh: n. 額外補貼, 獎金, 獎賞, 保險費；[醫] 保險費
words.example: She paid a higher premium for better health cover.
words.example_zh: 她付了較高的保費以換取更好的醫療保障。

words.zh: vt. 注視, 沉思, 盤算；vi. 冥思苦想
words.example: He had time to contemplate his life while ill.
words.example_zh: 生病期間他有時間沉思自己的人生。

words.zh: n. 火花, 火星, 閃光, 無線電報務員, 瞬間放電, 活力, 朝氣, 花花公子, 情郎；vi. 閃光, 發火花, 求婚；vt. 發動, 鼓舞, 使有朝氣, 求婚
words.example: A single spark of hope kept her going.
words.example_zh: 一絲希望的火花支撐著她繼續走下去。

words.zh: n. 桶；[計] 儲存桶; 桶
words.example: She filled a bucket with warm water to clean the floor.
words.example_zh: 她在桶子裡裝滿溫水來清理地板。

words.zh: v. 傳道, 講道, 說教, 宣講, 鼓吹；n. 說教, 佈道
words.example: It is easy to preach exercise but harder to do it.
words.example_zh: 鼓吹運動容易，要做到卻難。

words.zh: adv. 實質上, 本質上, 大體上
words.example: His health improved substantially after he quit smoking.
words.example_zh: 戒菸後他的健康狀況大幅改善。

words.zh: n. 承認, 坦白, 招供；[法] 自白, 招供, 自認有罪
words.example: His confession that he had skipped his pills shocked the nurse.
words.example_zh: 他坦承漏服了藥，令護理師震驚。

words.zh: n. 大理石, 石彈, 雕刻品；a. 大理石的, 冷酷無情的, 有大理石花紋的
words.example: The hospital lobby had a cool marble floor.
words.example_zh: 醫院大廳鋪著冰涼的大理石地板。

words.zh: n. 監視, 監督；[電] 偵測
words.example: The patient was kept under close surveillance overnight.
words.example_zh: 病人整夜受到密切的監測。

words.zh: a. 詳述的, 清楚的, 直言的
words.example: The doctor gave explicit instructions for the dose.
words.example_zh: 醫生對劑量給出了明確的指示。

words.zh: vi. 離開, 出發, 背離, 違反, 去世
words.example: She did not depart the hospital until she was fully well.
words.example_zh: 她直到完全康復才離開醫院。

words.zh: a. 有磁性的, 有吸引力的, 催眠術的；[醫] 磁[性]的
words.example: The scanner uses a strong magnetic field.
words.example_zh: 這台掃描儀使用強大的磁場。

words.zh: n. 浸, 溼透, 大雨；vt. 使上下溼透, 浸, 吸入, 吸收, 浸洗掉；vi. 浸泡, 滲透
words.example: Soak the bandage in warm water before removing it.
words.example_zh: 取下繃帶前先用溫水浸泡。

words.zh: n. 喃喃低語；vi. 喃喃自語, 作低沉聲；vt. 出怨言, 抱怨地說
words.example: The feverish man began to mutter in his sleep.
words.example_zh: 發燒的男子開始在睡夢中喃喃自語。

words.zh: n. 緞帶, 色帶, 帶狀物；vt. 用絲帶裝飾, 把...撕成條狀；vi. 形成帶狀；[計] 帶狀條, 格式欄
words.example: A small ribbon marked the patient's chart.
words.example_zh: 一條小緞帶標記著病人的病歷。

words.zh: n. 收穫, 成果, 收穫物, 收穫期；v. 收割, 收穫
words.example: The autumn harvest brought fresh food to the village.
words.example_zh: 秋收為村莊帶來了新鮮的食物。

words.zh: n. 水溝, 細長孔, 硬幣投幣口, 縫, 狹槽, 狹通道, 位置, 一檔(廣播節目等)；vt. 開槽於, 把...納入機構；[計] 槽; 儲存槽
words.example: The nurse fit her into the last slot of the day.
words.example_zh: 護理師把她排進了當天最後一個空檔。

words.zh: a. 連續的, 聯貫的；[計] 連續的; 連線的
words.example: She worked five consecutive night shifts.
words.example_zh: 她連續上了五個夜班。

words.zh: n. 同等的人(或物), 座標；a. 同等的, 並列的；v. (使)協調
words.example: The team coordinated their care of the patient.
words.example_zh: 團隊協調了對這名病人的照護。

words.zh: a. 營養的, 滋養的；n. 營養物, 滋養物
words.example: Milk is a rich source of nutrients for babies.
words.example_zh: 牛奶是嬰兒豐富的營養來源。

words.zh: n. 國籍, 市民權, 市民的身份；[法] 公民權, 公民資格, 公民身分
words.example: She gained citizenship and free access to healthcare.
words.example_zh: 她取得公民身分，得以免費享有醫療。

words.zh: n. 主權, 獨立國；[法] 主權, 主權國家, 統治權
words.example: The small nation guarded its sovereignty fiercely.
words.example_zh: 這個小國堅決捍衛它的主權。

words.zh: n. 脊, 山脊, 山脈；[醫] 嵴, 脊, 稜線
words.example: The doctor felt a hard ridge along the bone.
words.example_zh: 醫生摸到骨頭上有一道堅硬的稜脊。

words.zh: vt. 挫敗, 擊敗, 破壞；a. 無益的, 挫敗的, 挫折的
words.example: Slow healing began to frustrate the patient.
words.example_zh: 緩慢的癒合開始讓病人感到挫折。

words.zh: n. 經過, 通行, 運輸, 運輸線, 轉變；vt. 運送, 使通過, 經過；vi. 通過
words.example: The vaccine spoiled in transit due to the heat.
words.example_zh: 疫苗在運送途中因高溫而變質。

words.zh: a. 密集的, 濃厚的
words.example: The X-ray showed a dense white spot on the lung.
words.example_zh: X 光顯示肺部有一個緻密的白點。

words.zh: n. 增大, 隆起的部分, 巨浪, 腫脹；a. 優秀的, 一流的；vi. 增大, 膨脹, 腫脹, 增強, 驕傲；vt. 使膨脹, 使增大, 使上漲, 使驕傲
words.example: Her ankle began to swell after the fall.
words.example_zh: 跌倒後她的腳踝開始腫起來。

words.zh: n. 控告, 指控, 指責；[法] 控告, 起訴, 告發
words.example: The nurse denied the accusation of carelessness.
words.example_zh: 護理師否認了粗心的指控。

words.zh: adv. 可怕地, 甚為, 非常
words.example: His knee hurt terribly after the long walk.
words.example_zh: 走了那麼長的路後，他的膝蓋痛得厲害。

words.zh: n. 提示, 線索；vt. 給...暗示(或提示)；[計] 尾接指令
words.example: A nod from the surgeon was the cue to begin.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生點頭就是開始的暗號。

words.zh: n. 傳記
words.example: She wrote a biography of the famous surgeon.
words.example_zh: 她寫了這位知名外科醫生的傳記。

words.zh: a. 不常的, 稀少的；adv. 很少, 不常
words.example: He seldom complains, even when in pain.
words.example_zh: 即使疼痛，他也很少抱怨。

words.zh: a. 強制的, 強迫性的, 激發興趣的
words.example: There is compelling evidence that the drug works.
words.example_zh: 有令人信服的證據顯示這種藥有效。

words.zh: n. 磚瓦, 瓷磚, 瓦片；vt. 鋪以瓦, 鋪以瓷磚；[計] 平鋪
words.example: The bathroom tiles were wiped clean each day.
words.example_zh: 浴室的瓷磚每天都擦得乾乾淨淨。

words.zh: a. 含糊的, 不清楚的, 茫然的
words.example: Her symptoms were vague and hard to pin down.
words.example_zh: 她的症狀模糊，難以確定。

words.zh: a. 公平的, 平衡的；[計] 平衡的, 對稱的, 均衡的
words.example: A balanced diet keeps the body strong.
words.example_zh: 均衡的飲食能讓身體強健。

words.zh: n. 方便, 便利的事物, 方便的時候
words.example: The clinic opens late for the convenience of workers.
words.example_zh: 這間診所為了上班族的方便而開到很晚。

words.zh: n. 編法, 織法, 編織式樣；vt. 編織, 組合, 編排, 使迂迴前進；vi. 紡織, 迂迴行進
words.example: The nurse helped weave a blanket for the ward.
words.example_zh: 護理師幫忙為病房織了一條毯子。

words.zh: n. 懇求, 辯解, 抗辯, 訴訟, 請願, 託詞；[法] 抗辯, 申訴案件, 答辯
words.example: The family made a plea for more blood donors.
words.example_zh: 家屬呼籲更多人捐血。

words.zh: n. 學院, 院校, 學會
words.example: She trained at a respected medical academy.
words.example_zh: 她在一所受敬重的醫學院受訓。

words.zh: n. 木材, 木料；vt. 用木材建造
words.example: The old ward was built of dark timber.
words.example_zh: 那間舊病房是用深色木材建造的。

words.zh: prep. 直到, 在...以前, 迄；conj. 直到...為止；vt. 耕種；n. 放錢的抽屜, 備用現金, 冰磧
words.example: Don't stop the antibiotics till the course is done.
words.example_zh: 抗生素療程結束前別停藥。

words.zh: n. 門閂, 螺釘, 篩子, 閃電, 意外事件；vt. 閂住, 發射, 脫口而出, 篩, 囫圇吞下；vi. 囫圇吞棗, 射箭, 脫韁, 退出黨派；adv. 突然
words.example: A loose bolt made the hospital bed wobble.
words.example_zh: 一顆鬆掉的螺栓讓病床晃動。

words.zh: n. 球莖, 電燈泡；[醫] 球, 鱗莖, 球莖
words.example: The nurse replaced the dim bulb above the bed.
words.example_zh: 護理師換掉了床上方那顆昏暗的燈泡。

words.zh: n. 背骨, 脊柱, 尖刺；[醫] 脊柱; 棘, 刺; 馬蹄嵴
words.example: An injury to the spine can affect the legs.
words.example_zh: 脊椎的傷可能影響到雙腿。

words.zh: n. 貨物；[經] 貨櫃
words.example: A cargo of medical supplies arrived by ship.
words.example_zh: 一批醫療物資由船運抵達。

words.zh: n. 講述者, 敘述者；[法] 陳述者, 敘述者
words.example: The narrator of the audio guide had a calm voice.
words.example_zh: 這份語音導覽的旁白者聲音平靜。

words.zh: n. 碼頭, 船塢, 被告席, 尾巴的骨肉部分；vt. 使靠碼頭, 使(船)進港, 剪短；vi. 進港
words.example: The supply ship pulled up to the dock.
words.example_zh: 補給船靠上了碼頭。

words.zh: n. 霧, 迷惑, (割後的)最生草, 苔蘚；vi. 被霧籠罩, 變模糊；vt. 使困惑, 以霧籠罩
words.example: A thick fog delayed the air ambulance.
words.example_zh: 濃霧延誤了空中救護。

words.zh: n. 艦隊, 水兵, 海景畫；a. 海的, 海產的, 海底的, 船舶的, 海運的
words.example: The marine air was good for her weak lungs.
words.example_zh: 海邊的空氣對她虛弱的肺有益。

words.zh: n. 摘要, 概要；a. 摘要的, 簡略的；[計] 摘要; 概要
words.example: The doctor gave a brief summary of her case.
words.example_zh: 醫生簡要地總結了她的病情。

words.zh: n. 傳染病, 流行病；a. 流行的, 傳染性的
words.example: The clinic was overwhelmed during the flu epidemic.
words.example_zh: 流感疫情期間，診所應接不暇。

words.zh: n. 倉庫, 貨棧, 大商店；vt. 儲入倉庫
words.example: The vaccines are stored in a cold warehouse.
words.example_zh: 疫苗存放在一座冷藏倉庫裡。

words.zh: a. 固有的, 與生俱來的；[醫] 固有的, 生來的
words.example: There is an inherent risk in every surgery.
words.example_zh: 每場手術都有與生俱來的風險。

words.zh: n. 青銅, 銅像；a. 青銅色的
words.example: He won a bronze medal before his injury.
words.example_zh: 受傷前他贏得了一面銅牌。

words.zh: a. 全國性的；[法] 全國的, 全國範圍的
words.example: A nationwide campaign promoted hand washing.
words.example_zh: 一場全國性的活動推廣洗手。

words.zh: n. 小溪, 小河, 小灣
words.example: The clinic stood beside a small creek.
words.example_zh: 這間診所坐落在一條小溪旁。

words.zh: vi. 聽寫, 口述, 口授；vt. 口述, 使聽寫, 命令；n. 命令, 指揮, 指令
words.example: The doctor dictated her notes to the nurse.
words.example_zh: 醫生口述她的筆記讓護理師記下。

words.zh: n. 鉛版, 陳規, 老套；vt. 使用鉛版, 把...印製成盲文, 套用老套, 使一成不變
words.example: She broke the stereotype of the cold surgeon.
words.example_zh: 她打破了外科醫生冷漠的刻板印象。

words.zh: n. 手冊, 指南；a. 手的, 手動的, 手工的, 體力的；[計] 人工的, 手動的
words.example: The nurse followed the safety manual step by step.
words.example_zh: 護理師一步步遵照安全手冊。

words.zh: n. 原告, 起訴人；[經] 原告, 原起訴人
words.example: The plaintiff claimed the clinic had been negligent.
words.example_zh: 原告聲稱這間診所有疏失。

words.zh: n. 洗衣店, 洗好的衣服, 洗滌；[機] 洗衣作, 洗衣店, 洗衣房
words.example: Hospital laundry is washed at a high temperature.
words.example_zh: 醫院的衣物以高溫清洗。

words.zh: a. 海軍的, 軍艦的, 有艦隊的；[法] 海軍的, 軍艦的, 船的
words.example: He served as a doctor in a naval hospital.
words.example_zh: 他曾在一家海軍醫院當醫生。

words.zh: n. 手槍, 訊號槍；vt. 以手槍殺死(或傷害)
words.example: The wounded man had a pistol wound to the leg.
words.example_zh: 這名受傷的男子腿上有槍傷。

words.zh: n. 道歉, 辯護；[法] 道歉, 謝罪, 辯解者
words.example: The clinic offered a sincere apology for the delay.
words.example_zh: 診所為延誤誠摯地道歉。

words.zh: n. 貢物, 禮物, 頌辭
words.example: The ward paid tribute to the retiring nurse.
words.example_zh: 病房向這位即將退休的護理師致敬。

words.zh: a. 奇異的
words.example: He developed a bizarre rash overnight.
words.example_zh: 他一夜之間長出了一片奇怪的疹子。

words.zh: vt. 設計, 發明, 圖謀, 遺贈給；n. 遺贈
words.example: The team devised a new way to ease the pain.
words.example_zh: 團隊想出了一種緩解疼痛的新方法。

words.zh: n. 錨；vt. 拋錨停泊, 使固定；[計] 錨
words.example: Hope was the anchor that kept her calm.
words.example_zh: 希望是讓她保持平靜的支柱。

words.zh: n. 交易, 買賣協定, 特價商品；v. 講價, 交易
words.example: Good health is no bargain you can buy.
words.example_zh: 健康可不是你能買到的便宜貨。

words.zh: n. 細看, 仔細檢查, 監視, 選票檢查；[經] 複查, 評核, 仔細檢查
words.example: Every dose came under careful scrutiny.
words.example_zh: 每一劑都受到仔細的檢視。

words.zh: vt. 鎮壓, 使止住, 禁止, 抑制, 查禁；[法] 鎮壓, 平定, 禁止出版
words.example: The drug helps suppress the body's reaction.
words.example_zh: 這種藥有助於抑制身體的反應。

words.zh: n. 黃銅, 黃銅製品；a. 黃銅的, 銅管樂器的；v. 鍍以黃銅, 支付
words.example: The old hospital sign was made of polished brass.
words.example_zh: 那塊舊醫院招牌是用擦亮的黃銅做的。

words.zh: vt. 出賣, 背叛, 辜負, 暴露；[法] 出賣, 背叛, 洩漏
words.example: Her shaking hands betrayed her fear.
words.example_zh: 她顫抖的雙手洩露了她的恐懼。

words.zh: n. 堅硬性, 黏稠度, 一致性；[化] 稠度; 一致性
words.example: The medicine has the consistency of thick syrup.
words.example_zh: 這種藥的稠度像濃稠的糖漿。

words.zh: n. 官僚, 官吏；[法] 官僚主義, 官僚政治, 官僚機構
words.example: Too much bureaucracy slowed her treatment.
words.example_zh: 過多的官僚程序拖慢了她的治療。

words.zh: a. 相互作用的, 相互影響的；[計] 互動, 人機對話的
words.example: An interactive chart shows the patient's progress.
words.example_zh: 一張互動式圖表顯示病人的進展。

words.zh: n. 評論文章, 評論
words.example: The doctor wrote a critique of the new method.
words.example_zh: 醫生對這種新方法寫了一篇評論。

words.zh: adv. 在船上, 在火車上, 在飛機上；prep. 在...之上
words.example: A nurse was aboard the flight in case of emergency.
words.example_zh: 一名護理師隨機，以防緊急狀況。

words.zh: v. 繁殖, 再生, 複製, 生殖；[計] 複製
words.example: Bacteria reproduce quickly in warm conditions.
words.example_zh: 細菌在溫暖的環境中迅速繁殖。

words.zh: a. 有益的, 受益的；[經] 有使用權的, 可享利益的
words.example: A short walk each day is beneficial to the heart.
words.example_zh: 每天散步片刻對心臟有益。

words.zh: n. 蟲, 蠕蟲, 小人物, 螺紋, 蝸桿；vi. 蠕行, 慢慢前進；vt. 使蠕行, 慢慢地走, 除蟲；[計] 蠕蟲病毒
words.example: The child was treated for a worm in the gut.
words.example_zh: 這名孩子接受了腸道寄生蟲的治療。

words.zh: a. 傳說的, 傳奇中說的, 傳奇般的, 傳說中的, 著名的
words.example: Her kindness to patients was legendary.
words.example_zh: 她對病人的仁慈是出了名的。

words.zh: n. 義勇軍, 民兵組織, 國民軍
words.example: A local militia helped carry the wounded.
words.example_zh: 一支當地的民兵幫忙抬運傷者。

words.zh: n. 作曲家, 作家, 調停者
words.example: The old composer lost his hearing late in life.
words.example_zh: 這位老作曲家在晚年失去了聽力。

words.zh: a. 可靠的, 可信的, 真正的；[法] 被認證的, 確認的, 可信的
words.example: The herb was sold with an authentic label.
words.example_zh: 這種草藥附有真品標籤販售。

words.zh: n. 特許, 讓步, 認可；[經] 核准, 許可, 特殊(權)
words.example: The hospital made a concession on the bill.
words.example_zh: 醫院在帳單上做了讓步。

words.zh: n. 拒絕, 拋棄, 駁回, 被拋棄的東西, 嘔出物；[化] 報廢; 拒收
words.example: The body showed early signs of rejection of the organ.
words.example_zh: 身體出現了排斥這個器官的早期跡象。

words.zh: n. 享有, 保有期；[經] (財產,職位等的)佔有, 佔有權
words.example: She held tenure as head of the ward for ten years.
words.example_zh: 她擔任病房主管的任期長達十年。

words.zh: n. 圓頂；vt. 加圓頂；vi. 成圓頂狀
words.example: Light streamed through the glass dome above.
words.example_zh: 光線從上方的玻璃圓頂灑下。

words.zh: a. 不充分的, 不適當的；[法] 不充分的, 不適當的
words.example: The clinic's old equipment was inadequate.
words.example_zh: 這間診所的舊設備不敷使用。

words.zh: adv. 後來, 隨後
words.example: She fell ill and subsequently missed her exams.
words.example_zh: 她生病了，隨後錯過了考試。

words.zh: n. 合併, 歸併；[經] 購併
words.example: The merger of the two clinics improved care.
words.example_zh: 兩間診所的合併改善了照護品質。

words.zh: a. 忠實的, 詳確的, 可靠的；n. 信徒
words.example: He was faithful in taking his pills every day.
words.example_zh: 他每天忠實地服藥。

words.zh: n. 常到的地方, 生息地；vt. 常到, 出沒於, 縈繞於；vi. 出沒, 作祟
words.example: The loss of the patient continued to haunt her.
words.example_zh: 失去這名病人的事一直縈繞在她心頭。

words.zh: n. 郡治安官, 縣治安官；[法] 司法行政官, 郡長, 執行吏
words.example: The sheriff called the clinic about the accident.
words.example_zh: 警長為這起意外致電診所。

words.zh: vt. 喚起, 引起, 召(魂)；[法] 提審, 移送
words.example: The smell of the ward evoked old memories.
words.example_zh: 病房的氣味喚起了舊日的回憶。

words.zh: n. 血管, 靜脈, 紋理, 氣質, 情緒；vt. 使有脈絡, 像脈絡般分佈於
words.example: The nurse found a vein and drew the blood.
words.example_zh: 護理師找到一條靜脈，抽了血。

words.zh: n. 疤痕, 傷痕, 懸崖；vi. 結疤, 癒合, 痊癒；vt. 使有傷痕
words.example: The surgery left a thin scar on her arm.
words.example_zh: 手術在她手臂上留下一道細疤。

words.zh: n. 不一致, 變化, 變異, 分歧, 不和；[化] 方差; 變種
words.example: There was wide variance in the test results.
words.example_zh: 檢驗結果之間有很大的差異。

words.zh: vt. 檢查, 檢閱, 檢驗；vi. 檢查
words.example: The doctor inspected the wound for infection.
words.example_zh: 醫生檢查傷口有沒有感染。

words.zh: n. 註釋, 評論, 說明；[法] 註釋, 評註, 評論
words.example: The textbook had a clear commentary on each diagram.
words.example_zh: 這本教科書對每張圖都有清楚的註解。

words.zh: a. 帝王的, 宗主國的, 至尊的, 壯麗的；n. 特等品
words.example: The hospital was built in the imperial era.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院建於帝國時代。

words.zh: vi. 盤旋, 翱翔, 徘徊；vt. 孵；n. 翱翔
words.example: The nurse hovered nearby in case he fell.
words.example_zh: 護理師在一旁守著，以防他跌倒。

words.zh: n. 化石, 古物；a. 化石的, 陳腐的, 守舊的
words.example: The museum displayed an ancient fish fossil.
words.example_zh: 博物館展出了一塊古老的魚化石。

words.zh: a. 打昏迷的, 弄得人昏頭昏腦的, 令人震驚的
words.example: Her recovery was a stunning surprise to all.
words.example_zh: 她的康復讓所有人又驚又喜。

words.zh: a. 不適當的, 不相稱的
words.example: It would be inappropriate to give such a high dose.
words.example_zh: 給予這麼高的劑量並不恰當。

words.zh: n. 牛仔, 牛郎, 牧童
words.example: The injured cowboy was thrown from his horse.
words.example_zh: 這名受傷的牛仔從馬背上摔了下來。

words.zh: a. 能養活的, 能生長發育的；[醫] 有活力的, 有生機的
words.example: Surgery was the only viable option left.
words.example_zh: 手術是唯一可行的選擇。

words.zh: vi. 澄清, 闡明；vt. 使明晰
words.example: The doctor clarified the dosing instructions.
words.example_zh: 醫生釐清了用藥的指示。

words.zh: n. 素描, 草圖, 小品；v. 描繪略圖, 畫素描或速寫
words.example: He drew a quick sketch of where it hurt.
words.example_zh: 他快速畫了張圖標出哪裡痛。

words.zh: a. 數不盡的, 無數的
words.example: Countless lives have been saved by the vaccine.
words.example_zh: 這款疫苗拯救了無數的生命。

words.zh: n. 銅, 警察；[化] 銅Cu
words.example: Copper pipes carried clean water to the ward.
words.example_zh: 銅管把乾淨的水輸送到病房。

words.zh: n. 閒談；vi. 閒談, 聊天
words.example: A friendly chat eased the patient's nerves.
words.example_zh: 一段友善的閒聊緩解了病人的緊張。

words.zh: n. 學生, 門生, 未成年人, 瞳孔；[醫] 瞳孔
words.example: The doctor shone a light to check his pupil.
words.example_zh: 醫生用光照他的瞳孔做檢查。

words.zh: n. 疏忽, 忽略, 漏做；vt. 疏忽, 忽視, 不顧
words.example: The wound got worse through simple neglect.
words.example_zh: 這傷口因單純的疏忽而惡化。

words.zh: n. 病房, 守衛, 保衛, 保護, 監護, 牢房, 行政區, 鎖孔內的榫舌；vt. 使入病房, 守護, 保衛
words.example: The children's ward was painted in bright colors.
words.example_zh: 兒童病房漆上了明亮的色彩。

words.zh: n. 戰爭, 戰鬥, 交戰, 鬥爭, 競爭；[法] 戰事, 作戰, 交戰
words.example: Germs wage silent warfare inside the body.
words.example_zh: 病菌在體內進行著無聲的戰爭。

words.zh: n. 重擊, 突然巨響, 劉海；v. 發巨響, 重擊；adv. 砰然地, 突然巨響地, 直接地；[計] 撞擊符
words.example: He hit his head with a bang on the cabinet.
words.example_zh: 他的頭砰一聲撞上了櫃子。

words.zh: n. 傾斜, 傾向, 船篷, 車篷；vt. 使傾斜, 使傾側, 用帆布篷遮蓋；vi. 傾斜, 翹起, 衝, 評擊；[計] 傾斜
words.example: Tilt your head back so I can check your throat.
words.example_zh: 把頭往後仰，讓我檢查你的喉嚨。

words.zh: n. 擁護, 支援, 鼓吹, 辯護, 辯護術；[法] 辯護, 擁護, 提倡
words.example: Her advocacy helped change the health law.
words.example_zh: 她的倡議促成了衛生法的修改。

words.zh: a. 貨幣的, 金錢的；[經] 貨幣的, 金融的
words.example: The clinic faced serious monetary problems.
words.example_zh: 這間診所面臨嚴重的財務問題。

words.zh: v. 積聚, 堆積
words.example: Fluid began to accumulate in his lungs.
words.example_zh: 他的肺部開始積水。

words.zh: vt. 告發, 起訴, 徹底進行, 執行, 從事；vi. 告發, 起訴, 作檢察官
words.example: The state chose to prosecute the negligent doctor.
words.example_zh: 政府決定起訴這名失職的醫生。

words.zh: n. 赤熱, 光輝, 熱情, 熱烈, 紅光；vi. 發紅光, 紅光煥發, 發熱, 洋溢, 激動
words.example: A healthy glow returned to her cheeks.
words.example_zh: 她的雙頰恢復了健康的紅潤。

words.zh: vt. 具體表達, 使具體化；[經] 合併, 具體化, 具體表現
words.example: The nurse seemed to embody patience itself.
words.example_zh: 這位護理師簡直是耐心的化身。

words.zh: n. 襲擊, 突襲, 搜捕；v. 奇襲, 搜捕；[計] 廉價磁碟冗餘陣列
words.example: Police carried out a raid on the fake drug seller.
words.example_zh: 警方突襲了販賣假藥的人。

words.zh: n. 王冠, 王權, 頂點；vt. 使成王, 加冕, 居...之頂
words.example: The dentist fitted a crown on the broken tooth.
words.example_zh: 牙醫為這顆斷牙裝上牙冠。

words.zh: n. 假貨, 欺騙, 詭計；a. 假的；vt. 假造, 仿造；vi. 偽裝
words.example: He was sold a fake medicine that did nothing.
words.example_zh: 他被賣了一種毫無作用的假藥。

words.zh: n. 爬, 徐行, 蠕動；vi. 爬, 蔓延, 潛行
words.example: A cold fear began to creep over her.
words.example_zh: 一股冰冷的恐懼開始悄悄爬上她的心頭。

words.zh: n. 螃蟹, 偏航, 脾氣乖戾的人, 沙果；vi. 捕蟹, 偏航, 發牢騷；vt. 使偏航, 抱怨, 破壞
words.example: He came out in a rash after eating crab.
words.example_zh: 他吃了螃蟹後起了疹子。

words.zh: n. 氫；[化] 氫H-2
words.example: Water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.example_zh: 水是由氫和氧組成的。

words.zh: n. 醋, 尖酸刻薄；vt. 加醋於
words.example: A little vinegar can ease the sting of a jellyfish.
words.example_zh: 一點醋能緩解水母螫傷的刺痛。

words.zh: n. 無能, 無力
words.example: His inability to swallow worried the doctors.
words.example_zh: 他無法吞嚥的情況讓醫生擔憂。

words.zh: n. 打碎, 粉碎, 打碎時嘩啦聲, 猛擊, 扣球, 殺球, 經營失敗, 破產, 硬幣, 假硬幣；a. 非常轟動的, 了不起的；vt. 打碎, 粉碎, 擊潰, 使破產, 使裂變,
words.example: The glass vial fell and smashed on the floor.
words.example_zh: 玻璃藥瓶掉在地上摔碎了。

words.zh: n. 手稿, 原稿, 底稿；a. 手寫的
words.example: The doctor's manuscript was finally published.
words.example_zh: 這位醫生的手稿終於出版了。

words.zh: n. 想象力, 幻想, 喜好；a. 想象的, 精美的, 新奇的, 奇特的, 高價的, 特級的；vt. 想象, 設想, 相信, 喜愛；vi. 想象, 幻想
words.example: She had no fancy treatment, just rest and care.
words.example_zh: 她沒接受什麼花俏的治療，只是休息與照護。

words.zh: n. 潛水, 跳水；vi. 跳水, 俯衝, 猛衝；vt. 把...突然伸入
words.example: His blood pressure took a sudden dive.
words.example_zh: 他的血壓突然驟降。

words.zh: vt. 做廣告, 通知, 公佈；vi. 做廣告
words.example: The clinic does not advertise its services.
words.example_zh: 這間診所不為自己的服務打廣告。

words.zh: a. 有光澤的, 發光的, 輝煌的, 磨光的, 磨損的
words.example: The new ward had clean, shiny floors.
words.example_zh: 新病房的地板乾淨光亮。

words.zh: n. 備忘錄；[經] 備忘錄
words.example: The nurse left a memo about the dose change.
words.example_zh: 護理師留了張便箋說明劑量的更動。

words.zh: vt. 使昏迷, 使震驚, 打昏；n. 昏迷, 猛擊
words.example: The diagnosis seemed to stun the whole family.
words.example_zh: 這個診斷彷彿讓全家人都愣住了。

words.zh: a. 投入的, 深愛的
words.example: She was a devoted nurse who never gave up.
words.example_zh: 她是個盡心盡力、從不放棄的護理師。

words.zh: a. 成熟的, 到期的, 充分考慮的；vt. 使成熟；vi. 成熟, 到期
words.example: He grew more mature after his long illness.
words.example_zh: 久病之後他變得更成熟了。

words.zh: n. 產品, 製造；vt. 製造, 假造；vi. 製造
words.example: The company manufactures cheap, safe drugs.
words.example_zh: 這家公司製造便宜又安全的藥品。

words.zh: n. 影響, 病, 喜愛, 情感, 傾向；[醫] 疾患, 病變, 病; 感情
words.example: She cared for him with great affection.
words.example_zh: 她以深厚的情感照顧著他。

words.zh: n. 印, 郵票, 列印器, 戳子, 圖章, 印花稅票, 標誌, 特徵, 型別, 跺腳；vt. 蓋章於, 頓足, 貼上郵票, 銘刻, 搗碎, 撲滅；vi. 搗碎, 跺腳
words.example: The nurse put a date stamp on the chart.
words.example_zh: 護理師在病歷上蓋了日期章。

words.zh: n. 哲學家, 哲人, 思想開創人, 達觀的人；[法] 哲學家, 哲學研究者
words.example: The old philosopher faced death calmly.
words.example_zh: 這位老哲學家平靜地面對死亡。

words.zh: n. 抓緊, 掌握, 離合器, 一窩小雞；vt. 抓住, 踩汽車離合器踏板；vi. 抓；[計] 聯軸器; 離合器
words.example: She felt a sudden clutch of fear in her chest.
words.example_zh: 她胸口突然感到一陣揪緊的恐懼。

words.zh: n. 崩潰, 故障；[化] 事故; 擊穿
words.example: Months of stress led to a complete breakdown.
words.example_zh: 數月的壓力導致她徹底崩潰。

words.zh: vt. 隱藏, 掩蓋, 隱瞞；[法] 隱瞞, 隱匿, 保守秘密
words.example: He tried to conceal the pain from his family.
words.example_zh: 他試圖向家人隱藏疼痛。

words.zh: n. 腎, 個性；[醫] 腎
words.example: One healthy kidney is enough to live a full life.
words.example_zh: 一顆健康的腎臟就足以過完整的生活。

words.zh: a. 治癒的, 恢復健康的；[計] 修復, 恢復
words.example: Rest is a vital part of the healing process.
words.example_zh: 休息是癒合過程中重要的一環。

words.zh: adv. 顯著地, 引人注目地, 非常地
words.example: She recovered remarkably fast after surgery.
words.example_zh: 手術後她復原得異常快速。

words.zh: n. 讀寫能力, 識字, 精通文學
words.example: Health literacy helps patients make good choices.
words.example_zh: 健康識能幫助病人做出好的選擇。

words.zh: n. 命運, 定數
words.example: She felt that nursing was her destiny.
words.example_zh: 她覺得護理是她的天命。

words.zh: n. 獨奏, 獨唱, 單獨表演；a. 單獨的, 獨奏的, 獨唱的；vi. 放單飛
words.example: After months of help, she took her first solo steps.
words.example_zh: 經過數月的協助，她邁出了第一步自己走的路。

words.zh: n. 漏洞, 漏處, 漏出, 洩漏；vi. 漏, 洩漏；vt. 使滲漏
words.example: A leak in the roof dripped onto the ward floor.
words.example_zh: 屋頂漏水滴到了病房地板上。

words.zh: n. 溫室
words.example: The herbs were grown in a small greenhouse.
words.example_zh: 這些草藥種在一座小溫室裡。

words.zh: n. 大量；[經] 兆
words.example: The disease costs the world trillions each year.
words.example_zh: 這種病每年讓全世界損失數兆。

words.zh: n. 開支, 費用, 用光, 消費額；[經] 支出, 費用, 消費
words.example: Health expenditure rose sharply last year.
words.example_zh: 去年的醫療支出大幅上升。

words.zh: n. 殺人, 殺人者；[醫] 殺人, 殺人者
words.example: The doctor was asked to rule out homicide.
words.example_zh: 醫生被要求排除他殺的可能。

words.zh: n. 獸群, 人群, 牧人；vt. 群集, 使成群, 放牧；vi. 聚在一起
words.example: A herd of cattle grazed near the rural clinic.
words.example_zh: 一群牛在鄉村診所附近吃草。

words.zh: a. 熱情的, 熱烈的, 易怒的, 熱戀的
words.example: She is passionate about caring for the elderly.
words.example_zh: 她對照顧長者充滿熱情。

words.zh: n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量；[計] 原子
words.example: Everything around us is made of atoms.
words.example_zh: 我們周遭的一切都是由原子構成的。

words.zh: n. 候鳥, 移居者；[法] 移居者
words.example: The clinic gives free care to migrant workers.
words.example_zh: 這間診所免費為移工看診。

words.zh: n. 勝任, 職稱, 能力；[醫] 能力, 活性
words.example: No one doubted the surgeon's competence.
words.example_zh: 沒有人懷疑這位外科醫生的能力。

words.zh: n. 補充物, 增刊, 補充, 補遺, 補編, 附錄, 補角；vt. 補充, 增補
words.example: She takes an iron supplement for her anemia.
words.example_zh: 她為了貧血而服用鐵質補充劑。

words.zh: n. 苦惱, 貧困, 痛苦；vt. 使苦惱；a. 虧本出售的
words.example: The patient was in great distress before the drug.
words.example_zh: 在用藥前，病人非常痛苦。

words.zh: n. 適應, 改編, 改編本；[醫] 適應[作用]
words.example: Recovery requires slow adaptation to new limits.
words.example_zh: 康復需要慢慢適應新的限制。

words.zh: n. 肖像, 比喻, 雕刻；[化] 成像
words.example: The poem was full of healing imagery.
words.example_zh: 這首詩充滿了療癒的意象。

words.zh: adv. 向後地, 相反地；a. 向後的, 相反的；[計] 倒推
words.example: He took a step backward and nearly fell.
words.example_zh: 他往後退了一步，差點跌倒。

words.zh: n. 食慾, 慾望, 愛好；[醫] 食慾
words.example: Her appetite returned as she got better.
words.example_zh: 隨著她好轉，她的食慾也回來了。

words.zh: n. 等級制度, 僧侶統治, 等級體系；[計] 分級結構; 分層結構; 新聞組, 新聞組分層
words.example: There is a clear hierarchy among the ward staff.
words.example_zh: 病房的工作人員之間有明確的層級。

words.zh: v. 犯罪, 冒犯, 違反, 進攻
words.example: He did not mean to offend the nurse.
words.example_zh: 他並非有意冒犯護理師。

words.zh: n. 改造, 再建；[醫] 改建, 改造, 翻造
words.example: The surgeon performed a careful reconstruction of the jaw.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生小心地重建了下顎。

words.zh: a. 有同情心的, 合意的, 贊成的；n. 交感神經, 容易感受的人
words.example: The doctor was warm and sympathetic.
words.example_zh: 這位醫生既溫暖又富有同情心。

words.zh: n. 敵意, 敵對, 反對
words.example: The patient showed open hostility to the staff.
words.example_zh: 病人對工作人員表現出公然的敵意。

words.zh: adv. 暫時, 一時, 臨時
words.example: The pain eased temporarily after the shot.
words.example_zh: 打針後疼痛暫時緩解了。

words.zh: n. 觀眾, 目擊者, 旁觀者
words.example: He was just a spectator to his own slow recovery.
words.example_zh: 他只能眼睜睜看著自己緩慢地康復。

words.zh: n. 訴訟, 起訴；[經] 訴訟, 糾葛
words.example: Years of litigation followed the surgery error.
words.example_zh: 那次手術疏失之後是多年的訴訟。

words.zh: n. 彗星
words.example: A bright comet crossed the night sky.
words.example_zh: 一顆明亮的彗星劃過夜空。

words.zh: vi. 流血, 悲痛, 滲出；vt. 使出血, 榨取
words.example: The deep cut began to bleed heavily.
words.example_zh: 那道深深的傷口開始大量出血。

words.zh: vt. 窒息, 阻塞, 噎, 抑制；vi. 窒息, 阻塞, 噎；n. 窒息, 噎, 阻氣門
words.example: He began to choke on a piece of bread.
words.example_zh: 他被一塊麵包噎住了。

words.zh: n. 全體, 合唱曲, (女人的)全套服裝；[化] 總體; 整體; 系綜
words.example: The whole care ensemble worked as one.
words.example_zh: 整個照護團隊像一個整體般運作。

words.zh: n. 殺蟲劑；[化] 農藥
words.example: The farmer fell ill from pesticide exposure.
words.example_zh: 這名農夫因接觸農藥而病倒。

words.zh: n. 代表；vt. 委派...為代表
words.example: The hospital sent a delegate to the conference.
words.example_zh: 醫院派了一名代表參加會議。

words.zh: n. 儲存, 保藏, 保護；[醫] 保藏, 儲存, 防腐
words.example: Cold storage is key to the preservation of the drug.
words.example_zh: 冷藏是保存這種藥的關鍵。

words.zh: n. 旋轉, 迴圈, 輪流；[計] 旋轉
words.example: The interns work on a monthly rotation.
words.example_zh: 實習醫生以每月輪調的方式工作。

words.zh: n. 戰慄, 顫抖；vi. 戰慄, 憂慮, 搖晃
words.example: Her hands began to tremble with the cold.
words.example_zh: 她的雙手冷得開始發抖。

words.zh: n. 偏見, 成見, 侵害；vt. 使存偏見, 使有成見, 侵害
words.example: Patients should not face prejudice over their illness.
words.example_zh: 病人不該因疾病而受到偏見對待。

words.zh: vt. 指定, 指明, 稱呼；a. 已選出而未上任的
words.example: The doctor designated a nurse to watch him.
words.example_zh: 醫生指派了一名護理師看守他。

words.zh: n. 寬鬆長袍, 禮服, 披肩, 覆蓋物；v. (給)穿長袍
words.example: The patient slipped into a clean hospital robe.
words.example_zh: 病人換上了一件乾淨的病人服。

words.zh: n. 膜拜, 禮拜式, 祭儀, 一群信徒；[醫] 迷信, 巫術
words.example: The fake healer ran a dangerous cult.
words.example_zh: 這名假治療師經營著一個危險的邪教。

words.zh: n. 憎恨, 仇恨, 憎惡；[法] 敵意, 憎恨, 憎惡
words.example: Years of pain bred a quiet hatred of hospitals.
words.example_zh: 多年的疼痛讓他暗自厭惡醫院。

words.zh: n. 直徑；[醫] 直經, 徑
words.example: The tumor was about a centimeter in diameter.
words.example_zh: 這顆腫瘤的直徑約一公分。

words.zh: vt. 徵募, 參與, 謀取；vi. 從軍, 應募, 贊助
words.example: She enlisted the family's help in his care.
words.example_zh: 她請家人一起協助照顧他。

words.zh: a. 尖銳的, 敏銳的, 激烈的, 嚴重的, 急性的；[醫] 急性的; 尖銳的
words.example: He was rushed in with acute chest pain.
words.example_zh: 他因急性胸痛被緊急送來。

words.zh: n. 前任, 先輩, 前身；[醫] 初牙, 前輩, 祖先
words.example: She learned much from her predecessor on the ward.
words.example_zh: 她從病房的前任那裡學到很多。

words.zh: n. 新手
words.example: The rookie nurse learned fast on the busy ward.
words.example_zh: 這位菜鳥護理師在忙碌的病房裡學得很快。

words.zh: n. 少年, 少年讀物；a. 少年的, 不成熟的, 適於少年的
words.example: The clinic has a special wing for juvenile patients.
words.example_zh: 這間診所有一個專為少年病人設的側翼。

words.zh: adv. 顯著地, 著名地, 尤其, 特別
words.example: The new drug, notably, has very few side effects.
words.example_zh: 值得注意的是，這款新藥副作用極少。

words.zh: n. 有相互關係的東西, 相關物；vt. 使有相互關係；vi. 相關
words.example: Poor sleep correlates with a weaker immune system.
words.example_zh: 睡眠不足與較弱的免疫系統相關。

words.zh: n. 停止, 立定, 休息；vt. 使停止, 使立定；vi. 立定, 停止, 蹣跚, 躊躇, 有缺點；[計] 停止
words.example: Quick action halted the spread of the infection.
words.example_zh: 迅速的行動阻止了感染的擴散。

words.zh: n. 人道主義者, 博愛者, 基督凡人論者；a. 人道主義的, 博愛的, 凡人論的
words.example: A humanitarian team brought aid to the camp.
words.example_zh: 一支人道救援隊將援助帶到了營地。

words.zh: n. 拷問, 苦悶；vt. 拷問, 曲解, 折磨, 使彎曲
words.example: The endless waiting was a kind of torture.
words.example_zh: 無止盡的等待是種折磨。

words.zh: n. 放逐, 流放, 被放逐者；vt. 放逐, 流放, 使背井離鄉
words.example: The old doctor spent his last years in exile.
words.example_zh: 這位老醫生在流亡中度過了晚年。

words.zh: n. 合唱隊, 齊聲；v. 齊聲說道, 合唱
words.example: A chorus of beeps filled the busy ward.
words.example_zh: 一片嗶嗶聲此起彼落，充滿了忙碌的病房。

words.zh: n. 吼, 咆哮, 轟鳴；vi. 吼, 大聲說出, 叫喊, 喧鬧；vt. 呼喊, 使轟鳴
words.example: He let out a roar of pain as the bone was set.
words.example_zh: 接骨時他痛得大吼一聲。

words.zh: a. 有關建築的, 建築學的
words.example: The hospital won an architectural award.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院贏得了一座建築獎。

words.zh: n. 連環漫畫, 喜劇演員, 滑稽的人；a. 滑稽的, 有趣的, 喜劇的
words.example: A comic on the wall made the children laugh.
words.example_zh: 牆上的一幅漫畫逗笑了孩子們。

words.zh: vt. 使甦醒, 使復興, 使振奮, 回想起, 重播；vi. 甦醒, 復活, 復興, 恢復精神
words.example: The team worked fast to revive the patient.
words.example_zh: 團隊迅速搶救，讓病人甦醒。

words.zh: n. 報仇, 復仇, 報復；vt. 報仇, 報復
words.example: She had no thought of revenge, only of healing.
words.example_zh: 她沒有任何報復的念頭，只想著康復。

words.zh: a. 酸的, 酸臭的, 發酵的, 慍怒的, 討厭的, 拙劣的, 不健全的；vi. 變酸, 發酵, 厭煩, 變壞；vt. 使變酸, 使失望；n. 酸味, 酸飲料
words.example: The milk had turned sour in the warm room.
words.example_zh: 牛奶在溫暖的房間裡變酸了。

words.zh: a. 有生命危險的；瀕臨滅絕的
words.example: Some herbs come from endangered plants.
words.example_zh: 有些草藥取自瀕危的植物。

words.zh: n. 小心, 慎重, 警示；vt. 警告；[計] 警告
words.example: The label carried a clear caution about side effects.
words.example_zh: 標籤上有關於副作用的清楚警語。

words.zh: vt. 創始, 發明, 發起；vi. 發源, 發生, 起航；[計] 發自
words.example: The infection seemed to originate in the wound.
words.example_zh: 這個感染似乎源於那道傷口。

words.zh: n. 餌, 誘惑；vt. 引誘, 誘惑
words.example: Cheap fake cures lure desperate patients.
words.example_zh: 廉價的假療法引誘著走投無路的病人。

words.zh: vt. 編譯, 編輯, 編纂, 收集；[計] 編譯
words.example: She compiled a list of his daily medicines.
words.example_zh: 她整理了一份他每日用藥的清單。

words.zh: vi. 爆發；vt. 噴出
words.example: A rash can erupt within hours of the bite.
words.example_zh: 疹子可能在被咬後數小時內爆發。

words.zh: n. 織布機, 若隱若現的景象；vi. 朦朧地出現, 隱約可見, 可怕地出現
words.example: The risk of infection began to loom large.
words.example_zh: 感染的風險開始顯得越來越嚴重。

words.zh: n. 著名人士, 值得注意之事物；a. 值得注意的, 顯著的
words.example: There was a notable drop in his fever.
words.example_zh: 他的高燒明顯地退了。

words.zh: n. 巫婆, 女巫；vt. 施巫術, 迷惑
words.example: The villagers once blamed illness on a witch.
words.example_zh: 村民曾把疾病歸咎於女巫。

words.zh: n. 手杖, 細長的莖, 藤條；vt. 以杖擊, 以藤編制
words.example: He leaned on a cane as he learned to walk again.
words.example_zh: 他重新學走路時拄著一根拐杖。

words.zh: n. 輕敲, 拍擊, 責罵, 無價值的東西；vt. 輕敲, 厲聲說出, 叱責, 搶走, 使著迷；vi. 敲擊, 發敲擊聲, 交談, 同情；[計] 隨機存取程式, 資源分配處理器,
words.example: There was a soft rap on the ward door.
words.example_zh: 病房門上傳來輕輕的敲門聲。

words.zh: n. 熔爐, 鐵工廠；vt. 打製, 鍛造, 偽造；vi. 鍛造, 偽造
words.example: Trust between doctor and patient takes time to forge.
words.example_zh: 醫病之間的信任需要時間慢慢建立。

words.zh: a. 分裂的, 中斷的；vt. 使分裂, 使瓦解
words.example: Noise at night can disrupt a patient's healing.
words.example_zh: 夜間的噪音會擾亂病人的康復。

words.zh: a. 專門的, 特別的, 專科的, 特化的, 專化的；[計] 專業化的
words.example: She works in a specialized cancer ward.
words.example_zh: 她在一個專門的癌症病房工作。

words.zh: n. 氣味, 香味, 名聲, 意味；[醫] 氣味
words.example: A strong odor from the wound alarmed the nurse.
words.example_zh: 傷口散發的強烈氣味讓護理師警覺。

words.zh: a. 瘦的, 苗條的, 微小的, 稀少的, 微薄的；vi. 變苗條；vt. 使苗條
words.example: The chances of a full recovery were slim.
words.example_zh: 完全康復的機會很渺茫。

words.zh: a. 令人想望的, 可取的
words.example: A quiet room is desirable for a resting patient.
words.example_zh: 安靜的房間對休息中的病人是理想的。

words.zh: a. 警覺的, 靈敏的, 留心的；n. 警報；vt. 使警覺, 通知, 使意識到
words.example: The nurse stayed alert through the long night.
words.example_zh: 護理師整個漫漫長夜都保持警覺。

words.zh: vt. 宣稱, 主張, 提出, 斷言；[法] 斷言, 指稱, 指證
words.example: The report alleged that the drug was unsafe.
words.example_zh: 報告聲稱這種藥不安全。

words.zh: n. 大街, 途徑, 林蔭路
words.example: New research opened an avenue to a cure.
words.example_zh: 新的研究為治癒開闢了一條途徑。

words.zh: n. 小屋, 茅舍, 臨時軍營；v. (使)住在茅舍
words.example: The injured traveler rested in a roadside hut.
words.example_zh: 受傷的旅人在路邊的小屋裡歇息。

words.zh: n. 恐龍
words.example: The child loved the dinosaur painted on the ward wall.
words.example_zh: 這孩子很喜歡病房牆上畫的恐龍。

words.zh: vt. 刺激, 使興奮, 激勵
words.example: The good news seemed to excite the whole ward.
words.example_zh: 這個好消息彷彿讓整個病房都振奮起來。

words.zh: a. 緊急的, 急迫的, 催逼的；[經] 緊急的, 急迫的
words.example: The patient needed urgent surgery.
words.example_zh: 這名病人需要緊急手術。

words.zh: n. 唱詩班, 唱詩班的席位；v. 合唱
words.example: A children's choir sang in the hospital lobby.
words.example_zh: 一個兒童合唱團在醫院大廳獻唱。

words.zh: n. 旗幟；a. 顯著的, 特別好的
words.example: A banner outside urged people to get vaccinated.
words.example_zh: 外頭一條布條呼籲民眾接種疫苗。

words.zh: n. 內部的人, 權威人士, 知道內情的人；[經] 熟悉內情者
words.example: An insider warned of the unsafe drug.
words.example_zh: 一名知情人士警告了這種不安全的藥。

words.zh: vt. 限制, 使不外出, 禁閉；vi. 鄰接, 交界；n. 邊緣, 範圍, 區域
words.example: The illness confined her to bed for weeks.
words.example_zh: 這場病讓她臥床數週。

words.zh: n. 地下, 地鐵, 地道, 秘密活動；a. 地下的, 秘密的；adv. 在地下, 秘密地
words.example: An underground passage links the two wings.
words.example_zh: 一條地下通道連接著兩翼。

words.zh: n. (繩索的)股, 繩, 串, 海濱, 河岸；vi. 擱淺；vt. 使擱淺, 使落後, 使陷於困境, 弄斷, 搓
words.example: A loose strand of thread hung from the stitches.
words.example_zh: 一條鬆脫的線從縫線上垂了下來。

words.zh: adv. 新, 新近, 精神飽滿
words.example: The bed was made up with freshly washed sheets.
words.example_zh: 床鋪換上了剛洗好的床單。

words.zh: n. 管絃樂隊, 樂隊演奏處
words.example: She had played in an orchestra before her illness.
words.example_zh: 生病前她曾在管弦樂團裡演奏。

words.zh: a. 冷酷的, 堅強的, 殘忍的, 可怕的, 討厭的
words.example: The doctor's grim face said it all.
words.example_zh: 醫生凝重的神情說明了一切。

words.zh: n. 珠子, 滴；vt. 用珠裝飾；vi. 形成珠；[計] 珠
words.example: A bead of sweat ran down his forehead.
words.example_zh: 一滴汗珠從他的額頭滑落。

words.zh: n. 乾旱, 缺乏
words.example: The long drought left the village without clean water.
words.example_zh: 漫長的乾旱讓村莊沒有了乾淨的水。

words.zh: vt. 支撐, 贊成, 鼓勵, 舉起, 堅持；[法] 確認, 贊成, 支援
words.example: Doctors must uphold the safety of their patients.
words.example_zh: 醫生必須維護病人的安全。

words.zh: n. 評論員, 實況廣播員, 註釋者, 時事評論員
words.example: A medical commentator explained the new vaccine.
words.example_zh: 一位醫療評論員解說了這款新疫苗。

words.zh: a. 危險的, 冒險的, 碰運氣的；[法] 危險的, 冒險的, 碰運氣的
words.example: The lab handles many hazardous chemicals.
words.example_zh: 這間實驗室處理許多危險的化學品。

words.zh: n. 證實, 證明, 批准, 確認；[計] 確認
words.example: She waited anxiously for confirmation of the diagnosis.
words.example_zh: 她焦急地等待診斷的確認。

words.zh: n. 信徒
words.example: She was a firm believer in the power of rest.
words.example_zh: 她堅信休息的力量。

words.zh: vt. 使合併, 使消失, 吞沒；vi. 合併, 漸漸消失；[計] 合併
words.example: The two small clinics merged into one larger one.
words.example_zh: 兩間小診所合併成了一間較大的診所。

words.zh: n. 軸, 箭桿, 矛, 礦井；vt. 裝杆於, 利用
words.example: The miner was trapped at the bottom of the shaft.
words.example_zh: 礦工被困在礦井的底部。

words.zh: n. 盜竊, 失竊, 盜竊罪, 贓物；[法] 盜竊行為, 偷竊, 失竊
words.example: The clinic reported the theft of several drugs.
words.example_zh: 診所通報了數種藥品遭竊。

words.zh: a. 方便的, 合宜的；[法] 適當的, 合理而可行的, 方便的
words.example: The clinic's hours are convenient for working parents.
words.example_zh: 這間診所的時間對上班的家長很方便。

words.zh: n. (貯存穀物等的)容器, 箱子；[計] 二進位制, 商業資訊網
words.example: Used dressings go in the yellow bin.
words.example_zh: 用過的敷料丟進黃色的桶子裡。

words.zh: n. 磨, 碾, 苦差, 摩擦聲, 用功的學生；vt. 磨擦, 磨碎, 磨光, 折磨, 壓榨；vi. 磨, 磨碎, 苦幹
words.example: She had to grind the pills into a fine powder.
words.example_zh: 她得把藥丸磨成細粉。

words.zh: n. 香草, 香子蘭
words.example: The medicine had a sweet vanilla taste.
words.example_zh: 這種藥有股甜甜的香草味。

words.zh: a. 孤單的, 孤立的, 單身的, 寂寞的
words.example: A lone nurse watched over the quiet ward.
words.example_zh: 一名護理師獨自看守著安靜的病房。

words.zh: a. 生動的, 輪廓分明的, 繪畫似的, 圖解的；[計] 圖形的
words.example: The doctor avoided graphic details to spare the family.
words.example_zh: 醫生避開血腥的細節，以免家屬難受。

words.zh: n. 地鐵, 地道；vi. 乘地鐵
words.example: She felt faint on the crowded subway.
words.example_zh: 她在擁擠的地鐵上感到頭暈。

words.zh: n. 流通, 迴圈, 發行量；[化] 環流
words.example: Gentle movement improves blood circulation.
words.example_zh: 輕緩的活動能改善血液循環。

words.zh: n. 炸藥, 爆破音；a. 易爆發的, 爆炸的, 暴躁的
words.example: The lab stores explosive chemicals with great care.
words.example_zh: 實驗室非常謹慎地存放易爆的化學品。

words.zh: vt. 照明, 用燈裝飾, 闡明, 說明, 使燦爛；vi. 照亮, 用燈裝飾
words.example: A bright lamp illuminated the operating table.
words.example_zh: 一盞明燈照亮了手術臺。

words.zh: n. 犯罪地點, 審判地, 發生地點；（活動）會場、場地
words.example: The conference moved to a larger venue.
words.example_zh: 這場會議改到一個更大的場地。

words.zh: n. 國會議員, 眾議院議員；[法] 國會議會
words.example: A congressman visited the new children's ward.
words.example_zh: 一位國會議員參觀了新的兒童病房。

words.zh: a. 展開的, 進化論的, 進化的, 發展的；[計] 進化的, 改良的, 發展的
words.example: The change was evolutionary, not sudden.
words.example_zh: 這項改變是漸進的，而非突然的。

words.zh: n. 運河, 水道, 管, 溝渠；vt. 開運河
words.example: The ear canal was blocked with wax.
words.example_zh: 耳道被耳垢塞住了。

words.zh: n. 烤架, 鐵格子, 烤肉；v. 燒, 烤, 嚴加盤問, 給...裝柵欄
words.example: The chef cooked fish on the grill for the patients.
words.example_zh: 廚師在烤架上為病人烤魚。

words.zh: n. 無罪, 無知, 天真無邪；[法] 無罪, 無罪的人, 清白無辜者
words.example: The test proved his innocence in the error.
words.example_zh: 這項檢驗證明了他在這次疏失中是清白的。

words.zh: n. 參變數, 參變數, 引數, 參量；[計] 參量; 引數
words.example: Blood pressure is one parameter the nurse checks.
words.example_zh: 血壓是護理師檢查的一項指標。

words.zh: n. 缺點, 裂紋, 瑕疵, 一陣狂風；[化] 劃痕; 裂縫; 裂紋
words.example: A tiny flaw in the device caused the alarm.
words.example_zh: 裝置裡一個微小的瑕疵引發了警報。

words.zh: n. 姿勢, 態度, 情形, 形勢；vt. 作...的姿勢；vi. 作姿勢
words.example: Good posture can ease lower back pain.
words.example_zh: 良好的姿勢能緩解下背痛。

words.zh: a. 有系統的, 分類上的, 體系的；[醫] 系統的, 系的, 分類的
words.example: The clinic took a systematic approach to safety.
words.example_zh: 這間診所以系統化的方式處理安全問題。

words.zh: vt. 使...安心, 向...再保證；[法] 重新保證, 再保險, 使清除疑慮
words.example: The doctor tried to reassure the worried mother.
words.example_zh: 醫生試著安撫這位憂心的母親。

words.zh: n. 預演, 排演, 練習, 敘述, 複述；[法] 詳述, 列舉事實, 複述
words.example: The team did a rehearsal of the emergency drill.
words.example_zh: 團隊演練了一次緊急應變。

words.zh: vt. 祈求, 懇求, 實行, 援引, 引起；[計] 呼叫; 請求
words.example: She had to invoke her right to refuse treatment.
words.example_zh: 她不得不行使拒絕治療的權利。

words.zh: vi. 符合, 通訊, 相當；[法] 符合, 一致, 相當
words.example: His symptoms correspond to a mild infection.
words.example_zh: 他的症狀符合輕微的感染。

words.zh: vt. 丟棄, 拋棄；vi. 墊牌；n. 墊牌, 拋棄
words.example: Discard any pills that are past their date.
words.example_zh: 過期的藥丸請一律丟棄。

words.zh: n. 復興, 復活, 恢復精神, 甦醒；[醫] 復甦, 回生, 精神重振
words.example: A short rest brought a revival of her strength.
words.example_zh: 短暫的休息讓她恢復了元氣。

words.zh: n. 桶, 浴盆；vt. 裝入桶, 洗澡；vi. 洗盆浴, 被放在桶裡洗
words.example: She soaked her sore feet in a tub of warm water.
words.example_zh: 她把痠痛的腳泡在一桶溫水裡。

words.zh: n. 抑制, 剋制, 束縛；[醫] 約束, 拘束
words.example: The agitated patient needed gentle restraint.
words.example_zh: 躁動的病人需要溫和的約束。

words.zh: a. 預期的, 將來的；[經] 預期的, 未來的
words.example: A prospective donor must pass several tests.
words.example_zh: 準捐贈者必須通過數項檢查。

words.zh: n. 錫, 馬口鐵, 罐頭；vt. 在...鍍錫於；a. 錫制的；[計] tin閱讀程式
words.example: The pills came in a small metal tin.
words.example_zh: 這些藥丸裝在一個小鐵盒裡。

words.zh: n. 豐富, 充足, 大量；[經] 豐富, 充裕
words.example: There was an abundance of fresh fruit at the market.
words.example_zh: 市場上有大量的新鮮水果。

words.zh: n. 建議, 命題, 主張；vt. 向...提議, 向...提出猥褻的要求；（待處理的）事情、難題
words.example: Quitting smoking was a tough proposition for him.
words.example_zh: 戒菸對他來說是件難事。

words.zh: n. 隨從, 侍者, 出席者；a. 侍候的, 伴隨的, 出席的, 在場的
words.example: A flight attendant helped the sick passenger.
words.example_zh: 一名空服員協助了這名生病的乘客。

words.zh: a. 地理(學)的, 地區(性)的
words.example: The disease has a clear geographic pattern.
words.example_zh: 這種病有明顯的地理分布模式。

words.zh: a. 原子的, 原子能的；[醫] 原子的
words.example: The scan uses energy from an atomic source.
words.example_zh: 這項掃描使用來自原子源的能量。

words.zh: a. 可攜帶的, 可搬運的, 可移動的；[計] 可移植的
words.example: A portable monitor tracks her heart at home.
words.example_zh: 一台可攜式監測儀在家追蹤她的心臟。

words.zh: n. 清楚, 明晰；[化] 透明度; 透明性; 清晰性
words.example: The new lens gave the scan great clarity.
words.example_zh: 新鏡頭讓掃描有極佳的清晰度。

words.zh: n. 詩, 韻文, 詩句；vt. 用詩表達；vi. 作詩
words.example: He found comfort in a verse of poetry.
words.example_zh: 他從一句詩中得到慰藉。

words.zh: n. 溼氣, 水分, 降雨；[化] 含水量; 含溼量
words.example: The cream locks moisture into dry skin.
words.example_zh: 這款藥膏把水分鎖進乾燥的皮膚裡。

words.zh: a. 冷嘲的, 挖苦的, 反話的, 諷刺的, 令人啼笑皆非的, 出乎意料的
words.example: It was ironic that the doctor fell ill himself.
words.example_zh: 諷刺的是，醫生自己竟病倒了。

words.zh: vt. 使嘎嘎響, 喋喋不休地說；vi. 格格響, 喋喋不休；n. 格格聲, 撥浪鼓, 喋喋不休的話
words.example: The pills rattle in the bottle when shaken.
words.example_zh: 搖晃時藥丸在瓶子裡嘎嘎作響。

words.zh: n. 碎片, 粉碎, 落葉, 噴灑；vt. 打碎, 使散開, 粉碎, 破壞；vi. 粉碎, 損壞, 脫落
words.example: The bad news seemed to shatter her hope.
words.example_zh: 這個壞消息彷彿擊碎了她的希望。

words.zh: n. 降落, 家系, 侵襲, 血統；[醫] 下降, 世代, 血統
words.example: The patient's slow descent into sleep worried no one.
words.example_zh: 病人緩緩入睡，沒人擔心。

words.zh: n. 驚愕, 驚恐；vt. 吃驚, 使驚愕；vi. 驚起
words.example: A sudden noise can startle a sleeping baby.
words.example_zh: 突然的聲響可能驚醒熟睡的嬰兒。

words.zh: a. 華麗的, 燦爛的
words.example: A gorgeous sunset filled the ward window.
words.example_zh: 一片絢麗的夕陽映滿了病房的窗。

words.zh: n. 揶揄, 戲弄, 逗惹；vt. 戲弄, 取笑, 強求, 梳理, 使起毛
words.example: The nurse gently teased a smile from the shy child.
words.example_zh: 護理師溫和地逗害羞的孩子笑了。

words.zh: n. 福音, 信仰, 真理
words.example: She took the doctor's advice as gospel.
words.example_zh: 她把醫生的建議奉為金科玉律。

words.zh: adv. [表]分開, 不相連, 分隔, 分離, 不同, 單獨, 獨立, 各自, 各別, 脫離肉體, 靈魂；[計] 分離地
words.example: The two drugs must be taken separately.
words.example_zh: 這兩種藥必須分開服用。

words.zh: n. 學期
words.example: She fell ill in her final semester of nursing school.
words.example_zh: 她在護校最後一個學期病倒了。

words.zh: n. 精密, 精確, 精確度, 精度；a. 精密的, 精確的；[計] 精度
words.example: The surgeon worked with great precision.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生以極高的精準度進行手術。

words.zh: a. 堅硬的, 剛性的, 嚴格的, 精密的, 刻板的
words.example: His joints had grown rigid with age.
words.example_zh: 他的關節隨著年齡變得僵硬。
