words.zh: n. 跌倒, 摔跤, 翻斤斗；vi. 翻倒, 摔倒, 倒塌, 滾動, 翻斤斗, 倉促地行動；vt. 使摔倒, 使滾翻, 弄亂
words.example: The frail man took a bad tumble in the bathroom.
words.example_zh: 這位虛弱的男子在浴室裡狠狠摔了一跤。

words.zh: vt. 詳述, 敘述, 重新計算；n. 重新計算
words.example: She recounted her symptoms to the doctor.
words.example_zh: 她向醫生細述了她的症狀。

words.zh: n. 照明燈, 反光燈, 聚光燈
words.example: The outbreak put the small clinic in the spotlight.
words.example_zh: 這場疫情讓這間小診所成了焦點。

words.zh: a. 華麗的, 高尚的, 宏偉的
words.example: The view from the ward was magnificent.
words.example_zh: 從病房望出去的景色十分壯麗。

words.zh: n. 刮, 擦, 挖, 擦痕, 刮擦聲, 困境；vi. 刮掉, 擦掉, 刮出刺耳聲；vt. 刮, 擦, 擦傷, 挖成, 積蓄
words.example: She got a small scrape on her knee.
words.example_zh: 她膝蓋上有一道小擦傷。

words.zh: a. 相反的, 矛盾的, 對立的；n. 相反, 對立面；adv. 相反地
words.example: Contrary to fears, the surgery went smoothly.
words.example_zh: 與大家的擔憂相反，手術很順利。

words.zh: n. 監督人, 主管人, 主日學校校長；[經] 監督人, 主管人(部門)
words.example: The hospital superintendent approved the plan.
words.example_zh: 醫院的院長批准了這項計畫。

words.zh: a. 眼睛的, 視覺的, 光學的；[機] 光學上的, 光學的
words.example: An optical scan checks the back of the eye.
words.example_zh: 一項視光掃描檢查眼睛的後方。

words.zh: n. 被掠食者, 犧牲者；vi. 捕食
words.example: A weak immune system makes the body easy prey.
words.example_zh: 虛弱的免疫系統讓身體容易被病魔侵襲。

words.zh: n. 審計, 查帳；vt. 查(帳), 旁聽；vi. 查賬；[計] 查帳; 審查; 檢查
words.example: An audit found the drug records were in order.
words.example_zh: 一次稽核發現藥品紀錄井然有序。

words.zh: n. 撞擊, 腫塊；vt. 碰撞；vi. 撞, 顛簸而行
words.example: He got a small bump on his head from the fall.
words.example_zh: 他跌倒後頭上腫了一個小包。

words.zh: adv. 不斷地, 頻繁地
words.example: The pump beeps continually until it is reset.
words.example_zh: 這台幫浦會持續嗶嗶叫，直到被重設。

words.zh: n. 申請者；[經] 申請人, 請求人, 謀事人
words.example: Each applicant for the trial had a health check.
words.example_zh: 每位試驗的申請者都做了健康檢查。

words.zh: a. 缺席的, 不在的, 缺乏的, 漫不經心的；vt. 使缺席
words.example: The patient was absent from his appointment.
words.example_zh: 這名病人沒來看診。

words.zh: n. 數據機；[計] 數據機
words.example: A faulty modem cut the clinic's internet.
words.example_zh: 一台故障的數據機讓診所斷了網。

words.zh: a. 概念的；[醫] 概念的
words.example: The plan was still at a conceptual stage.
words.example_zh: 這項計畫還在概念階段。

words.zh: n. 養育, 營養物, 培育；vt. 養育, 供給營養物, 教養
words.example: Good food and rest nurture the healing body.
words.example_zh: 好的飲食與休息滋養著復原中的身體。

words.zh: a. 生動的, 鮮明的, 鮮豔的, 活潑的, 逼真的, 清晰的
words.example: She had vivid dreams while on the medicine.
words.example_zh: 服藥期間她做了許多生動的夢。

words.zh: a. 令人恐懼的；引起突然驚恐的
words.example: The first night in hospital was frightening for the child.
words.example_zh: 住院的第一晚對孩子來說很可怕。

words.zh: n. 鍵盤；[計] 鍵盤
words.example: The doctor typed her notes on the keyboard.
words.example_zh: 醫生在鍵盤上打下她的筆記。

words.zh: n. 毒藥, 毒, 毒物, 有毒害的事物；vt. 毒害, 毒殺, 使中毒；vi. 放毒, 下毒
words.example: A common houseplant can be a poison to pets.
words.example_zh: 一種常見的室內植物對寵物來說可能有毒。

words.zh: n. 承租人, 房客, 居住者；vt. 租借；[計] 佔據者
words.example: The clinic is the building's only tenant.
words.example_zh: 這間診所是這棟建築唯一的承租戶。

words.zh: adv. 無疑, 必定, 確實地
words.example: Rest is undoubtedly the best medicine here.
words.example_zh: 在這種情況下，休息無疑是最好的藥。

words.zh: a. 岩石的, 多石的, 像岩石的, 無情的, 搖動的, 搖晃的
words.example: The road to recovery was long and rocky.
words.example_zh: 康復之路漫長而崎嶇。

words.zh: vt. 省略, 刪除, 疏忽, 遺漏；[化] 省略
words.example: Do not omit a single dose of the antibiotic.
words.example_zh: 抗生素一劑也不可漏服。

words.zh: n. 蜘蛛, 設圈套者；[化] 星形輪
words.example: A spider bite left a red mark on his arm.
words.example_zh: 蜘蛛咬傷在他手臂上留下一個紅印。

words.zh: n. 屍體；[醫] 屍體
words.example: The corpse was taken to the morgue for examination.
words.example_zh: 屍體被送往太平間檢驗。

words.zh: n. 確定, 確實的事情；[法] 確定, 肯定, 必然的事
words.example: There is no certainty that the drug will work.
words.example_zh: 沒有十足的把握說這種藥會有效。

words.zh: n. 潮溼, 溼氣；a. 潮溼的；vt. 使潮溼, 使阻尼, 抑止；vi. 變潮溼, 衰減
words.example: A damp cloth cooled the feverish child's brow.
words.example_zh: 一塊溼布讓發燒孩子的額頭涼了下來。

words.zh: n. 營養, 營養學；[醫] 營養, 營養品
words.example: Good nutrition speeds up healing.
words.example_zh: 良好的營養能加速癒合。

words.zh: n. 曲子, 美妙音樂, 曲調
words.example: A soft melody helped the patient relax.
words.example_zh: 一段輕柔的旋律幫助病人放鬆。

words.zh: n. 電子；[化] 電子
words.example: An electron carries a tiny negative charge.
words.example_zh: 一個電子帶有微小的負電荷。

words.zh: n. 物理學家, 機械唯物論者, 自然科學家；[醫] 菲西克氏手術(虹膜圓片切除)
words.example: A physicist helped design the new scanner.
words.example_zh: 一位物理學家協助設計了新的掃描儀。

words.zh: n. 羊毛, 毛織物, 毛線, 絨線；[醫] 羊毛, 絨毛, 棉[花]
words.example: A warm wool blanket covered the shivering patient.
words.example_zh: 一條溫暖的羊毛毯蓋住了發抖的病人。

words.zh: adv. 完全地, 全然, 絕對
words.example: He was utterly exhausted after the long surgery.
words.example_zh: 漫長的手術後他徹底累垮了。

words.zh: n. 楓, 楓木, 淡棕色；[機] 楓木
words.example: A maple tree turned red outside the ward window.
words.example_zh: 病房窗外一棵楓樹轉紅了。

words.zh: n. 傳記, 實錄, 追思錄, 回憶錄, 自傳；[化] 研究報告
words.example: The retired nurse wrote a memoir of her years on the ward.
words.example_zh: 這位退休護理師寫下了她在病房歲月的回憶錄。

words.zh: vt. 培養, 耕作
words.example: A doctor must cultivate the trust of her patients.
words.example_zh: 醫生必須培養病人的信任。

words.zh: n. 奢侈, 豪華；a. 奢侈的, 豪華的
words.example: Rest felt like a rare luxury to the busy nurse.
words.example_zh: 對忙碌的護理師來說，休息像是難得的奢侈。

words.zh: n. 實現, 領悟, 實得；[醫] 現實化, 實現
words.example: The realization that he was cured brought tears.
words.example_zh: 意識到自己已痊癒，他流下了眼淚。

words.zh: n. 丟掉, 處理, 排列, 銷燬, 佈置；[醫] 處理, 處置
words.example: The clinic follows strict rules for waste disposal.
words.example_zh: 這間診所遵循嚴格的廢棄物處理規定。

words.zh: vt. 藐視, 挑釁, 使落空；n. 挑戰
words.example: Her recovery seemed to defy all the odds.
words.example_zh: 她的康復彷彿違背了一切機率。

words.zh: a. 魔術的, 有魔力的, 不可思議的
words.example: A child's laughter has an almost magical effect.
words.example_zh: 孩子的笑聲有種近乎神奇的力量。

words.zh: vt. 誘惑, 引誘, 引起...的興趣, 吸引, 冒...風險
words.example: Don't let sweets tempt you off your diet.
words.example_zh: 別讓甜食誘惑你偏離飲食控制。

words.zh: n. 碎片, 殘餘物, 些微, 片斷, 鐵屑, 吵架；vt. 扔棄, 敲碎, 拆毀；vi. 互相毆打；a. 零碎拼湊成的, 廢棄的
words.example: Not a scrap of food was left on his plate.
words.example_zh: 他的盤子裡一點食物都沒剩。

words.zh: n. 宣告, 說明, 宣佈；[計] 說明
words.example: She signed a declaration of consent before surgery.
words.example_zh: 手術前她簽署了一份同意聲明。

words.zh: vt. 注射, 注入, 使入軌；[醫] 注射
words.example: The nurse injected the drug into his arm.
words.example_zh: 護理師把藥注射進他的手臂。

words.zh: n. 軸；[計] 座標軸
words.example: The chart's vertical axis shows blood pressure.
words.example_zh: 圖表的縱軸顯示血壓。

words.zh: n. 鼓掌, 喝彩, 讚許
words.example: Warm applause greeted the recovered patient.
words.example_zh: 熱烈的掌聲迎接這位康復的病人。

words.zh: n. 手提箱
words.example: She packed a small suitcase for her hospital stay.
words.example_zh: 她為住院打包了一個小行李箱。

words.zh: adv. 平衡地, 平坦地, 平等地
words.example: Spread the cream evenly over the rash.
words.example_zh: 把藥膏均勻地塗在疹子上。

words.zh: a. 雙重的, 雙的；n. 雙數
words.example: The drug has a dual effect on pain and fever.
words.example_zh: 這種藥對疼痛與發燒有雙重作用。

words.zh: v. 監督, 管理, 指導
words.example: A senior doctor supervises every new intern.
words.example_zh: 一位資深醫生督導每一位新進的實習醫生。

words.zh: n. 三角形, 三個一組, 三角關係；[醫] 三角, 三角形
words.example: The bandage was folded into a triangle.
words.example_zh: 繃帶被摺成一個三角形。

words.zh: n. 熱望, 志向, 渴望；[醫] 吸入; 吸[引], 吸引術
words.example: Her lifelong aspiration was to cure the sick.
words.example_zh: 她畢生的志向是醫治病人。

words.zh: n. 融資, 理財, 籌集的資金；[經] 籌措資金, 理財
words.example: The new wing needed years of careful financing.
words.example_zh: 這座新側翼需要多年謹慎的資金籌措。

words.zh: a. 傾向於...的, 想要...的, 可能的, 趨向於...的
words.example: He felt inclined to rest rather than walk.
words.example_zh: 他比較想休息而不想走動。

words.zh: n. 代理, 代理人, 代用品, 代替者, 代替物；vt. 代替；vi. 替代, 取代, 代用；a. 代替的, 代用的, 代用品的；[計] 置換; 替代
words.example: Honey can be a substitute for sugar in her tea.
words.example_zh: 蜂蜜可以代替糖加進她的茶裡。

words.zh: n. 監督, 管理；[經] 監督, 管理
words.example: The child took the medicine under close supervision.
words.example_zh: 這孩子在密切的監督下服了藥。

words.zh: n. 鈣；[化] 鈣Ca
words.example: Milk gives the body the calcium it needs.
words.example_zh: 牛奶提供身體所需的鈣質。

words.zh: n. 量, 量子；[計] 量子
words.example: The discovery was a quantum leap in treatment.
words.example_zh: 這項發現是治療上的一大飛躍。

words.zh: n. 砂礫, 碎石；[醫] 沙礫, 尿沙
words.example: He scraped his hands on the rough gravel.
words.example_zh: 他的手在粗糙的碎石上擦傷了。

words.zh: n. 紡織品, 紡織業；a. 織的, 紡織的
words.example: The bandage is made from a soft textile.
words.example_zh: 這款繃帶以柔軟的織品製成。

words.zh: n. 先例, 前例；a. 在先的, 在前的
words.example: The unusual case set a new medical precedent.
words.example_zh: 這個特殊的病例開創了新的醫學先例。

words.zh: a. 永恆的, 永遠的, 不滅的
words.example: She faced her illness with eternal hope.
words.example_zh: 她以永不熄滅的希望面對病痛。

words.zh: n. 起訴, 控告, 起訴狀；[經] 起訴書
words.example: The doctor faced an indictment over the error.
words.example_zh: 這名醫生因這次疏失而面臨起訴。

words.zh: n. 碰撞, 衝突, 牴觸；[計] 衝突
words.example: He broke his arm in a collision on the field.
words.example_zh: 他在場上的一次撞擊中摔斷了手臂。

words.zh: vt. 證明, 查證, 證實, 檢驗, 校驗；[計] 校驗, 檢驗; DOS內部命令:設定寫入磁碟時是否驗證寫入的正確性
words.example: The lab ran a second test to verify the result.
words.example_zh: 實驗室做了第二次檢查來核實結果。

words.zh: n. 氏族, 宗族, 集團；[醫] 支
words.example: The whole clan gathered at her bedside.
words.example_zh: 整個家族聚集在她的床邊。

words.zh: n. 外交, 外交手腕, 交際手段；[法] 外交, 外交手腕, 權謀
words.example: It took some diplomacy to calm the angry patient.
words.example_zh: 安撫這名憤怒的病人費了一番交際手腕。

words.zh: n. 小派系, 內訌；[法] 宗派, 派別, 小集團
words.example: A faction of doctors opposed the new rule.
words.example_zh: 一派醫生反對這項新規定。

words.zh: n. 煮鍋, 長柄淺鍋
words.example: She warmed the broth in a small skillet.
words.example_zh: 她用一個小煎鍋把清湯熱了一下。

words.zh: a. 極廣大的, 無邊的, 非常好的
words.example: The nurses showed immense patience with him.
words.example_zh: 護理師對他展現了極大的耐心。

words.zh: a. 儀器的, 器具的, 可作為手段的；[醫] 器械的
words.example: Her support was instrumental in his recovery.
words.example_zh: 她的支持在他的康復中起了關鍵作用。

words.zh: n. 結果, 後果；[法] 後果, 結果
words.example: In the aftermath of the crash, medics rushed in.
words.example_zh: 車禍發生後，醫護人員立刻趕到。

words.zh: a. 無用的, 無效的, 無益的；[機] 無用, 無價值, 無效
words.example: The old, expired drug was now useless.
words.example_zh: 這款老舊過期的藥已經沒用了。

words.zh: n. 再現, 複製, 生殖, 繁殖, 複製品；[醫] 生殖, 復現(心理)
words.example: The textbook had a reproduction of an old anatomy chart.
words.example_zh: 這本教科書複製了一張古老的解剖圖。

words.zh: n. 外殼, 堅硬外皮, 麵包皮；vt. 蓋以硬皮；vi. 結硬皮
words.example: A dry crust formed over the healing wound.
words.example_zh: 癒合的傷口上結了一層乾痂。

words.zh: n. 喘氣；vi. 喘氣, 喘息, 渴望；vt. 氣喘吁吁地說
words.example: She let out a gasp of pain as she sat up.
words.example_zh: 她坐起來時痛得倒抽一口氣。

words.zh: n. 千禧年, 一千年
words.example: The herb has been used for over a millennium.
words.example_zh: 這種草藥已使用了超過一千年。

words.zh: n. 蚊子；[醫] 蚊
words.example: A single mosquito can spread the disease.
words.example_zh: 一隻蚊子就能傳播這種疾病。

words.zh: a. 未意識到的, 無意識的, 無知覺的；[醫] 人事不省的, 神志喪失的; 無意識的
words.example: He was found unconscious on the floor.
words.example_zh: 他被發現倒在地上不省人事。

words.zh: n. 親密, 熟悉, 親暱行為(言語)；[法] 親近的行為, 親密, 隱私
words.example: Illness can test the intimacy of a marriage.
words.example_zh: 疾病可能考驗一段婚姻的親密。

words.zh: vt. 轉移, 使歡娛；vi. 轉移
words.example: A funny story helped divert the child's attention.
words.example_zh: 一個有趣的故事幫忙轉移了孩子的注意力。

words.zh: a. 深思的, 體貼的
words.example: It was thoughtful of her to bring his glasses.
words.example_zh: 她想到把他的眼鏡帶來，真貼心。

words.zh: n. 藤本植物, 葡萄, 藤, 蔓；vi. 形成藤蔓
words.example: A vine climbed the wall of the hospital garden.
words.example_zh: 一株藤蔓爬上了醫院花園的牆。

words.zh: a. 震撼的；震驚的
words.example: She was shocked by the sudden diagnosis.
words.example_zh: 突如其來的診斷讓她震驚。

words.zh: n. 方法學, 方法論；[化] 操作法; 工藝
words.example: The study used a careful methodology.
words.example_zh: 這項研究採用了嚴謹的方法。

words.zh: a. 消極的, 被動的, 冷漠的, 順從的, 無源的；[醫] 被動的
words.example: Even passive smoking can harm the lungs.
words.example_zh: 即使是被動吸菸也會傷害肺部。

words.zh: n. 壟斷, 專賣權, 獨佔事業；[經] 壟斷, 專利品, 壟斷(權)獨佔
words.example: One firm holds a monopoly on the drug.
words.example_zh: 一家公司獨佔了這種藥。

words.zh: n. 連線, 附屬物, 連線物, 愛慕；[計] 附加, 附件
words.example: She formed a deep attachment to her young patient.
words.example_zh: 她對她年幼的病人產生了深厚的感情。

words.zh: vt. 召喚, 召集, 號召, 振奮, 喚起, 鼓起；[經] 傳喚, 傳訊
words.example: The nurse summoned the doctor at once.
words.example_zh: 護理師立刻把醫生請了來。

words.zh: a. 可選擇的, 隨意的；[化] 選購的
words.example: A second scan is optional, not required.
words.example_zh: 第二次掃描是選擇性的，並非必要。

words.zh: vi. 搖晃地懸掛著, 追求；vt. 使搖晃地懸掛；n. 懸垂
words.example: The drip tube dangled beside the bed.
words.example_zh: 點滴管垂掛在床邊。

words.zh: n. 種類, 品種；v. 養育, 引起, 飼養, 繁殖
words.example: Dirty water breeds dangerous bacteria.
words.example_zh: 髒水會孳生危險的細菌。

words.zh: n. 港, 避難所, 安息所；vt. 安置...於港中, 庇護, 入港
words.example: The quiet ward was a haven from the busy city.
words.example_zh: 安靜的病房是逃離忙碌城市的避風港。

words.zh: n. 性情古怪的人, 急拉, 肌肉抽搐, 牛肉乾；vi. 痙攣, 急拉, 急推；vt. 猛拉
words.example: His leg gave a sudden jerk during the test.
words.example_zh: 檢查時他的腿突然抽動了一下。

words.zh: a. 相互矛盾的；牴觸的
words.example: The doctors weighed two competing treatments.
words.example_zh: 醫生們權衡了兩種互相牴觸的療法。

words.zh: n. 哭, 哭泣；vi. 哭泣, 流淚, 哀悼, 滴落；vt. 哭著使..., 悲嘆, 滴下
words.example: She began to weep with relief at the news.
words.example_zh: 聽到消息，她如釋重負地哭了起來。

words.zh: n. 二氧化物；[醫] 二氧化物
words.example: Carbon dioxide is breathed out by the lungs.
words.example_zh: 二氧化碳由肺部呼出。

words.zh: v. 斷言, 確認
words.example: The test affirmed that she was healthy.
words.example_zh: 這項檢查確認了她很健康。

words.zh: n. 啜飲, 小口喝, 抿；vi. 啜飲；vt. 啜；[計] 單列直插式元件
words.example: She took a small sip of water after the pill.
words.example_zh: 吃完藥後她喝了一小口水。

words.zh: n. 指距, 全長, 跨距, 一段時間, 小範圍；vt. 以手指測量, 跨越, 架設, 持續
words.example: The illness covered a span of three long months.
words.example_zh: 這場病橫跨了漫長的三個月。

words.zh: n. 出現, 浮現, 發生
words.example: The emergence of new drugs gave them hope.
words.example_zh: 新藥的問世給了他們希望。

words.zh: vi. 逗留, 消磨, 徘徊；vt. 消磨
words.example: A dull ache lingered after the wound healed.
words.example_zh: 傷口癒合後仍殘留著一陣隱痛。

words.zh: v. 拍手喝彩, 稱讚, 贊同
words.example: The crowd applauded the brave young patient.
words.example_zh: 群眾為這位勇敢的小病人鼓掌。

words.zh: vt. 使安定, 使穩固；vi. 穩定, 安定
words.example: Doctors worked to stabilize his heartbeat.
words.example_zh: 醫生努力穩住他的心跳。

words.zh: n. 立方體, 立方；[機] 立方體, 立方
words.example: She dropped a cube of ice into the water.
words.example_zh: 她把一塊冰塊丟進水裡。

words.zh: n. 港, 避難所；v. 庇護, 藏匿, (使)入港停泊
words.example: The body can harbor the virus for years.
words.example_zh: 身體可能潛藏這種病毒多年。

words.zh: adv. 在下面；prep. 在...的下面
words.example: The bruise was tender underneath the skin.
words.example_zh: 皮膚底下的瘀青一碰就疼。

words.zh: a. 暗淡的, 模糊的；vt. 使暗淡；[計] 資料解釋模組
words.example: The nurse dimmed the lights for the night.
words.example_zh: 護理師把燈光調暗準備過夜。

words.zh: n. 注射, 注射劑；[化] 注入; 注射
words.example: A single injection eased the worst of the pain.
words.example_zh: 一針就緩解了最劇烈的疼痛。

words.zh: n. 種植園, 大農場, 植樹造林, 新開墾地；[醫] 栽植(如牙或其他組織的植入、再植和移植)
words.example: Many workers on the plantation caught the fever.
words.example_zh: 種植園裡許多工人染上了熱病。

words.zh: n. 日落, 晚年
words.example: She loved to watch the sunset from her bed.
words.example_zh: 她喜歡從床上看夕陽。

words.zh: vt. 假定, 推測, 擅自, 意味著；vi. 擅自行動, 相信
words.example: The doctor presumed the rash was an allergy.
words.example_zh: 醫生推測這疹子是過敏。

words.zh: n. 成分, 選民, 構成物；a. 構成的, 組織的, 選舉的
words.example: Each constituent of the drug was tested.
words.example_zh: 這種藥的每個成分都經過檢驗。

words.zh: n. 古董, 古物；a. 古老的, 古風的, 舊式的, 過時的
words.example: An antique clock ticked in the waiting room.
words.example_zh: 候診室裡一座古董鐘滴答作響。

words.zh: a. 波蘭的；n. 波蘭人, 上光劑, 光澤, 優雅；vt. 擦亮, 擦去, 使完美；vi. 擦亮, 變得光亮
words.example: The nurse gave the steel tray a final polish.
words.example_zh: 護理師把鋼盤做了最後的擦亮。

words.zh: n. 掃除, 垃圾；a. 掃蕩的, 徹底的, 廣泛的
words.example: The clinic made sweeping changes to its rules.
words.example_zh: 這間診所對規定做了全面的更動。

words.zh: n. 機智, 智力, 頭腦, 理智, 妙語, 機智的人
words.example: He kept his wit even through the painful treatment.
words.example_zh: 即使在痛苦的治療中，他仍保有機智。

words.zh: a. 傳說的, 寓言般的, 難以置信的
words.example: She made a fabulous recovery in record time.
words.example_zh: 她以破紀錄的速度奇蹟般地康復。

words.zh: n. 交集, 十字路口, 交叉點；[計] 邏輯乘; 與
words.example: The accident happened at a busy intersection.
words.example_zh: 這起意外發生在一個繁忙的十字路口。

words.zh: n. 辭職, 辭呈, 聽從；[經] 辭職
words.example: The doctor handed in her resignation after the scandal.
words.example_zh: 醜聞之後，這位醫生遞出了辭呈。

words.zh: n. 和解, 和好, 復交, 調解, 調停, 和諧, 一致, 甘願, 順從；[經] (銀行往來)調節, 調和, 一致
words.example: Illness brought a quiet reconciliation between them.
words.example_zh: 疾病讓他們之間悄悄地和解了。

words.zh: n. 行為, 實行, 契約；vt. 立契轉讓
words.example: A kind deed by the nurse lifted his spirits.
words.example_zh: 護理師的一個善舉振奮了他的精神。

words.zh: a. 悲慘的；痛苦的；卑鄙的
words.example: The high fever made him utterly miserable.
words.example_zh: 高燒讓他痛苦不堪。

words.zh: a. 活潑的, 鮮明的, 生動的
words.example: She felt lively again after a week's rest.
words.example_zh: 休息一週後她又恢復了活力。

words.zh: vt. 抹去, 擦掉；[計] 清洗; 擦除; 抹除; DOS內部命令:從磁碟上刪除一個或多個檔案
words.example: Time slowly erased the memory of the pain.
words.example_zh: 時間慢慢抹去了疼痛的記憶。

words.zh: n. 終端機, 終點, 末端, 極限, 終點站；a. 終點的, 定期的, 致死的, 結尾的, 末端的, 晚期的；[計] 終端; 終端裝置
words.example: He was moved to a hospice in the terminal stage.
words.example_zh: 末期時他被轉到了安寧病房。

words.zh: a. 不恰當的, 無關係的, 不相干的；[法] 無關的, 不相干的, 離題的
words.example: That old test result is now irrelevant.
words.example_zh: 那份舊的檢查結果現在已無關緊要。

words.zh: a. 愚蠢的, 傻的
words.example: It was foolish to ignore such severe pain.
words.example_zh: 忽視這麼劇烈的疼痛實在愚蠢。

words.zh: n. 盔甲, 潛水服, 裝甲；vt. 為...裝甲
words.example: The skin is like armor against everyday germs.
words.example_zh: 皮膚就像抵禦日常病菌的盔甲。

words.zh: n. 無知, 愚味；[法] 無知, 不知情, 愚昧
words.example: Much fear of illness comes from ignorance.
words.example_zh: 對疾病的許多恐懼來自無知。

words.zh: n. 業餘愛好者, 外行, 愛好者；[電] 業餘家
words.example: An amateur cook, he changed his diet with care.
words.example_zh: 身為業餘廚師，他細心地改變了飲食。

words.zh: a. 細胞的；[醫] 細胞的
words.example: The drug works at the cellular level.
words.example_zh: 這種藥在細胞層面發揮作用。

words.zh: a. 能幹的, 勝任的, 有效的, 足夠的；[經] 有權的, 授權的, 勝任的
words.example: She is a competent nurse, calm under pressure.
words.example_zh: 她是個能幹的護理師，臨危不亂。

words.zh: n. 陽臺, 戲院樓廳
words.example: She sat on the balcony to get some fresh air.
words.example_zh: 她坐在陽臺上透透氣。

words.zh: n. 清真寺
words.example: A doctor was on call near the village mosque.
words.example_zh: 一名醫生在村裡清真寺附近待命。

words.zh: a. 線的, 直線的, 線狀的；[計] 線性
words.example: The healing followed a slow, linear path.
words.example_zh: 癒合循著一條緩慢而呈線性（直線）的路徑。

words.zh: vt. 使再迴圈, 重新利用, 再製；n. 再迴圈
words.example: The clinic recycles its paper and glass.
words.example_zh: 這間診所回收紙張與玻璃。

words.zh: n. 崇拜, 禮拜, 尊敬；vi. 參加禮拜；vt. 崇拜, 尊敬
words.example: On Sundays the patients gathered for worship.
words.example_zh: 每逢週日，病人們會聚在一起做禮拜。

words.zh: a. 有害的, 傷害的
words.example: Too much sun is harmful to the skin.
words.example_zh: 過度曝曬對皮膚有害。

words.zh: n. 巧合, 同時發生；[電] 符合計數器
words.example: It was no coincidence that both fell ill together.
words.example_zh: 兩人同時病倒並非巧合。

words.zh: n. 怨恨, 憤恨
words.example: Years of pain bred a quiet resentment in him.
words.example_zh: 多年的疼痛在他心中埋下了一股暗自的怨恨。

words.zh: n. 辯護, 證明正當, 釋罪；[計] 調整
words.example: There was no justification for the high dose.
words.example_zh: 那麼高的劑量毫無正當理由。

words.zh: n. 學費, 講授
words.example: Her parents paid the tuition for nursing school.
words.example_zh: 她的父母支付了護校的學費。

words.zh: n. 重複, 背誦, 迴圈, 複製品, 副本；[機] 重複, 反覆
words.example: Daily repetition of the exercise rebuilt his strength.
words.example_zh: 每日反覆做這項運動重建了他的力量。

words.zh: n. 壁龕；vt. 放入壁龕, 安頓；（市場）利基、適合的位置
words.example: The clinic found a niche caring for the elderly.
words.example_zh: 這間診所在照顧長者上找到了一個利基。

words.zh: vt. 使恐懼, 恐嚇
words.example: The sight of blood seemed to terrify the child.
words.example_zh: 血的景象似乎嚇壞了孩子。

words.zh: n. 樹皮, 吠聲；vi. 吠, 叫罵；vt. 喊出, 剝樹皮
words.example: Some old remedies are made from tree bark.
words.example_zh: 有些古老的藥方是用樹皮製成的。

words.zh: vt. 令人入神, 使著迷；vi. 入迷
words.example: The workings of the brain fascinate her.
words.example_zh: 大腦的運作令她著迷。

words.zh: n. 刺, 戳, 劇痛, 嘗試, 努力；vt. 刺, 戳, 刺入, 刺痛, 直入, 使傷心；vi. 刺, 刺傷
words.example: He felt a sudden stab of pain in his side.
words.example_zh: 他的側腹突然一陣刺痛。

words.zh: n. 產生器, 發電機, 生產者；[計] 發生器
words.example: A backup generator kept the ward running.
words.example_zh: 一台備用發電機維持著病房的運作。

words.zh: n. 平行, 對比, 相匹敵之物；a. 平行的, 相似的；vt. 與...平行, 與...相似, 相比, 使平行；[計] 並聯; 並行
words.example: Her case ran parallel to one he had seen before.
words.example_zh: 她的病例與他從前見過的一個很相似。

words.zh: vt. 用公式表示, 明確敘述, 制訂；[機] 公式化, 公式表示
words.example: The team formulated a clear plan of care.
words.example_zh: 團隊擬定了一套清楚的照護計畫。

words.zh: n. 支柱, 支持者, 倚靠人, 道具, 螺旋槳；vt. 支撐, 維持
words.example: A pillow was used to prop up his injured leg.
words.example_zh: 一個枕頭被用來墊高他受傷的腿。

words.zh: n. 微波；[計] 微波
words.example: She warmed the soup in the microwave.
words.example_zh: 她用微波爐把湯熱了一下。

words.zh: n. 發生, 發生率, 影響, 負擔者, 入射, 傾角；[醫] 入射, 發生率, 發生數
words.example: The incidence of the disease is rising fast.
words.example_zh: 這種病的發生率正快速上升。

words.zh: vt. 實踐, 履行, 實行, 完成, 結束, 滿足；[經] 履行(契約), 滿期
words.example: She worked hard to fulfil her dream of nursing.
words.example_zh: 她努力實現當護理師的夢想。

words.zh: a. 腐敗的, 貪汙的, 訛誤充斥的；vt. 使腐爛, 腐蝕, 使惡化；vi. 腐爛, 墮落
words.example: A corrupt official sold the donated drugs.
words.example_zh: 一名貪腐的官員把捐贈的藥品賣掉了。

words.zh: n. 樣品, 標本, 試料；[化] 試樣
words.example: A specimen of blood was sent to the lab.
words.example_zh: 一份血液檢體被送到實驗室。

words.zh: a. 蒼白的, 無血色的, 病態的, 暗淡的；v. (使)變蒼白；[計] 廣域網
words.example: Her wan face showed how ill she had been.
words.example_zh: 她蒼白的臉色顯示她病得有多重。

words.zh: n. 引人羨慕的東西, 景象, 眼鏡, 場面, 公開展示
words.example: The crowded waiting room was quite a spectacle.
words.example_zh: 擠滿人的候診室是個不小的場面。

words.zh: n. 觀點, 景色, 前途, 瞭望；[經] 展望
words.example: With treatment, her outlook is good.
words.example_zh: 在治療下，她的預後良好。

words.zh: a. 生殖的, 再生的, 複製的；[醫] 生殖的, 復現的
words.example: The drug may affect the reproductive system.
words.example_zh: 這種藥可能影響生殖系統。

words.zh: n. 一回, 回合, 較量；[醫] 發作
words.example: He had a nasty bout of flu last winter.
words.example_zh: 去年冬天他得了一場嚴重的流感。

words.zh: n. 娛樂, 消遣, 休息, 再創造；[醫] 娛樂, 休養
words.example: Reading was her only recreation in hospital.
words.example_zh: 閱讀是她住院時唯一的消遣。

words.zh: a. 空間的, 受空間條件限制的, 佔地位的；[醫] 隙的, 間隙的, 腔的; 空間的, 立體的
words.example: The illness affected her spatial awareness.
words.example_zh: 這種病影響了她的空間感。

words.zh: n. 以鼻吸氣, 嗅, 氣息；vi. 嗅, 蔑視, 嗤之以鼻；vt. 聞, 用力吸, 發覺
words.example: She gave the medicine a careful sniff.
words.example_zh: 她小心地聞了聞這帖藥。

words.zh: n. 母體, 子宮, 基質, 脈石, 模型, 矩陣；[計] 矩陣
words.example: Bone is built on a tough matrix of fibers.
words.example_zh: 骨骼建立在堅韌的纖維基質之上。

words.zh: n. 圓錐體, 球果；vt. 使成錐形
words.example: The eye test used a brightly colored cone.
words.example_zh: 視力檢查用了一個色彩鮮豔的圓錐。

words.zh: adv. 地方性地, 區域性性地, 在當地
words.example: The herb grows locally in these hills.
words.example_zh: 這種草藥在這些山丘上有當地生長。

words.zh: n. 氮；[化] 氮N-2
words.example: Most of the air we breathe is nitrogen.
words.example_zh: 我們呼吸的空氣大部分是氮氣。

words.zh: n. 整體, 積分, 整數；a. 固有的, 整體的, 整數的, 積分的；[計] 積分
words.example: Sleep is an integral part of recovery.
words.example_zh: 睡眠是康復不可或缺的一環。

words.zh: a. 分別的, 各自的
words.example: The two nurses returned to their respective wards.
words.example_zh: 兩名護理師回到各自的病房。

words.zh: v. (使)流通, (使)迴圈, (使)傳播
words.example: Blood must circulate freely through the legs.
words.example_zh: 血液必須在雙腿中順暢地循環。

words.zh: n. 分類, 分級；[化] 分級; 分粒; 分類
words.example: The drug falls under a strict classification.
words.example_zh: 這種藥屬於一個嚴格的分類。

words.zh: n. 努力, 盡力；vi. 努力, 盡力
words.example: Every endeavor was made to save the patient.
words.example_zh: 為了救這名病人，眾人盡了一切努力。

words.zh: a. 吸引人的, 有趣的
words.example: The unusual case was deeply intriguing to her.
words.example_zh: 這個不尋常的病例讓她深感興趣。

words.zh: vt. 取...最大值, 使增加(或擴大)到最大限度；[計] 最大化
words.example: Rest helps maximize the body's healing.
words.example_zh: 休息有助於將身體的自癒力發揮到最大。

words.zh: a. 荒謬的, 不合理的, 可笑的；n. 荒誕
words.example: It seemed absurd to wait weeks for a simple test.
words.example_zh: 為一項簡單的檢查等上數週似乎很荒謬。

words.zh: n. 插, 戳, 刺, 猛推, 口頭攻擊, 推力；vt. 插入, 猛推, 刺, 戳, 強加, 延伸；vi. 插, 刺, 戳, 延伸, (用力)推
words.example: She felt a sharp thrust of pain in her side.
words.example_zh: 她的側腹感到一陣劇烈的刺痛。

words.zh: n. 誘惑, 誘惑物；[法] 誘惑, 誘惑物
words.example: He resisted the temptation to skip his pills.
words.example_zh: 他克制住了想漏服藥的誘惑。

words.zh: n. 貯水池, 貯藏處, 貯備, 水庫；vt. 儲藏
words.example: The body keeps a reservoir of stored energy.
words.example_zh: 身體保有一座儲存能量的庫存。

words.zh: n. 帶, 皮帶；vt. (用皮帶)捆紮
words.example: A strap held his injured arm in place.
words.example_zh: 一條帶子把他受傷的手臂固定住。

words.zh: n. 領導者, 指揮者, 售票員, 嚮導；[化] 導體
words.example: The nerve acts as a conductor of signals.
words.example_zh: 神經充當訊號的傳導體。

words.zh: n. 相似, 類似；[計] 模擬
words.example: The doctor used an analogy to explain the heart.
words.example_zh: 醫生用一個比喻來解釋心臟。

words.zh: n. 居民, 居住者；[醫] 居民
words.example: Every inhabitant of the village was vaccinated.
words.example_zh: 村裡的每位居民都接種了疫苗。

words.zh: vt. 加強；vi. 強化
words.example: The pain began to intensify through the night.
words.example_zh: 疼痛在夜裡開始加劇。

words.zh: n. 弧, 弧形, 弓形, 弧光；[化] 弧
words.example: The needle followed a smooth arc into the skin.
words.example_zh: 針沿著一道平滑的弧線扎入皮膚。

words.zh: n. 搖擺, 影響力, 支配；vt. 搖動, 支配, 弄歪, 使傾斜, 使動搖, 影響；vi. 搖動, 搖擺, 傾斜, 動搖, 統治, 轉向
words.example: She began to sway and the nurse caught her.
words.example_zh: 她開始搖晃，護理師扶住了她。

words.zh: n. 上坡, 升級, 上升；adv. 往上；vt. 使升級, 提升, 改良品種；vi. 升級；[計] 升級
words.example: The clinic plans to upgrade its old scanner.
words.example_zh: 這間診所計劃升級它老舊的掃描儀。

words.zh: a. 戰後的
words.example: The hospital was built in the postwar years.
words.example_zh: 這家醫院建於戰後的那些年。

words.zh: n. 腐蝕, 沖蝕, 侵蝕；[化] 磨耗; 侵蝕
words.example: Acid causes slow erosion of the teeth.
words.example_zh: 酸會造成牙齒的緩慢腐蝕。

words.zh: a. 消遣的, 娛樂的
words.example: The ward has a small recreational area.
words.example_zh: 這個病房有一個小小的休閒區。

words.zh: n. 流溢, 面紅, 旺盛, 發燒, 驚飛的鳥, 同花牌；a. 豐足的, 齊平的, 滿盈的, 氾濫的；adv. 齊平地, 直接地；vi. 臉發紅, 奔湧, 旺盛, 驚飛；vt. 淹
words.example: Her cheeks flushed red with the fever.
words.example_zh: 她的雙頰因發燒而泛紅。

words.zh: a. 受過教育的, 有教養的
words.example: An educated guess pointed to a mild infection.
words.example_zh: 一個有根據的推測指向輕微的感染。

words.zh: vi. 排列, 排成一行, 結盟；vt. 使結盟, 使成一行, 校正
words.example: The surgeon worked to align the broken bones.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生設法把斷骨接正。

words.zh: n. 有勢力的人；a. 有勢力的, 強大的, 有力的；adv. 很, 極
words.example: Even a mighty fever finally broke by morning.
words.example_zh: 連那場猛烈的高燒到了早上也終於退了。

words.zh: n. 白痴, 極蠢之人；[醫] 白痴者, 痴子
words.example: He felt like an idiot for ignoring the warning signs.
words.example_zh: 他為忽視警訊而覺得自己像個傻瓜。

words.zh: n. 法院, 郡政府所在地
words.example: The injured clerk was treated near the courthouse.
words.example_zh: 受傷的職員在法院附近接受了治療。

words.zh: n. 缺點；[醫] 缺損, 缺陷
words.example: The baby was born with a small heart defect.
words.example_zh: 這名嬰兒生來就有一個小小的心臟缺陷。

words.zh: a. 主觀的, 個人的；[醫] 主觀的, 自覺的
words.example: Pain is subjective and hard to measure.
words.example_zh: 疼痛是主觀的，難以衡量。

words.zh: n. 會計人員, 會計師；[經] 會計師, 會計人員
words.example: The clinic's accountant kept the books in order.
words.example_zh: 診所的會計把帳目管理得井井有條。

words.zh: n. 活瓣, 閥, 活門；v. 裝閥, 用閥調節
words.example: A faulty heart valve had to be replaced.
words.example_zh: 一個故障的心臟瓣膜必須更換。

words.zh: n. 貓頭鷹；[法] 走私
words.example: An owl hooted in the trees outside the ward.
words.example_zh: 一隻貓頭鷹在病房外的樹叢中鳴叫。

words.zh: v. 猛砍, 亂砍；n. 猛砍, 亂砍, 刪減；[計] 斜線
words.example: The budget cuts will slash the clinic's funding.
words.example_zh: 預算刪減將大幅砍掉診所的經費。

words.zh: n. 請願, 訴狀, 陳情書, 申請, 祈求, 禱文；v. 正式請求, 懇求, 請願
words.example: Residents signed a petition to keep the clinic open.
words.example_zh: 居民連署請願以保住這間診所。

words.zh: n. 相符, 通訊, 信件；[醫] 對應, 相對
words.example: She kept up a warm correspondence with her old doctor.
words.example_zh: 她和她的老醫生一直保持著溫暖的書信往來。

words.zh: n. 動脈, 幹道, 要道；[醫] 動脈
words.example: A blocked artery can lead to a heart attack.
words.example_zh: 阻塞的動脈可能導致心臟病發作。

words.zh: n. 管理者, 經理, 主管人, 掌管者, 館長, 大學學監, 監護人, 保護人；[經] 臨時監護人
words.example: The curator gave a tour of the medical museum.
words.example_zh: 館長帶領參觀了醫學博物館。

words.zh: n. 無意義的事, 荒謬言行, 荒唐
words.example: It is nonsense that herbs alone can cure cancer.
words.example_zh: 宣稱單靠草藥就能治癒癌症是無稽之談。

words.zh: a. 低下的, 謙遜的, 粗陋的；vt. 使...卑下, 降低...地位, 貶抑
words.example: The famous surgeon remained humble and kind.
words.example_zh: 這位著名的外科醫生依然謙遜而仁慈。

words.zh: n. 樹膠, 橡皮, 橡皮糖, 牙床, 老天；vt. 塗以樹膠, 用膠粘, 使有粘性；vi. 分泌樹膠, 發粘
words.example: Sore gums can make eating painful.
words.example_zh: 牙齦痠痛會讓進食變得疼痛。

words.zh: n. 漁業；[法] 捕魚, 捕魚權
words.example: The coastal fishery supplies fresh fish to the town.
words.example_zh: 沿海漁業為這個鎮供應新鮮的魚。

words.zh: n. 論題, 論文
words.example: Her thesis was on the causes of heart disease.
words.example_zh: 她的論文探討心臟病的成因。

words.zh: a. 宇宙的, 宇宙航行的, 無限的, 有秩序的；[醫] 宇宙的
words.example: Looking up at the cosmic scale of the night sky, her worries felt small.
words.example_zh: 抬頭望向宇宙般浩瀚的夜空，她的煩惱顯得渺小。

words.zh: a. 有資格的；[經] 合格的, 有條件的, 有限制的
words.example: Only a qualified doctor may sign the form.
words.example_zh: 只有合格的醫生才能簽署這份表格。

words.zh: v. 沉思, 考慮
words.example: The doctor paused to ponder the strange result.
words.example_zh: 醫生停下來思索這個奇怪的結果。

words.zh: n. 聖所(指教堂、寺院等), 耶路撒冷的神殿, 避難所；[法] 庇護所, 避難所, 教堂
words.example: The quiet ward was a sanctuary from the noise.
words.example_zh: 安靜的病房是逃離喧囂的避風港。

words.zh: vt. 告發, 抨擊, 譴責；[法] 譴責, 斥責, 告發
words.example: Experts denounced the fake cure as dangerous.
words.example_zh: 專家譴責這種假療法很危險。

words.zh: n. 閒逛, 休閒室, 長沙發；vi. 閒混, (懶洋洋地)躺；vt. 閒混
words.example: Visitors waited in the family lounge.
words.example_zh: 訪客在家屬休息室等候。

words.zh: a. 可信的, 可靠的；[法] 可信的, 可靠的
words.example: The patient gave a credible account of the fall.
words.example_zh: 病人對這次跌倒給出了可信的說法。

words.zh: n. 校訂, 修正, 修訂本, 修訂版；[計] 修訂版
words.example: The treatment plan needed a small revision.
words.example_zh: 這套治療計畫需要稍作修訂。

words.zh: n. 授權, 正當理由, 根據, 證明, 批准, 憑證, 令狀, 委任狀；vt. 授權給, 保證, 擔保, 批准, 使有正當理由
words.example: Such mild symptoms do not warrant surgery.
words.example_zh: 這麼輕微的症狀不需要動手術。

words.zh: n. 水平線, 水平面, 水平位置；a. 水平線的, 平坦的, 橫的；n. 水平；[計] 水平
words.example: The patient must lie horizontal after the test.
words.example_zh: 檢查後病人必須平躺。

words.zh: n. 床墊, 空氣墊, 沉床；[醫] 褥子, 床墊
words.example: A soft mattress eased the pressure on her back.
words.example_zh: 一張柔軟的床墊減輕了她背部的壓力。

words.zh: a. 例外的, 異常的, 特別的
words.example: She showed exceptional courage during treatment.
words.example_zh: 她在治療期間展現了非凡的勇氣。

words.zh: n. 捆, 束；vt. 包紮, 胡亂塞進；vi. 匆忙離開
words.example: The nurse carried a bundle of clean towels.
words.example_zh: 護理師抱著一捆乾淨的毛巾。

words.zh: a. 飽和的, 滲透的；[醫] 飽和的
words.example: Too much saturated fat harms the heart.
words.example_zh: 過多的飽和脂肪會傷害心臟。

words.zh: vt. 使插入, 使嵌入, 使深留腦中；[計] 嵌入
words.example: A splinter was embedded deep in his foot.
words.example_zh: 一根刺深深嵌進了他的腳裡。

words.zh: n. 亞麻布, 亞麻線, 亞麻製品；a. 亞麻布制的, 亞麻的
words.example: The bed was made with crisp white linen.
words.example_zh: 床鋪鋪著挺括的白色亞麻床單。

words.zh: n. 新鮮的空氣, 臭氧, 使人愉快的影響；[化] 臭氧
words.example: Ozone high above shields us from the sun.
words.example_zh: 高空的臭氧層保護我們免受陽光傷害。

words.zh: n. 加侖；[醫] 加侖
words.example: She drank nearly a gallon of water that hot day.
words.example_zh: 那個炎熱的日子她喝了將近一加侖的水。

words.zh: a. 值得紀念的, 難忘的
words.example: Her recovery was a memorable day for the ward.
words.example_zh: 她的康復是病房裡值得紀念的一天。

words.zh: n. 水滴；v. (使)滴下
words.example: Water began to drip from the cracked pipe.
words.example_zh: 水開始從裂開的水管滴落。

words.zh: a. 令人震驚的, 極壞的, 不正當的
words.example: The cost of the surgery was shocking.
words.example_zh: 手術的費用高得驚人。

words.zh: vt. 舉起, 提拔, 鼓舞
words.example: Elevate your leg to bring down the swelling.
words.example_zh: 把腿抬高以消腫。

words.zh: vt. 放鬆, 鬆開, 解除；vi. 變鬆, 鬆弛
words.example: Loosen the bandage if your fingers go numb.
words.example_zh: 若手指發麻就把繃帶鬆開。

words.zh: n. 獎券, 彩票, 運氣；[經] 抽彩給獎法
words.example: Getting a donor organ can feel like a lottery.
words.example_zh: 等到捐贈器官有時像中樂透。

words.zh: n. 零工, 家務；[經] 零工
words.example: Taking his pills became a daily chore.
words.example_zh: 吃藥成了他每天的例行雜事。

words.zh: n. 邊緣, 端, 流蘇, 穗, 初步；vt. 加穗於, 加飾邊於；a. 邊緣的, 附加的
words.example: Such cures sit on the fringe of real medicine.
words.example_zh: 這類療法處於正規醫學的邊緣。

words.zh: a. 冗長的, 漫長的
words.example: Recovery was a lengthy but steady process.
words.example_zh: 康復是個漫長卻穩定的過程。

words.zh: n. 樹籬, 障礙, 套頭交易；vt. 用樹籬圍, 套期保值, 妨礙, 兩面下注以防...的損失；vi. 築樹籬, 躲閃, 兩面下注以防損失；a. 樹籬的, 偷偷摸摸的
words.example: A low hedge ran along the clinic path.
words.example_zh: 一道矮樹籬沿著診所的小徑延伸。

words.zh: n. 租約, 租期, 租；vt. 出租, 租出, 租得
words.example: The clinic signed a ten-year lease on the building.
words.example_zh: 診所為這棟建築簽了十年的租約。

words.zh: n. 低語, 低聲的怨言；vi. 低語, 低聲而言；vt. 低聲說
words.example: The doctor heard a faint murmur in his heart.
words.example_zh: 醫生聽到他的心臟有輕微的雜音。

words.zh: n. 珊瑚, 珊瑚色；[化] 珊瑚
words.example: Diving near the coral, he cut his foot.
words.example_zh: 在珊瑚附近潛水時，他割傷了腳。

words.zh: n. 器械, 用具, 應用；[醫] 矯正器; 器
words.example: A small breathing appliance helped her at night.
words.example_zh: 一個小型的呼吸輔助器在夜裡幫助她。

words.zh: n. 標準度量, 計量器；vt. 精確計量, 估計；[計] 線規
words.example: The nurse used a gauge to check his pressure.
words.example_zh: 護理師用一個量計測量他的血壓。

words.zh: n. 戶口普查；vt. 實施統計調查
words.example: The census showed an aging population in the town.
words.example_zh: 人口普查顯示這個鎮人口老化。

words.zh: n. 軍, 隊, 部隊, 兵種；[醫] 對, 團; 體, 物體
words.example: A medical corps was sent to the disaster zone.
words.example_zh: 一支醫療隊被派往災區。

words.zh: vt. 居住於, 佔據, 棲息
words.example: Bacteria inhabit even the cleanest skin.
words.example_zh: 即使最乾淨的皮膚上也住著細菌。

words.zh: n. 不公平, 非正義的行為；[法] 不公正, 不公平, 權利侵害
words.example: Poor access to care is a real injustice.
words.example_zh: 醫療資源不足是一種真正的不公。

words.zh: n. 配額, 限額；[化] 定額
words.example: The clinic met its quota of free checkups.
words.example_zh: 這間診所達成了免費健檢的配額。

words.zh: n. 摘錄；v. 引用, 摘錄
words.example: She read an excerpt from a medical journal.
words.example_zh: 她讀了一段醫學期刊的摘錄。

words.zh: n. 醬油, 大豆；[醫] 大豆; 醬油
words.example: He switched to soy milk after the allergy test.
words.example_zh: 過敏檢查後他改喝豆漿。

words.zh: n. 勘漏, 失察, 失敗, 照料；[經] 監督權
words.example: A simple oversight led to the wrong dose.
words.example_zh: 一個單純的疏忽導致了錯誤的劑量。

words.zh: a. 成熟的, 熟練的, 成年的；[醫] 成熟的
words.example: She waited for the fruit to grow ripe and sweet.
words.example_zh: 她等著水果長到成熟香甜。

words.zh: n. 搶奪, 攫取, 片斷；vt. 奪取, 攫取；vi. 想搶走, 攫取
words.example: He managed only to snatch a few hours of sleep.
words.example_zh: 他只勉強搶到了幾個小時的睡眠。

words.zh: n. 珠寶, 貴重物, 鑲珠寶的飾物；vt. 飾以珠寶, 鑲以寶石
words.example: Good health, she said, is life's truest jewel.
words.example_zh: 她說，健康是人生最珍貴的寶物。

words.zh: n. 一致, 調和, 協定；vt. 給與, 使一致；vi. 相符合
words.example: The two doctors were in full accord on the plan.
words.example_zh: 兩位醫生對這項計畫完全一致。

words.zh: n. 吶喊聲, 標語, 口號
words.example: The campaign slogan urged people to wash their hands.
words.example_zh: 這項活動的口號呼籲民眾洗手。

words.zh: a. 暴虐的, 極無禮的, 可惡的
words.example: The price of the drug was simply outrageous.
words.example_zh: 這種藥的價格實在離譜。

words.zh: n. 棲木, 高位, 杆, 河鱸；v. (使)棲息, 就位, 位於, (使)暫歇
words.example: A small bird came to perch on the windowsill.
words.example_zh: 一隻小鳥飛來停在窗臺上。

words.zh: n. 聖地, 神龕, 廟；vt. 將...置於神龕內
words.example: An old shrine stood near the village clinic.
words.example_zh: 村裡的診所附近有一座古老的神龕。

words.zh: conj. 儘管, 雖然
words.example: He recovered, albeit more slowly than hoped.
words.example_zh: 他康復了，儘管比預期的慢。

words.zh: n. 模子, 模型, 黴；v. 形成, 塑造, 發黴
words.example: Mold grew on the damp ward wall.
words.example_zh: 潮溼的病房牆上長了黴。

words.zh: n. 綽號, 暱稱；vt. 給...取綽號, 叫錯名字；[計] 綽號
words.example: The kind nurse earned the nickname 'Sunshine'.
words.example_zh: 這位親切的護理師得了個「陽光」的綽號。

words.zh: vt. 使沉溺, 使上癮；n. 入迷的人, 上癮者
words.example: He was once an addict but has been clean for years.
words.example_zh: 他曾是個癮君子，但已戒了多年。

words.zh: a. 邊緣的, 最低限度的, 有旁註的；[醫] 緣的
words.example: There was only a marginal change in his blood pressure.
words.example_zh: 他的血壓只有微小的變化。

words.zh: n. 斜坡, 坡道, 敲詐；vi. 狂跳亂撞, 亂衝, 敲詐, 蔓延；vt. 使有斜面, 敲詐
words.example: A wheelchair ramp led up to the clinic door.
words.example_zh: 一道輪椅坡道通向診所的門口。

words.zh: a. 鬆懈的, 不嚴密的, 不嚴格的, 放鬆的, 得到休息的, 隨意的, 不拘束的, 自在的
words.example: After the good news, she felt calm and relaxed.
words.example_zh: 聽到好消息後，她感到平靜放鬆。

words.zh: n. 冰雹, 致敬, 歡呼, 招呼；vt. 向...歡呼, 致敬, 招呼, 使象下雹樣落下；vi. 招呼, 下雹；interj. 萬歲, 歡迎
words.example: People hailed the vaccine as a breakthrough.
words.example_zh: 人們將這款疫苗譽為一大突破。

words.zh: n. 衣服, 衣裝, 外表
words.example: Each garment was washed at a high heat.
words.example_zh: 每件衣物都以高溫清洗。

words.zh: vt. 使活動, 使啟用, 正式建成；vi. 有活力
words.example: Warmth helps activate the healing cells.
words.example_zh: 溫暖有助於啟動修復細胞。

words.zh: a. 天真的, 純真的, 幼稚的
words.example: It is naive to think a cold needs antibiotics.
words.example_zh: 認為感冒需要抗生素是很天真的。

words.zh: a. 北極的, 極寒的；n. 北極圈, 北極
words.example: The arctic cold made his old wound ache.
words.example_zh: 極地般的寒冷讓他的舊傷隱隱作痛。

words.zh: n. 大圓石；[機] 圓石, 漂石
words.example: A fallen boulder blocked the road to the clinic.
words.example_zh: 一塊掉落的巨石擋住了通往診所的路。

words.zh: n. 穀類食品, 穀類植物；a. 穀類的
words.example: A bowl of cereal was all she could eat.
words.example_zh: 一碗麥片是她唯一吃得下的。

words.zh: n. 棉被；vt. 加軟襯料後縫製, 東拼西湊地編；vi. 縫被子
words.example: A warm quilt covered the sleeping child.
words.example_zh: 一條溫暖的棉被蓋著熟睡的孩子。

words.zh: a. 有感覺的, 敏感的, 明智的；[醫] 可感覺的
words.example: It is sensible to rest when you feel ill.
words.example_zh: 覺得不舒服時休息是明智的。

words.zh: n. 角錐, 金字塔；v. (使)成金字塔狀, (使)漸增, (使)上漲
words.example: The food pyramid puts vegetables near the base.
words.example_zh: 飲食金字塔把蔬菜放在底層附近。

words.zh: n. 單身漢, 學士；[法] 學士, 單身漢
words.example: She earned a bachelor of nursing last year.
words.example_zh: 她去年取得了護理學士學位。

words.zh: n. 大片土地, 地帶, 小冊子；[醫] 束, 道
words.example: The infection spread along the urinary tract.
words.example_zh: 感染沿著泌尿道擴散。

words.zh: a. 使人信服的, 有力的, 令人心悅誠服的
words.example: The trial gave convincing proof of the drug's value.
words.example_zh: 這項試驗給出了藥物價值的有力證明。

words.zh: n. 後裔, 子孫；a. 傳下的, 下降的
words.example: He is a descendant of a long line of doctors.
words.example_zh: 他是一個醫生世家的後代。

words.zh: n. 塊, 瘤, 很多, 腫塊, 笨人；vt. 使成塊狀, 混在一起；vi. 結塊
words.example: She found a small lump under her arm.
words.example_zh: 她在腋下發現一個小腫塊。

words.zh: n. 圍巾, 頭巾, 領帶, 領巾, 嵌接；vt. 用圍巾圍, 嵌接
words.example: She wrapped a warm scarf around her neck.
words.example_zh: 她在脖子上圍了一條溫暖的圍巾。

words.zh: n. 衝突, 撞擊聲, 牴觸；vi. 衝突, 牴觸；vt. 使發出撞擊聲；[計] 對撞
words.example: There was a clash between the two test results.
words.example_zh: 兩份檢驗結果之間出現了矛盾。

words.zh: n. 哺乳動物；[化] 哺乳動物
words.example: The whale is the largest mammal on earth.
words.example_zh: 鯨魚是地球上最大的哺乳動物。

words.zh: v. 繁殖, 乘, 增加；[計] 乘
words.example: Bacteria multiply fast in a warm wound.
words.example_zh: 細菌在溫暖的傷口中迅速繁殖。

words.zh: n. 南瓜
words.example: Pumpkin is rich in vitamins and easy to digest.
words.example_zh: 南瓜富含維生素又好消化。

words.zh: n. 結構, 表面配置, 外形, 配置；[計] 配置
words.example: The new ward has a more open configuration.
words.example_zh: 新病房的格局較為開放。

words.zh: a. 聲名狼藉的, 臭名昭著的, 眾人皆知的
words.example: The disease is notorious for its long recovery.
words.example_zh: 這種病以漫長的康復期而惡名昭彰。

words.zh: n. 混合物, 堆肥；vt. 施堆肥於
words.example: The garden waste was turned into compost.
words.example_zh: 花園的廢料被製成了堆肥。

words.zh: n. 國書, 憑據, 證明書；[經] 憑證, 證書
words.example: Her credentials as a surgeon were impressive.
words.example_zh: 她身為外科醫生的資歷令人印象深刻。

words.zh: n. 漩渦, 渦動；vt. 使成漩渦；vi. 打漩, 盤繞, 眩暈
words.example: She watched the medicine swirl in the water.
words.example_zh: 她看著藥在水中打轉。

words.zh: adv. 平滑地, 流暢地, 流利地
words.example: The operation went smoothly from start to finish.
words.example_zh: 手術從頭到尾都很順利。

words.zh: n. 火腿, 後腿, 笨拙演員；a. 過火的, 做作的；v. 演得過火
words.example: He could finally enjoy a slice of ham.
words.example_zh: 他終於能享用一片火腿了。

words.zh: n. 家畜；[經] 牲畜, 家畜
words.example: The farmer's livestock kept him fit and busy.
words.example_zh: 這位農夫的牲畜讓他既忙碌又健康。

words.zh: n. 盆, 盆地；[醫] 第三腦室, 骨盆
words.example: The nurse filled a basin with warm water.
words.example_zh: 護理師在臉盆裡裝滿溫水。

words.zh: v. 漫遊, 閒逛, 徜徉；n. 漫步, 漫遊
words.example: After weeks in bed, she was glad to roam the garden.
words.example_zh: 臥床數週後，她樂於在花園裡漫步。

words.zh: n. 繼承人, 嗣子, 後嗣；[法] 繼承人, 後嗣
words.example: He was the sole heir to the family clinic.
words.example_zh: 他是這家家族診所的唯一繼承人。

words.zh: n. 泡沫, 水沫, 泡沫材料；vi. 起泡沫, 吐白沫；vt. 使起泡沫
words.example: White foam formed at the corner of his mouth.
words.example_zh: 他的嘴角冒出了白沫。

words.zh: n. 抵消, 把...並列, 旁系, 支管, 用膠印法印；vt. 彌補, 抵消, 膠印；vi. 裝支管；n. 偏移量；[計] 偏移量
words.example: Rest can offset the strain of a busy week.
words.example_zh: 休息能抵消一週忙碌的勞累。

words.zh: n. 聯絡, 從屬關係；[醫] 父權(判定私生兒的父親)
words.example: The clinic has an affiliation with the city hospital.
words.example_zh: 這間診所與市立醫院有合作關係。

words.zh: n. 小行星, 海盤車；a. 星狀的
words.example: The museum showed a fragment of an asteroid.
words.example_zh: 博物館展出了一塊小行星的碎片。

words.zh: a. 被拋棄的, 無約束的, 恣意放蕩的
words.example: The abandoned clinic stood empty for years.
words.example_zh: 那間廢棄的診所空置了多年。

words.zh: a. 禿頭的, 光禿的, 單調的, 赤裸的；vi. 變禿
words.example: The drug left him temporarily bald.
words.example_zh: 這種藥讓他暫時掉光了頭髮。

words.zh: n. 預期, 預料；[醫] 提前出現(如遺傳病)
words.example: In anticipation of flu season, they stocked up on vaccines.
words.example_zh: 為了因應流感季，他們囤積了疫苗。

words.zh: a. 令人沮喪的
words.example: It was frustrating to heal so slowly.
words.example_zh: 癒合得這麼慢令人沮喪。

words.zh: a. 光榮的；極好的、令人愉悅的
words.example: It was a glorious feeling to walk again.
words.example_zh: 能再次走路是種美妙的感受。

words.zh: a. 脆的, 新鮮的, 活潑的；v. (使)烘脆, (使)拳曲, (使)起皺；n. 鬆脆物
words.example: She nibbled a crisp cracker between doses.
words.example_zh: 她在兩劑藥之間啃了一塊脆餅乾。

words.zh: n. 沉思, 冥想
words.example: Daily meditation helped ease her anxiety.
words.example_zh: 每日的冥想幫助緩解了她的焦慮。

words.zh: a. 緊湊的, 緊密的, 簡潔的；vt. 使緊密結合, 壓縮；vi. 變堅實
words.example: The clinic packed everything into a compact space.
words.example_zh: 這間診所把一切塞進了一個緊湊的空間。

words.zh: n. 抄本, 副本, 成績單；[法] 法院文本, 官方記錄, 記錄的副本
words.example: She asked for a transcript of the doctor's notes.
words.example_zh: 她要了一份醫生筆記的抄本。

words.zh: n. 立場, 觀點
words.example: From a safety standpoint, the drug is sound.
words.example_zh: 從安全的角度來看，這種藥是可靠的。

words.zh: vi. 繁榮, 茂盛, 活躍, 手舞足蹈；vt. 揮舞, 誇耀；n. 揮舞, 炫耀, 茂盛, 興旺, 華麗詞藻
words.example: The garden began to flourish in the spring sun.
words.example_zh: 花園在春日的陽光下開始繁茂起來。

words.zh: n. 用力拉, 拖曳, 苦幹, 掙扎, 繩索；v. 用力拉
words.example: He felt a gentle tug as the stitch came out.
words.example_zh: 拆線時他感到輕輕一扯。

words.zh: n. 龍蝦
words.example: He broke out in a rash after eating lobster.
words.example_zh: 他吃了龍蝦後起了疹子。

words.zh: n. 團結, 團結一致, 共同一致；[法] 團結, 共同責任
words.example: The nurses showed great solidarity during the crisis.
words.example_zh: 護理師們在危機中展現了高度的團結。

words.zh: n. 鞍, 馬鞍, 車座, 鞍狀物；vt. 裝以馬鞍, 使負擔；vi. 跨上馬鞍
words.example: A bad fall from the saddle broke his collarbone.
words.example_zh: 從馬鞍上重重摔下，他摔斷了鎖骨。

words.zh: a. 永久的, 永恆的, 持久的；n. 厚實斜紋織物
words.example: The therapy brought lasting relief from the pain.
words.example_zh: 這項治療帶來了持久的疼痛緩解。

words.zh: n. 黨羽, 虔誠信徒, 同黨, 游擊隊員；a. 黨派的, 偏袒的, 效忠的, 獻身的, 盲目推崇的
words.example: Health should not be a partisan issue.
words.example_zh: 健康不該是個黨派議題。

words.zh: a. 豐富的, 充分的, 大量的
words.example: The region has an abundant supply of clean water.
words.example_zh: 這個地區有充足的乾淨水源。

words.zh: n. 錘, 鐵錘, 釘錘；vt. 錘打, 敲打, 釘；vi. 連續錘打；[計] 錘頭
words.example: Pain pounded in his head like a hammer.
words.example_zh: 疼痛像鐵錘般敲打著他的頭。

words.zh: n. 排除, 除外, 逐出；[醫] 排除, 除外, 分離術
words.example: The exclusion of salt helped lower her pressure.
words.example_zh: 戒除鹽分有助於降低她的血壓。

words.zh: n. 埋葬, 葬禮；[法] 埋葬, 葬禮
words.example: The family held a quiet burial for the old doctor.
words.example_zh: 這家人為這位老醫生舉行了簡單的葬禮。

words.zh: n. 平衡, 均衡, 姿勢, 鎮靜, 安靜, 砝碼；vt. 使平衡, 使懸著, 保持...姿勢；vi. 平衡, 懸著, 準備好
words.example: The surgeon kept her poise under great pressure.
words.example_zh: 外科醫生在巨大的壓力下保持鎮定。

words.zh: a. 丈夫的, 婚姻的, 夫婦間的；[醫] 婚姻的
words.example: Illness can strain even a strong marital bond.
words.example_zh: 疾病可能讓再穩固的婚姻關係也緊繃。

words.zh: a. 邪惡的, 墮落的, 品性不端的, 惡毒的, 惡性的, 有錯誤的；[醫] 缺點的, 惡的
words.example: A vicious infection spread through the ward.
words.example_zh: 一場凶猛的感染在病房中蔓延。

words.zh: a. 自制的, 國產的
words.example: She brought him some homemade chicken soup.
words.example_zh: 她為他帶來了一些自製的雞湯。

words.zh: a. 沙的, 沙地的, 多沙的
words.example: He twisted his ankle on the soft, sandy path.
words.example_zh: 他在鬆軟的沙地小徑上扭傷了腳踝。

words.zh: a. 緊張的, 拉緊的；v. (使)緊張, (使)拉緊；n. 時態
words.example: Her muscles were tense before the operation.
words.example_zh: 手術前她的肌肉緊繃。

words.zh: n. 擾亂, 不安, 憂慮；[化] 擾動; 干擾; 失調
words.example: A disturbance in the hall woke the patients.
words.example_zh: 走廊裡的一陣騷動吵醒了病人。

words.zh: a. 比較的, 相對的；n. 對手
words.example: The two drugs were tried in a comparative study.
words.example_zh: 這兩種藥在一項比較研究中受測。

words.zh: a. 藥學的, 製藥的, 藥用的, 藥物的, 藥劑師的, 藥師的；n. 藥品, 成藥, 藥劑
words.example: The pharmaceutical company recalled the drug.
words.example_zh: 這家製藥公司回收了這種藥。

words.zh: n. 原型；[計] 樣機; 原型
words.example: The team tested a prototype of the new monitor.
words.example_zh: 團隊測試了新型監測儀的原型。

words.zh: n. 植物；[醫] 贄生物, 贄疣, 增殖體; 生長, 增殖
words.example: Thick vegetation surrounded the rural clinic.
words.example_zh: 茂密的植被環繞著這間鄉村診所。

words.zh: vt. 發出, 放射, 發表(意見等), 散發, 發行；[化] 放射
words.example: The machine emits a soft beep with each heartbeat.
words.example_zh: 這台機器隨著每次心跳發出輕柔的嗶聲。

words.zh: n. 輕視, 輕蔑；[法] 藐視, 侮辱, 輕視
words.example: He treated the fake cure with open contempt.
words.example_zh: 他對這種假療法毫不掩飾地嗤之以鼻。

words.zh: a. 季節的, 依照季節的, 週期性的；[經] 季節性的, 季節的
words.example: Hay fever is a common seasonal complaint.
words.example_zh: 花粉熱是常見的季節性病症。

words.zh: n. 功效, 效力；[醫] 效能, 功效, 效驗
words.example: Trials confirmed the efficacy of the vaccine.
words.example_zh: 試驗證實了這款疫苗的功效。

words.zh: a. 大量的, 充足的, 豐富的
words.example: There was ample time to prepare for the surgery.
words.example_zh: 有充裕的時間為手術做準備。

words.zh: n. 缺點, 不利, 壞處
words.example: Poor sleep puts the body at a disadvantage.
words.example_zh: 睡眠不足讓身體處於劣勢。

words.zh: n. 斑紋, 條紋；[醫] 紋, 條紋
words.example: A red stripe marked the edge of the rash.
words.example_zh: 一道紅紋標出了疹子的邊緣。

words.zh: a. 最初的, 最重要的；adv. 在最前
words.example: Patient safety is foremost in her mind.
words.example_zh: 病人安全在她心中是第一位的。

words.zh: v. 大叫, 呼喊, 大聲叫
words.example: She exclaimed with joy at the good news.
words.example_zh: 聽到好消息，她欣喜地驚呼。

words.zh: n. 牙科醫生；[醫] 牙醫師
words.example: The dentist gently checked her aching tooth.
words.example_zh: 牙醫輕輕地檢查了她疼痛的牙齒。

words.zh: n. 橫越, 橫渡, 交叉點, 渡口；[經] 劃線
words.example: He was hit by a car at the crossing.
words.example_zh: 他在路口被一輛車撞了。

words.zh: n. 獸穴, 洞穴；[法] 匪巢, 賊窩
words.example: The fox lay sick in its earthy den.
words.example_zh: 那隻狐狸生病了，躺在牠的土穴裡。

words.zh: n. 牡蠣, 蠔, 沉默者
words.example: A bad oyster left him with food poisoning.
words.example_zh: 一顆壞掉的牡蠣讓他食物中毒。

words.zh: n. 外地人, 粗野的人；a. 省的, 外地的, 偏狹的
words.example: She trained at a small provincial hospital.
words.example_zh: 她在一家小型的地方醫院受訓。

words.zh: n. 調節, 條件作用, 整修；[計] 調節; 調整
words.example: Gentle conditioning rebuilt his weak muscles.
words.example_zh: 溫和的鍛鍊重建了他虛弱的肌肉。

words.zh: a. 學者派頭的, 學者風度的, 有學問的, 博學的, 好學的
words.example: She wrote a scholarly paper on the disease.
words.example_zh: 她寫了一篇關於這種病的學術論文。

words.zh: v. 誇大, 誇張
words.example: Don't exaggerate your symptoms to the doctor.
words.example_zh: 別向醫生誇大你的症狀。

words.zh: n. 油酥點心, 麵粉糕餅
words.example: She baked light pastry for the ward staff.
words.example_zh: 她為病房的工作人員烤了鬆軟的糕點。

words.zh: n. 火山
words.example: Ash from the volcano harmed people's lungs.
words.example_zh: 火山的灰燼危害了人們的肺。

words.zh: a. 嫉妒的, 羨慕的, 留心的, 戒備的
words.example: He grew jealous of his healthier friends.
words.example_zh: 他漸漸羨慕起那些較健康的朋友。

words.zh: a. 分子的, 由分子組成的；[醫] 分子的
words.example: The drug works at the molecular level.
words.example_zh: 這種藥在分子層面發揮作用。

words.zh: n. 拱門, 拱形, 足弓；vt. 使成弓形；vi. 拱起, 成弓形；a. 主要的, 調皮的, 傲慢無禮的, 狡猾的
words.example: The arch of her foot ached after standing all day.
words.example_zh: 站了一整天後，她的足弓痠痛。

words.zh: n. 牧場, 草地, 牧草；vt. 放牧；vi. 吃草
words.example: The cattle grazed in the green pasture.
words.example_zh: 牛群在綠色的牧場上吃草。

words.zh: n. 謀反, 叛亂, 反抗；[法] 造反, 反叛, 叛亂
words.example: His body's rebellion against the organ worried doctors.
words.example_zh: 他身體對這個器官的反抗讓醫生擔憂。

words.zh: n. 咯咯的笑聲, 輕笑；vi. 咯咯的笑, 咕咕叫
words.example: The old man gave a soft chuckle at the joke.
words.example_zh: 老先生聽了笑話輕聲笑了笑。

words.zh: n. 沼澤, 進退兩難的困境；vt. 淹沒, 擊潰, 清除, 使陷於沼澤；vi. 陷於沼澤, 淹沒
words.example: Mosquitoes bred in the nearby swamp.
words.example_zh: 蚊子在附近的沼澤中繁殖。

words.zh: a. 標準化的；標準的；定型的
words.example: The clinic uses a standardized safety checklist.
words.example_zh: 這間診所使用一份標準化的安全檢查表。

words.zh: a. 深思熟慮的, 故意的, 從容的；v. 仔細考慮
words.example: She made a deliberate choice to change her diet.
words.example_zh: 她有意識地選擇改變飲食。

words.zh: a. 虛構的, 編造的, 小說式的；[法] 擬製的, 假定的, 虛構的
words.example: The story was fictional, but the illness was real.
words.example_zh: 這個故事是虛構的，但病痛是真實的。
